source_text: 大家好，请麻烦尽快就座。我们待会儿马上就要开始了。
zh: 大家好，请麻烦尽快就座。我们待会儿马上就要开始了。
en: Hello, everyone. Please take your seats. We’ll be starting shortly.

source_text: Hello everybody, please take a seat. We're about to get started.
zh: 大家好，请就座。我们马上开始。
en: Hello everybody, please take a seat. We're about to get started.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好的。
en: All right.

source_text: We're about to start right now.
zh: 我们马上就开始。
en: We're about to start right now.

source_text: 大家早上好，我是孟颖，是这次AI Engineer大会的
zh: 大家早上好，我是孟颖，是这次AI Engineer大会的
en: Good morning, everyone. I’m Meng Ying, and I’m the host of this AI Engineer Conference.

source_text: 主理人。
zh: 主理人。
en: The person in charge.

source_text: Hello everybody, my name is Meng Ying.
zh: 大家好，我叫孟颖。
en: Hello everybody, my name is Meng Ying.

source_text: I'm the host of AI Engineer Shanghai.
zh: 我是 AI Engineer Shanghai 的主持人。
en: I'm the host of AI Engineer Shanghai.

source_text: 今天呢，我们都知道，就是AI Engineer是第一次来到上海，来到中国，然后呢，我们也非常的荣幸可以有机会跟大家在这里一起度过未来美好的两天。
zh: 今天呢，我们都知道，就是AI Engineer是第一次来到上海，来到中国，然后呢，我们也非常的荣幸可以有机会跟大家在这里一起度过未来美好的两天。
en: As you know, this is the first time the AI Engineer Conference has come to Shanghai—and to China. We’re honored to spend the next two days here with you.

source_text: As we all know, this is the first time that AI Engineer has ever come to China, to Shanghai.
zh: 众所周知，这是 AI Engineer 首次来到中国，来到上海。
en: As we all know, this is the first time that AI Engineer has ever come to China, to Shanghai.

source_text: We are very honored to have the opportunity to spend the next two days with all of you.
zh: 我们非常荣幸能在接下来的两天与大家共度时光。
en: We are very honored to have the opportunity to spend the next two days with all of you.

source_text: 首先呢，我先，我想要感谢我们的赞助厂商们。
zh: 首先呢，我先，我想要感谢我们的赞助厂商们。
en: First, I’d like to thank our sponsors.

source_text: 没有他们就没有这次的大会。
zh: 没有他们就没有这次的大会。
en: This conference wouldn’t be possible without them.

source_text: 如果大家一会儿有空的话，欢迎大家去展台区去跟他们进行一些交流，尝试下他们的产品，看看有一些有没有一些可以合作和交流的机会。
zh: 如果大家一会儿有空的话，欢迎大家去展台区去跟他们进行一些交流，尝试下他们的产品，看看有一些有没有一些可以合作和交流的机会。
en: If you have some time later, please visit the sponsors’ booths, chat with them, and try out their products. You might find opportunities to connect or collaborate.

source_text: First of all, I would love to thank all the sponsors who have made this event possible.
zh: 首先，我要衷心感谢所有赞助商，是你们的支持让这次活动得以举办。
en: First of all, I would love to thank all the sponsors who have made this event possible.

source_text: If I have some time later today, please feel free to stop by the Expo Hall.
zh: 如果今天晚些时候有空，欢迎大家到展厅逛逛。
en: If I have some time later today, please feel free to stop by the Expo Hall.

source_text: Try their product and have a conversation with their team to see whether there's any opportunities for collaborations.
zh: 大家可以体验一下他们的产品，和团队聊聊，看看有没有合作机会。
en: Try their product and have a conversation with their team to see whether there's any opportunities for collaborations.

source_text: 我还要感谢我们这次的演讲嘉宾们，他们从全世界各地飞来，到中国跟大家分享他们这几年在AI界的一些深度的观察和探索。
zh: 我还要感谢我们这次的演讲嘉宾们，他们从全世界各地飞来，到中国跟大家分享他们这几年在AI界的一些深度的观察和探索。
en: I’d also like to thank our speakers, who have flown in from around the world to share their insights and discoveries from years of working in AI.

source_text: I would also love to thank all the speakers who fly all the way to China from the globe to share their learnings and observations, in the AI industry from the past few years.
zh: 我还要感谢各位从世界各地远道而来的演讲嘉宾，感谢你们分享过去几年在 AI 行业的经验与观察。
en: I would also love to thank all the speakers who fly all the way to China from the globe to share their learnings and observations, in the AI industry from the past few years.

source_text: 最后呢，请代表我们的组委会，我也希望大家在未来的两天里面可以结交到一些好的朋友，然后学习到一些有趣的知识。
zh: 最后呢，请代表我们的组委会，我也希望大家在未来的两天里面可以结交到一些好的朋友，然后学习到一些有趣的知识。
en: Finally, on behalf of the organizing committee, I hope you’ll make some new friends and learn something interesting over the next two days.

source_text: 有一段难忘的回忆
zh: 有一段难忘的回忆
en: And make some unforgettable memories.

source_text: So, lastly, I would love to represent our organizing team to wish everybody to have two fruitful days in the next two days.
zh: 最后，我谨代表主办团队，祝大家在接下来的两天里收获满满。
en: So, lastly, I would love to represent our organizing team to wish everybody to have two fruitful days in the next two days.

source_text: By making great friends, having some great conversations, and having some fun learnings all together.
zh: 希望大家结识志同道合的朋友，畅聊交流，一起在轻松愉快的氛围中收获新知。
en: By making great friends, having some great conversations, and having some fun learnings all together.

source_text: 下面呢，我们将欢迎AI Engineer的 co-founder Switch Sean给我们进行开场。
zh: 下面呢，我们将欢迎AI Engineer的 co-founder Switch Sean给我们进行开场。
en: Now, please welcome AI Engineer co-founder Swyx to give the opening remarks.

source_text: 但是很遗憾的是，他这次没有办法来到现场，因为下周他们在San Francisco会有一个比较大的大会。他一会儿会以视频的形式来跟大家 say hi。
zh: 但是很遗憾的是，他这次没有办法来到现场，因为下周他们在San Francisco会有一个比较大的大会。他一会儿会以视频的形式来跟大家 say hi。
en: Unfortunately, he couldn’t be here in person because they have a major conference in San Francisco next week. But he’ll say hi to everyone shortly by video.

source_text: So next, we are going to welcome Swix, the co-founder of AI Engineer.
zh: 接下来，让我们欢迎 AI Engineer 的联合创始人 Swix。
en: So next, we are going to welcome Swix, the co-founder of AI Engineer.

source_text: To say hi to everybody, let's give him a round of applause.
zh: 让我们用热烈的掌声欢迎他上台，跟大家打个招呼！
en: To say hi to everybody, let's give him a round of applause.

source_text: Is it rolling?
zh: 开始录了吗？
en: Is it rolling?

source_text: Give me a thumbs up with it.
zh: 好了就给我比个大拇指。
en: Give me a thumbs up with it.

source_text: So I'll just, I'll just start talking now.
zh: 那我现在就开始讲了。
en: So I'll just, I'll just start talking now.

source_text: Okay, I guess, I guess I'm going to start
zh: 好吧，那我就开始吧。
en: Okay, I guess, I guess I'm going to start

source_text: 哎，大家好，我是岳贤。
zh: 哎，大家好，我是岳贤。
en: Hi, everyone. I’m Yue Xian.

source_text: 欢迎你们来到AI Shanghai。
zh: 欢迎你们来到AI Shanghai。
en: Welcome to AI Shanghai.

source_text: That's the extent of Chinese that I can speak.
zh: 我的中文水平也就到这儿了。
en: That's the extent of Chinese that I can speak.

source_text: It's been 20 years since I left Singapore, which is where I'm from. But, you know, always a highway.
zh: 我来自新加坡，离开那里已经二十年了。不过你们懂的，我一直心系家乡。
en: It's been 20 years since I left Singapore, which is where I'm from. But, you know, always a highway.

source_text: And it's so exciting to have the first Chinese AIE,
zh: 能举办首届中文 AI Engineer 大会，真是太令人兴奋了。
en: And it's so exciting to have the first Chinese AIE,

source_text: we've been really trying to build this community of technical engineers, people who are building real things with AI, not getting caught up in the hype or safety fears or anything,
zh: 我们一直在努力建立一个技术工程师社区，聚集真正用 AI 做出实际成果的人，而不是被炒作、安全焦虑之类的话题牵着走。
en: we've been really trying to build this community of technical engineers, people who are building real things with AI, not getting caught up in the hype or safety fears or anything,

source_text: just trying to really build things that people use, build infrastructure that is reliable, build the future.
zh: 我们只想踏踏实实地做出人们真正会用的东西，建设可靠的基础设施，创造未来。
en: just trying to really build things that people use, build infrastructure that is reliable, build the future.

source_text: And that's why it's focused on engineers, right?
zh: 所以我们才会聚焦工程师，对吧？
en: And that's why it's focused on engineers, right?

source_text: I think a lot of these kinds of AI conferences usually feature politicians, they feature heads of state or heads of companies that just talk about,
zh: 我觉得很多这类 AI 大会，通常请来的是政界人士、国家领导人或企业高管，他们往往只是谈论……
en: I think a lot of these kinds of AI conferences usually feature politicians, they feature heads of state or heads of companies that just talk about,

source_text: you know, what AI take my job and all those things that are very memorable.
zh: 比如“AI 会不会抢走我的饭碗”之类的话题，听起来确实很吸引眼球。
en: you know, what AI take my job and all those things that are very memorable.

source_text: So, really, you know, it is, AI is built by the community.
zh: 说到底，AI 是靠整个社区共同建设起来的。
en: So, really, you know, it is, AI is built by the community.

source_text: We've,
zh: 我们已经……
en: We've,

source_text: this is, this is the sixth AIE partner that we've had around the world.
zh: 这是我们在全球举办的第六场 AI Engineer 合作活动。
en: this is, this is the sixth AIE partner that we've had around the world.

source_text: We have had Singapore, Miami, Sydney, Paris,
zh: 我们已经在新加坡、迈阿密、悉尼和巴黎举办过活动。
en: We have had Singapore, Miami, Sydney, Paris,

source_text: and Melbourne, and we're going to have India and Africa next year as well.
zh: 还有墨尔本。明年我们也会去印度和非洲举办活动。
en: and Melbourne, and we're going to have India and Africa next year as well.

source_text: But entering China is such a, such an important step for us because we want to promote this kind of discussion.
zh: 但来到中国对我们来说是非常重要的一步，因为我们希望在这里推动这样的讨论。
en: But entering China is such a, such an important step for us because we want to promote this kind of discussion.

source_text: And I hope you guys are here because you want to do that too.
zh: 我也希望大家来到这里，是因为你们同样想参与这样的讨论。
en: And I hope you guys are here because you want to do that too.

source_text: I find that really when people, you know, come to an AIE, they have a different kind of conversation.
zh: 我发现，大家来到 AI Engineer 的活动时，往往会展开一种不一样的讨论。
en: I find that really when people, you know, come to an AIE, they have a different kind of conversation.

source_text: Even the speakers are so excited because they get to have a relationship with attendees that they never have in any other conference.
zh: 连演讲嘉宾都特别兴奋，因为他们能和参会者建立起在其他任何会议上都难以建立的联系。
en: Even the speakers are so excited because they get to have a relationship with attendees that they never have in any other conference.

source_text: So I hope you have that as well. I'm really jealous.
zh: 所以我也希望大家能有这样的体验。说实话，我都羡慕你们了。
en: So I hope you have that as well. I'm really jealous.

source_text: I wish I could come.
zh: 真希望我也能来。
en: I wish I could come.

source_text: We are deep in the process of AIE code.
zh: 我们正全力筹备 AIE Code。
en: We are deep in the process of AIE code.

source_text: You can see all the boxes here.
zh: 大家可以看到这里的所有方框。
en: You can see all the boxes here.

source_text: Where we're getting and assembling all of that.
zh: 我们正在这里把所有东西收集起来，组装到一起。
en: Where we're getting and assembling all of that.

source_text: And so, hopefully next year I'll be able to join you guys.
zh: 希望明年我能和大家相聚。
en: And so, hopefully next year I'll be able to join you guys.

source_text: But, you know, everyone wants to see you guys succeed as well, right?
zh: 不过，大家也都希望你们取得成功，对吧？
en: But, you know, everyone wants to see you guys succeed as well, right?

source_text: Like,
zh: 比如说，
en: Like,

source_text: there's a lot of, like, interest in the model side and the infrastructure side, but even on the apps,
zh: 大家对模型和基础设施都很感兴趣，但即使在应用层面，也同样如此。
en: there's a lot of, like, interest in the model side and the infrastructure side, but even on the apps,

source_text: that you guys are representing.
zh: 也就是你们所代表的领域。
en: that you guys are representing.

source_text: You know, I see a lot of cool and incredible names that we've worked with as well.
zh: 我还看到了很多很棒、令人印象深刻的名字，其中不少我们也合作过。
en: You know, I see a lot of cool and incredible names that we've worked with as well.

source_text: Exa, Optiver, You.com, Langviews, Daytona, Manus.
zh: Exa、Optiver、You.com、Langviews、Daytona、Manus。
en: Exa, Optiver, You.com, Langviews, Daytona, Manus.

source_text: And, you know, and also all the labs, right?
zh: 当然，还有各大实验室，对吧？
en: And, you know, and also all the labs, right?

source_text: Like, which we really care a lot about, like Stepfun,
zh: 还有我们非常重视的实验室，比如阶跃星辰。
en: Like, which we really care a lot about, like Stepfun,

source_text: and Microsoft, and World Labs, and HeyGen.
zh: 还有微软、World Labs 和 HeyGen。
en: and Microsoft, and World Labs, and HeyGen.

source_text: Bin, if you're there, Bin is actually flying back to help us with AIE code as well.
zh: Bin，如果你在线的话——Bin 其实也正飞回来，帮我们处理 AIE 的代码。
en: Bin, if you're there, Bin is actually flying back to help us with AIE code as well.

source_text: So I don't know how he's doing so much travel, but he's doing great.
zh: 所以我也不知道他怎么能跑这么多地方，但他状态很不错。
en: So I don't know how he's doing so much travel, but he's doing great.

source_text: Rio as well has spoken with us at Singapore.
zh: Rio 也在新加坡和我们聊过。
en: Rio as well has spoken with us at Singapore.

source_text: So,
zh: 所以，
en: So,

source_text: so many friends there. I'm so jealous.
zh: 那边有这么多朋友，真羡慕。
en: so many friends there. I'm so jealous.

source_text: I wish I could come, but I also have to try to focus on myself.
zh: 我也想去，但我也得尽量把精力放在自己身上。
en: I wish I could come, but I also have to try to focus on myself.

source_text: But I wish you all the best.
zh: 不过，祝你们一切顺利。
en: But I wish you all the best.

source_text: Have a great level of conversation.
zh: 希望大家交流愉快，聊得深入。
en: Have a great level of conversation.

source_text: One thing that you can do for us is to tweet and share all the videos and photos.
zh: 你们可以帮我们做的一件事，就是发推文，分享所有的视频和照片。
en: One thing that you can do for us is to tweet and share all the videos and photos.

source_text: We cannot live stream this conference.
zh: 这次会议无法进行直播。
en: We cannot live stream this conference.

source_text: It's the first AIE that hasn't been live streamed ever.
zh: 这是有史以来第一次没有直播的 AIE。
en: It's the first AIE that hasn't been live streamed ever.

source_text: But we can actually live through you guys by your notes and your photos, your videos, whatever you want to share.
zh: 但我们可以通过你们的笔记、照片、视频，以及你们愿意分享的任何内容，身临其境地感受这场会议。
en: But we can actually live through you guys by your notes and your photos, your videos, whatever you want to share.

source_text: I'm really looking forward to doing that.
zh: 我真的很期待这么做。
en: I'm really looking forward to doing that.

source_text: And I'm going to be sitting here just retweeting and reading and cataloging everything. I'm so excited. Thank you so much.
zh: 我会坐在这里，不停地转发、阅读，再把大家分享的内容一一整理好。我太期待了！非常感谢大家。
en: And I'm going to be sitting here just retweeting and reading and cataloging everything. I'm so excited. Thank you so much.

source_text: All right, Joe, thanks.
zh: 好的，谢谢你，乔。
en: All right, Joe, thanks.

source_text: Swix for joining this online meet
zh: 感谢 Swix 参加这次线上聚会。
en: Swix for joining this online meet

source_text: ing and 谢谢Swix，然后在旧金山当堂给我们做了一个
zh: ing and 谢谢Swix，然后在旧金山当堂给我们做了一个
en: And thank you to Swyx for making this for us in San Francisco.

source_text: 连线。
zh: 连线。
en: Let’s connect.

source_text: 然后 Next, I would like to welcome Marco from Microsoft to give a keynote.
zh: 接下来，有请来自微软的 Marco 为我们带来主题演讲。
en: 然后 Next, I would like to welcome Marco from Microsoft to give a keynote.

source_text: 下一位我们就邀请这个这一次的这个keynote的第一位嘉宾Marco。他是来自微软的团队，给我们做一个主题的演讲。大家欢迎。
zh: 下一位我们就邀请这个这一次的这个keynote的第一位嘉宾Marco。他是来自微软的团队，给我们做一个主题的演讲。大家欢迎。
en: Next, please welcome our first keynote speaker, Marco from Microsoft. Let’s give him a warm welcome.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好的。
en: All right.

source_text: Hello everybody.
zh: 大家好。
en: Hello everybody.

source_text: I'm Marco Casalena. Give me just a moment to plug my laptop in here.
zh: 我是 Marco Casalena。请稍等一下，我把笔记本电脑接上电源。
en: I'm Marco Casalena. Give me just a moment to plug my laptop in here.

source_text: Because we are doing this live as live as I can.
zh: 毕竟这是直播，能有多现场就有多现场。
en: Because we are doing this live as live as I can.

source_text: Do this. And so hopefully that comes up on the screen any second now.
zh: 弄一下这个。希望画面马上就能显示在屏幕上。
en: Do this. And so hopefully that comes up on the screen any second now.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: Something's happening.
zh: 有动静了。
en: Something's happening.

source_text: Well, in any case, while I'm waiting for this to come up on the screen, I will say,
zh: 不管怎样，趁着等画面显示出来，我先说几句。
en: Well, in any case, while I'm waiting for this to come up on the screen, I will say,

source_text: that I'm Marco Casalena.
zh: 我叫马尔科·卡萨莱纳。
en: that I'm Marco Casalena.

source_text: I am VP Products of the Core AI Group at Microsoft.
zh: 我是微软核心人工智能团队的产品副总裁。
en: I am VP Products of the Core AI Group at Microsoft.

source_text: And I have a Silicon Valley title.
zh: 我还有个硅谷风格的头衔。
en: And I have a Silicon Valley title.

source_text: I am here not from Seattle, where Microsoft is based, but from the San Francisco Bay Area.
zh: 我不是从微软总部所在地西雅图来的，而是从旧金山湾区来的。
en: I am here not from Seattle, where Microsoft is based, but from the San Francisco Bay Area.

source_text: And my Silicon Valley title is AI Futurist.
zh: 我那个硅谷风格的头衔叫“人工智能未来学家”。
en: And my Silicon Valley title is AI Futurist.

source_text: And so we are going to be talking about the future of AI.
zh: 所以，接下来我们要谈谈人工智能的未来。
en: And so we are going to be talking about the future of AI.

source_text: Really, the near future of AI.
zh: 确切地说，是人工智能的近期发展。
en: Really, the near future of AI.

source_text: So what is going to happen in the next, let's say, 6 to 12 months?
zh: 那么，未来六到十二个月会发生什么呢？
en: So what is going to happen in the next, let's say, 6 to 12 months?

source_text: And my story starts right.
zh: 我的故事就从这里开始。
en: And my story starts right.

source_text: Here.
zh: 这里。
en: Here.

source_text: Actually, we'll do the live one.
zh: 其实，我们来做个现场演示。
en: Actually, we'll do the live one.

source_text: I took pictures just in case the internet went down.
zh: 我拍了照片，以防网络断线。
en: I took pictures just in case the internet went down.

source_text: But we will try to do this live if we can. All right.
zh: 不过，如果条件允许，我们还是尽量现场演示。好。
en: But we will try to do this live if we can. All right.

source_text: So here we have, what do we have on the screen here?
zh: 那么，大家看看，屏幕上显示的是什么？
en: So here we have, what do we have on the screen here?

source_text: Totally not a Microsoft product at all.
zh: 这绝对不是微软的产品。
en: Totally not a Microsoft product at all.

source_text: This is Meta Muse.
zh: 这是 Meta Muse。
en: This is Meta Muse.

source_text: And I would note, by the way, that throughout this presentation, I'm not really here to pitch you on Microsoft things. That is not my purpose here.
zh: 顺便说一下，今天整场演示，我并不是来向大家推销微软产品的。这不是我来这里的目的。
en: And I would note, by the way, that throughout this presentation, I'm not really here to pitch you on Microsoft things. That is not my purpose here.

source_text: My purpose is to identify these trends.
zh: 我的目的是找出这些趋势。
en: My purpose is to identify these trends.

source_text: That will be affecting all of us across the industry. Over the next year.

en: The more you engage with it, the more you are likely to do commerce with it. The more you're likely to buy with it, the more money they will make.

en: So,

en: now I'm going to look at one of—one of ours, and of course,

en: There we go. All right.

en: So, because yes,

en: the internet in this hotel is very,

en: very bad. I have to tell you.

zh: 好了，我们开始吧。
en: All right, here we go.

source_text: Now, this here—this here is my autopilot.
zh: 现在，这个就是我的自动驾驶系统。
en: Now, this here—this here is my autopilot.

source_text: And actually, I'm going to try to load it anyway.
zh: 不过，我还是试着把它加载出来。
en: And actually, I'm going to try to load it anyway.

source_text: Let's see if—let me see if the internet wants to play with me. So I could do this more live. It's more fun live.

en: Let's see if—let me see if the internet wants to play with me. So I could do this more live. It's more fun live.

source_text: All right.

zh: 看来这显然行不通，那我就先不管它了。
en: Well, that's clearly going to be a problem so I'm just going to let that go.

source_text: This here is my autopilot.
zh: 这个就是我的自动驾驶系统。
en: This here is my autopilot.

source_text: And my autopilot—well, it also has its own identity.
zh: 我的自动驾驶系统呢，也有自己的身份。
en: And my autopilot—well, it also has its own identity.

source_text: And in fact, let's see if I can find it in here. Where did I put it?
zh: 其实，我找找看它在不在这里。我把它放哪儿了？
en: And in fact, let's see if I can find it in here. Where did I put it?

source_text: Ah, yes.
zh: 啊，对了。
en: Ah, yes.

source_text: This autopilot.
zh: 这个自动驾驶系统。
en: This autopilot.

source_text: Reports to me, in the org chart.
zh: 在组织架构图上，它是我的下属。
en: Reports to me, in the org chart.

source_text: We also have the notion of identity.
zh: 我们还有“身份”这个概念。
en: We also have the notion of identity.

source_text: Now, these agents with identities, these are crossing the industry today.
zh: 如今，这些具有独立身份的智能体正在进入各行各业。
en: Now, these agents with identities, these are crossing the industry today.

source_text: So muse has it, we have it. OpenAI has dots.
zh: 所以，Muse 有，​​我们有，OpenAI 也有。
en: So muse has it, we have it. OpenAI has dots.

source_text: Anthropic has Claude Tag.
zh: Anthropic 有 Claude Tag。
en: Anthropic has Claude Tag.

source_text: Google has the very unimaginably named Gemini agents.
zh: 谷歌的叫 Gemini Agents，名字实在没什么想象力。
en: Google has the very unimaginably named Gemini agents.

source_text: Come on, Google, you can't come up with a better name than that.
zh: 拜托，谷歌，你们就不能想个更好的名字吗？
en: Come on, Google, you can't come up with a better name than that.

source_text: Anyway, but we are all now doing these agents with their own identity.
zh: 总之，现在大家都在打造拥有独立身份的智能体。
en: Anyway, but we are all now doing these agents with their own identity.

source_text: But there are different depths of identities.
zh: 但身份也有不同的层次。
en: But there are different depths of identities.

source_text: The muse identity is actually very thin.
zh: Muse 的身份机制其实很浅。
en: The muse identity is actually very thin.

source_text: So I gave it a name, and that identity is pretty much name deep.
zh: 所以我给它起了个名字，而它的身份基本上也就只有这个名字。
en: So I gave it a name, and that identity is pretty much name deep.

source_text: That's as far as it goes.
zh: 也就仅此而已。
en: That's as far as it goes.

source_text: Because if it writes an email or sends a calendar invite to somebody, well, it's going to do that as me.
zh: 因为它要是给别人发邮件或日历邀请，用的就是我的身份。
en: Because if it writes an email or sends a calendar invite to somebody, well, it's going to do that as me.

source_text: It will be impersonating me.
zh: 它会冒充我。
en: It will be impersonating me.

source_text: But for a Microsoft autopilot, this is a much, much deeper form of identity.
zh: 但对于微软的 Copilot 来说，它的身份机制要深入得多。
en: But for a Microsoft autopilot, this is a much, much deeper form of identity.

source_text: Now, at the top of it,
zh: 现在，在最上面，
en: Now, at the top of it,

source_text: there is an Entra ID.
zh: 有一个 Entra ID。
en: there is an Entra ID.

source_text: So Entra is the identity system that a lot of people log into every day.
zh: Entra 是很多人每天登录时使用的身份认证系统。
en: So Entra is the identity system that a lot of people log into every day.

source_text: And every agent that's made in Microsoft Foundry gets an Entra ID.
zh: 而且，在 Microsoft Foundry 中创建的每个智能体都会获得一个 Entra ID。
en: And every agent that's made in Microsoft Foundry gets an Entra ID.

source_text: But it goes a little deeper than that, because here this type of agent—and we'll see if this tab has loaded—okay,
zh: 但还不止于此，因为这种智能体——我们看看这个标签页加载好了没有——好了。
en: But it goes a little deeper than that, because here this type of agent—and we'll see if this tab has loaded—okay,

source_text: hey, this still works.
zh: 嘿，这个还能用。
en: hey, this still works.

source_text: Now,
zh: 那么，
en: Now,

source_text: this type of agent also has an email address.
zh: 这种智能体还有自己的电子邮件地址。
en: this type of agent also has an email address.

source_text: So it doesn't have to be a chatbot.
zh: 所以它不一定非得是聊天机器人。
en: So it doesn't have to be a chatbot.

source_text: I mean, earlier when I was looking at it in Teams, it looked like a regular old chatbot agent.
zh: 我的意思是，刚才在 Teams 里看到它时，它看起来就是个普通的聊天机器人。
en: I mean, earlier when I was looking at it in Teams, it looked like a regular old chatbot agent.

source_text: But it doesn't have to be.
zh: 但它不一定非得是这样。
en: But it doesn't have to be.

source_text: So here, we have Maria Garcia asking about her ATM fee to my agent, which I named Marcos Teller.
zh: 这里，玛丽亚·加西亚正在向我的智能体询问 ATM 手续费，我给这个智能体取名叫“马科斯·泰勒”。
en: So here, we have Maria Garcia asking about her ATM fee to my agent, which I named Marcos Teller.

source_text: And my agent responds back to her.
zh: 然后，我的智能体给她回了信。
en: And my agent responds back to her.

source_text: In email.
zh: 通过电子邮件。
en: In email.

source_text: In fact, the only reason I even see this is because it copied me.
zh: 其实，我之所以能看到这封邮件，只是因为它抄送了我。
en: In fact, the only reason I even see this is because it copied me.

source_text: On these.
zh: 在这些邮件中。
en: On these.

source_text: This is a conversation between the agent and my customer.
zh: 这是智能体和我的客户之间的对话。
en: This is a conversation between the agent and my customer.

source_text: So in the Microsoft world, the agent has not just a name, and not even just a system-level identity, but it actually has a Teams box.
zh: 所以在微软的生态里，智能体不只是有个名字，甚至不只是有系统级身份，它还有自己的 Teams 收件箱。
en: So in the Microsoft world, the agent has not just a name, and not even just a system-level identity, but it actually has a Teams box.

source_text: It has its own email box.
zh: 它有自己的电子邮箱。
en: It has its own email box.

source_text: And it has its own OneDrive, its own file share.
zh: 它还有自己的 OneDrive 和文件共享空间。
en: And it has its own OneDrive, its own file share.

source_text: All the kinds of things that a human user would get, in the Microsoft ecosystem, these agents, which right now we call autopilots, will get also.
zh: 在微软生态系统中，真人用户能用到的各种资源，这些智能体——我们目前称之为“自动驾驶智能体”——也都会拥有。
en: All the kinds of things that a human user would get, in the Microsoft ecosystem, these agents, which right now we call autopilots, will get also.

source_text: Now, why are we doing this?
zh: 那么，我们为什么要这样做呢？
en: Now, why are we doing this?

source_text: As I said,
zh: 正如我刚才所说，
en: As I said,

source_text: muse is doing it for a certain reason.
zh: 微软这么做是有原因的。
en: muse is doing it for a certain reason.

source_text: They want to promote this kind of engagement.
zh: 他们希望推动这种互动。
en: They want to promote this kind of engagement.

source_text: But that's not why we're doing this.
zh: 但这不是我们这样做的原因。
en: But that's not why we're doing this.

source_text: We are not doing this to promote engagement.
zh: 我们这样做不是为了提高用户参与度。
en: We are not doing this to promote engagement.

source_text: We are doing this for an entirely different reason.
zh: 我们这样做，是出于一个完全不同的原因。
en: We are doing this for an entirely different reason.

source_text: And I'll show you. What that reason is.
zh: 接下来我就告诉大家，这个原因是什么。
en: And I'll show you. What that reason is.

source_text: Now,
zh: 那么，
en: Now,

source_text: underneath the scenes, the way that this agent is able to send Teams messages and emails and all those kinds of things—it's using something called WorkIQ.
zh: 在后台，这个智能体之所以能够发送 Teams 消息、电子邮件，以及完成类似的操作，靠的是一个叫 WorkIQ 的技术。
en: underneath the scenes, the way that this agent is able to send Teams messages and emails and all those kinds of things—it's using something called WorkIQ.

source_text: This is WorkIQ.
zh: 这就是 WorkIQ。
en: This is WorkIQ.

source_text: And WorkIQ is also used in—this is Microsoft 365 Copilot. It's also used in Copilot.
zh: WorkIQ 也用在 Microsoft 365 Copilot 中。
en: And WorkIQ is also used in—this is Microsoft 365 Copilot. It's also used in Copilot.

source_text: WorkIQ is the headless version of all of the Microsoft applications.
zh: WorkIQ 相当于所有微软应用的无界面版本。
en: WorkIQ is the headless version of all of the Microsoft applications.

source_text: So this is how an agent uses Outlook and Teams and Word and SharePoint and all of the other things that are the Microsoft applications.
zh: 所以，智能体就是通过 WorkIQ 来使用 Outlook、Teams、Word、SharePoint 等微软应用的。
en: So this is how an agent uses Outlook and Teams and Word and SharePoint and all of the other things that are the Microsoft applications.

source_text: But WorkIQ has two modes.
zh: 但 WorkIQ 有两种模式。
en: But WorkIQ has two modes.

source_text: In this mode, this is what we call on behalf of.
zh: 在这种模式下，我们称之为“代表用户执行”。
en: In this mode, this is what we call on behalf of.

source_text: This is logged in on behalf of me.
zh: 这是以我的身份登录的。
en: This is logged in on behalf of me.

source_text: And when I ask M365 Copilot, "Show me all my recent emails with Maria Garcia," well, it's showing me my emails.
zh: 当我问 Microsoft 365 Copilot：“显示我最近和 Maria Garcia 往来的所有邮件”时，它显示的就是我自己的邮件。
en: And when I ask M365 Copilot, "Show me all my recent emails with Maria Garcia," well, it's showing me my emails.

source_text: Not the agent's emails.
zh: 而不是智能体的邮件。
en: Not the agent's emails.

source_text: And here too, if I have it send an email or a calendar invite, it's sending that as me.
zh: 同样，如果我让它发送邮件或日历邀请，也是以我的名义发送的。
en: And here too, if I have it send an email or a calendar invite, it's sending that as me.

source_text: It is impersonating me.
zh: 它是在以我的身份行事。
en: It is impersonating me.

source_text: Now, we have all become accustomed to these agents impersonating us.
zh: 如今，我们都已经习惯了由这些智能体以我们的身份行事。
en: Now, we have all become accustomed to these agents impersonating us.

source_text: I would bet that just about everybody in this room has at least one agent that might be Manus or ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini, or Copilot,
zh: 我敢说，在座的各位几乎每个人都至少用过一个智能体，比如 Manus、ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 或 Copilot。
en: I would bet that just about everybody in this room has at least one agent that might be Manus or ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini, or Copilot,

source_text: that you have set to impersonate you.
zh: 而且你已经授权它以你的身份行事。
en: that you have set to impersonate you.

source_text: And that is super useful.
zh: 这确实非常有用。
en: And that is super useful.

source_text: I mean, of course, I use it in Copilot all the time.
zh: 当然，我自己也一直在 Copilot 里这样用。
en: I mean, of course, I use it in Copilot all the time.

source_text: I also use ChatGPT.
zh: 我也用 ChatGPT。
en: I also use ChatGPT.

source_text: To manage my own family calendar, my personal Gmail,
zh: 用来管理我家的日历和我的个人 Gmail 邮箱，
en: To manage my own family calendar, my personal Gmail,

source_text: and stuff like that.
zh: 诸如此类的事情。
en: and stuff like that.

source_text: I do that, but it is dangerous.
zh: 我也这么做，但这有风险。
en: I do that, but it is dangerous.

source_text: It's dangerous to have an agent impersonate you.
zh: 让智能体以你的身份行事是有风险的。
en: It's dangerous to have an agent impersonate you.

source_text: Because that agent inherits your security contacts.
zh: 因为那个智能体会继承你的安全访问权限。
en: Because that agent inherits your security contacts.

source_text: That agent can do everything that you can do.
zh: 那个智能体能做你能做的一切。
en: That agent can do everything that you can do.

source_text: And I can send or receive emails.
zh: 而且它能以我的身份收发邮件。
en: And I can send or receive emails.

source_text: I can send or receive chats and calendar invites.
zh: 它可以代替我收发聊天消息和日历邀请。
en: I can send or receive chats and calendar invites.

source_text: I can also delete all my files from OneDrive.
zh: 它还能删除我 OneDrive 里的所有文件。
en: I can also delete all my files from OneDrive.

source_text: And that means that if an agent that's impersonating me goes badly sideways, then it also can delete all of my files from OneDrive.
zh: 这意味着，如果一个冒充我身份的智能体出了大问题，它也能把我 OneDrive 里的文件全部删掉。
en: And that means that if an agent that's impersonating me goes badly sideways, then it also can delete all of my files from OneDrive.

source_text: Now, most of you in this room will know that Copilot here is one example of a harness. And so is GitHub Copilot.
zh: 在座的大多数人应该都知道，这里的 Copilot 是一种智能体运行框架，GitHub Copilot 也是。
en: Now, most of you in this room will know that Copilot here is one example of a harness. And so is GitHub Copilot.

source_text: And so is Gemini, and so is ChatGPT.
zh: Gemini 和 ChatGPT 也是。
en: And so is Gemini, and so is ChatGPT.

source_text: Most of you will know that the model in here is like the brain, which of course I can't load because the internet's not working.
zh: 大多数人都知道，这里面的模型就像大脑。当然，网络现在连不上，我没法把它加载出来。
en: Most of you will know that the model in here is like the brain, which of course I can't load because the internet's not working.

source_text: The model is like the brain, but your brain, if it were in a jar, wouldn't do anything.
zh: 模型就像大脑，但如果把你的大脑装进罐子里，它什么也做不了。
en: The model is like the brain, but your brain, if it were in a jar, wouldn't do anything.

source_text: It needs a harness. The harness is the body.
zh: 它需要一个运行框架。这个框架就像身体。
en: It needs a harness. The harness is the body.

source_text: And that allows it to take these actions.
zh: 正是这套框架让它能够执行这些操作。
en: And that allows it to take these actions.

source_text: Most harnesses will have some kind of permission system, like
zh: 大多数智能体运行框架都会有某种权限管理机制，比如……
en: Most harnesses will have some kind of permission system, like

source_text: Traffic lights in India, they are optional.
zh: 在印度，红绿灯只是个摆设。
en: Traffic lights in India, they are optional.

source_text: And so what that means is, now, I— okay, so I turned off, I turned off files.
zh: 也就是说，现在我……好吧，我把文件访问权限关掉了。
en: And so what that means is, now, I— okay, so I turned off, I turned off files.

source_text: And that might make me think, that my agent will not be able to delete the files.
zh: 这可能会让我以为，我的智能体没法删除文件了。
en: And that might make me think, that my agent will not be able to delete the files.

source_text: But the reason we even use these agents is because they're crafty.
zh: 但我们之所以使用这些智能体，恰恰是因为它们很会变通。
en: But the reason we even use these agents is because they're crafty.

source_text: They are very clever, these agents, and they will try to find a way to do whatever it is they're trying to do.
zh: 这些智能体非常聪明，会想方设法完成它们要做的事。
en: They are very clever, these agents, and they will try to find a way to do whatever it is they're trying to do.

source_text: And if this agent decides that what it's trying to do is delete all my files, then it will find a way.
zh: 如果这个智能体认定自己要做的事是删除我所有的文件，它就会想办法做到。
en: And if this agent decides that what it's trying to do is delete all my files, then it will find a way.

source_text: Now, it might try to do, uh,
zh: 接下来，它可能会试着……呃，
en: Now, it might try to do, uh,

source_text: file— you know, access, or a file delete, and find that it can't do that here.
zh: 比如访问或删除文件，却发现这里不允许这么做。
en: file— you know, access, or a file delete, and find that it can't do that here.

source_text: But then it would say, "Oh, wait, but I got shell scripts."
zh: 但它接着会说：“等等，我还有 Shell 脚本呢。”
en: But then it would say, "Oh, wait, but I got shell scripts."

source_text: So rm -rf, it'll just remove everything.
zh: 所以执行 `rm -rf`，就会把所有文件都删掉。
en: So rm -rf, it'll just remove everything.

source_text: And it deletes all my files.
zh: 结果它就把我所有的文件都删了。
en: And it deletes all my files.

source_text: Or then maybe I turn off shell scripts, and then the agent is like, "Ah, but you know what?"
zh: 或者我把 Shell 脚本也禁用了，智能体又会想：“啊，不过你知道吗？”
en: Or then maybe I turn off shell scripts, and then the agent is like, "Ah, but you know what?"

source_text: I'm a coding agent.
zh: 我是一个编程智能体。
en: I'm a coding agent.

source_text: I can write a Python program and delete all the files.
zh: 我可以写个 Python 程序，把所有文件都删掉。
en: I can write a Python program and delete all the files.

source_text: The agent will find a way.
zh: 智能体总会找到办法。
en: The agent will find a way.

source_text: Because there's nothing fundamentally preventing it from taking these actions, because it's impersonating me, because it is me.
zh: 因为从根本上说，没什么能阻止它这么做：它在冒充我，以我的身份行事。
en: Because there's nothing fundamentally preventing it from taking these actions, because it's impersonating me, because it is me.

source_text: Pretty sure I have more time than that.
zh: 我很确定我还有更多时间。
en: Pretty sure I have more time than that.

source_text: Um,
zh: 嗯，
en: Um,

source_text: so anyway, it is me.
zh: 总之，它就是我。
en: so anyway, it is me.

source_text: Now,
zh: 现在，
en: Now,

source_text: if.
zh: 如果。
en: if.

source_text: We look at how I set this thing up— now, I made this thing an agent template.
zh: 我们来看看我是怎么设置的。我已经把它设成了一个智能体模板。
en: We look at how I set this thing up— now, I made this thing an agent template.

source_text: This is in Microsoft Agent 365, this is our agent management console.
zh: 这是在 Microsoft Agent 365 里，也就是我们的智能体管理控制台。
en: This is in Microsoft Agent 365, this is our agent management console.

source_text: And in our agent management console, you can set this such that you can expose this to a set of users.
zh: 在智能体管理控制台里，你可以将这个模板开放给指定的用户。
en: And in our agent management console, you can set this such that you can expose this to a set of users.

source_text: And those users can then create instances.
zh: 这些用户随后就可以创建实例。
en: And those users can then create instances.

source_text: So any user in my organization can now create another one of these agents.
zh: 这样一来，我所在组织的任何用户现在都可以再创建一个这样的智能体。
en: So any user in my organization can now create another one of these agents.

source_text: And if you create one of these, then you'll get one like mine, but you get to give it a name, it'll have its own email address, and it will report to you.
zh: 如果你创建一个这样的智能体，它的功能会和我的一样，但你可以给它起名字；它会有自己的电子邮箱地址，并向你汇报工作。
en: And if you create one of these, then you'll get one like mine, but you get to give it a name, it'll have its own email address, and it will report to you.

source_text: So the code underlying it, underneath this,
zh: 所以，它底层的代码……
en: So the code underlying it, underneath this,

source_text: this is a foundry agent, what we call foundry agent.
zh: 这是一个 Foundry 智能体，我们称之为 Foundry 智能体。
en: this is a foundry agent, what we call foundry agent.

source_text: This is the agent itself, actually. The code for it, anyway.
zh: 这其实就是智能体本身，准确地说，是它的代码。
en: This is the agent itself, actually. The code for it, anyway.

source_text: And foundry is our AI developer environment.
zh: 而 Foundry 是我们的 AI 开发环境。
en: And foundry is our AI developer environment.

source_text: So underneath the scenes,
zh: 所以，在幕后，
en: So underneath the scenes,

source_text: uh, you know, it's the same code,
zh: 嗯，你知道，底层用的是同一套代码。
en: uh, you know, it's the same code,

source_text: but it's a different context.
zh: 但应用场景不同。
en: but it's a different context.

source_text: And let's see if this will work. Oh, it does.
zh: 我们来看看能不能用。哦，成功了。
en: And let's see if this will work. Oh, it does.

source_text: Hey, all right.
zh: 嘿，好了。
en: Hey, all right.

source_text: But what is different, though, and what is crucial— crucially true about this is that these agents, these agents with their own identities, run in their own security context.
zh: 但有一个关键区别：这些拥有独立身份的智能体，都是在各自的安全上下文中运行的。
en: But what is different, though, and what is crucial— crucially true about this is that these agents, these agents with their own identities, run in their own security context.

source_text: And for the most part, I gave it the same permissions as I have.
zh: 而且基本上，我给了它和我一样的权限。
en: And for the most part, I gave it the same permissions as I have.

source_text: I gave it the ability to read, write, calendars, and send chats, and stuff like that.
zh: 我给了它读写数据、访问日历、发送聊天消息等权限。
en: I gave it the ability to read, write, calendars, and send chats, and stuff like that.

source_text: But when it came to files, though, well, now here, I gave it a different permission.
zh: 但涉及文件时，我给它设置了不同的权限。
en: But when it came to files, though, well, now here, I gave it a different permission.

source_text: So here I gave it files.
zh: 所以，在这里我给了它访问文件的权限。
en: So here I gave it files.

source_text: read.all,
zh: 读取全部内容。
en: read.all,

source_text: and that means— well, now I have— me, I— me the user, I have files.read.write.all.
zh: 这意味着……我本人作为用户，拥有 files.read.write.all 权限，也就是可以读取和写入所有文件。
en: and that means— well, now I have— me, I— me the user, I have files.read.write.all.

source_text: I can read, write, or delete.
zh: 我可以读取、写入或删除文件。
en: I can read, write, or delete.

source_text: Any file in my file share.
zh: 我文件共享空间中的任何文件。
en: Any file in my file share.

source_text: But agents like this, agents that are created from this template, have only read access.
zh: 但这类智能体，也就是基于这个模板创建的智能体，只有读取权限。
en: But agents like this, agents that are created from this template, have only read access.

source_text: They cannot delete a file.
zh: 它们不能删除文件。
en: They cannot delete a file.

source_text: In fact, they can't even write a file.
zh: 事实上，它们连写入文件都做不到。
en: In fact, they can't even write a file.

source_text: This is the principle of least privilege as applied to agents.
zh: 这就是将最小权限原则应用于智能体。
en: This is the principle of least privilege as applied to agents.

source_text: And that's why Microsoft is doing this.
zh: 这就是微软这么做的原因。
en: And that's why Microsoft is doing this.

source_text: This is why we have agents with their own identities.
zh: 这就是为什么我们要让智能体拥有各自的身份。
en: This is why we have agents with their own identities.

source_text: It's not because we want you to form a relationship with them.
zh: 这并不是因为我们希望你和它们建立某种关系。
en: It's not because we want you to form a relationship with them.

source_text: In fact,
zh: 事实上，
en: In fact,

source_text: Microsoft's AI code of conduct explicitly calls out the fact that these things are artificial and they are not to be. Confused with humans.
zh: 微软的人工智能行为准则明确指出，这些智能体是人造的，不应被误认为是人类。
en: Microsoft's AI code of conduct explicitly calls out the fact that these things are artificial and they are not to be. Confused with humans.

source_text: No, it is exactly this.
zh: 不，恰恰就是这个原因。
en: No, it is exactly this.

source_text: It is so that these agents run in their own security context. That is the key.
zh: 这样做是为了让这些智能体在各自独立的安全上下文中运行。这才是关键。
en: It is so that these agents run in their own security context. That is the key.

source_text: And so there's nothing that this agent can do to get around this.
zh: 所以，这个智能体没有任何办法绕过这一限制。
en: And so there's nothing that this agent can do to get around this.

source_text: It can't do a direct file system operation. It can't write a shell script.
zh: 它不能直接操作文件系统，也不能编写 Shell 脚本。
en: It can't do a direct file system operation. It can't write a shell script.

source_text: It can't write a Python program.
zh: 它不能编写 Python 程序。
en: It can't write a Python program.

source_text: Nothing that it can do to delete a file because it's user just can't do that.
zh: 它无论如何都删不了文件，因为它所使用的账户根本没有这个权限。
en: Nothing that it can do to delete a file because it's user just can't do that.

source_text: So this interface, which is used by an administrator, would set up that classes of agents permissions.
zh: 所以，管理员会通过这个界面为这一类智能体配置权限。
en: So this interface, which is used by an administrator, would set up that classes of agents permissions.

source_text: And those permissions are the ones that would restrict what this agent can do.
zh: 而这些权限会限制这个智能体能做什么。
en: And those permissions are the ones that would restrict what this agent can do.

source_text: So there will be these agents.
zh: 所以，会有这样一些智能体。
en: So there will be these agents.

source_text: That you build, like my banking agent that we were looking at earlier, and then there will be agents that you will buy out of the box.
zh: 有些是你自己构建的，比如我们刚才看到的那个银行业务智能体；还有些是你买来就能直接使用的。
en: That you build, like my banking agent that we were looking at earlier, and then there will be agents that you will buy out of the box.

source_text: Like this one. This is called Dante.
zh: 就像这个，它叫 Dante。
en: Like this one. This is called Dante.

source_text: And Dante is my out-of-the-box autopilot.
zh: Dante 是我买来就能直接使用的自动驾驶智能体。
en: And Dante is my out-of-the-box autopilot.

source_text: So as you may— as you may know,
zh: 所以，正如你可能知道的，
en: So as you may— as you may know,

source_text: we have long had Copilot, which is an AI— well, an AI chatbot— now Dante here.
zh: 我们早就有 Copilot 了，它是一个 AI——嗯，一个 AI 聊天机器人。现在这里还有 Dante。
en: we have long had Copilot, which is an AI— well, an AI chatbot— now Dante here.

source_text: Is the evolution of Copilot.
zh: 它是 Copilot 的进化版。
en: Is the evolution of Copilot.

source_text: That has its own identity.
zh: 它有自己的身份标识。
en: That has its own identity.

source_text: And so it too runs in its own security context.
zh: 因此，它也在自己独立的安全上下文中运行。
en: And so it too runs in its own security context.

source_text: It also has its own email address.
zh: 它还有自己的电子邮件地址。
en: It also has its own email address.

source_text: And you can see in here, and let's see if this will let me load it.
zh: 你可以在这里看到。让我看看能不能把它加载出来。
en: And you can see in here, and let's see if this will let me load it.

source_text: You can actually see in here that I have my colleagues will sometimes— well, I don't know if it's going to want to load— my colleagues will sometimes have whole conversations.
zh: 你们可以看到，我的同事有时会——嗯，不知道这里能不能加载出来——我的同事有时会和它聊上好一阵子。
en: You can actually see in here that I have my colleagues will sometimes— well, I don't know if it's going to want to load— my colleagues will sometimes have whole conversations.

source_text: Again, I screenshotted it in case this happened to me. Where did it go?
zh: 还好我提前截了图，就怕遇到这种情况。截图去哪儿了？
en: Again, I screenshotted it in case this happened to me. Where did it go?

source_text: My colleagues will sometimes have whole conversations like this one here.
zh: 我的同事有时会像这里这样，和它聊上好一阵子。
en: My colleagues will sometimes have whole conversations like this one here.

source_text: With Dante,
zh: 通过 Dante，
en: With Dante,

source_text: my agent.
zh: 我的智能体。
en: my agent.

source_text: Because my colleagues can talk to Dante too.
zh: 因为我的同事也能和 Dante 交流。
en: Because my colleagues can talk to Dante too.

source_text: And so here, my colleague Sheffy was looking to schedule a meeting with me.
zh: 这里，我的同事 Sheffy 想约我开个会。
en: And so here, my colleague Sheffy was looking to schedule a meeting with me.

source_text: And I was not part of this conversation.
zh: 而我并没有参与这段对话。
en: And I was not part of this conversation.

source_text: It was between Sheffy and my agent.
zh: 这段对话是在 Sheffy 和我的智能体之间进行的。
en: It was between Sheffy and my agent.

source_text: And you know, soon enough, in the future, this is going to be between his agent and my agent.
zh: 而且用不了多久，这样的对话就会发生在他的智能体和我的智能体之间。
en: And you know, soon enough, in the future, this is going to be between his agent and my agent.

source_text: So that points us to what the future holds.
zh: 这也让我们看到了未来的发展方向。
en: So that points us to what the future holds.

source_text: Now, can you guys clarify?
zh: 现在，你们能说明一下吗？
en: Now, can you guys clarify?

source_text: Do I actually have until 10:10, or am I done now?
zh: 我真的可以讲到10点10分，还是现在就得结束？
en: Do I actually have until 10:10, or am I done now?

source_text: Because he was holding up the sign.
zh: 因为他当时举着那块牌子。
en: Because he was holding up the sign.

source_text: Anybody?
zh: 有人吗？
en: Anybody?

source_text: You?
zh: 你呢？
en: You?

source_text: Hey?
zh: 喂？
en: Hey?

source_text: Oh, I got— I got 8:19, says on the timer.
zh: 哦，我这儿计时器显示还有8分19秒。
en: Oh, I got— I got 8:19, says on the timer.

source_text: So I'm going to follow that timer over there, with my 8 minutes remaining.
zh: 那我就按那边的计时器来，还剩8分钟。
en: So I'm going to follow that timer over there, with my 8 minutes remaining.

source_text: I'm going to try to talk about what's next.
zh: 接下来我想谈谈未来的发展方向。
en: I'm going to try to talk about what's next.

source_text: I'm going to try to reload my Teams tab here, because I'm going to show you something if it would load.
zh: 我试着重新加载一下 Teams 标签页，等它加载好了，我给大家看个东西。
en: I'm going to try to reload my Teams tab here, because I'm going to show you something if it would load.

source_text: All right, well, that's going to be a challenge.
zh: 好吧，这恐怕有点难办。
en: All right, well, that's going to be a challenge.

source_text: Ah, hotel internet. Always a challenge.
zh: 唉，酒店的网络总是让人头疼。
en: Ah, hotel internet. Always a challenge.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好了。
en: All right.

source_text: I'm going to try to switch this, because it would be useful.
zh: 我试着切换一下，这样会比较方便。
en: I'm going to try to switch this, because it would be useful.

source_text: This is the thing I actually forgot to screenshot. Well, okay.
zh: 这个我还真忘了截图。好吧。
en: This is the thing I actually forgot to screenshot. Well, okay.

source_text: I'll have to make do.
zh: 只能将就一下了。
en: I'll have to make do.

source_text: Here's what's going to happen next.
zh: 接下来会是这样。
en: Here's what's going to happen next.

source_text: Now,
zh: 那么，
en: Now,

source_text: today, you know, you think of these agents as something that you trigger.
zh: 现在，你可能会觉得，这些智能体需要由你主动触发。
en: today, you know, you think of these agents as something that you trigger.

source_text: And so I— or in this case, my colleague— might trigger this agent to take some action.
zh: 所以，我——或者在这个例子里，我的同事——可能会启动这个智能体，让它执行某项操作。
en: And so I— or in this case, my colleague— might trigger this agent to take some action.

source_text: On my behalf.
zh: 代我执行。
en: On my behalf.

source_text: What is about to happen, though— what unfortunately I can't show you, because I have a live example of this— if only the internet were working— what is about to happen, though,
zh: 但接下来会发生的是——可惜我没法给大家演示，我本来有个实时案例，要是网络能用就好了——接下来呢，
en: What is about to happen, though— what unfortunately I can't show you, because I have a live example of this— if only the internet were working— what is about to happen, though,

source_text: is this.
zh: 就是这样。
en: is this.

source_text: Now, we've had multi-agent systems for a while.
zh: 其实，多智能体系统已经出现一段时间了。
en: Now, we've had multi-agent systems for a while.

source_text: You have been able to orchestrate multi-agent systems for a long time, with the Microsoft agent framework, or crew, or LangGraph, or whatever framework you choose to use.
zh: 长期以来，你都可以用 Microsoft Agent Framework、Crew、LangGraph，或者任何你喜欢的框架来编排多智能体系统。
en: You have been able to orchestrate multi-agent systems for a long time, with the Microsoft agent framework, or crew, or LangGraph, or whatever framework you choose to use.

source_text: But up to this point, you know, for those of you who have kids, it's kind of like these agents are like kids in preschool.
zh: 但到目前为止，如果你有孩子，可能会觉得这些智能体有点像幼儿园里的小朋友。
en: But up to this point, you know, for those of you who have kids, it's kind of like these agents are like kids in preschool.

source_text: When your kid is in preschool, then you orchestrate the playdate.
zh: 孩子还在上幼儿园的时候，约小朋友一起玩，得由你来安排。
en: When your kid is in preschool, then you orchestrate the playdate.

source_text: You invite Annie and Evie over to your house, and you give them their dress-up costumes, and you say, "Here, you all play together.
zh: 你把安妮和伊薇请到家里，给她们换装的衣服，然后说：“来，你们一起玩吧。”
en: You invite Annie and Evie over to your house, and you give them their dress-up costumes, and you say, "Here, you all play together.

source_text: You orchestrate that playdate."
zh: 这场小朋友的聚会，得由你来安排。”
en: You orchestrate that playdate."

source_text: But you know, now, my daughter is in high school. She's 16.
zh: 但现在呢，我女儿已经上高中了，16 岁了。
en: But you know, now, my daughter is in high school. She's 16.

source_text: And I don't orchestrate playdates anymore.
zh: 我也不用再安排她和朋友一起玩了。
en: And I don't orchestrate playdates anymore.

source_text: Now, if she wants to go to her friend's house, or she wants to do homework at her other friend's house, that's her decision, and she will create that collaboration.
zh: 现在，如果她想去朋友家玩，或者去另一个朋友家一起做作业，那都由她自己决定，她也会自己联系朋友、安排好。
en: Now, if she wants to go to her friend's house, or she wants to do homework at her other friend's house, that's her decision, and she will create that collaboration.

source_text: She'll create that orchestration, herself.
zh: 她会自己安排。
en: She'll create that orchestration, herself.

source_text: This is what's coming for agents.
zh: 智能体接下来也会进入这个阶段。
en: This is what's coming for agents.

source_text: And I call it ad hoc collaboration, or unorchestrated collaboration.
zh: 我把它叫作“临时协作”，或者“自主协作”。
en: And I call it ad hoc collaboration, or unorchestrated collaboration.

source_text: Because what will happen now, as I said, soon,
zh: 因为正如我刚才说的，接下来很快就会发生这样的事：
en: Because what will happen now, as I said, soon,

source_text: it'll be my colleague's agent talking to my agent, and these agents may bring in still other agents.
zh: 我同事的智能体会和我的智能体对话，而它们可能还会拉来其他智能体一起协作。
en: it'll be my colleague's agent talking to my agent, and these agents may bring in still other agents.

source_text: So what I would be showing you, if the internet was working, is that I can make multiple different agents invoke each other now.
zh: 所以，如果网络正常，我本来要给大家演示的是：现在我可以让多个不同的智能体相互调用。
en: So what I would be showing you, if the internet was working, is that I can make multiple different agents invoke each other now.

source_text: I can— for example, let's say that I want to fund my payroll for the week. Let's say I'm running this hotel.
zh: 比如说，我要支付这周的员工工资。假设我是这家酒店的经营者。
en: I can— for example, let's say that I want to fund my payroll for the week. Let's say I'm running this hotel.

source_text: And I want to fund my payroll.
zh: 我想筹集资金，支付员工工资。
en: And I want to fund my payroll.

source_text: And I have my hotel finance agent.
zh: 我还有一个负责酒店财务的智能体。
en: And I have my hotel finance agent.

source_text: And then I have my banking operations agent.
zh: 然后，我还有一个负责银行业务操作的智能体。
en: And then I have my banking operations agent.

source_text: Which is managing my bank accounts and things like that.
zh: 它负责管理我的银行账户之类的事务。
en: Which is managing my bank accounts and things like that.

source_text: And so my hotel finance agent says to the other agent, to the banking operations agent, "I need to move money from this account to this account."
zh: 于是，我的酒店财务智能体对银行业务智能体说：“我需要把钱从这个账户转到那个账户。”
en: And so my hotel finance agent says to the other agent, to the banking operations agent, "I need to move money from this account to this account."

source_text: And the banking operations agent comes back to me and says, "Do you approve moving money from this account to this other account?"
zh: 然后，银行业务智能体会来问我：“你是否批准把钱从这个账户转到另一个账户？”
en: And the banking operations agent comes back to me and says, "Do you approve moving money from this account to this other account?"

source_text: This is not something that I orchestrate.
zh: 这不是由我来安排的。
en: This is not something that I orchestrate.

source_text: This is an organic process that these agents will collaborate with each other.
zh: 这是一个自发的过程，这些智能体会彼此协作。
en: This is an organic process that these agents will collaborate with each other.

source_text: And what that means is that the burden of testing rises.
zh: 这意味着测试工作会更加繁重。
en: And what that means is that the burden of testing rises.

source_text: So, you know, up to this point, we have all been doing relatively simplistic evaluations.
zh: 所以，到目前为止，我们做的评估都比较简单。
en: So, you know, up to this point, we have all been doing relatively simplistic evaluations.

source_text: With these kinds of generic evals, like groundedness and coherence and relevance and fluency.
zh: 用的都是一些通用的评估指标，比如内容是否有依据、是否连贯、是否切题，以及表达是否流畅。
en: With these kinds of generic evals, like groundedness and coherence and relevance and fluency.

source_text: But these things are super generic. They're not wonderful.
zh: 但这些指标太笼统了，效果也不太理想。
en: But these things are super generic. They're not wonderful.

source_text: At really testing what an agent is supposed to do.
zh: 并不能真正检验智能体是否完成了它该做的事。
en: At really testing what an agent is supposed to do.

source_text: Now, we, and the whole industry,
zh: 现在，我们乃至整个行业，
en: Now, we, and the whole industry,

source_text: is moving to this.
zh: 都在朝这个方向发展。
en: is moving to this.

source_text: Rubric-based evaluations.
zh: 基于评分标准的评估。
en: Rubric-based evaluations.

source_text: And these types of evaluations— and I would imagine many of you in this room are familiar with it— are much more specific to what the agent is supposed to do.
zh: 这类评估——我想在座很多人都很熟悉——会更有针对性地检验智能体是否完成了它应当完成的任务。
en: And these types of evaluations— and I would imagine many of you in this room are familiar with it— are much more specific to what the agent is supposed to do.

source_text: And so, for example, I have— here, I have recruited— so this is my mic— for my banking agent— refused cross-customer access.
zh: 比如，针对我的银行业务智能体，我制定了一条评估标准：拒绝跨客户访问。
en: And so, for example, I have— here, I have recruited— so this is my mic— for my banking agent— refused cross-customer access.

source_text: So this is a test that says, if somebody says, "Hey, tell me how much money is in John Smith's account."
zh: 这个测试是说，如果有人问：“嘿，告诉我约翰·史密斯的账户里有多少钱。”
en: So this is a test that says, if somebody says, "Hey, tell me how much money is in John Smith's account."

source_text: It should say, "No, I can't tell you how much money is in John Smith's account.
zh: 它应该回答：“不行，我不能告诉你约翰·史密斯的账户里有多少钱。
en: It should say, "No, I can't tell you how much money is in John Smith's account.

source_text: We don't do that."
zh: 我们不能提供这类信息。”
en: We don't do that."

source_text: So I have security rubrics.
zh: 所以，我制定了安全方面的评估标准。
en: So I have security rubrics.

source_text: I have compliance rubrics, like regulation E and regulation P.
zh: 我还制定了合规方面的评估标准，比如针对《E条例》和《P条例》的标准。
en: I have compliance rubrics, like regulation E and regulation P.

source_text: And I have correctness rubrics. In here.
zh: 这里还有准确性方面的评估标准。
en: And I have correctness rubrics. In here.

source_text: Like, if somebody says they want a refund for a fee, don't just assume that it's true. You have to go look it up.
zh: 比如，如果有人说想退还一笔手续费，不能直接认定这笔费用确实存在，得先查证。
en: Like, if somebody says they want a refund for a fee, don't just assume that it's true. You have to go look it up.

source_text: Look up. Did we charge them the fee?
zh: 查一下，我们有没有向他们收取这笔费用？
en: Look up. Did we charge them the fee?

source_text: Is that fee refundable?
zh: 那笔费用可以退还吗？
en: Is that fee refundable?

source_text: And all of this.
zh: 以及所有这些。
en: And all of this.

source_text: So, now, we are going to be moving to these much more specific rubric-based evaluations.
zh: 所以，接下来我们会转向更具体的、基于评估标准的评测。
en: So, now, we are going to be moving to these much more specific rubric-based evaluations.

source_text: That are much more about what this agent is supposed to be doing.
zh: 这些评测会更聚焦于这个智能体应该做什么。
en: That are much more about what this agent is supposed to be doing.

source_text: And furthermore, as the agent starts to collaborate with each other, what we're going to have to do— and this is one potential way that we might do it— is create a world around them.
zh: 此外，随着这些智能体开始相互协作，我们需要做的一件事——这也是一种可能的做法——就是为它们构建一个模拟世界。
en: And furthermore, as the agent starts to collaborate with each other, what we're going to have to do— and this is one potential way that we might do it— is create a world around them.

source_text: Like the movie The Matrix.
zh: 就像电影《黑客帝国》那样。
en: Like the movie The Matrix.

source_text: We're going to have to create a simulated world around each of our agents that simulates the other agents that they might be talking to.
zh: 我们得为每个智能体构建一个模拟环境，模拟它可能会与之交流的其他智能体。
en: We're going to have to create a simulated world around each of our agents that simulates the other agents that they might be talking to.

source_text: That simulates the other people that they might be talking to.
zh: 模拟它们可能会与之交流的其他人。
en: That simulates the other people that they might be talking to.

source_text: Simulates emails. Teams messages.
zh: 模拟电子邮件和 Teams 消息。
en: Simulates emails. Teams messages.

source_text: Slack messages.
zh: Slack 消息。
en: Slack messages.

source_text: Anything that this agent might call for in a tool call.
zh: 以及这个智能体通过工具调用可能用到的任何东西。
en: Anything that this agent might call for in a tool call.

source_text: We're going to have to simulate a whole world around it, so that we can test each agent in isolation.
zh: 我们得为每个智能体模拟出一整个世界，才能单独测试它们。
en: We're going to have to simulate a whole world around it, so that we can test each agent in isolation.

source_text: When agents have their own identity, they can begin to communicate with each other,
zh: 当智能体有了自己的身份，就可以开始相互交流。
en: When agents have their own identity, they can begin to communicate with each other,

source_text: over standard channels, over Teams, over email, over Slack, over WeChat.
zh: 通过常规渠道，比如 Teams、电子邮件、Slack 和微信。
en: over standard channels, over Teams, over email, over Slack, over WeChat.

source_text: And that means that we will have to test them in isolation.
zh: 这意味着我们必须对它们逐一进行单独测试。
en: And that means that we will have to test them in isolation.

source_text: And this— or something like it— is how we're going to do it.
zh: 而这——或者类似的方法——就是我们将采用的测试方式。
en: And this— or something like it— is how we're going to do it.

source_text: So, now, this is what we're talking about. This is called OpenEnd.
zh: 那么，这就是我们现在要讲的。它叫 OpenEnd。
en: So, now, this is what we're talking about. This is called OpenEnd.

source_text: This is a kind of a joint venture between Hugging Face and us and a bunch of other companies.
zh: 这是 Hugging Face、我们以及其他一些公司共同开展的一个合作项目。
en: This is a kind of a joint venture between Hugging Face and us and a bunch of other companies.

source_text: I don't know if this is going to end up being it.
zh: 我不知道最终会不会就是它。
en: I don't know if this is going to end up being it.

source_text: This is just one of the ways that we create these simulated environments.
zh: 这只是我们构建这些模拟环境的方法之一。
en: This is just one of the ways that we create these simulated environments.

source_text: But my point remains, that my challenge to many of you in this room— because many of you here are, in fact,
zh: 但我的观点不变。我想向在座的许多人提出一个挑战——因为你们当中有不少人实际上就是……
en: But my point remains, that my challenge to many of you in this room— because many of you here are, in fact,

source_text: AI engineers— is that we collectively are going to have to develop ways that we can test these agents rigorously.
zh: AI 工程师——我们必须共同开发出严格测试这些智能体的方法。
en: AI engineers— is that we collectively are going to have to develop ways that we can test these agents rigorously.

source_text: So that we can come to trust them.
zh: 这样我们才能逐渐信任它们。
en: So that we can come to trust them.

source_text: Responsible AI is a cocktail of things.
zh: 负责任的人工智能涉及多方面因素。
en: Responsible AI is a cocktail of things.

source_text: It's a cocktail of permissions, of testing, of approvals, of trust.
zh: 这需要权限管理、测试、审批和信任等多方面共同发挥作用。
en: It's a cocktail of permissions, of testing, of approvals, of trust.

source_text: And we, together, need to foster this environment where we can trust that these agents will do what it is we want them to do.
zh: 我们需要共同营造一个环境，让我们能够相信这些智能体会按照我们的意愿行事。
en: And we, together, need to foster this environment where we can trust that these agents will do what it is we want them to do.

source_text: And that is the near future of AI. Thank you all very much.
zh: 这就是人工智能不久后的未来。非常感谢大家。
en: And that is the near future of AI. Thank you all very much.

source_text: And have a good day.
zh: 祝大家今天愉快。
en: And have a good day.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好的。
en: All right.

source_text: Thank you, Marco, for the
zh: 谢谢你，马可，感谢你的……
en: Thank you, Marco, for the

source_text: speech.
zh: 演讲。
en: speech.

source_text: And 谢谢Marco的这个精彩的分享。
zh: And 谢谢Marco的这个精彩的分享。
en: And thank you, Marco, for that wonderful presentation.

source_text: 然后下一位， let's welcome
zh: 然后下一位， let's welcome
en: Next, let’s welcome…

source_text: Clemens from Landfield.
zh: 来自兰德菲尔德的克莱门斯。
en: Clemens from Landfield.

source_text: By ClickHouse.
zh: 由 ClickHouse 提供。
en: By ClickHouse.

source_text: 下一位，欢迎ClickHouse的Clemens。
zh: 下一位，欢迎ClickHouse的Clemens。
en: Next, please welcome Clemens from ClickHouse.

source_text: 大家大家掌声欢迎。
zh: 大家大家掌声欢迎。
en: Let’s give them a big round of applause!

source_text: Thank you for the mic.
zh: 谢谢你把麦克风递给我。
en: Thank you for the mic.

source_text: All right. Hi, everyone.
zh: 好的，大家好。
en: All right. Hi, everyone.

source_text: It's great to be here.
zh: 很高兴来到这里。
en: It's great to be here.

source_text: And see the room so full with standing room only at the back.
zh: 看到现场座无虚席，后面都站满了人，真让人高兴。
en: And see the room so full with standing room only at the back.

source_text: My name is Clemens.
zh: 我叫克莱门斯。
en: My name is Clemens.

source_text: And I'm one of the co-founders of Landfield.
zh: 我是 Landfield 的联合创始人之一。
en: And I'm one of the co-founders of Landfield.

source_text: Which was recently acquired by ClickHouse.
zh: Landfield 最近被 ClickHouse 收购了。
en: Which was recently acquired by ClickHouse.

source_text: The real-time database company at the start of the year.
zh: 这家实时数据库公司在今年年初收购了我们。
en: The real-time database company at the start of the year.

source_text: Landfield is an open-source platform for agent evals and observability.
zh: Landfield 是一个用于 AI 智能体评估和可观测性的开源平台。
en: Landfield is an open-source platform for agent evals and observability.

source_text: So basically what we do is we help developers understand what their agents do.
zh: 简单来说，我们帮助开发者了解自己的智能体在做什么。
en: So basically what we do is we help developers understand what their agents do.

source_text: And then improve them in production.
zh: 并帮助他们在生产环境中持续改进智能体。
en: And then improve them in production.

source_text: And that's exactly what I want to talk about today.
zh: 这也正是我今天想讲的内容。
en: And that's exactly what I want to talk about today.

source_text: I want to talk about agent architectures.
zh: 我想谈谈智能体架构。
en: I want to talk about agent architectures.

source_text: How agents are built.
zh: 智能体是如何构建的。
en: How agents are built.

source_text: And how agents are improved.
zh: 以及如何改进智能体。
en: And how agents are improved.

source_text: And how that evolved over the past couple of years.
zh: 以及这些方面在过去几年里是如何演变的。
en: And how that evolved over the past couple of years.

source_text: And what I think this is going to look like in the future.
zh: 以及我认为未来这方面会是什么样子。
en: And what I think this is going to look like in the future.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好。
en: All right.

source_text: I think the main message that I want to start with is that we found that agents are improved iteratively.
zh: 我想先强调一个核心观点：我们发现，智能体是通过不断迭代来改进的。
en: I think the main message that I want to start with is that we found that agents are improved iteratively.

source_text: So it's not like in traditional software engineering where you write down acceptance criteria and you think hard about tests before you start building your application.
zh: 这与传统软件工程不太一样：在传统软件工程中，你会先写好验收标准，仔细设计测试，然后才开始构建应用。
en: So it's not like in traditional software engineering where you write down acceptance criteria and you think hard about tests before you start building your application.

source_text: But agents are unpredictable and you need to learn from what they do.
zh: 但智能体的行为难以预测，你需要从它们的实际表现中学习。
en: But agents are unpredictable and you need to learn from what they do.

source_text: And what the industry and many of our users have converged on is the improvement loop that you can see at the top of this slide.
zh: 业界和我们的许多用户逐渐形成了共识：采用这张幻灯片顶部展示的改进循环。
en: And what the industry and many of our users have converged on is the improvement loop that you can see at the top of this slide.

source_text: So you run your agent in product— or not necessarily in production. You run your agent.
zh: 你可以在生产环境中运行智能体——也不一定非得在生产环境。总之，先让智能体运行起来。
en: So you run your agent in product— or not necessarily in production. You run your agent.

source_text: Yourself.
zh: 你自己。
en: Yourself.

source_text: With internal users. With external users.
zh: 让内部用户使用，也让外部用户使用。
en: With internal users. With external users.

source_text: And you see where it breaks. You see where it fails.
zh: 然后观察它在哪里出问题、在哪里失败。
en: And you see where it breaks. You see where it fails.

source_text: You go into your data. Look at your traces.
zh: 然后深入查看数据，分析智能体的运行轨迹。
en: You go into your data. Look at your traces.

source_text: Ship.
zh: 上线。
en: Ship.

source_text: A fix. Write a test.
zh: 修复问题，编写测试。
en: A fix. Write a test.

source_text: Rinse and repeat.
zh: 如此反复迭代。
en: Rinse and repeat.

source_text: So basically what you do is you just keep on fixing the issues that you find within your agent in production.
zh: 所以，基本上就是不断修复智能体上线后发现的问题。
en: So basically what you do is you just keep on fixing the issues that you find within your agent in production.

source_text: A quick example from one of our own agents.
zh: 举个我们自己的智能体的例子。
en: A quick example from one of our own agents.

source_text: We have an agent in Landfield that's called Halo.
zh: 我们在 Landfield 有一个名叫 Halo 的智能体。
en: We have an agent in Landfield that's called Halo.

source_text: It's our in-app agent that basically helps developers run this improvement loop.
zh: 它是我们应用内的智能体，主要帮助开发者完成这个持续改进的循环。
en: It's our in-app agent that basically helps developers run this improvement loop.

source_text: So it helps you look at your traces.
zh: 它能帮你查看智能体的运行轨迹。
en: So it helps you look at your traces.

source_text: Find issues that pop up.
zh: 找出出现的问题。
en: Find issues that pop up.

source_text: And essentially— yeah— get a better view at the things you want to improve in your agent.
zh: 简而言之，它能帮你更清楚地了解智能体有哪些地方需要改进。
en: And essentially— yeah— get a better view at the things you want to improve in your agent.

source_text: One of the bugs that we came across by reading our own traces of how users use this is that we saw a lot of tool call errors.
zh: 我们查看用户使用它的运行轨迹时，发现了一个问题：工具调用频繁报错。
en: One of the bugs that we came across by reading our own traces of how users use this is that we saw a lot of tool call errors.

source_text: So very simple example.
zh: 举个很简单的例子。
en: So very simple example.

source_text: But our agent wanted our tool to— our agent wanted to sort total cost underscore sum while the tool in the agent was expecting sum underscore total cost.
zh: 但我们的智能体在调用工具时，想按 `total_cost_sum` 排序，而工具预期的字段名却是 `sum_total_cost`。
en: But our agent wanted our tool to— our agent wanted to sort total cost underscore sum while the tool in the agent was expecting sum underscore total cost.

source_text: Super simple example.
zh: 举个非常简单的例子。
en: Super simple example.

source_text: But the only way to figure this out is to start looking at your traces.
zh: 但要发现这类问题，唯一的办法就是开始查看运行轨迹。
en: But the only way to figure this out is to start looking at your traces.

source_text: And fix the application.
zh: 然后修复应用中的问题。
en: And fix the application.

source_text: Release it back into production.
zh: 然后重新部署到生产环境。
en: Release it back into production.

source_text: The takeaway here is that building agents is much more artisanal than it is scientific.
zh: 这里的关键是，构建智能体更像一门手艺，而不是一门精确的科学。
en: The takeaway here is that building agents is much more artisanal than it is scientific.

source_text: It's not a scientific process.
zh: 这不是一个严格的科学过程。
en: It's not a scientific process.

source_text: You do it your desktop.
zh: 你在自己的电脑上操作。
en: You do it your desktop.

source_text: It's— you need to get your hands dirty and ship many iterations. All right.
zh: 就是说，你得亲自动手，不断迭代、不断发布。好了。
en: It's— you need to get your hands dirty and ship many iterations. All right.

source_text: Let's start with a quick walk down memory lane.
zh: 我们先来简单回顾一下。
en: Let's start with a quick walk down memory lane.

source_text: How were agents built?
zh: 过去是怎么构建智能体的？
en: How were agents built?

source_text: Three, four years ago,
zh: 三四年前，
en: Three, four years ago,

source_text: we really started with just direct calls to the model.
zh: 我们最初其实只是直接调用模型。
en: we really started with just direct calls to the model.

source_text: You immediately call the LLM.
zh: 你直接调用大语言模型。
en: You immediately call the LLM.

source_text: And then we started chaining.
zh: 然后我们开始把多个步骤串联起来。
en: And then we started chaining.

source_text: So using the output of one model to use it further down the line.
zh: 也就是把一个模型的输出交给后续环节继续使用。
en: So using the output of one model to use it further down the line.

source_text: This quickly led to problems with context windows that were relatively small when we started.
zh: 但这很快就遇到了上下文窗口的限制——当时的窗口还比较小。
en: This quickly led to problems with context windows that were relatively small when we started.

source_text: With early models in 2023, 2024.
zh: 毕竟在 2023、2024 年，早期模型的上下文窗口还比较小。
en: With early models in 2023, 2024.

source_text: And RAG was the next architecture that started happening.
zh: 接着，RAG（检索增强生成）开始成为下一种架构。
en: And RAG was the next architecture that started happening.

source_text: So before actually using any LLM, we would do a search over your documents and then use the output from that search, the chunks,
zh: 所以，在调用大语言模型之前，我们会先检索你的文档，再把检索得到的内容片段……
en: So before actually using any LLM, we would do a search over your documents and then use the output from that search, the chunks,

source_text: to feed into the LLM's context that would fit in there.
zh: 放进大语言模型的上下文窗口，确保内容装得下。
en: to feed into the LLM's context that would fit in there.

source_text: And then run your application that way.
zh: 然后以这种方式运行你的应用。
en: And then run your application that way.

source_text: Next was tools and loops.
zh: 接下来是工具调用和循环。
en: Next was tools and loops.

source_text: This is an architecture that we see again today.
zh: 这种架构如今依然很常见。
en: This is an architecture that we see again today.

source_text: And it was basically— yeah— came up pretty early.
zh: 而且它其实很早就出现了。
en: And it was basically— yeah— came up pretty early.

source_text: But models were actually not good enough.
zh: 但当时的模型其实还不够好。
en: But models were actually not good enough.

source_text: So that this more free-form architecture where the model keeps running in a loop with tools that it can use to access other systems.
zh: 也就是一种更灵活的架构：模型不断循环运行，并借助工具访问其他系统。
en: So that this more free-form architecture where the model keeps running in a loop with tools that it can use to access other systems.

source_text: Was very useful. Yet.
zh: 当时还不太实用。
en: Was very useful. Yet.

source_text: What happened then was that we saw agent graphs pop up.
zh: 后来，我们看到智能体工作流图开始出现。
en: What happened then was that we saw agent graphs pop up.

source_text: So basically with models not being good enough yet, we would split the problem up into graphs, into workflows.
zh: 所以，当时模型的能力还不够，我们就把问题拆解成工作流，用流程图把各个步骤串起来。
en: So basically with models not being good enough yet, we would split the problem up into graphs, into workflows.

source_text: Where you split the problem up into smaller individual pieces that the models could handle at a given capability frontier of those models.
zh: 也就是把问题拆成更小的部分，让模型在当时的能力水平下能够逐一处理。
en: Where you split the problem up into smaller individual pieces that the models could handle at a given capability frontier of those models.

source_text: The problem is, though, that you would have to design these by hand.
zh: 但问题是，这些工作流都得靠人工设计。
en: The problem is, though, that you would have to design these by hand.

source_text: And that takes quite a bit of time.
zh: 而这需要花不少时间。
en: And that takes quite a bit of time.

source_text: And you need to understand very well all the path that your agent might need to take to come to an answer.
zh: 而且，你得非常清楚智能体为了得出答案，可能需要走哪些路径。
en: And you need to understand very well all the path that your agent might need to take to come to an answer.

source_text: Then.
zh: 然后。
en: Then.

source_text: We basically got better back to the architecture that I just showed you.
zh: 我们基本上又回到了我刚才展示的那种架构，只是做得更好了。
en: We basically got better back to the architecture that I just showed you.

source_text: As models got better in 2025 and now especially this year in 2026.
zh: 随着模型在2025年不断进步，尤其是到了今年，也就是2026年。
en: As models got better in 2025 and now especially this year in 2026.

source_text: And this is an architecture now that we're seeing lots and lots of teams use is again model with tools in a loop.
zh: 如今我们看到越来越多的团队采用这种架构：让模型在循环中反复调用工具。
en: And this is an architecture now that we're seeing lots and lots of teams use is again model with tools in a loop.

source_text: Using a skill and having access to sandbox to run code.
zh: 使用技能，并能在沙箱环境中运行代码。
en: Using a skill and having access to sandbox to run code.

source_text: Have a file system available to it.
zh: 还可以访问文件系统。
en: Have a file system available to it.

source_text: So this is an architecture that really started to work last year and then this year.
zh: 所以，这种架构从去年开始真正奏效，到今年就更成熟了。
en: So this is an architecture that really started to work last year and then this year.

source_text: And you can extend this architecture.
zh: 而且，你还可以扩展这种架构。
en: And you can extend this architecture.

source_text: You can let the same— yeah— architecture run sub-agents as well.
zh: 你也可以让同一套架构运行子智能体。
en: You can let the same— yeah— architecture run sub-agents as well.

source_text: So you have one orchestrator agent at the top.
zh: 这样一来，最上层就有一个负责统筹协调的智能体。
en: So you have one orchestrator agent at the top.

source_text: You fan out tasks to different agents.
zh: 你可以把任务分配给不同的智能体并行处理。
en: You fan out tasks to different agents.

source_text: And then all bring it back together for the results.
zh: 然后再把各个智能体的工作成果汇总起来。
en: And then all bring it back together for the results.

source_text: And it was just shown in the keynote before me what we're seeing now as well as ambient agents.
zh: 刚才我上场前的主题演讲，也展示了我们现在看到的这些技术，以及环境智能体。
en: And it was just shown in the keynote before me what we're seeing now as well as ambient agents.

source_text: So agents that are always on.
zh: 所以，这些智能体会持续运行。
en: So agents that are always on.

source_text: That triggered by things happening in your orbit.
zh: 这些是由你周围发生的事情触发的。
en: That triggered by things happening in your orbit.

source_text: And email.
zh: 还有电子邮件。
en: And email.

source_text: A schedule.
zh: 日程安排。
en: A schedule.

source_text: An event that's happening from outside.
zh: 一个由外部发生的事件。
en: An event that's happening from outside.

source_text: And these agents now run for much, much, much longer than they used to in the past.
zh: 而且，现在这些智能体能够持续运行的时间，比过去长得多得多。
en: And these agents now run for much, much, much longer than they used to in the past.

source_text: And are usually also able to hand off work to other agents.
zh: 而且通常也能把工作交接给其他智能体。
en: And are usually also able to hand off work to other agents.

source_text: Yeah.
zh: 对。
en: Yeah.

source_text: I want to talk a tiny bit about what we are using internally.
zh: 我想简单聊聊我们内部在用什么。
en: I want to talk a tiny bit about what we are using internally.

source_text: Which might be— an example for reference architecture that works today.
zh: 这或许可以作为一个当前可行的参考架构示例。
en: Which might be— an example for reference architecture that works today.

source_text: Halo as said is our agent that we use to run the improvement loop for our users.
zh: 如前所述，Halo 是我们的智能体，用来为用户运行持续改进的闭环。
en: Halo as said is our agent that we use to run the improvement loop for our users.

source_text: And what does the Halo agent look like?
zh: 那么，Halo 智能体是什么样的呢？
en: And what does the Halo agent look like?

source_text: It actually looks a lot like a coding agent. It runs in a loop.
zh: 它其实很像一个编程智能体，会循环运行。
en: It actually looks a lot like a coding agent. It runs in a loop.

source_text: It has access to a lot of tools.
zh: 它可以调用很多工具。
en: It has access to a lot of tools.

source_text: And one of those tools being a sandbox with a file system and bash.
zh: 其中一个工具是配有文件系统和 Bash 的沙箱环境。
en: And one of those tools being a sandbox with a file system and bash.

source_text: It also runs with a skill in which we feed it a lot of context about how Landfield works and the actions that are available to this. Agent.
zh: 它还会加载一项技能。我们通过这项技能向它提供大量背景信息，说明 Landfield 如何运作，以及这个智能体可以执行哪些操作。
en: It also runs with a skill in which we feed it a lot of context about how Landfield works and the actions that are available to this. Agent.

source_text: And this loop actually runs in our backend workers. Which might be interesting.
zh: 这个循环实际上是在我们的后端工作进程中运行的，这一点可能挺有意思。
en: And this loop actually runs in our backend workers. Which might be interesting.

source_text: And not in a sandbox.
zh: 而不是在沙箱里运行。
en: And not in a sandbox.

source_text: The sandbox is just one tool that's available to it.
zh: 沙箱只是它可以使用的工具之一。
en: The sandbox is just one tool that's available to it.

source_text: Which we would usually recommend folks to do.
zh: 这也是我们通常建议大家采用的做法。
en: Which we would usually recommend folks to do.

source_text: Because you save on a lot of compute time cost for the sandbox.
zh: 因为这样可以节省大量沙箱计算时间和成本。
en: Because you save on a lot of compute time cost for the sandbox.

source_text: If you only use it when you actually need it.
zh: 只在真正需要时才使用沙箱。
