en: If you only use it when you actually need it.

source_text: And have the agent run outside it at first.
zh: 并让智能体一开始在沙箱外运行。
en: And have the agent run outside it at first.

source_text: So this is not the only design that we see working for agent architectures.
zh: 所以，对于智能体架构来说，这并不是我们见过的唯一行之有效的设计。
en: So this is not the only design that we see working for agent architectures.

source_text: But it's one that we really see repeatedly within our user base and then also within ourselves.
zh: 但我们确实一再看到，用户和我们自己都在采用这种设计。
en: But it's one that we really see repeatedly within our user base and then also within ourselves.

source_text: And now we come to the question of how do we improve these agent architectures that get more and more difficult over time. More and more complex.
zh: 接下来就要谈到一个问题：这些智能体架构越来越复杂，我们该如何改进它们？
en: And now we come to the question of how do we improve these agent architectures that get more and more difficult over time. More and more complex.

source_text: In the past, especially when agent architectures were more simple, humans could eyeball everything.
zh: 过去，尤其是在智能体架构还比较简单的时候，人们凭肉眼就能检查所有环节。
en: In the past, especially when agent architectures were more simple, humans could eyeball everything.

source_text: You could look at your traces.
zh: 你可以查看运行轨迹。
en: You could look at your traces.

source_text: They were generally pretty short.
zh: 它们通常都比较简短。
en: They were generally pretty short.

source_text: You can read them. See where things break.
zh: 你可以通读它们，看看哪里出了问题。
en: You can read them. See where things break.

source_text: Fix your application.
zh: 修复你的应用程序。
en: Fix your application.

source_text: Today,
zh: 如今，
en: Today,

source_text: that's a little bit harder as agents get bigger.
zh: 但随着智能体变得越来越复杂，这就没那么容易了。
en: that's a little bit harder as agents get bigger.

source_text: Traffic that runs on these systems increases.
zh: 这些系统上的流量不断增加。
en: Traffic that runs on these systems increases.

source_text: And basically what we've seen is that the industry has converged on this improvement loop for agents.
zh: 基本上，我们看到整个行业逐渐形成了一套改进智能体的闭环。
en: And basically what we've seen is that the industry has converged on this improvement loop for agents.

source_text: You find failures in the application.
zh: 找出应用程序中的故障。
en: You find failures in the application.

source_text: You write evals for these failures.
zh: 针对这些故障编写评估用例。
en: You write evals for these failures.

source_text: You change your application.
zh: 然后修改应用程序。
en: You change your application.

source_text: You backtest the application against these evals.
zh: 再用这些评估用例回测应用程序。
en: You backtest the application against these evals.

source_text: And then you release to production.
zh: 然后将应用程序部署到生产环境。
en: And then you release to production.

source_text: And then you start all over again.
zh: 然后再从头开始，重复这一流程。
en: And then you start all over again.

source_text: This process is mostly run by humans today.
zh: 目前，这个流程主要由人工完成。
en: This process is mostly run by humans today.

source_text: And that means that there's a lot of judgment calls involved.
zh: 这意味着其中有很多环节需要人为判断。
en: And that means that there's a lot of judgment calls involved.

source_text: Which failures do you care about in your application?
zh: 你最关注应用程序中的哪些故障？
en: Which failures do you care about in your application?

source_text: Which do you need to turn into evals?
zh: 哪些故障需要转化为评估用例？
en: Which do you need to turn into evals?

source_text: What do these evals look like?
zh: 这些评估用例具体是什么样的？
en: What do these evals look like?

source_text: When do you release these evals?
zh: 什么时候发布这些评估用例？
en: When do you release these evals?

source_text: So you can see that in the diagram here, everything that's orange is still run by humans.
zh: 所以你可以看到，这张图中所有橙色的部分，目前仍然由人工完成。
en: So you can see that in the diagram here, everything that's orange is still run by humans.

source_text: And that's all of it right now.
zh: 而目前，整个流程都是如此。
en: And that's all of it right now.

source_text: And there's a good news is, or there's a good news and the good news is that this process works.
zh: 好消息是，这套流程确实有效。
en: And there's a good news is, or there's a good news and the good news is that this process works.

source_text: And we've seen it really— yeah— take hold as a best practice in the industry.
zh: 我们也看到，它确实已成为行业内广泛采用的最佳实践。
en: And we've seen it really— yeah— take hold as a best practice in the industry.

source_text: But the bad news is it's slow and expensive.
zh: 但坏消息是，这套流程耗时又费钱。
en: But the bad news is it's slow and expensive.

source_text: Because it uses the one resource that you probably can't scale in your organization.
zh: 因为它依赖的资源，恰恰是你的组织里最难扩充的：人力。
en: Because it uses the one resource that you probably can't scale in your organization.

source_text: Which is the engineers that you have that are working on your agents.
zh: 也就是负责开发智能体的工程师。
en: Which is the engineers that you have that are working on your agents.

source_text: And there's another problem.
zh: 还有一个问题。
en: And there's another problem.

source_text: Agent traces and the amount of data you use also increases a lot.
zh: 智能体的运行轨迹数量和数据用量也会大幅增加。
en: Agent traces and the amount of data you use also increases a lot.

source_text: So while in the past you were able with a simpler agent architecture that you can see at the top left, you were usually able to read the entire trace and just follow everything the agent was doing.
zh: 过去，面对左上角那种较简单的智能体架构，你通常能读完整条运行轨迹，弄清智能体的每一步操作。
en: So while in the past you were able with a simpler agent architecture that you can see at the top left, you were usually able to read the entire trace and just follow everything the agent was doing.

source_text: Increasingly, with tool loop agents and sub-agents, et cetera, it's not possible anymore to read everything that's happening in your agent.
zh: 但随着工具循环型智能体、子智能体等架构越来越普遍，你已经不可能再逐一读完智能体运行过程中发生的所有事情了。
en: Increasingly, with tool loop agents and sub-agents, et cetera, it's not possible anymore to read everything that's happening in your agent.

source_text: And then, I mean, as you go to production, lots of you will know the amount of traffic you get really explodes.
zh: 而且，等系统正式上线后，很多人都知道，流量会猛增。
en: And then, I mean, as you go to production, lots of you will know the amount of traffic you get really explodes.

source_text: So that means no one can actually read all traces by hand anymore. So how do you improve agents with that much traffic?
zh: 这意味着，已经没人能靠人工读完所有运行轨迹了。那么，面对这么大的流量，该怎么改进智能体呢？
en: So that means no one can actually read all traces by hand anymore. So how do you improve agents with that much traffic?

source_text: The good news is you can at this point already hand off a lot of the improvement loop to agents.
zh: 好消息是，到这一步，改进流程中的很多工作已经可以交给智能体了。
en: The good news is you can at this point already hand off a lot of the improvement loop to agents.

source_text: Agents have gotten a lot— or coding agents.
zh: 智能体已经进步了很多——我是说编程智能体。
en: Agents have gotten a lot— or coding agents.

source_text: Coding agents have gotten a lot better at helping you traverse your data.
zh: 编程智能体现在更擅长帮你梳理和分析数据了。
en: Coding agents have gotten a lot better at helping you traverse your data.

source_text: Find failures.
zh: 找出失败案例。
en: Find failures.

source_text: Propose fixes to your prompts. To your evals.
zh: 针对提示词和评测提出改进建议。
en: Propose fixes to your prompts. To your evals.

source_text: In your datasets.
zh: 还有数据集。
en: In your datasets.

source_text: And backtest your application against these evals that you've set.
zh: 再用你设定的这些评测，对应用进行回测。
en: And backtest your application against these evals that you've set.

source_text: So good news is you can use AI to basically get a hold on all the data that is being produced by your AI systems.
zh: 所以好消息是，你可以利用 AI，基本掌握自己的 AI 系统产生的所有数据。
en: So good news is you can use AI to basically get a hold on all the data that is being produced by your AI systems.

source_text: It's important that you're able to connect all of your application data.
zh: 重要的是，你要能把应用中的所有数据关联起来。
en: It's important that you're able to connect all of your application data.

source_text: Your traces to coding agents via MCP, API, or CLI.
zh: 通过 MCP、API 或命令行工具，把应用的追踪数据接入编程智能体。
en: Your traces to coding agents via MCP, API, or CLI.

source_text: But there is a catch.
zh: 但这里有个问题。
en: But there is a catch.

source_text: An.
zh: 一个。
en: An.

source_text: Agent's context usually doesn't fit millions of traces.
zh: 智能体的上下文窗口通常容纳不了数百万条追踪记录。
en: Agent's context usually doesn't fit millions of traces.

source_text: So as the data explodes that you want to analyze, you can't just feed everything into a coding agent.
zh: 所以，随着待分析的数据量激增，你不能把所有数据一股脑儿地塞给编程智能体。
en: So as the data explodes that you want to analyze, you can't just feed everything into a coding agent.

source_text: At most, you need maybe hundreds, dozens, thousands of traces depending on how large they are that you can actually analyze within your coding agent.
zh: 你最多只能让编程智能体分析几十、几百，或几千条追踪记录，具体取决于每条记录的大小。
en: At most, you need maybe hundreds, dozens, thousands of traces depending on how large they are that you can actually analyze within your coding agent.

source_text: So you need to shape your data first.
zh: 所以，你得先整理好数据。
en: So you need to shape your data first.

source_text: And what that means is you are basically have to summarize— you need to start from all the data that you have.
zh: 这意味着，你基本上得先从手头的全部数据入手，再进行汇总。
en: And what that means is you are basically have to summarize— you need to start from all the data that you have.

source_text: And then summarize it down to the things that you really care about that your agent should look at and should reference.
zh: 然后把数据提炼成你真正关心、需要智能体查看和参考的内容。
en: And then summarize it down to the things that you really care about that your agent should look at and should reference.

source_text: And how we see this play out in the industry right now is basically progressive disclosure.
zh: 而目前业界的做法，基本上就是渐进式地呈现信息。
en: And how we see this play out in the industry right now is basically progressive disclosure.

source_text: But for data. What does that mean?
zh: 只不过，这里说的是数据。什么意思呢？
en: But for data. What does that mean?

source_text: You take traces.
zh: 先拿到追踪记录。
en: You take traces.

source_text: You summarize these traces as trajectories which are basically short textual representations of your traces.
zh: 然后把这些追踪记录概括成“轨迹”，也就是对追踪过程的简短文字描述。
en: You summarize these traces as trajectories which are basically short textual representations of your traces.

source_text: And then you use smaller language models, less expensive language models to summarize these trajectories.
zh: 接着，用规模更小、成本更低的语言模型来总结这些轨迹。
en: And then you use smaller language models, less expensive language models to summarize these trajectories.

source_text: A long dimensions that you care about.
zh: 按你关心的维度来总结。
en: A long dimensions that you care about.

source_text: And that's basically coming from your domain expertise, what you know about your agents,
zh: 而这些维度，基本上取决于你的领域专业知识，以及你对自己智能体的了解。
en: And that's basically coming from your domain expertise, what you know about your agents,

source_text: where they break, what things you care about, how do you want them to be summarized, where do you expect things to fail,
zh: 比如智能体会在哪些环节出问题、你关注什么、希望如何总结，以及预期哪里可能出错。
en: where they break, what things you care about, how do you want them to be summarized, where do you expect things to fail,

source_text: what do you want to know about how your users use your application.
zh: 你想了解用户是如何使用你的应用的哪些方面。
en: what do you want to know about how your users use your application.

source_text: And then you take these summaries and you embed them and cluster them.
zh: 然后，把这些摘要转换成向量表示，并进行聚类。
en: And then you take these summaries and you embed them and cluster them.

source_text: So you can take these clusters label them and then again use language models to rank these clusters.
zh: 这样就可以给这些聚类打标签，再用语言模型对它们进行排序。
en: So you can take these clusters label them and then again use language models to rank these clusters.

source_text: So if you have, for example,
zh: 所以，举个例子，如果你有……
en: So if you have, for example,

source_text: a class of failures where tool loops are tool calls fail,
zh: 有一类故障是工具调用陷入循环，或者工具调用失败。
en: a class of failures where tool loops are tool calls fail,

source_text: you can then use a model to rank these issues only look at the failures that are most egregious and then pass the full traces for these failures back to your model.
zh: 你就可以用模型对这些问题排序，只查看最严重的故障，再把这些故障的完整执行轨迹交回模型。
en: you can then use a model to rank these issues only look at the failures that are most egregious and then pass the full traces for these failures back to your model.

source_text: And this is how you go from— yeah— millions of rows of traces and logs to a smaller amount that you can actually send back to your coding agent.
zh: 这样一来，就能从数百万条执行轨迹和日志中筛选出少量真正值得交给编程智能体分析的内容。
en: And this is how you go from— yeah— millions of rows of traces and logs to a smaller amount that you can actually send back to your coding agent.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好的。
en: All right.

source_text: So what we see happening next is that background agents take over this process.
zh: 所以，我们认为接下来会由后台智能体接手这个流程。
en: So what we see happening next is that background agents take over this process.

source_text: Because LLM applications, agents that are running constantly produce traces.
zh: 因为大语言模型应用和持续运行的智能体会不断产生执行轨迹。
en: Because LLM applications, agents that are running constantly produce traces.

source_text: And because they constantly produce traces, constantly come up with new failures and need to constantly evaluate and improve them.
zh: 而且，由于它们不断产生执行轨迹，也会不断出现新的故障，因此需要持续评估和改进。
en: And because they constantly produce traces, constantly come up with new failures and need to constantly evaluate and improve them.

source_text: So what we see happening and what we think where the industry is going is that teams will use background agents.
zh: 所以，我们看到的趋势，也是我们认为整个行业的发展方向，是团队会使用后台智能体。
en: So what we see happening and what we think where the industry is going is that teams will use background agents.

source_text: Background agents that take the data that you ingest into the systems, maintain this data, and basically long running find failures, propose fixes,
zh: 这些后台智能体会接收导入系统的数据、持续维护，并长期监测故障、提出修复方案。
en: Background agents that take the data that you ingest into the systems, maintain this data, and basically long running find failures, propose fixes,

source_text: backtest these changes to your applications. A couple of minutes left.
zh: 再对应用中的这些改动进行回测。还剩几分钟。
en: backtest these changes to your applications. A couple of minutes left.

source_text: Okay. I'll speed up a bit.
zh: 好，我稍微讲快一点。
en: Okay. I'll speed up a bit.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: Once agents take over this loop, what remains for you?
zh: 一旦智能体接手了这个闭环，你还需要做什么？
en: Once agents take over this loop, what remains for you?

source_text: Humans to do.
zh: 人类还需要做什么？
en: Humans to do.

source_text: In our view, that's mostly quality.
zh: 我们认为，主要还是把控质量。
en: In our view, that's mostly quality.

source_text: So you need to own the outcome.
zh: 所以，你需要对最终结果负责。
en: So you need to own the outcome.

source_text: What is good look like for your application?
zh: 你的应用做到什么程度才算好？
en: What is good look like for your application?

source_text: What are the feedback signals you use to determine what a good applic— what a good outcome is?
zh: 你会根据哪些反馈信号来判断，什么样的结果才算好？
en: What are the feedback signals you use to determine what a good applic— what a good outcome is?

source_text: And then the decision to actually release fixes to your application.
zh: 然后，你还要决定是否真正将修复方案发布到应用中。
en: And then the decision to actually release fixes to your application.

source_text: I think I'll just skip over this here.
zh: 这部分我就先略过了。
en: I think I'll just skip over this here.

source_text: To basically get to the end where I will share some of my predictions and bets that we're making at Langviews as we are building for this transition into agentic improvement of applications.
zh: 直接讲到最后吧。我会分享一些预测，以及我们在 Langviews 为推动应用向智能体自主改进转型所做的布局。
en: To basically get to the end where I will share some of my predictions and bets that we're making at Langviews as we are building for this transition into agentic improvement of applications.

source_text: In general,
zh: 总的来说，
en: In general,

source_text: at Langviews we think frontier intelligence is already very close to helping you solve many of the problems that are there and that reliability of your agents is generally the bigger issues.
zh: 在 Langviews，我们认为前沿模型的智能水平已经很接近能够帮你解决许多现有问题了；眼下更大的挑战，通常是智能体的可靠性。
en: at Langviews we think frontier intelligence is already very close to helping you solve many of the problems that are there and that reliability of your agents is generally the bigger issues.

source_text: If your task has a default shape and it's not necessarily incredibly complex or custom, improvement will get a lot easier as you can get agents in the loop to automate it.
zh: 如果你的任务有比较固定的模式，不算特别复杂，也不需要高度定制，那么一旦让智能体参与进来、实现自动化，改进起来就会容易得多。
en: If your task has a default shape and it's not necessarily incredibly complex or custom, improvement will get a lot easier as you can get agents in the loop to automate it.

source_text: If you have a custom shape of a problem or something that's way above the current intelligence frontier of models, you will need to continue running the loop, write evals, rewrite,
zh: 如果你的问题比较特殊，或者难度远超当前模型的能力边界，你就仍然需要持续迭代：编写评估、修改方案，
en: If you have a custom shape of a problem or something that's way above the current intelligence frontier of models, you will need to continue running the loop, write evals, rewrite,

source_text: rewrite the skills that you use for your application to give them the manual for the things they need to do and run backtests against your application.
zh: 重写应用中使用的技能，为智能体提供完成任务所需的操作指南，并对应用进行回测。
en: rewrite the skills that you use for your application to give them the manual for the things they need to do and run backtests against your application.

source_text: The good news is that when you run this loop, and you write evals, you label data, you collect a lot of data that's incredibly valuable.
zh: 好消息是，在持续迭代、编写评估用例和标注数据的过程中，你会积累大量极有价值的数据。
en: The good news is that when you run this loop, and you write evals, you label data, you collect a lot of data that's incredibly valuable.

source_text: It's a unique application specific dataset that you can use to improve your application going forward.
zh: 这是一套针对你应用的独有数据集，可以用来持续改进应用。
en: It's a unique application specific dataset that you can use to improve your application going forward.

source_text: And the next step that we see the best teams starting to do right now is to basically build their own reinforcement learning environments.
zh: 而我们看到，顶尖团队现在开始迈出的下一步，就是搭建自己的强化学习环境。
en: And the next step that we see the best teams starting to do right now is to basically build their own reinforcement learning environments.

source_text: Because these labels that you get from running the improvement loop are signals that you can use to build tasks, build verifiers,
zh: 因为在改进迭代中获得的这些标签，可以作为信号，用来设计任务、构建验证器，
en: Because these labels that you get from running the improvement loop are signals that you can use to build tasks, build verifiers,

source_text: and in the end train your own open source models that saturate on task quality for what you need. All right.
zh: 最终训练出适合自身需求的开源模型，让它们在特定任务上的表现达到最优。好。
en: and in the end train your own open source models that saturate on task quality for what you need. All right.

source_text: To wrap up, what do we find?
zh: 最后总结一下，我们发现了什么？
en: To wrap up, what do we find?

source_text: Agent architectures are very much converging on a coding agent pattern is what we see.
zh: 我们观察到，智能体架构正逐渐趋同，向编程智能体的模式靠拢。
en: Agent architectures are very much converging on a coding agent pattern is what we see.

source_text: The traces these generate really outpace anything that humans can read.
zh: 这些智能体生成的运行轨迹，数量远远超出了人类能够逐一阅读的范围。
en: The traces these generate really outpace anything that humans can read.

source_text: Which means that we need background agents and AI to automate the improvement loop that we've seen take hold for AI agents.
zh: 这意味着，我们需要后台智能体和 AI，把如今已成为 AI 智能体开发常态的改进迭代流程自动化。
en: Which means that we need background agents and AI to automate the improvement loop that we've seen take hold for AI agents.

source_text: But it's important that we as humans keep the big pieces to ourselves and that's mostly quality.
zh: 但重要的是，我们人类要把握住大方向，尤其是质量这一关。
en: But it's important that we as humans keep the big pieces to ourselves and that's mostly quality.

source_text: What does a good application look like?
zh: 一个好的应用应该是什么样的？
en: What does a good application look like?

source_text: What are the feedback signals you can trust?
zh: 哪些反馈信号是值得信赖的？
en: What are the feedback signals you can trust?

source_text: Like user feedback, implicit or explicit you can collect from your product. Yeah.
zh: 比如从产品中收集到的用户反馈，无论是隐性的还是显性的。对。
en: Like user feedback, implicit or explicit you can collect from your product. Yeah.

source_text: I think that's it. And I'm out of time.
zh: 我想就讲到这里。时间也到了。
en: I think that's it. And I'm out of time.

source_text: Thank you so much, everyone. And looking forward to spending the next two days with you here at the conference.
zh: 非常感谢大家！期待接下来两天在大会上与各位交流。
en: Thank you so much, everyone. And looking forward to spending the next two days with you here at the conference.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好的。
en: All right.

source_text: Thank you, Clemens, for your sh
zh: 谢谢你，克莱门斯，感谢你的分享。
en: Thank you, Clemens, for your sh

source_text: aring.
zh: ……aring。
en: aring.

source_text: 谢谢Clemens的分享。
zh: 谢谢Clemens的分享。
en: Thank you, Clemens, for your presentation.

zh: 然后
en: And then…

source_text: next, let's welcome Rio.
zh: 接下来，让我们欢迎里奥。
en: next, let's welcome Rio.

source_text: He was the founding engineer at Cursor.
zh: 他是 Cursor 的创始工程师。
en: He was the founding engineer at Cursor.

source_text: 下一位是这个Rio，他之前是这个Founding Engineer在Cursor的Founding Engineer。然后欢迎他。 我是Designer。
zh: 下一位是这个Rio，他之前是这个Founding Engineer在Cursor的Founding Engineer。然后欢迎他。 我是Designer。
en: Next up is Rio, who was a founding engineer at Cursor. Please welcome him! I’m a designer.

source_text: Designer. Sorry. Designer.
zh: 设计师。抱歉，是设计师。
en: Designer. Sorry. Designer.

source_text: 设计师。然后欢迎他。
zh: 设计师。然后欢迎他。
en: Designer. Please welcome him.

zh: 然后你要。
en: And then you need to…

source_text: 我要用这个。
zh: 我要用这个。
en: I’ll use this one.

source_text: 好的。手那边比较好玩。
zh: 好的。手那边比较好玩。
en: Okay. That part is more fun.

source_text: 好。
zh: 好。
en: Okay.

source_text: 我有点紧张。请大家关照。
zh: 我有点紧张。请大家关照。
en: I’m a little nervous, so please bear with me.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: Oh.
zh: 哦。
en: Oh.

source_text: Cool.
zh: 好。
en: Cool.

source_text: 你。
zh: 你。
en: You.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: 好。
zh: 好。
en: Okay.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: 大家好，我是Rio。
zh: 大家好，我是Rio。
en: Hello, everyone. I’m Rio.

source_text: 今天我想演讲的题目是，当我们什么都能做，还知道自己想做什么吗？
zh: 今天我想演讲的题目是，当我们什么都能做，还知道自己想做什么吗？
en: Today, I’d like to talk about this question: When we can do anything, do we still know what we want to do?

source_text: 那我们开始吧。
zh: 那我们开始吧。
en: Let’s get started.

source_text: 开幕。工具更强，为何我们更加不安？
zh: 开幕。工具更强，为何我们更加不安？
en: Opening: If our tools are getting more powerful, why are we feeling more anxious?

source_text: 我今天不想讲AI有多厉害，因为大家已经看过用过很多了。
zh: 我今天不想讲AI有多厉害，因为大家已经看过用过很多了。
en: I don’t want to talk about how powerful AI is today, because we’ve all seen and used it plenty already.

source_text: 一句话做出一个网站，几分钟做一个功能，睡醒以后机器已经替你完成了一晚上的工作，甚至已经把你没有想过的事情做完了。
zh: 一句话做出一个网站，几分钟做一个功能，睡醒以后机器已经替你完成了一晚上的工作，甚至已经把你没有想过的事情做完了。
en: You can build a website with a single sentence, create a feature in minutes, and wake up to find that a machine has done a night’s work for you—even things you hadn’t thought of yet.

source_text: 这一切开始的时候我也很兴奋。
zh: 这一切开始的时候我也很兴奋。
en: When all this began, I was excited too.

source_text: 很多时候只能想想的东西，现在真的可以做了。
zh: 很多时候只能想想的东西，现在真的可以做了。
en: Things we used to only dream about can now actually be built.

source_text: 但不知道你们有没有另外一种感觉。
zh: 但不知道你们有没有另外一种感觉。
en: But I wonder if you’ve felt something else, too.

source_text: 看到别人用新的模型做出点什么，第一个反应是，哇，好厉害。
zh: 看到别人用新的模型做出点什么，第一个反应是，哇，好厉害。
en: When you see someone build something with a new model, your first reaction is, “Wow, that’s impressive.”

source_text: 第二个反应却是，我是不是又落后了。
zh: 第二个反应却是，我是不是又落后了。
en: But your second thought is, “Am I falling behind again?”

source_text: 好像每个人都变得聪明了，做的事情更多了。
zh: 好像每个人都变得聪明了，做的事情更多了。
en: It feels like everyone’s getting smarter and getting more done.

source_text: 你原本花很多时间积累的能力，现在好像就是任何人可以放在输入框里的一句话。
zh: 你原本花很多时间积累的能力，现在好像就是任何人可以放在输入框里的一句话。
en: The skills you spent years developing now seem like something anyone can type into a prompt box.

source_text: 这个时候，很容易会觉得，我也应该更多产出，再多学几个工具，再多开几个agents。
zh: 这个时候，很容易会觉得，我也应该更多产出，再多学几个工具，再多开几个agents。
en: At times like this, it’s easy to think, “I should be producing more, learning a few more tools, and running a few more agents.”

source_text: 但我想问，如果我们真的可以一直这样做下去，那什么时候才算够？
zh: 但我想问，如果我们真的可以一直这样做下去，那什么时候才算够？
en: But I want to ask: if we can keep doing this indefinitely, when will it ever be enough?

source_text: 我一直很相信做工具。
zh: 我一直很相信做工具。
en: I’ve always believed in building tools.

source_text: 从设计协作工具，让每个人可以搭建自己的系统，到设计帮助所有人做软件的工具。
zh: 从设计协作工具，让每个人可以搭建自己的系统，到设计帮助所有人做软件的工具。
en: From designing collaborative tools that let anyone build their own systems to designing tools that help everyone create software.

source_text: 我希望把想象与现实之间的距离缩短。这个相信没有病。
zh: 我希望把想象与现实之间的距离缩短。这个相信没有病。
en: I want to close the gap between imagination and reality. I still believe in that.

source_text: 但我开始在意，工作让我能工具能让我做的更多的同时， 有没有让我更能了解自己在想做什么？
zh: 但我开始在意，工作让我能工具能让我做的更多的同时， 有没有让我更能了解自己在想做什么？
en: But I’ve started to wonder: as tools let me do more, do they also help me better understand what I actually want to do?

source_text: 还是我们只是盲目的追赶别人的速度？
zh: 还是我们只是盲目的追赶别人的速度？
en: Or are we just blindly trying to keep up with everyone else?

source_text: 今天我想跟大家讲的，不是应不应该用AI，也不是慢一定比快好，而是当我们什么都能做，还知道自己想做什么吗？
zh: 今天我想跟大家讲的，不是应不应该用AI，也不是慢一定比快好，而是当我们什么都能做，还知道自己想做什么吗？
en: What I want to talk about today isn’t whether we should use AI, or whether slower is always better than faster. It’s this: when we can do anything, do we still know what we want to do?

source_text: 以及在这些越来越强的工具旁边，我们要怎么才能继续长出自己的判断，自己的在乎和自己的生活？
zh: 以及在这些越来越强的工具旁边，我们要怎么才能继续长出自己的判断，自己的在乎和自己的生活？
en: And as these tools grow more powerful, how do we keep developing our own judgment, stay connected to what matters to us, and build lives of our own?

source_text: 一，当做事变成证明之前。
zh: 一，当做事变成证明之前。
en: First, before doing things became a way to prove ourselves.

source_text: 这种焦虑，有很大一部分来自我们太习惯用自己能做什么来证明自己是谁。
zh: 这种焦虑，有很大一部分来自我们太习惯用自己能做什么来证明自己是谁。
en: Much of this anxiety comes from being so used to proving who we are through what we can do.

source_text: 我是设计师，因为我懂设计。
zh: 我是设计师，因为我懂设计。
en: I’m a designer because I understand design.

source_text: 我是工程师，因为我能手敲代码。
zh: 我是工程师，因为我能手敲代码。
en: I’m an engineer because I can write code by hand.

source_text: 所以当机器也能做到的时候，不安就不只是关于工作。
zh: 所以当机器也能做到的时候，不安就不只是关于工作。
en: So when machines can do those things too, the unease isn’t just about work.

source_text: 还有一个比较私人的问题。如果我做的事情不再特别，那我特别在哪里？
zh: 还有一个比较私人的问题。如果我做的事情不再特别，那我特别在哪里？
en: There’s also a more personal question: If what I do is no longer special, what makes me special?

source_text: 我没有一个很漂亮的答案，但我会想起，在这些东西变成工作之前，我跟电脑是什么关系？
zh: 我没有一个很漂亮的答案，但我会想起，在这些东西变成工作之前，我跟电脑是什么关系？
en: I don’t have a neat answer. But I think back to what my relationship with computers was like before any of this became work.

source_text: 我小的时候搬到加拿大，看到那台荧幕浮在半空中的苹果电脑，我觉得，怎么可能有这么漂亮的东西？
zh: 我小的时候搬到加拿大，看到那台荧幕浮在半空中的苹果电脑，我觉得，怎么可能有这么漂亮的东西？
en: When I moved to Canada as a kid, I saw one of those Apple computers with a screen that seemed to float in midair. I thought, how could something be so beautiful?

source_text: 我当时买不起，就把自己的电脑改得像它，换图标，换字体，研究那些让人想舔的按钮怎么做。
zh: 我当时买不起，就把自己的电脑改得像它，换图标，换字体，研究那些让人想舔的按钮怎么做。
en: I couldn’t afford one, so I made my own computer look like it—changing the icons and fonts, and figuring out how to make those buttons that looked good enough to lick.

source_text: 我不是先想成为设计师才做这些事，我只是喜欢，好奇，想靠近一点，想看看自己能不能也做出那种感觉。
zh: 我不是先想成为设计师才做这些事，我只是喜欢，好奇，想靠近一点，想看看自己能不能也做出那种感觉。
en: I didn’t do those things because I’d decided to become a designer. I just loved it. I was curious. I wanted to get closer and see if I could create that same feeling myself.

source_text: 后来喜欢真的变成了工作，这很幸运。
zh: 后来喜欢真的变成了工作，这很幸运。
en: Eventually, what I loved became my job. I was lucky.

source_text: 可以靠自己的在意的事情工作、生活，也可以遇到一群同样在意的人。
zh: 可以靠自己的在意的事情工作、生活，也可以遇到一群同样在意的人。
en: I got to build a career and a life around something I cared about, and meet people who cared about it just as much.

source_text: 但慢慢的，好奇变成规划，游戏变成产出，品味变成了你必须替别人负责做出的决定。
zh: 但慢慢的，好奇变成规划，游戏变成产出，品味变成了你必须替别人负责做出的决定。
en: But slowly, curiosity turned into planning, play turned into output, and taste turned into decisions you had to make on someone else’s behalf.

source_text: 你越来越能回答，这有没有价值，什么时候能上线。
zh: 你越来越能回答，这有没有价值，什么时候能上线。
en: You get better and better at answering: Is this valuable? When can we launch it?

source_text: 却还不一定还记得，当没有人需要你做这些事的时候，你为什么已经想做了？
zh: 却还不一定还记得，当没有人需要你做这些事的时候，你为什么已经想做了？
en: But you might no longer remember why you wanted to do it in the first place, back when no one was asking you to.

source_text: 我不想用机器永远不会有某种能力来安慰自己，因为这个界限一直在变。我比较想保留的是我跟做东西这件事情的关系。
zh: 我不想用机器永远不会有某种能力来安慰自己，因为这个界限一直在变。我比较想保留的是我跟做东西这件事情的关系。
en: I don’t want to comfort myself by saying machines will never be able to do certain things, because that line keeps moving. What I’d rather hold on to is my relationship with making things.

source_text: 不必先证明自己做得比谁好，才有资格继续喜欢做东西。
zh: 不必先证明自己做得比谁好，才有资格继续喜欢做东西。
en: You don’t have to prove you’re better than anyone else to keep loving making things.

source_text: 就算机器可以很快做出10个版本，我还是可以在其中一个地方停下来，觉得这里不对，想自己亲手改一下。
zh: 就算机器可以很快做出10个版本，我还是可以在其中一个地方停下来，觉得这里不对，想自己亲手改一下。
en: Even if a machine can make ten versions in no time, I can still pause at one detail, feel that something isn’t quite right, and want to change it with my own hands.

source_text: 那个感觉不一定立刻说得清楚，但它可能比我应该做的更多、更接近我想真正做的事。
zh: 那个感觉不一定立刻说得清楚，但它可能比我应该做的更多、更接近我想真正做的事。
en: I might not be able to put that feeling into words right away, but it may bring me closer to what I truly want to make than asking myself what more I should be doing.

source_text: 但现在的问题是，工具会不会太快把这整个过程跳过了？
zh: 但现在的问题是，工具会不会太快把这整个过程跳过了？
en: But the question now is: will the tools move so fast that they skip over this whole process?

source_text: 二，答案很完整，不代表我真的想过。
zh: 二，答案很完整，不代表我真的想过。
en: Second, having a complete answer doesn’t mean I’ve actually thought it through.

source_text: 我想用一个很小的例子。
zh: 我想用一个很小的例子。
en: I’d like to use a small example.

source_text: 假设我说，帮我做一个记下生活的工具，等了2分钟，Groppa回答，做好了请过目。
zh: 假设我说，帮我做一个记下生活的工具，等了2分钟，Groppa回答，做好了请过目。
en: Suppose I say, “Make me a tool for recording my life.” Two minutes later, Groppa replies, “Done—take a look.”

source_text: 然后它给我这个，还会解释为什么需要这些功能，心情分数可以看到趋势，每天提醒可以养成习惯，每周报告可以帮助反思。
zh: 然后它给我这个，还会解释为什么需要这些功能，心情分数可以看到趋势，每天提醒可以养成习惯，每周报告可以帮助反思。
en: Then it shows me the tool and explains why it included those features: a mood score to track trends, daily reminders to build a habit, and a weekly report to help me reflect.

source_text: 听起来都很有道理。
zh: 听起来都很有道理。
en: It all sounds perfectly reasonable.

source_text: 我可能就说，
zh: 我可能就说，
en: I might just say,

source_text: 哦，那好吧就这样。
zh: 哦，那好吧就这样。
en: Oh, okay, let’s go with that.

source_text: 但等一下，
zh: 但等一下，
en: But wait,

source_text: 我有真的想过，为什么我的生活需要被打分数吗？
zh: 我有真的想过，为什么我的生活需要被打分数吗？
en: Have I really thought about why my life needs to be rated?

source_text: 我有决定过每天都写，
zh: 我有决定过每天都写，
en: Did I ever decide I wanted to write every day?

source_text: 才算好好记录吗？
zh: 才算好好记录吗？
en: Is that the only way to properly document my life?

source_text: 还是因为它把理由写得很完整，看过别人怎么做，我就把那份完整当成我自己已经理解了？
zh: 还是因为它把理由写得很完整，看过别人怎么做，我就把那份完整当成我自己已经理解了？
en: Or is it just that the reasons were laid out so thoroughly, and after seeing how others do it, I mistook that thoroughness for my own understanding?

source_text: 这是我有点担心的地方。
zh: 这是我有点担心的地方。
en: That’s what worries me a little.

source_text: 有时候，我不是先形成自己的想法再请工具帮忙，而是先看它怎么说，然后发现我找不到反对的理由，就直接用了。
zh: 有时候，我不是先形成自己的想法再请工具帮忙，而是先看它怎么说，然后发现我找不到反对的理由，就直接用了。
en: Sometimes, instead of forming my own opinion first and then asking the tool for help, I see what it says, can’t find a reason to disagree, and just go with it.

source_text: 这不代表那个答案一定是错的，它甚至比我原来想象的还好。
zh: 这不代表那个答案一定是错的，它甚至比我原来想象的还好。
en: That doesn’t mean the answer is necessarily wrong. It might even be better than what I had in mind.

source_text: 但如果每次都这样，我很有可能会判断一句话听起来合不合理，却越来越少练习，从我自己的经验出发，想一遍问题。
zh: 但如果每次都这样，我很有可能会判断一句话听起来合不合理，却越来越少练习，从我自己的经验出发，想一遍问题。
en: But if I do that every time, I might get better at judging whether something sounds reasonable while getting less and less practice thinking through the question for myself, based on my own experience.

source_text: 答案完成了，不代表我的思考也完成了。
zh: 答案完成了，不代表我的思考也完成了。
en: Having an answer doesn’t mean I’ve finished thinking it through.

source_text: 我们很容易注意到明显的错误，但比较难注意到的，是那些被完整答案盖过去，还没有机会形成的问题。
zh: 我们很容易注意到明显的错误，但比较难注意到的，是那些被完整答案盖过去，还没有机会形成的问题。
en: It’s easy to spot obvious mistakes. What’s harder to notice are the questions we haven’t had a chance to form because a polished answer came first.

source_text: 所以我想请大家玩一个小游戏。
zh: 所以我想请大家玩一个小游戏。
en: So I’d like to invite everyone to play a little game.

source_text: 看着这个画面，先不要问它还缺什么功能，心情分数连续记录天数，每天提醒，每周报告，如果是你，有哪一样最想去掉？
zh: 看着这个画面，先不要问它还缺什么功能，心情分数连续记录天数，每天提醒，每周报告，如果是你，有哪一样最想去掉？
en: Looking at this screen, don’t ask what features it still needs—mood scores, a streak counter, daily reminders, weekly reports. If it were up to you, which one would you most want to remove?

source_text: 心情分数想去掉的请举手。
zh: 心情分数想去掉的请举手。
en: Raise your hand if you’d get rid of the mood score.

source_text: 连续记录天数。
zh: 连续记录天数。
en: The streak counter.

source_text: 每天提醒。
zh: 每天提醒。
en: Daily reminders.

source_text: 然后每周报告。
zh: 然后每周报告。
en: And the weekly report.

source_text: 我自己可能想要拿掉连续天数，
zh: 我自己可能想要拿掉连续天数，
en: I’d probably get rid of the streak counter myself.

source_text: 每日提醒，每周报告，因为我不想有一天没写，觉得自己欠了点什么。
zh: 每日提醒，每周报告，因为我不想有一天没写，觉得自己欠了点什么。
en: Daily reminders and weekly reports—because I don’t want to miss a day and feel like I owe something.

source_text: 我想留下生活，不是替生活添加一份作业，但有可能你恰好相反，
zh: 我想留下生活，不是替生活添加一份作业，但有可能你恰好相反，
en: I want to capture my life, not give myself another assignment. But you might feel the exact opposite.

source_text: 你需要的就是那个提醒，或者那条记录对你很重要。
zh: 你需要的就是那个提醒，或者那条记录对你很重要。
en: Maybe you need that reminder, or keeping a streak really matters to you.

source_text: 甚至说整个都是错的，
zh: 甚至说整个都是错的，
en: You might even think the whole thing is wrong.

source_text: 你想要的是一个无尽的画布，可以随意摆放记忆和生活的点滴。这里没有标准答案。
zh: 你想要的是一个无尽的画布，可以随意摆放记忆和生活的点滴。这里没有标准答案。
en: What you want is an endless canvas where you can arrange memories and moments from your life however you like. There’s no right answer.

source_text: 刚刚我们只是停了一下，
zh: 刚刚我们只是停了一下，
en: We just paused for a moment.

source_text: 但不是什么都没做。
zh: 但不是什么都没做。
en: But that doesn’t mean we did nothing.

source_text: 我们挑出一个决定，发现自己对它有一点感觉，然后开始说得出为什么。
zh: 我们挑出一个决定，发现自己对它有一点感觉，然后开始说得出为什么。
en: We picked one decision, noticed how we felt about it, and began to put into words why.

source_text: 那个原本模糊的"我想记录生活"，到这里才开始有一点自己的形状。
zh: 那个原本模糊的"我想记录生活"，到这里才开始有一点自己的形状。
en: That vague desire to “document my life” is only now beginning to take a shape of its own.

source_text: 知道自己想要什么，不一定是动手的前提，也可以是动手之后，慢慢出现的结果。
zh: 知道自己想要什么，不一定是动手的前提，也可以是动手之后，慢慢出现的结果。
en: You don’t always have to know what you want before you begin. Sometimes you figure it out along the way.

source_text: 三，一个服务窗口和一张工作台。
zh: 三，一个服务窗口和一张工作台。
en: Three: a service counter and a workbench.

source_text: 那么工具可以怎么帮助我们？
zh: 那么工具可以怎么帮助我们？
en: So how can tools help us?

source_text: 我不希望的答案是，每次用之前都要自己苦想一遍，不然就是偷懒。
zh: 我不希望的答案是，每次用之前都要自己苦想一遍，不然就是偷懒。
en: What I don’t want to hear is that I have to rack my brain every time before using a tool, or else I’m just being lazy.

source_text: 有些事情我是真的想交出去，把资料搬好，把格式转好，不需要每次都上一堂课。
zh: 有些事情我是真的想交出去，把资料搬好，把格式转好，不需要每次都上一堂课。
en: There are things I genuinely want to hand off—organizing the materials, converting the format. I don’t need a lesson every time.

source_text: 但有些事情，我还没有想清楚，我需要的不是机器替我关上问题，而是有工具让我继续探索。
zh: 但有些事情，我还没有想清楚，我需要的不是机器替我关上问题，而是有工具让我继续探索。
en: But some things I haven’t figured out yet. I don’t need a machine to settle those questions for me; I need tools that help me keep exploring.

source_text: 我想用两个画面来比较。
zh: 我想用两个画面来比较。
en: I want to compare two scenes.

source_text: 左边像一个服务窗口，它处理完给我一个新的版本。如果刚好很好，那很棒，我直接用。
zh: 左边像一个服务窗口，它处理完给我一个新的版本。如果刚好很好，那很棒，我直接用。
en: On the left is something like a service counter: it processes my request and gives me a new version. If it’s just right, great—I’ll use it as is.

source_text: 但如果它拿掉了我喜欢的提醒，
zh: 但如果它拿掉了我喜欢的提醒，
en: But if it removes a reminder I liked,

source_text: 改掉了设计，我就得再解释一次，哪里要留，哪里不要。
zh: 改掉了设计，我就得再解释一次，哪里要留，哪里不要。
en: or changes the design, I have to explain all over again what to keep and what to leave out.

source_text: 如果我面前只有成品，就很容易只剩下接受、拒绝、再说一次。
zh: 如果我面前只有成品，就很容易只剩下接受、拒绝、再说一次。
en: If all I have in front of me is the finished product, my options quickly narrow to accepting it, rejecting it, or explaining myself all over again.

source_text: 右面更像一张工作台，同样一句话，我可以看见它打算改什么，要删掉什么功能，或者它想给你什么建议。
zh: 右面更像一张工作台，同样一句话，我可以看见它打算改什么，要删掉什么功能，或者它想给你什么建议。
en: On the right, it’s more like a workbench. From the same request, I can see what it plans to change, which features it wants to remove, and what suggestions it has for me.

source_text: 我看到才发现，等一等，可能提醒要留着，我也可以在它开始动作之前介入这个计划。
zh: 我看到才发现，等一等，可能提醒要留着，我也可以在它开始动作之前介入这个计划。
en: Once I see the plan, I might realize, “Wait, maybe I want to keep that reminder.” I can step in before it makes any changes.

source_text: 在它完成之后，用实时预览微调。
zh: 在它完成之后，用实时预览微调。
en: After it’s done, I can fine-tune it using a live preview.

source_text: 这个差别不只是右面多了几个按钮，而是我可以接触我正在改变的东西，我不必一直站在外面等待一个答案。
zh: 这个差别不只是右面多了几个按钮，而是我可以接触我正在改变的东西，我不必一直站在外面等待一个答案。
en: The difference isn’t just that the one on the right has a few extra buttons. I can interact with what I’m changing instead of standing outside, waiting for an answer.

source_text: 有时候可能是看到它准备删除提醒，我才知道我自己想要保留。
zh: 有时候可能是看到它准备删除提醒，我才知道我自己想要保留。
en: Sometimes it’s only when I see that it’s about to remove a reminder that I realize I want to keep it.

source_text: 有时候可能是我要放进去自己的设计，才知道那个layout不适合我。
zh: 有时候可能是我要放进去自己的设计，才知道那个layout不适合我。
en: Sometimes I only realize the layout doesn’t work for me when I try to add my own design.

source_text: 或者我自己想清楚之后，再开始执行。
zh: 或者我自己想清楚之后，再开始执行。
en: Or I can take time to figure out what I want before making any changes.

source_text: 工具让我更容易碰到自己的想法，而不是要求我一开始就要把想法说得完美。
zh: 工具让我更容易碰到自己的想法，而不是要求我一开始就要把想法说得完美。
en: The tool helps me explore my ideas instead of expecting me to express them perfectly from the start.

source_text: 这也是我做软件工具的时候，为什么我会在意档案、
zh: 这也是我做软件工具的时候，为什么我会在意档案、
en: That’s also why, when I build software tools, I care about files,

source_text: 规划、编辑、修改前后的差异和人可以随时介入的入口。
zh: 规划、编辑、修改前后的差异和人可以随时介入的入口。
en: planning, editing, before-and-after comparisons, and ways for people to step in at any point.

source_text: 不是每个人都应该阅读每一行代码，也不是把所有细节摊开才叫透明。
zh: 不是每个人都应该阅读每一行代码，也不是把所有细节摊开才叫透明。
en: Not everyone needs to read every line of code, and transparency doesn’t mean laying out every detail.

source_text: 重要的是，我想理解的时候，有路可以进去。 我想改的时候，有地方可以动手。
zh: 重要的是，我想理解的时候，有路可以进去。 我想改的时候，有地方可以动手。
en: What matters is that when I want to understand something, there’s a way in. And when I want to change it, there’s a place to start.

source_text: 聊天也可以是工作台的一部分。
zh: 聊天也可以是工作台的一部分。
en: Chat can be part of the workspace, too.

source_text: 我不想要把某一种界面、某一个品牌永远归类到一边。
zh: 我不想要把某一种界面、某一个品牌永远归类到一边。
en: I don’t want to permanently put any particular interface or brand in one camp.

source_text: 我想比较的是，在这个任务里，我能不能只改一部分，能不能理解关键的决定，能不能把方向拿回来。这个界面，能不能让我有思考和探索的自由。
zh: 我想比较的是，在这个任务里，我能不能只改一部分，能不能理解关键的决定，能不能把方向拿回来。这个界面，能不能让我有思考和探索的自由。
en: What I want to compare is whether, for this task, I can change just one part, understand the key decisions, and take back control of the direction. Does this interface give me the freedom to think and explore?

source_text: 我希望工具能让我更加参与，而不是证明我越来越不需要参与。
zh: 我希望工具能让我更加参与，而不是证明我越来越不需要参与。
en: I want tools to help me be more involved, not prove that I’m needed less and less.

source_text: 如果你也在做工具，我可以，我建议可以从三个很小的点开始：一，
zh: 如果你也在做工具，我可以，我建议可以从三个很小的点开始：一，
en: If you’re building tools too, I’d suggest starting with three small things. First,

source_text: 让重要的假设看得见；让一次修改小到可以放心试；让交出去的工作在需要的时候可以拿回来；二，不是每一步都加确认按钮，
zh: 让重要的假设看得见；让一次修改小到可以放心试；让交出去的工作在需要的时候可以拿回来；二，不是每一步都加确认按钮，
en: Make the important assumptions visible. Make each change small enough to try with confidence. Make it possible to take back work you’ve handed off when you need to. Second, don’t add a confirmation button to every step.

source_text: 而是让使用者知道它不是只有接受或拒绝整个答案这两种选择。
zh: 而是让使用者知道它不是只有接受或拒绝整个答案这两种选择。
en: Instead, let users know they have options beyond accepting or rejecting the entire answer.

source_text: 三，好的工具应该拿掉的是阻碍，不是顺便拿掉人形成判断的过程。
zh: 三，好的工具应该拿掉的是阻碍，不是顺便拿掉人形成判断的过程。
en: Third, a good tool should remove obstacles, not the process by which people form their own judgments.

source_text: 四，工具一直在那里，不代表一直要用。
zh: 四，工具一直在那里，不代表一直要用。
en: Fourth, just because a tool is always there doesn’t mean you always have to use it.

source_text: 就算有一张很棒的工作台，我们也不一定一直永远坐在前面。
zh: 就算有一张很棒的工作台，我们也不一定一直永远坐在前面。
en: Even with a great workbench, we don’t have to sit at it all the time.

source_text: 我们人类其实还在探索跟AI之间应该有什么关系。
zh: 我们人类其实还在探索跟AI之间应该有什么关系。
en: We humans are still figuring out what our relationship with AI should be.

source_text: 它可以帮我想，也可以让我比较少自己想。
zh: 它可以帮我想，也可以让我比较少自己想。
en: It can help me think, but it can also make me think less for myself.

source_text: 它可以替我省下时间，也可以让我有更多理由把剩下来的时间重新填满。
zh: 它可以替我省下时间，也可以让我有更多理由把剩下来的时间重新填满。
en: It can save me time, but it can also give me more reasons to fill that time right back up.

source_text: 所以光是工具变强，还不足以回答我应该怎么用它。
zh: 所以光是工具变强，还不足以回答我应该怎么用它。
en: So simply making the tool more powerful doesn’t answer how I should use it.

source_text: 就像我们有了email，不代表任何时间、任何事情都要寄一封信。
zh: 就像我们有了email，不代表任何时间、任何事情都要寄一封信。
en: Just because we have email doesn’t mean we need to send one for everything, at any time.

source_text: 有的事情适合写下来，有的事情适合当面讲，有的事情不需要立刻回复。
zh: 有的事情适合写下来，有的事情适合当面讲，有的事情不需要立刻回复。
en: Some things are best put in writing, some are best discussed face-to-face, and some don’t need an immediate reply.

source_text: 也有些事，根本不需要多发那一封信。
zh: 也有些事，根本不需要多发那一封信。
en: And some things don’t need another email at all.

source_text: 工具一直在那里，但什么时候用，用它做什么，还是需要我们自己来选。
zh: 工具一直在那里，但什么时候用，用它做什么，还是需要我们自己来选。
en: The tool is always there, but it’s still up to us to decide when to use it and what to use it for.

source_text: AI也是一样。
zh: AI也是一样。
en: The same goes for AI.

source_text: 有时候我就是要它快一点，
zh: 有时候我就是要它快一点，
en: Sometimes I just want it to be faster,

source_text: 帮我整理复杂的工作。
zh: 帮我整理复杂的工作。
en: to help me organize complex work.

source_text: 有时候我可能想要先自己写几句，不知道怎么好，但是想看看脑子里原来还剩下什么。
zh: 有时候我可能想要先自己写几句，不知道怎么好，但是想看看脑子里原来还剩下什么。
en: Other times, I might want to write a few lines myself first. I may not know how to put it, but I want to see what ideas I still have in my head.

source_text: 有时候我需要的不是再多一份分析，而是去跟那个人去茶馆真正聊一次天。
zh: 有时候我需要的不是再多一份分析，而是去跟那个人去茶馆真正聊一次天。
en: Sometimes what I need isn’t another analysis, but to sit down with that person at a teahouse and really talk.

source_text: 这些不是谁比较高尚，而是我想保有选择不同的理由。
zh: 这些不是谁比较高尚，而是我想保有选择不同的理由。
en: It’s not that one choice is more virtuous than another. I just want to keep the freedom to choose differently, for different reasons.

source_text: 我离开旧金山，搬到台北，也有一部分在练习这件事。
zh: 我离开旧金山，搬到台北，也有一部分在练习这件事。
en: Moving from San Francisco to Taipei was, in part, my way of practicing that.

source_text: 不是不想做东西了，而是不希望生活里的每一件事最后都只能用它对工作有没有帮助来解释。
zh: 不是不想做东西了，而是不希望生活里的每一件事最后都只能用它对工作有没有帮助来解释。
en: It’s not that I don’t want to make things anymore. I just don’t want everything in my life to be measured by whether it helps my work.

source_text: 离开熟悉的节奏以后，我也没有立刻变得很笃定。
zh: 离开熟悉的节奏以后，我也没有立刻变得很笃定。
en: After leaving behind the rhythm I was used to, I didn’t suddenly become sure of myself.

source_text: 日程空下来，反而每天要自己回答今天想做什么。
zh: 日程空下来，反而每天要自己回答今天想做什么。
en: Once my schedule opened up, I had to decide for myself each day what I wanted to do.

source_text: 如果不靠自己的工作介绍自己，那我又是谁？
zh: 如果不靠自己的工作介绍自己，那我又是谁？
en: If I don’t define myself by my work, then who am I?

source_text: 但我开始觉得，那些没有立刻变成产出的时间也不是浪费。
zh: 但我开始觉得，那些没有立刻变成产出的时间也不是浪费。
en: But I’m beginning to feel that time doesn’t have to produce something right away to be worthwhile.

source_text: 一段谈话，一条没有走过的路，一首反复听的歌，都可能让我注意到原来我还在乎这件事。
zh: 一段谈话，一条没有走过的路，一首反复听的歌，都可能让我注意到原来我还在乎这件事。
en: A conversation, a road I’ve never taken, a song I keep listening to—any of them might remind me that I still care about something.

source_text: 原来我还拥有属于自己的感受。
zh: 原来我还拥有属于自己的感受。
en: I still have feelings of my own.

source_text: 生活不是创作的竞争对手，不是把生活压缩掉就能把创作留下来。
zh: 生活不是创作的竞争对手，不是把生活压缩掉就能把创作留下来。
en: Life isn’t in competition with creating things. You can’t preserve your creativity by squeezing the rest of your life out.

source_text: 生活是让我有东西想做的来源。
zh: 生活是让我有东西想做的来源。
en: Life is what gives me things I want to create.

source_text: 所以如果要说，我希望这些工具最后能带来什么，比起最大化产出，我更想说是让我们更有时间去关心他人，和我们生活的这个世界。
zh: 所以如果要说，我希望这些工具最后能带来什么，比起最大化产出，我更想说是让我们更有时间去关心他人，和我们生活的这个世界。
en: So if you ask what I ultimately hope these tools will bring, it’s not maximum productivity. It’s more time to care for one another and for the world we live in.

source_text: 不是把关心也要变成一个要求最高分的指标，而是真的花时间、花注意力，留意眼前的人，有余裕理解一个自己还没有懂的问题。
zh: 不是把关心也要变成一个要求最高分的指标，而是真的花时间、花注意力，留意眼前的人，有余裕理解一个自己还没有懂的问题。
en: Not turning care into yet another metric to maximize, but actually giving our time and attention to the people in front of us, and having the space to understand a question we don’t yet have an answer to.

source_text: 也有能力对在乎的事情做点什么。
zh: 也有能力对在乎的事情做点什么。
en: And being able to do something about the things we care about.

source_text: 五，不是各自变强，而是一同演奏。
zh: 五，不是各自变强，而是一同演奏。
en: Fifth, it’s not about each of us becoming stronger on our own, but about playing together.

source_text: 关心世界，也包括让另一个人真的进到我的想法里。
zh: 关心世界，也包括让另一个人真的进到我的想法里。
en: Caring about the world also means letting someone else into my thoughts.

source_text: 回到刚才的日记工具，我们已经改了一个决定，但它现在变得更像我想要的，不代表就是你想要的。
zh: 回到刚才的日记工具，我们已经改了一个决定，但它现在变得更像我想要的，不代表就是你想要的。
en: Coming back to the journaling tool, we’ve already changed one decision. But the fact that it’s now closer to what I want doesn’t mean it’s what you want.

source_text: 它变成了一个简洁的每天一页，没有任何冗余的功能。
zh: 它变成了一个简洁的每天一页，没有任何冗余的功能。
en: It became a simple one-page-a-day journal, with no unnecessary features.

source_text: 但它也可以像是手杖，是无边际的画布，记忆的自由片段。
zh: 但它也可以像是手杖，是无边际的画布，记忆的自由片段。
en: But it could also be a walking stick, a boundless canvas, a collection of free-floating fragments of memory.

source_text: 这两种如果是你，会比较想用哪一个？
zh: 这两种如果是你，会比较想用哪一个？
en: Which of the two would you rather use?

source_text: 每天一页可能会让你更容易回到某一天，自由片段可能让你更容易把不同时间的东西放在一起。
zh: 每天一页可能会让你更容易回到某一天，自由片段可能让你更容易把不同时间的东西放在一起。
en: One page a day might make it easier to revisit a particular day, while free-form fragments might make it easier to bring together things from different times.

source_text: 我们其实不需要选出一个答案，可以把两个版本都留下来，甚至整合在一起，然后再找一个跟自己选的不一样的人问问为什么。
zh: 我们其实不需要选出一个答案，可以把两个版本都留下来，甚至整合在一起，然后再找一个跟自己选的不一样的人问问为什么。
en: We don’t actually have to choose one answer. We could keep both versions, or even combine them, then ask someone who chose differently why they made that choice.

source_text: 这个时候，做出来的东西不只是一个成果，也是我们理解彼此的材料。
zh: 这个时候，做出来的东西不只是一个成果，也是我们理解彼此的材料。
en: At that point, what we create isn’t just a finished product; it’s also a way for us to understand each other.

source_text: 光说"我想记录生活"，我们可能以为自己在说同一件事，但看到这两种形状，才知道原来我们想留下来的东西不太一样。
zh: 光说"我想记录生活"，我们可能以为自己在说同一件事，但看到这两种形状，才知道原来我们想留下来的东西不太一样。
en: If we just say, “I want to record my life,” we might think we mean the same thing. But seeing these two forms makes us realize that what we want to hold on to isn’t quite the same.

source_text: 我工作里的很多判断也是这样形成的，不是自己坐着想通，而是有人用过觉得奇怪，有人在我认为不重要的地方坚持，有人把我很确定的东西拆开，我才知道自己漏看了什么。
zh: 我工作里的很多判断也是这样形成的，不是自己坐着想通，而是有人用过觉得奇怪，有人在我认为不重要的地方坚持，有人把我很确定的东西拆开，我才知道自己漏看了什么。
en: A lot of the judgments I make at work take shape this way too. I don’t arrive at them by sitting alone and thinking things through. Someone tries something and finds it odd; someone insists on a detail I thought didn’t matter; someone picks apart an idea I was sure about. That’s when I realize what I’ve overlooked.

source_text: 这个过程不总是舒服，跟人一起做事会误会，会不同意，会要道歉，再试一次。
zh: 这个过程不总是舒服，跟人一起做事会误会，会不同意，会要道歉，再试一次。
en: The process isn’t always comfortable. Working with others means misunderstandings, disagreements, having to apologize, and trying again.

source_text: 但我很多珍惜的关系，也是在这里开始的。
zh: 但我很多珍惜的关系，也是在这里开始的。
en: But many of the relationships I cherish began there, too.

source_text: 有人看过我不懂、出错、很累，也有人看过我真正兴奋的样子，慢慢地，我们知道谁会注意到自己漏掉的地方，谁可以把一个念头拆开，却不把它弄死。
zh: 有人看过我不懂、出错、很累，也有人看过我真正兴奋的样子，慢慢地，我们知道谁会注意到自己漏掉的地方，谁可以把一个念头拆开，却不把它弄死。
en: Some people have seen me confused, making mistakes, or exhausted; others have seen what I’m like when I’m genuinely excited. Over time, we come to know who will spot what we’ve missed, and who can take an idea apart without killing it.

source_text: 像一个爵士乐团，不是每个人弹最多的音符，也不是每个人都抢着证明自己是最厉害的。
zh: 像一个爵士乐团，不是每个人弹最多的音符，也不是每个人都抢着证明自己是最厉害的。
en: It’s like a jazz band: no one is trying to play the most notes or prove they’re the best.

source_text: 有一个人带着旋律，有人先听，留一点空间，再接进来。
zh: 有一个人带着旋律，有人先听，留一点空间，再接进来。
en: One person carries the melody; someone else listens first, leaves a little space, then joins in.

source_text: 偶尔失去节奏，就听着彼此，慢慢找回来。
zh: 偶尔失去节奏，就听着彼此，慢慢找回来。
en: When we lose the rhythm now and then, we listen to one another and gradually find our way back.

source_text: 最后出现的东西，不是任何一个人事先想好的，也不是任何一个人能做出来的。
zh: 最后出现的东西，不是任何一个人事先想好的，也不是任何一个人能做出来的。
en: What emerges in the end isn’t something any one person planned in advance, or something any one person could have made alone.

source_text: AI很方便，很有耐心，也常常比跟一个人沟通来得容易。这种容易有的时候真的帮助到我，我不想否定它。
zh: AI很方便，很有耐心，也常常比跟一个人沟通来得容易。这种容易有的时候真的帮助到我，我不想否定它。
en: AI is convenient and patient, and talking to it is often easier than talking to another person. Sometimes that ease genuinely helps me, and I don’t want to dismiss it.

source_text: 但如果我永远都选择最容易回应我的对象，我也会担心自己是不是慢慢失去了跟另一个不一样的人建立默契的机会。
zh: 但如果我永远都选择最容易回应我的对象，我也会担心自己是不是慢慢失去了跟另一个不一样的人建立默契的机会。
en: But if I always choose whoever is easiest to talk to, I worry I might slowly lose the chance to build a connection with someone who sees things differently.

source_text: 所以我希望工具不只是把每个人关进一个更有效率的小世界，我不想要一个更会回应我的世界。
zh: 所以我希望工具不只是把每个人关进一个更有效率的小世界，我不想要一个更会回应我的世界。
en: So I hope these tools won’t just shut each of us inside a more efficient little world. I don’t want a world that’s simply better at responding to me.

source_text: 我想保留一个能让我改变的世界。
zh: 我想保留一个能让我改变的世界。
en: I want to preserve a world that can change me.

source_text: 工具让我一个人能不能做的事情，变得做得到，而其他人让我原本想不到的事情，变成可能。
zh: 工具让我一个人能不能做的事情，变得做得到，而其他人让我原本想不到的事情，变成可能。
en: Tools make it possible for me to do things I couldn’t do alone. Other people make possible things I couldn’t even have imagined.

source_text: 周末，不是先知道自己是谁，再开始做。
zh: 周末，不是先知道自己是谁，再开始做。
en: On weekends, you don’t have to know who you are before you begin.

source_text: 所以回到今天的问题，当我们什么都能做，还知道自己想做什么吗？
zh: 所以回到今天的问题，当我们什么都能做，还知道自己想做什么吗？
en: So, back to today’s question: when we can do anything, do we still know what we want to do?

source_text: 我的答案还是不一定。
zh: 我的答案还是不一定。
en: My answer is still: not necessarily.

source_text: 但现在，我不觉得这代表我们一定缺少什么。
zh: 但现在，我不觉得这代表我们一定缺少什么。
en: But now, I don’t think that necessarily means we’re missing something.

source_text: 也不代表我们一定要先找到一个宏大的使命才能开始。
zh: 也不代表我们一定要先找到一个宏大的使命才能开始。
en: Nor does it mean we have to find some grand purpose before we can begin.

source_text: 有时候，所谓找到自己，不是突然得到一个很清楚的自我介绍，而是在每一次小小的选择里发现，原来我在乎的是这个。
zh: 有时候，所谓找到自己，不是突然得到一个很清楚的自我介绍，而是在每一次小小的选择里发现，原来我在乎的是这个。
en: Sometimes, “finding yourself” doesn’t mean suddenly having a clear answer to who you are. It means discovering, through each small choice, “Oh, this is what matters to me.”

source_text: 这个我不想要照单全收。
zh: 这个我不想要照单全收。
en: I don’t want to just accept all of this without question.

source_text: 这件事，我愿意再多花一点时间。
zh: 这件事，我愿意再多花一点时间。
en: This is something I’m willing to spend a little more time on.

source_text: 就像我们刚才没有先写完一份PRD，只是看着一个版本，觉得它哪里不对，动手改了一下，才知道自己想要什么。
zh: 就像我们刚才没有先写完一份PRD，只是看着一个版本，觉得它哪里不对，动手改了一下，才知道自己想要什么。
en: Just like earlier, we didn’t write a full PRD first. We looked at a version, noticed what felt off, made a change, and only then figured out what we wanted.

source_text: 做东西，不只是把已经想好的自己表达出来，它也会让你遇见原来那个不知道的自己。
zh: 做东西，不只是把已经想好的自己表达出来，它也会让你遇见原来那个不知道的自己。
en: Making something isn’t just a way to express the self you already know. It can also help you discover a side of yourself you didn’t know was there.

source_text: 所以，找到自己和超越自己，对我来说不是相反的事。
zh: 所以，找到自己和超越自己，对我来说不是相反的事。
en: So, to me, finding yourself and going beyond yourself aren’t opposites.

source_text: 你在做事的过程里，更知道自己在乎什么，也因为工具和其他人有机会走到原来走不到的地方。
zh: 你在做事的过程里，更知道自己在乎什么，也因为工具和其他人有机会走到原来走不到的地方。
en: As you work, you come to understand what matters to you—and with the help of tools and other people, you can go places you couldn’t have reached before.

source_text: 那不是每天都要比昨天产出更多，也不是把自己变成一个永远需要升级的产品。
zh: 那不是每天都要比昨天产出更多，也不是把自己变成一个永远需要升级的产品。
en: That doesn’t mean producing more every day than you did yesterday, or treating yourself like a product that constantly needs upgrading.

source_text: 它也许只是，以前你只能接受的地方，现在可以修改。
zh: 它也许只是，以前你只能接受的地方，现在可以修改。
en: Maybe it just means that something you once had no choice but to accept is now something you can change.

source_text: 以前不敢拿出来的想法，现在可以做出一个很粗糙的版本，给另外一个人试一试。
zh: 以前不敢拿出来的想法，现在可以做出一个很粗糙的版本，给另外一个人试一试。
en: An idea you once didn’t dare share can now become a rough prototype for someone else to try.

source_text: 也许是，你终于可以去做那件以前很想做却觉得自己做不到的事。
zh: 也许是，你终于可以去做那件以前很想做却觉得自己做不到的事。
en: Maybe it means you can finally do the thing you’ve long wanted to do but thought you couldn’t.

source_text: 如果今天要带走一件事，
zh: 如果今天要带走一件事，
en: If there’s one thing to take away today,

source_text: 我希望不是回去再多用一个工具，而是下次看到一个很完整的答案的时候，先给自己留一点时间，问一句：这里面哪个决定我自己还没有想过？
zh: 我希望不是回去再多用一个工具，而是下次看到一个很完整的答案的时候，先给自己留一点时间，问一句：这里面哪个决定我自己还没有想过？
en: I hope it’s not that you go home and start using one more tool. Instead, the next time you see an answer that seems complete, take a moment to ask yourself: Which of the decisions behind it haven’t I thought through for myself?

source_text: 挑一个你在乎的地方，改一小处，试一试。
zh: 挑一个你在乎的地方，改一小处，试一试。
en: Pick something you care about, make one small change, and see what happens.

source_text: 有机会的话，再拿给另外一个人看。
zh: 有机会的话，再拿给另外一个人看。
en: If you get the chance, show it to someone else too.

source_text: 不用一次改变全部，也不用证明自己比机器更厉害。
zh: 不用一次改变全部，也不用证明自己比机器更厉害。
en: You don’t have to change everything at once, or prove you’re better than a machine.

source_text: 只要那个过程还有你的感觉、
zh: 只要那个过程还有你的感觉、
en: As long as your own feelings are still part of the process,

source_text: 你的判断，和你愿意继续关心的东西，你就不是只站在旁边批准一个结果。
zh: 你的判断，和你愿意继续关心的东西，你就不是只站在旁边批准一个结果。
en: your judgment, and the things you still care about, then you’re not just standing on the sidelines approving an outcome.

source_text: 你还在形成自己的生活。
zh: 你还在形成自己的生活。
en: You’re still shaping your own life.

source_text: 我还是很相信工具，我希望它让原本不能参与的人有机会表达，让原本做不到的事有机会被做出来。
zh: 我还是很相信工具，我希望它让原本不能参与的人有机会表达，让原本做不到的事有机会被做出来。
en: I still have a lot of faith in these tools. I hope they give people who couldn’t participate before a chance to express themselves, and make things possible that weren’t possible before.

source_text: 也让我们不用维持系统的运转，去把全部的生活交给系统。
zh: 也让我们不用维持系统的运转，去把全部的生活交给系统。
en: And I hope they don’t make us hand over our whole lives just to keep the system running.

source_text: 我想要的不是一个替我过完人生的工具，而是在它的帮助下，我能更清楚地感觉自由地探索，更有能力关心这个世界。
zh: 我想要的不是一个替我过完人生的工具，而是在它的帮助下，我能更清楚地感觉自由地探索，更有能力关心这个世界。
en: What I want isn’t a tool that lives my life for me. I want one that helps me find my way, explore more freely, and care more deeply about the world.

source_text: 也和其他人一起，做出原本做不出来的东西。
zh: 也和其他人一起，做出原本做不出来的东西。
en: And work with others to create things we couldn’t have made before.

source_text: 慢慢找回原本的自己。
zh: 慢慢找回原本的自己。
en: Slowly find my way back to myself.

source_text: 谢谢。
zh: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.

source_text: 谢谢Rio。
zh: 谢谢Rio。
en: Thank you, Rio.

source_text: 然后 We are going to take like five minute break, and for the guys sitting right there, you can probably take a seat at the front if you are, you know, feel free to take
zh: 然后我们休息大概五分钟。坐在那边的朋友，如果愿意的话，可以到前排坐。
en: 然后 We are going to take like five minute break, and for the guys sitting right there, you can probably take a seat at the front if you are, you know, feel free to take

source_text: a seat at the front.
zh: 前排的一个座位。
en: a seat at the front.

source_text: 好的，我们会休息5分钟的时间。
zh: 好的，我们会休息5分钟的时间。
en: Okay, we’ll take a five-minute break.

source_text: 如果要去洗手间，如果要去外面跟参展的朋友一起交流，我们5分钟之后回来。
zh: 如果要去洗手间，如果要去外面跟参展的朋友一起交流，我们5分钟之后回来。
en: If you need to use the restroom or step outside to chat with other attendees, we’ll be back in five minutes.

source_text: 如果前面还有一些位置，如果大家这个想坐下来的话，也可以坐下来。好，我们5分钟之后回来。
zh: 如果前面还有一些位置，如果大家这个想坐下来的话，也可以坐下来。好，我们5分钟之后回来。
en: There are still some seats up front, so feel free to sit down if you’d like. We’ll be back in five minutes.

source_text: 喂？
zh: 喂？
en: Hello?

zh: 呃，不用，他会切换到另一个页面，然后你就可以用手机了。
en: 呃， no, he will switch to another page, and then you can use the phone.

source_text: Because it's the—
zh: 因为这……
en: Because it's the—

source_text: 那我。

en: So, I…

source_text: Alright, everyone, um, so let's wel— let's move on to the next session.
zh: 好了，各位，我们进入下一个环节。
en: Alright, everyone, um, so let's wel— let's move on to the next session.

source_text: So this session, let's welcome David, and Alex from you.com.
zh: 接下来这个环节，让我们欢迎来自 You.com 的 David 和 Alex。
en: So this session, let's welcome David, and Alex from you.com.

source_text: 呃，大家欢迎，呃，进入到我们的下一场的分享就开始了。
zh: 呃，大家欢迎，呃，进入到我们的下一场的分享就开始了。

source_text: 那这一场是来自于you.com的A
zh: 那这一场是来自于you.com的A
en: This session features A from You.com.

source_text: lex，还有David。
zh: lex，还有David。
en: Lex, and David.

source_text: So, um, let's give applause to them.
zh: 那么，让我们用掌声欢迎他们。
en: So, um, let's give applause to them.

source_text: 大家欢迎。
zh: 大家欢迎。
en: Welcome, everyone.

source_text: 谢谢。
zh: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.

source_text: 你好。
zh: 你好。
en: Hello.

source_text: Big room.
zh: 大房间。
en: Big room.

source_text: Excellent.
zh: 太好了。
en: Excellent.

source_text: I am Alex, I'm the Chief Operating Officer of you.com.
zh: 我是 Alex，You.com 的首席运营官。
en: I am Alex, I'm the Chief Operating Officer of you.com.

source_text: It's a pleasure to be here with everyone.
zh: 很高兴能和大家相聚在这里。
en: It's a pleasure to be here with everyone.

source_text: We're going to spend a couple minutes talking about you.com, what we do, why it's important, how maybe we can help one of your companies or your agents or your LLMs.
zh: 接下来我们花几分钟介绍一下 You.com：我们做什么、为什么这很重要，以及我们或许能如何帮助各位的公司、智能体或大语言模型。
en: We're going to spend a couple minutes talking about you.com, what we do, why it's important, how maybe we can help one of your companies or your agents or your LLMs.

source_text: Uh, and then we'll introduce our Head of APAC, Ryan, and our Head of Field Engineering, David.
zh: 之后，我们会介绍亚太区负责人 Ryan，以及现场工程负责人 David。
en: Uh, and then we'll introduce our Head of APAC, Ryan, and our Head of Field Engineering, David.

source_text: And David will take us to a case study where we helped CoreWeave and NVIDIA post-train the Nematron model.
zh: David 还会分享一个案例：我们如何帮助 CoreWeave 和英伟达对 Nemotron 模型进行后训练。
en: And David will take us to a case study where we helped CoreWeave and NVIDIA post-train the Nematron model.

source_text: So.
zh: 那么。
en: So.

source_text: A little bit of the agenda, but we don't have a lot of time, so I'm just going to breeze right through this. I want everyone to do something for me.
zh: 先简单说一下议程。不过时间不多，我就快速过一下。现在请大家帮我做一件事。
en: A little bit of the agenda, but we don't have a lot of time, so I'm just going to breeze right through this. I want everyone to do something for me.

source_text: Take your hands, cover your eyes, yeah?
zh: 请大家用手捂住眼睛，好吗？
en: Take your hands, cover your eyes, yeah?

source_text: Cover your eyes with your hands?
zh: 用手捂住眼睛？
en: Cover your eyes with your hands?

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好。
en: Okay.

source_text: Some are doing it, some aren't.
zh: 有些人照做了，有些人还没有。
en: Some are doing it, some aren't.

source_text: If you do that,
zh: 如果你这么做，
en: If you do that,

source_text: that is what an LLM or an agent experiences.
zh: 这就是大语言模型或智能体所感知到的世界。
en: that is what an LLM or an agent experiences.

source_text: When it cannot reach the web,
zh: 当它无法访问网络时，
en: When it cannot reach the web,

source_text: an LLM's training data ends.
zh: 大语言模型的训练数据就到此为止。
en: an LLM's training data ends.

source_text: It has no idea who just won the U.S. elections.
zh: 它根本不知道刚刚谁赢了美国大选。
en: It has no idea who just won the U.S. elections.

source_text: An agent can't access the web.
zh: 智能体无法访问网络。
en: An agent can't access the web.

source_text: It can't make the right decision.
zh: 它就无法做出正确的决定。
en: It can't make the right decision.

source_text: And so what we did is we built a search index specifically for LLMs and AI agents to search the web. That is what you.com does.
zh: 所以，我们专门为大语言模型和 AI 智能体打造了一个网络搜索索引。这就是 You.com 所做的。
en: And so what we did is we built a search index specifically for LLMs and AI agents to search the web. That is what you.com does.

source_text: We are the search engine for your AI agents.
zh: 我们是为您的 AI 智能体打造的搜索引擎。
en: We are the search engine for your AI agents.

source_text: We are the search engine for your LLMs.
zh: 我们是为您的大语言模型打造的搜索引擎。
en: We are the search engine for your LLMs.

source_text: Many of us use Baidu, Google, maybe Microsoft to search the web.
zh: 我们很多人会用百度、谷歌，或是微软的必应来搜索网页。
en: Many of us use Baidu, Google, maybe Microsoft to search the web.

source_text: That's not how agents search the web.
zh: 智能体并不是这样搜索网络的。
en: That's not how agents search the web.

source_text: They're much faster than us. They consume much more information.
zh: 它们的搜索速度比我们快得多，获取的信息量也大得多。
en: They're much faster than us. They consume much more information.

source_text: They need a whole different experience.
zh: 它们需要的是一套完全不同的搜索体验。
en: They need a whole different experience.

source_text: They need a whole different search engine. That's what we built.
zh: 它们需要一款完全不同的搜索引擎。这正是我们打造的。
en: They need a whole different search engine. That's what we built.

source_text: About 15 years ago, our founder, Richard Socher,
zh: 大约 15 年前，我们的创始人理查德·索赫尔，
en: About 15 years ago, our founder, Richard Socher,

source_text: was one of the leading minds in AI, was at Stanford thinking about the future, thinking about the way that humans and machines would access information.
zh: 当时已是人工智能领域的领军人物之一。他在斯坦福大学思考未来，思考人类和机器将如何获取信息。
en: was one of the leading minds in AI, was at Stanford thinking about the future, thinking about the way that humans and machines would access information.

source_text: And one of the things that Richard Socher thought was that eventually more machines would access information; more machines would search the web than humans.
zh: 理查德·索赫尔当时有一个判断：终有一天，上网获取信息、搜索网页的机器会比人类还多。
en: And one of the things that Richard Socher thought was that eventually more machines would access information; more machines would search the web than humans.

source_text: This is before AI was a term,
zh: 那时，“人工智能”这个词还没有普及，
en: This is before AI was a term,

source_text: and before AI was really invented.
zh: 甚至可以说，那时人工智能还没有真正诞生。
en: and before AI was really invented.

source_text: And in the last year, that's happened. More AI agents search the web than humans.
zh: 而就在过去一年，这个判断成了现实：搜索网页的 AI 智能体已经比人类还多。
en: And in the last year, that's happened. More AI agents search the web than humans.

source_text: And many of them use us to do it.
zh: 其中很多智能体就是通过我们的搜索引擎来搜索网页的。
en: And many of them use us to do it.

source_text: you.com.
zh: You.com。
en: you.com.

source_text: We've got an ecosystem of APIs. That's how the agents connect to us. That's how the LLMs connect to us.
zh: 我们有一套 API 生态系统，AI 智能体和大语言模型都是通过这些接口接入我们的。
en: We've got an ecosystem of APIs. That's how the agents connect to us. That's how the LLMs connect to us.

source_text: In the purple is our search API.
zh: 紫色部分是我们的搜索 API。
en: In the purple is our search API.

source_text: Very simply put, you take it,
zh: 简单来说，你拿到它，
en: Very simply put, you take it,

source_text: you can hook it to an MCP or hook it to an API, and your agent gets access to the full web. Everything that you can possibly find.
zh: 把它接入 MCP 或 API，你的智能体就能访问整个互联网，找到网上能找到的一切信息。
en: you can hook it to an MCP or hook it to an API, and your agent gets access to the full web. Everything that you can possibly find.

source_text: We also have licensed structured data sources of information, not found on the web, from things like World Bank and S&P and Polymarket.
zh: 我们还获得了世界银行、标普和 Polymarket 等机构的结构化数据授权，这些信息在公开网页上找不到。
en: We also have licensed structured data sources of information, not found on the web, from things like World Bank and S&P and Polymarket.

source_text: If you want very specific information for your agent, but primarily the base of what we do is we provide our search engine through an API for your agent, your LLM to search the web.
zh: 如果你想让智能体获取非常具体的信息，我们也能提供相应的数据。但我们的核心服务，是通过 API 向你的智能体或大语言模型开放搜索引擎，让它们搜索网页。
en: If you want very specific information for your agent, but primarily the base of what we do is we provide our search engine through an API for your agent, your LLM to search the web.

source_text: If you want to pull down the full page of a web page, we have a contents API that can do that in the gray.
zh: 如果你想获取某个网页的完整内容，灰色部分的内容 API 就能做到。
en: If you want to pull down the full page of a web page, we have a contents API that can do that in the gray.

source_text: If you want to have a long-running task with multiple searches that fan out and find a variety of information and use a harness to synthesize that, that's what our answers and our research APIs do.
zh: 如果你需要执行耗时较长的任务，发起多路搜索、收集各类信息，再通过一套框架将其整合，我们的答案 API 和研究 API 就是做这个的。
en: If you want to have a long-running task with multiple searches that fan out and find a variety of information and use a harness to synthesize that, that's what our answers and our research APIs do.

source_text: So we have a variety of APIs; different levels of orchestration.
zh: 所以我们提供多种 API，对应不同程度的任务编排。
en: So we have a variety of APIs; different levels of orchestration.

source_text: Different things that you're searching for, but all comes back to the singular point: we help AI agents and LLMs search the web.
zh: 无论你想搜索什么，归根结底只有一点：我们帮助 AI 智能体和大语言模型搜索互联网。
en: Different things that you're searching for, but all comes back to the singular point: we help AI agents and LLMs search the web.

source_text: Lots of clicks.
zh: 点击量很高。
en: Lots of clicks.

source_text: We operate at scale.
zh: 我们具备大规模运营能力。
en: We operate at scale.

source_text: We've been doing this for several years.
zh: 我们已经在这个领域深耕好几年了。
en: We've been doing this for several years.

source_text: We process billions of queries a month, or backed by NVIDIA, Salesforce, and some leading investors.
zh: 我们每月处理数十亿次查询，并获得了英伟达、Salesforce 及多家顶尖投资机构的支持。
en: We process billions of queries a month, or backed by NVIDIA, Salesforce, and some leading investors.

source_text: And most of what we focus on is the enterprise.
zh: 我们的业务重点主要面向企业客户。
en: And most of what we focus on is the enterprise.

source_text: We focus on the enterprise because it's the most challenging area to focus.
zh: 我们聚焦企业市场，因为这是最具挑战性的领域。
en: We focus on the enterprise because it's the most challenging area to focus.

source_text: Biggest volume,
zh: 业务量最大，
en: Biggest volume,

source_text: biggest demand, most complicated queries, most complicated challenges.
zh: 需求最大、查询最复杂、面临的挑战也最艰巨。
en: biggest demand, most complicated queries, most complicated challenges.

source_text: Oftentimes the requirement is something called zero data retention, where we don't remember what your queries are. We don't train on your data, so you're safe with us.
zh: 客户通常要求“零数据留存”：我们不会保留你的查询内容，也不会用你的数据训练模型，因此你的数据在我们这里是安全的。
en: Oftentimes the requirement is something called zero data retention, where we don't remember what your queries are. We don't train on your data, so you're safe with us.

source_text: And often the requirements are your ability to process billions of queries a month, your ability to have really good real-time SLAs and reliability. That's what we do.
zh: 客户通常还要求我们具备每月处理数十亿次查询的能力，并能提供出色的实时服务水平保障和可靠性。这正是我们的专长。
en: And often the requirements are your ability to process billions of queries a month, your ability to have really good real-time SLAs and reliability. That's what we do.

source_text: We also focus on search labs.
zh: 我们也专注于搜索实验室。
en: We also focus on search labs.

source_text: We focus on providing LLMs pre-training data, post-training data, and web search at inference.
zh: 我们专注于为大语言模型提供预训练数据、后训练数据，以及推理阶段的网络搜索服务。
en: We focus on providing LLMs pre-training data, post-training data, and web search at inference.

source_text: So we partner with these labs.
zh: 因此，我们与这些实验室合作。
en: So we partner with these labs.

source_text: We are their search lab.
zh: 我们就是他们的搜索实验室。
en: We are their search lab.

source_text: They are the model lab.
zh: 他们负责模型研发。
en: They are the model lab.

source_text: And we have many, many relationships with many of the frontier models or the open weight models that you probably use today. That partner with us.
zh: 如今你们常用的许多前沿模型和开放权重模型背后的团队，都是我们的合作伙伴；我们与他们有着广泛的合作关系。
en: And we have many, many relationships with many of the frontier models or the open weight models that you probably use today. That partner with us.

source_text: And David will talk in a second about one of those experiences where we helped NVIDIA's Nematron post-train.
zh: 稍后 David 会介绍一个合作案例：我们如何帮助英伟达的 Nemotron 模型完成后训练。
en: And David will talk in a second about one of those experiences where we helped NVIDIA's Nematron post-train.

source_text: So simply put, we are the partner to most of the models: open weight or closed weight out there, to search the web. We are the partner to most of the leading AI agent companies to search the web. That's what we do.
zh: 简单来说，无论是开放权重模型还是闭源模型，大多数模型进行网络搜索时都会与我们合作。许多领先的 AI 智能体公司也选择我们作为网络搜索合作伙伴。这就是我们所做的事。
en: So simply put, we are the partner to most of the models: open weight or closed weight out there, to search the web. We are the partner to most of the leading AI agent companies to search the web. That's what we do.

source_text: I'd like to now introduce Ryan Lee, our Head of APAC.
zh: 接下来，我想介绍一下我们的亚太区负责人 Ryan Lee。
en: I'd like to now introduce Ryan Lee, our Head of APAC.

source_text: Hello, everyone. I am Ryan.
zh: 大家好，我是 Ryan。
en: Hello, everyone. I am Ryan.

source_text: 接下来我用中文说，我就说一分钟时间。
zh: 接下来我用中文说，我就说一分钟时间。
en: I’ll speak in Chinese for the next minute.

source_text: 为什么you.com要设一个亚洲的总部，然后我们在这里布了我们专门的这个服务的各个的工程师，
zh: 为什么you.com要设一个亚洲的总部，然后我们在这里布了我们专门的这个服务的各个的工程师，
en: Why did You.com establish an Asian headquarters and station engineers here to support our services?

source_text: 还有所有的这个业务的团队？
zh: 还有所有的这个业务的团队？
en: And our entire business team?

source_text: 因为我们知道中国的这个产品，它要在海外。
zh: 因为我们知道中国的这个产品，它要在海外。
en: Because we know Chinese products are looking to expand overseas.

source_text: 然后它要去搜索全球的信息，我们是需要在第一线给大家提供这样的服务。
zh: 然后它要去搜索全球的信息，我们是需要在第一线给大家提供这样的服务。
en: It needs to search for information from around the world, and we need to be on the ground to provide that service.

source_text: 我现在是负责这个you.com在APAC这边的业务。
zh: 我现在是负责这个you.com在APAC这边的业务。
en: I’m currently responsible for You.com’s business in the Asia-Pacific region.

source_text: 我想说的是，我们的产品，首先在亚洲已经有非常多的公司在使用了，不管是中国的互联网大厂，
zh: 我想说的是，我们的产品，首先在亚洲已经有非常多的公司在使用了，不管是中国的互联网大厂，
en: What I’m saying is that many companies across Asia are already using our product, including major Chinese internet companies.

source_text: 还是中国领先的AI model labs，他们都会在这个大模型的推理当中，或者在训练当中用到我们。
zh: 还是中国领先的AI model labs，他们都会在这个大模型的推理当中，或者在训练当中用到我们。
en: Leading Chinese AI model labs use us too, both to train their large models and when those models generate responses.

source_text: 然后我们知道就是很多产品，它都有一个帕雷托的曲线。
zh: 然后我们知道就是很多产品，它都有一个帕雷托的曲线。
en: And we know that many products follow a Pareto curve.

source_text: 你如果需要最好的性能，它的价格会有一些compromise，然后如果那个如果有性价比的问题，有的时候会带来性能的问题。
zh: 你如果需要最好的性能，它的价格会有一些compromise，然后如果那个如果有性价比的问题，有的时候会带来性能的问题。
en: If you want the best performance, you may have to compromise on price. And if you prioritize value for money, you may sometimes have to compromise on performance.

source_text: 但是我们的产品在搜索这个领域当中，我们在帕雷托的曲线上面的各个部分都有很好的解决方案。
zh: 但是我们的产品在搜索这个领域当中，我们在帕雷托的曲线上面的各个部分都有很好的解决方案。
en: But in search, our products offer strong solutions at every point along the Pareto curve.

source_text: 不管你是做大规模的推理、AI to C，还是对于一些非常需要这个高精尖或者是那个data zero retention的一些客户，
zh: 不管你是做大规模的推理、AI to C，还是对于一些非常需要这个高精尖或者是那个data zero retention的一些客户，
en: Whether you’re running large-scale inference, building consumer-facing AI products, or serving customers who need cutting-edge capabilities or zero data retention,

source_text: 我们都有解决方案。
zh: 我们都有解决方案。
en: We have solutions for all of them.

source_text: 所以我们希望就是在中国的市场能够把这些面对面的带到你们的业务团队，从零搭建你们的产品，
zh: 所以我们希望就是在中国的市场能够把这些面对面的带到你们的业务团队，从零搭建你们的产品，
en: So we hope to bring these solutions directly to your business teams in China and help you build your products from the ground up.

source_text: 然后帮助从产品的全生命周期去帮助你们的大模型，你们的基座和实时和全球数据进行实时的对接。
zh: 然后帮助从产品的全生命周期去帮助你们的大模型，你们的基座和实时和全球数据进行实时的对接。
en: And support your large models throughout the entire product lifecycle, connecting your foundation models to real-time data from around the world.

source_text: 而且我们的服务意识和我们的服务的能力非常的强，我们能提供24小时的服务，能够覆盖整个欧美和亚洲的所有市区。
zh: 而且我们的服务意识和我们的服务的能力非常的强，我们能提供24小时的服务，能够覆盖整个欧美和亚洲的所有市区。
en: And we’re highly committed to customer service, with the capacity to provide 24/7 support across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

source_text: 因此我希望有机会可以和大家在线下多聊聊，然后对于整个AI出海的所有话题，我也可以给大家提供很多想法或者情绪价值。非常感谢能够有机会和大家在这里见面，我们线下见。

source_text: There are many many inference techniques to improve throughput and latency here I highlighted a few and inference engines like VLM and SGLAN are built largely to optimize one model deployed to a single GPU node and first thing to notice here is that inference can be divided into two stages prefill and decode and in prefill on this side the KV cache is produced along with the first output token so the prefill stage determines the time to first token latency TTFT and prefill is mostly doing matrix multiplication right so which makes it a compute bound and in the decode stage it takes the KV cache and recursively generates the next token so the decode stage determines your inter token latency ITL at every step it reads the updated KV cache so the memory bandwidth for transferring the KV cache become the bottleneck in here and because the requirement for prefill and decode are very different running them on separate replicas can improve the GPU utilization rate so this is called prefill decode disaggregation and on the top left the chunked prefill that flash attention in the middle and down the bottom the paged KV cache these are all different techniques that breaks down large chunks of compute and memory into smaller pieces to improve efficiency and quantization here helps to reduce the size of model weights you can also apply it to activation and KV cache as well and when done properly you can preserve the quantized model fidelity to the original full precision model and.
zh:
有很多推理技术可以提高吞吐量、降低延迟，这里我重点介绍几种。像 vLLM 和 SGLang 这样的推理引擎，主要优化的是在单个 GPU 节点上部署模型的场景。

首先，推理可以分为两个阶段：预填充和解码。预填充阶段会生成 KV 缓存和第一个输出 token，因此它决定了首 token 延迟，也就是 TTFT。这一阶段主要进行矩阵乘法运算，所以瓶颈在算力。

解码阶段则利用 KV 缓存，逐个生成后续 token，因此它决定了 token 间延迟，也就是 ITL。每生成一个 token，都要读取更新后的 KV 缓存，所以传输 KV 缓存所需的内存带宽就成了瓶颈。由于预填充和解码对硬件资源的需求差别很大，把它们放在不同的副本上运行，可以提高 GPU 利用率。这就叫作预填充与解码分离。

图中左上角的分块预填充、中间的 FlashAttention，以及下方的分页式 KV 缓存，都是把大块计算或内存数据拆成更小的部分，以提高效率。量化则可以缩小模型权重的体积，也可以应用于激活值和 KV 缓存。如果处理得当，量化模型仍能保持与原始全精度模型接近的效果。

source_text: Also different parallelisms can be applied which distributes model weights and input data to different GPUs for faster inference here I highlighted Tensor sorry expert parallelism which essentially applies to MOE models to host different experts on different GPUs and lastly the speculative decoding here down the bottom right corner generates multiple draft tokens really really fast with a small draft model or MTP heads and then the large language model target model verifies all the draft token in a single pass for high throughput and at the core all these inferencing techniques are really about reducing repeated compute remove unnecessary operations minimize data movement and maximize the hardware utilization rate and that's inference in a single GPU node and.
zh:
此外，还可以采用不同的并行策略，把模型权重和输入数据分配到多个 GPU 上，加快推理。这里我重点标出了专家并行，它主要用于混合专家模型（MoE）：让不同的专家运行在不同的 GPU 上。

最后，右下角的推测解码会用一个小型草稿模型或多 token 预测头，快速生成多个候选 token，再由大型目标模型一次性验证，从而提高吞吐量。

这些推理技术的核心，都是减少重复计算、去掉不必要的操作、尽量减少数据搬运，并最大限度提高硬件利用率。以上讲的都是单个 GPU 节点上的推理。
en: Also different parallelisms can be applied which distributes model weights and input data to different GPUs for faster inference here I highlighted Tensor sorry expert parallelism which essentially applies to MOE models to host different experts on different GPUs and lastly the speculative decoding here down the bottom right corner generates multiple draft tokens really really fast with a small draft model or MTP heads and then the large language model target model verifies all the draft token in a single pass for high throughput and at the core all these inferencing techniques are really about reducing repeated compute remove unnecessary operations minimize data movement and maximize the hardware utilization rate and that's inference in a single GPU node and.

zh:
如今，推理服务商在一小时内处理数万亿个 token 已经很常见了。显然，这样的工作负载不是靠某人桌下叠放的几台 Mac mini 来运行，而是部署在跨云、跨地区的分布式 GPU 集群上。客户既要求低延迟和高可靠性，流量模式又不断变化，因此这本质上是一个系统级的编排问题。

路由用户请求时，不仅要考虑地理距离和可用容量，还要考虑 KV 缓存的匹配情况。如果请求中有很长一段内容已在某处缓存，把请求路由到那里，就能更快生成第一个 token，同时降低用户成本。为提高缓存命中率，还可以将 KV 缓存卸载到不同层级的存储中，保存更多前缀缓存。

当负载超过现有实例的容量时，系统必须及早发现需要扩容，并在满足数据驻留要求的前提下，从不同云和地区找到可用集群，尽快启动并预热实例。同时，还要具备故障切换能力，不能依赖任何单一集群。否则，P90 延迟就可能急剧飙升。

与直接从 Hugging Face 下载模型权重、不做任何优化就运行的基准实现相比，这些技术都能提升推理性能。这里列出了一些社区公开的性能提升数据：采用其中任何一项技术，都可能大幅改善吞吐量和延迟；把它们结合起来，提升幅度甚至可以达到几个数量级。

在 BaseTen，我们覆盖了从编排层一直到基础设施层的整个技术栈。正因如此，我们才能在实现极高输出速度和吞吐量的同时，为企业客户保持 99.99% 的可靠性和可用性。要打造高性能推理平台，每一层都不可或缺，但单靠任何一层都不够。
