en: based on this slide, we're not going into the details, but the question emerges like, why do you want to do this?

source_text: And it's not just about the developer experience and ergonomics.
zh: 而且，这不只是关乎开发者体验和使用便利性。
en: And it's not just about the developer experience and ergonomics.

source_text: It's also about the performance and the cost, which is, I would say, number one requirement in this AI agent space.
zh: 这还关乎性能和成本。我认为，这两点是 AI 智能体领域的首要要求。
en: It's also about the performance and the cost, which is, I would say, number one requirement in this AI agent space.

source_text: For example, you can see that by comparing, uh, third row sandbox spin up times.
zh: 比如，对比第三行就能看到沙箱的启动时间。
en: For example, you can see that by comparing, uh, third row sandbox spin up times.

source_text: So natural follow-up question can be, what do we do that we can achieve this kind of new, uh, features and requirements compared to Kubernetes?
zh: 所以接下来自然会问：相比 Kubernetes，我们做了什么，才能实现这些新功能并满足这些要求？
en: So natural follow-up question can be, what do we do that we can achieve this kind of new, uh, features and requirements compared to Kubernetes?

source_text: I just put here, uh,
zh: 我这里只列了，呃，
en: I just put here, uh,

source_text: three short, uh, topics about what we do differently.
zh: 我们有哪些不同的做法，我在这里只简要列了三点。
en: three short, uh, topics about what we do differently.

source_text: So number one is local snapshotting.
zh: 第一点是本地快照。
en: So number one is local snapshotting.

source_text: Everything inside Daytona, when a sandbox run and stops,
zh: 在 Daytona 中，每当一个沙箱运行结束并停止时，
en: Everything inside Daytona, when a sandbox run and stops,

source_text: it isn't deleted or wiped out.
zh: 它不会被删除，里面的数据也不会被清空。
en: it isn't deleted or wiped out.

source_text: It's still preserved on the runner device or cache storage.
zh: 它仍然保存在运行节点的设备或缓存存储中。
en: It's still preserved on the runner device or cache storage.

source_text: So next time when you resume the sandbox,
zh: 这样，下次恢复沙箱时，
en: So next time when you resume the sandbox,

source_text: it's basically a, uh, just a start of the container.
zh: 基本上只需要重新启动容器。
en: it's basically a, uh, just a start of the container.

source_text: Uh,
zh: 呃，
en: Uh,

source_text: so there's also that's why we the main goal is here to prevent the pooling or cold starts where you need to pull the image from some Docker registry, etc.
zh: 所以我们的主要目标，是避免每次启动都要从 Docker 镜像仓库拉取镜像，从而减少冷启动。
en: so there's also that's why we the main goal is here to prevent the pooling or cold starts where you need to pull the image from some Docker registry, etc.

source_text: Uh, and also yeah,
zh: 嗯，还有就是，
en: Uh, and also yeah,

source_text: we are all distribution algorithm prefers the nodes that already have the sandbox image stored.
zh: 我们的分配算法也会优先选择已经存有沙箱镜像的节点。
en: we are all distribution algorithm prefers the nodes that already have the sandbox image stored.

source_text: Number two is snapshot distribution.
zh: 第二点是快照分发。
en: Number two is snapshot distribution.

source_text: So regarding snapshot distribution, short terms is like if some user or company uses,
zh: 关于快照分发，简单来说，如果某个用户或公司使用……
en: So regarding snapshot distribution, short terms is like if some user or company uses,

source_text: uh, certain snapshot with on a large scale and pretty often, we will propagate these snapshots to more runners.
zh: 某个快照的使用量很大、频率也很高，我们就会把它分发到更多运行节点。
en: uh, certain snapshot with on a large scale and pretty often, we will propagate these snapshots to more runners.

source_text: And if some snapshots are not used, we'll deactivate them and clear them up from nodes to save space.
zh: 如果有些快照不再使用，我们就会停用它们，并从节点上清除，以节省空间。
en: And if some snapshots are not used, we'll deactivate them and clear them up from nodes to save space.

source_text: Third one is database approach.
zh: 第三点是数据库方案。
en: Third one is database approach.

source_text: So we don't transfer whole images.
zh: 所以我们不会传输整个镜像。
en: So we don't transfer whole images.

source_text: We only transfer differences or deltas.
zh: 我们只传输差异数据，也就是增量部分。
en: We only transfer differences or deltas.

source_text: Which enables, you know, even cold starts to be pretty, pretty fast.
zh: 这使得即使是冷启动，速度也相当快。
en: Which enables, you know, even cold starts to be pretty, pretty fast.

source_text: So yeah, back to Kubernetes.
zh: 好，回到 Kubernetes。
en: So yeah, back to Kubernetes.

source_text: This is the flow that takes you that is required for you to spin up a sandbox or a pod on a Kubernetes.
zh: 这就是在 Kubernetes 上启动沙箱或 Pod 所需的流程。
en: This is the flow that takes you that is required for you to spin up a sandbox or a pod on a Kubernetes.

source_text: And as you can see here, Kubernetes is because of its nature, it has defined these sequential steps that need to happen in order to spin up or start a pod.
zh: 如图所示，Kubernetes 本身的机制决定了：启动一个 Pod 必须依次完成这些步骤。
en: And as you can see here, Kubernetes is because of its nature, it has defined these sequential steps that need to happen in order to spin up or start a pod.

source_text: And at best case, you'll get running pod or sandbox in one or two seconds.
zh: 即使在最理想的情况下，也要一两秒才能启动一个 Pod 或沙箱。
en: And at best case, you'll get running pod or sandbox in one or two seconds.

source_text: But mostly it will be in orders of tens of seconds.
zh: 但大多数情况下，启动时间要几十秒。
en: But mostly it will be in orders of tens of seconds.

source_text: Also because of this sequential steps, your throughput can only be around 100 pods or sandboxes per second.
zh: 而且，由于这些步骤必须依次执行，每秒最多只能启动大约 100 个 Pod 或沙箱。
en: Also because of this sequential steps, your throughput can only be around 100 pods or sandboxes per second.

source_text: And default density, so the amount of sandboxes you can place on one Kubernetes node is around 110. Next part, statefulness.
zh: 此外，默认密度，也就是每个 Kubernetes 节点上能部署的沙箱数量，大约是 110 个。接下来讲有状态性。
en: And default density, so the amount of sandboxes you can place on one Kubernetes node is around 110. Next part, statefulness.

source_text: As I mentioned before, so number one agentic runtime requirement is statefulness.
zh: 正如我之前提到的，智能体运行时的首要需求是有状态性。
en: As I mentioned before, so number one agentic runtime requirement is statefulness.

source_text: And at Daytona, everything is stateful by default and everything is preserved.
zh: 而在 Daytona，一切默认都是有状态的，所有状态都会保留下来。
en: And at Daytona, everything is stateful by default and everything is preserved.

source_text: So when you resume the sandbox, everything is already on the disk.
zh: 所以，当你恢复沙箱时，所有内容都已经保存在磁盘上了。
en: So when you resume the sandbox, everything is already on the disk.

source_text: But with Kubernetes,
zh: 但在 Kubernetes 中，
en: But with Kubernetes,

source_text: Kubernetes is stateless.
zh: Kubernetes 是无状态的。
en: Kubernetes is stateless.

source_text: What does that mean?
zh: 这是什么意思？
en: What does that mean?

source_text: That means if you want to achieve statefulness on Kubernetes, you have to mount some kind of an external storage.
zh: 这意味着，如果想在 Kubernetes 上实现有状态运行，就必须挂载某种外部存储。
en: That means if you want to achieve statefulness on Kubernetes, you have to mount some kind of an external storage.

source_text: And this is the trap because once you do that, then all of your file system operations go over the network and your EOPS, uh, number falls from around 500k on Daytona, which is near native,
zh: 这就是陷阱：一旦挂载外部存储，所有文件系统操作都得走网络，IOPS 就会从 Daytona 上接近原生性能的约 50 万大幅下降。
en: And this is the trap because once you do that, then all of your file system operations go over the network and your EOPS, uh, number falls from around 500k on Daytona, which is near native,

source_text: to around 50 to 60k when we're talking about EBS, for example.
zh: 比如使用 EBS 时，IOPS 会降到大约 5 万到 6 万。
en: to around 50 to 60k when we're talking about EBS, for example.

source_text: And, and also you need to explicitly choose what parts or what types do you want to preserve.
zh: 而且，你还得明确指定要保留哪些部分，或者哪些类型的数据。
en: And, and also you need to explicitly choose what parts or what types do you want to preserve.

source_text: So it's not preserve everything is not preserved by default like on Daytona.
zh: 所以它不会像 Daytona 那样默认保留所有内容。
en: So it's not preserve everything is not preserved by default like on Daytona.

source_text: And this is what it takes you then to spin up a pod or a sandbox when you have external storage in the picture and statefulness.
zh: 而一旦引入外部存储、需要保持状态，启动一个 Pod 或沙箱就得花这么长时间。
en: And this is what it takes you then to spin up a pod or a sandbox when you have external storage in the picture and statefulness.

source_text: So typically it takes around 30 to 19 seconds to mount.
zh: 所以，挂载通常需要大约 19 到 30 秒。
en: So typically it takes around 30 to 19 seconds to mount.

source_text: This external volume to the node where pod is running.
zh: 把这个外部存储卷挂载到 Pod 所在的节点上。
en: This external volume to the node where pod is running.

source_text: When it, uh, when the external storage, uh, mounting goes into error state, you can only remount it again after 6 minutes.
zh: 如果外部存储挂载出错，必须等 6 分钟才能重新挂载。
en: When it, uh, when the external storage, uh, mounting goes into error state, you can only remount it again after 6 minutes.

source_text: Because of the limited number of these, let's say, sockets on the nodes,
zh: 因为节点上的这类接口数量有限，
en: Because of the limited number of these, let's say, sockets on the nodes,

source_text: you can only mount 25 to 39, uh,
zh: 你最多只能挂载 25 到 39 个……
en: you can only mount 25 to 39, uh,

source_text: volumes on a single node.
zh: 个存储卷到同一个节点上。
en: volumes on a single node.

source_text: Previously I mentioned you can have 110.
zh: 我之前提到过，一个节点可以运行 110 个 Pod。
en: Previously I mentioned you can have 110.

source_text: So you can see that the amount of sandboxes you can have on a single node is fell by three times.
zh: 所以可以看到，单个节点上能运行的沙箱数量减少到了原来的三分之一。
en: So you can see that the amount of sandboxes you can have on a single node is fell by three times.

source_text: And you can only mount, so you can only mount one volume per sandbox per pod.
zh: 而且，每个 Pod 中的每个沙箱只能挂载一个存储卷。
en: And you can only mount, so you can only mount one volume per sandbox per pod.

source_text: So you can't mount, uh, single volume to be used by multiple sandboxes.
zh: 所以，不能把同一个存储卷挂载给多个沙箱使用。
en: So you can't mount, uh, single volume to be used by multiple sandboxes.

source_text: So this is pretty, pretty bad state you enter in when you try to tackle up with setting up your own stateful Kubernetes for sandboxes.
zh: 所以，如果你想自己搭建基于 Kubernetes 的有状态沙箱，就会陷入一个相当棘手的局面。
en: So this is pretty, pretty bad state you enter in when you try to tackle up with setting up your own stateful Kubernetes for sandboxes.

source_text: And to prove all of this, to not just talk about it, we did some benchmarks.
zh: 为了证明这些结论，而不只是纸上谈兵，我们还做了一些基准测试。
en: And to prove all of this, to not just talk about it, we did some benchmarks.

source_text: So the benchmarks consisted of three tiers of task.
zh: 基准测试包含三个层级的任务。
en: So the benchmarks consisted of three tiers of task.

source_text: Tier zero was essentially running a sleep command and starting a sandbox.
zh: 第零层级的任务基本上就是启动一个沙箱，并在其中运行 sleep 命令。
en: Tier zero was essentially running a sleep command and starting a sandbox.

source_text: And it surfaces the sandbox spin up time.
zh: 这样就能测出沙箱的启动耗时。
en: And it surfaces the sandbox spin up time.

source_text: Second one was doing some light CPU and file system work.
zh: 第二层级的任务是执行一些轻量级的 CPU 运算和文件系统操作。
en: Second one was doing some light CPU and file system work.

source_text: And tier two one was giving the agent actual SVE test to run on, which essentially surfaces what will your real time in production be like when your agent actually solves some real world task.
zh: 而第二层级是让智能体实际运行 SVE 测试，以此了解它在生产环境中处理真实任务时的耗时。
en: And tier two one was giving the agent actual SVE test to run on, which essentially surfaces what will your real time in production be like when your agent actually solves some real world task.

source_text: And these are the results for all three tiers.
zh: 这就是三个层级的测试结果。
en: And these are the results for all three tiers.

source_text: So as you can notice,
zh: 所以，大家可以看到，
en: So as you can notice,

source_text: Daytona is the green one.
zh: 绿色的代表 Daytona。
en: Daytona is the green one.

source_text: It's on the on the bottom and it was fastest among all of the options.
zh: 它位于图表底部，在所有选项中速度最快。
en: It's on the on the bottom and it was fastest among all of the options.

source_text: And this is for one trajectory.
zh: 这是一条任务轨迹的测试结果。
en: And this is for one trajectory.

source_text: So imagine what most of the people do is run thousands or tens of thousand these trajectories concurrently.
zh: 试想一下，大多数人会同时运行成千上万条这样的任务轨迹。
en: So imagine what most of the people do is run thousands or tens of thousand these trajectories concurrently.

source_text: So you can know sense how this can accumulate over, uh, large number.
zh: 这样你就能体会到，当任务数量很大时，这些时间差会累积成多大的优势。
en: So you can know sense how this can accumulate over, uh, large number.

source_text: And, uh, transfer to numbers.
zh: 再把它换算成具体数字。
en: And, uh, transfer to numbers.

source_text: So running the same workload on Daytona versus these other Kubernetes options, uh, takes 36% less time.
zh: 因此，运行相同的工作负载时，Daytona 比其他基于 Kubernetes 的方案节省 36% 的时间。
en: So running the same workload on Daytona versus these other Kubernetes options, uh, takes 36% less time.

source_text: And this is like a huge number because yeah, time is money and you need to move fast, especially in this AI, uh, domain.
zh: 这个数字相当可观。毕竟时间就是金钱，尤其在人工智能领域，行动速度至关重要。
en: And this is like a huge number because yeah, time is money and you need to move fast, especially in this AI, uh, domain.

source_text: Now next spiky workloads.
zh: 接下来看看突发性工作负载。
en: Now next spiky workloads.

source_text: So these are the workloads that require a lot of, you know,
zh: 这类工作负载需要大量的……
en: So these are the workloads that require a lot of, you know,

source_text: infrastructure for some certain amount of time.
zh: 在特定时间段内需要大量基础设施资源。
en: infrastructure for some certain amount of time.

source_text: But then outside the outside this time, when infra is used, the infrastructure sits there idle and it's not utilized, but you still pay for them.
zh: 但在这段使用时间之外，基础设施就会闲置，得不到利用，你却仍然要为它付费。
en: But then outside the outside this time, when infra is used, the infrastructure sits there idle and it's not utilized, but you still pay for them.

source_text: While contrary when you use sandbox provider, you just pay for the amount.
zh: 而使用沙箱服务商时，你只需按实际用量付费。
en: While contrary when you use sandbox provider, you just pay for the amount.

source_text: So you spin up sandboxes on demand and you just pay for the amount of time the sandbox is up and running.
zh: 也就是说，你可以按需启动沙箱，只需为沙箱实际运行的时间付费。
en: So you spin up sandboxes on demand and you just pay for the amount of time the sandbox is up and running.

source_text: So compared we did a comparison on 1000 sandboxes running for, uh,
zh: 我们做了个对比：让 1000 个沙箱运行……
en: So compared we did a comparison on 1000 sandboxes running for, uh,

source_text: 47, uh, 176 hours.
zh: 呃，176 个小时。
en: 47, uh, 176 hours.

source_text: That's like running 9 to 5, uh,
zh: 这差不多就是朝九晚五地运行，呃……
en: That's like running 9 to 5, uh,

source_text: daily for a month.
zh: 连续一个月每天朝九晚五运行。
en: daily for a month.

source_text: And the result is that it costs you 2.7 times less to run the same workload on Daytona than on, uh, setting up your own Kubernetes.
zh: 结果是，运行相同的工作负载，使用 Daytona 的成本比自行搭建 Kubernetes 低约 2.7 倍。
en: And the result is that it costs you 2.7 times less to run the same workload on Daytona than on, uh, setting up your own Kubernetes.

source_text: And yeah,
zh: 对，没错。
en: And yeah,

source_text: so I hope based on all of these previous slides that it's pretty obvious why using sandbox providers is better approach than using Kubernetes for the agentic infra layer.
zh: 所以，我希望通过前面这些幻灯片，大家已经很清楚：在智能体基础设施层，使用沙箱服务商比使用 Kubernetes 更合适。
en: so I hope based on all of these previous slides that it's pretty obvious why using sandbox providers is better approach than using Kubernetes for the agentic infra layer.

source_text: Both regarding developer experience, ergonomics, and money and, uh, time.
zh: 无论是开发者体验、使用便捷性，还是成本和时间，都是如此。
en: Both regarding developer experience, ergonomics, and money and, uh, time.

source_text: And yeah, as we like to say it, uh, don't reinvent the wheel.
zh: 对，正如我们常说的，别重复造轮子。
en: And yeah, as we like to say it, uh, don't reinvent the wheel.

source_text: Same as it's not that smart to roll up your own authentication system, say that you will use some well-established authentication platform.
zh: 同样，自己从头开发一套身份认证系统也不太明智；不如使用成熟的身份认证平台。
en: Same as it's not that smart to roll up your own authentication system, say that you will use some well-established authentication platform.

source_text: Same as with sandboxes, you should trust people that are experts in this field because believe me, so doing rolling up your own sandbox, uh, isn't that, uh, easy.
zh: 沙箱也是一样：你应该信任这个领域的专家。相信我，自己从头搭建沙箱并没有那么容易。
en: Same as with sandboxes, you should trust people that are experts in this field because believe me, so doing rolling up your own sandbox, uh, isn't that, uh, easy.

source_text: And if you mess, you mess up big times.
zh: 而且一旦搞砸，后果会很严重。
en: And if you mess, you mess up big times.

source_text: If some secrets and stuff leak and you can basically kill your whole product.
zh: 如果密钥之类的敏感信息泄露，整个产品基本上就完了。
en: If some secrets and stuff leak and you can basically kill your whole product.

source_text: And yeah, as we like to say it, uh, use sandbox for your sandbox. That's it. Thank you.
zh: 所以，正如我们常说的：沙箱的事，就交给沙箱服务商吧。就这些，谢谢大家。
en: And yeah, as we like to say it, uh, use sandbox for your sandbox. That's it. Thank you.

source_text: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好的。
en: All right.

source_text: Um, thank you for Ms. L
zh: 嗯，感谢L女士。
en: Um, thank you for Ms. L

source_text: eff's sharing.
zh: 感谢分享。
en: eff's sharing.

source_text: 谢谢Ms.
zh: 谢谢Ms.
en: Thank you, Ms.

source_text: Leff的分享。
zh: Leff的分享。
en: Thank you, Ms. Leff, for sharing.

source_text: 然后呃下一场是来自Manus的范斌
zh: 然后呃下一场是来自Manus的范斌
en: Next up is Fan Bin from Manus.

source_text: Uh, let's welcome uh Fanbin from Manus.
zh: 下面有请来自 Manus 的范斌。
en: Uh, let's welcome uh Fanbin from Manus.

source_text: 好的。
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: Uh, hello 大家好，我是范斌。
zh: Uh, hello 大家好，我是范斌。
en: Uh, hello, everyone. I’m Fan Bin.

source_text: 呃，网名是青年李大猫。
zh: 呃，网名是青年李大猫。
en: My online handle is Young Li the Big Cat.

source_text: 呃，我在Manus主要做agent harness的研发工作。
zh: 呃，我在Manus主要做agent harness的研发工作。
en: I mainly work on agent harness development at Manus.

source_text: 呃，感谢主办方邀请。
zh: 呃，感谢主办方邀请。
en: Uh, thank you to the organizers for inviting me.

source_text: 呃，很高兴来到这里为大家分享一些呃Manus团队内部对于AI呃native工作方式的探索和思考。
zh: 呃，很高兴来到这里为大家分享一些呃Manus团队内部对于AI呃native工作方式的探索和思考。
en: I’m delighted to be here to share some of the Manus team’s explorations and thoughts on AI-native ways of working.

source_text: 呃，前几天我们的一位联合创始人涛哥在他的公众号上也写了一篇文章。
zh: 呃，前几天我们的一位联合创始人涛哥在他的公众号上也写了一篇文章。
en: A few days ago, one of our co-founders, Tao, also published an article on his WeChat account.

source_text: 呃，讲我们AI native呃组织实践。
zh: 呃，讲我们AI native呃组织实践。
en: It was about how we’re putting AI-native ways of working into practice across the organization.

source_text: 呃，在座应该有朋友已经读过了。
zh: 呃，在座应该有朋友已经读过了。
en: Some of you here have probably already read it.

source_text: 呃，没读过也没关系，我会提到他讲的一些内容，也会分享一些我自己啊比较个人的心得。
zh: 呃，没读过也没关系，我会提到他讲的一些内容，也会分享一些我自己啊比较个人的心得。
en: If you haven’t read it, that’s fine. I’ll touch on some of his points and share a few personal takeaways of my own.

source_text: 涛哥的文章一开头就提到了这样一个场景。
zh: 涛哥的文章一开头就提到了这样一个场景。
en: Tao opens his article with a scenario like this.

source_text: 他说他非常的呃震撼。
zh: 他说他非常的呃震撼。
en: He said he was really struck by it.

source_text: 呃，这是一个现在在Manus办公室里很常见的呃呃情况，就是产品提了一个需求，
zh: 呃，这是一个现在在Manus办公室里很常见的呃呃情况，就是产品提了一个需求，
en: This is something you see all the time in the Manus office now: the product team raises a request,

source_text: 然后呃研发同学把这个需求原文一一字不动的转发给了他的AI。
zh: 然后呃研发同学把这个需求原文一一字不动的转发给了他的AI。
en: And then the engineer forwards the request to their AI, word for word, without changing a thing.

source_text: 可能是Manus可能是Codex，然后AI就会端到端的把这个需求给做完。
zh: 可能是Manus可能是Codex，然后AI就会端到端的把这个需求给做完。
en: It might be Manus or Codex, and the AI handles the request from start to finish.

source_text: 而且这个工程师同时可能接了十几二十个这样的需求。
zh: 而且这个工程师同时可能接了十几二十个这样的需求。
en: And that engineer might be handling ten or twenty requests like this at the same time.

source_text: 呃，但其实在AI native化的早期，我们要做到端到端的呃需求研发是相对比较困难的。
zh: 呃，但其实在AI native化的早期，我们要做到端到端的呃需求研发是相对比较困难的。
en: But in the early stages of becoming AI-native, it was relatively difficult to have AI handle a development request from start to finish.

source_text: 呃，我们梳理了其中的难点。
zh: 呃，我们梳理了其中的难点。
en: We identified the main challenges.

source_text: 呃，发现组织内的上下文其实是分散在不同的个人代码仓库，还有内部系统中的。
zh: 呃，发现组织内的上下文其实是分散在不同的个人代码仓库，还有内部系统中的。
en: We found that the organization’s context was scattered across individuals, code repositories, and internal systems.

source_text: 呃，当我们要让AI干活的时候，还是得有人先去收集这些上下文。
zh: 呃，当我们要让AI干活的时候，还是得有人先去收集这些上下文。
en: When we wanted AI to do the work, someone still had to gather all that context first.

source_text: 呃，比如一个功能迭代过几次，
zh: 呃，比如一个功能迭代过几次，
en: For example, if a feature has gone through several iterations,

source_text: 它横跨了哪几个仓库，呃，开发完怎么测试，上线的时候是先上哪个服务，还是后上哪个服务。
zh: 它横跨了哪几个仓库，呃，开发完怎么测试，上线的时候是先上哪个服务，还是后上哪个服务。
en: Which repositories does it span? How do you test it once development is done? And when you deploy it, which service goes first and which comes later?

source_text: 呃，如果你把一个需求交给一个同事，他中间卡住了怎么办。
zh: 呃，如果你把一个需求交给一个同事，他中间卡住了怎么办。
en: If you hand a request to a colleague and they get stuck halfway through, what do you do?

source_text: 呃，他最后做出的方案跟你想的完全不一样又怎么办。
zh: 呃，他最后做出的方案跟你想的完全不一样又怎么办。
en: And what if the solution they come up with is completely different from what you had in mind?

source_text: 呃，这些上下文的缺失，还有过程中的摩擦，还是在拖累每一个人的效率，导致整个组织的效率依然是上不去的。
zh: 呃，这些上下文的缺失，还有过程中的摩擦，还是在拖累每一个人的效率，导致整个组织的效率依然是上不去的。
en: These gaps in context and the friction along the way were still slowing everyone down, so the organization as a whole couldn’t become more efficient.

source_text: 呃，这里时间有限，呃，没办法跟大家详细的分享我们的尝试和摸索。我们可以直接上答案。
zh: 呃，这里时间有限，呃，没办法跟大家详细的分享我们的尝试和摸索。我们可以直接上答案。
en: We’re short on time, so I can’t walk you through all our experiments and what we learned. Let’s jump straight to the answer.

source_text: 我们把上下文工具，还有任务全都放到了所有人都看得到的地方。
zh: 我们把上下文工具，还有任务全都放到了所有人都看得到的地方。
en: We put all the context, tools, and tasks in one place where everyone could see them.

source_text: 呃，这里其实主要就是两个事情，一个是Manus mono repo，呃，
zh: 呃，这里其实主要就是两个事情，一个是Manus mono repo，呃，
en: There are really two main things here. One is the Manus monorepo, and…

source_text: 它里面包含了公司所有的代码仓库、知识库、内部工具。
zh: 它里面包含了公司所有的代码仓库、知识库、内部工具。
en: It contains all the company’s code repositories, knowledge bases, and internal tools.

source_text: 我们一般内部就都叫它mono。
zh: 我们一般内部就都叫它mono。
en: Internally, we usually just call it “mono.”

source_text: 第二个事情是任务权公开化，就是呃，
zh: 第二个事情是任务权公开化，就是呃，
en: The second is making all tasks visible to everyone, so…

source_text: 公司里的每一个人都可以看到其他人的agent的任务是什么。你也可以直接加进去进行协作。
zh: 公司里的每一个人都可以看到其他人的agent的任务是什么。你也可以直接加进去进行协作。
en: Everyone in the company can see what tasks other people’s agents are working on, and they can jump in and collaborate directly.

source_text: 呃，那我们先来看看mono里面具体有什么吧。
zh: 呃，那我们先来看看mono里面具体有什么吧。
en: So, let’s take a look at what’s actually in mono.

source_text: 这里其实整合了开发Manus系统所需要的所有的东西。
zh: 这里其实整合了开发Manus系统所需要的所有的东西。
en: It brings together everything we need to develop the Manus system.

source_text: 呃，所有的东西指的是什么？
zh: 呃，所有的东西指的是什么？
en: What exactly do we mean by “everything”?

source_text: 呃，举个最简单的例子，有一个新同事入职，他只需要让Manus帮他配好这个mono repo，他就可以直接上手开发。
zh: 呃，举个最简单的例子，有一个新同事入职，他只需要让Manus帮他配好这个mono repo，他就可以直接上手开发。
en: For example, when someone new joins the company, they can simply ask Manus to set up the mono repo for them, and they’re ready to start developing.

source_text: 不管他是做前端、后端，还是移动端，亦或者他是产品还是设计。
zh: 不管他是做前端、后端，还是移动端，亦或者他是产品还是设计。
en: Whether they work on the frontend, backend, or mobile app—or in product or design.

source_text: 除了开发组件以外呢，这里还集成了debug、查日志、数据分析等等的工具。
zh: 除了开发组件以外呢，这里还集成了debug、查日志、数据分析等等的工具。
en: Besides development components, it also includes tools for debugging, checking logs, data analysis, and more.

source_text: 所以现在经常是一个产品同学觉得线上哪里有问题，他会自己先去mono里面做查询和分析。
zh: 所以现在经常是一个产品同学觉得线上哪里有问题，他会自己先去mono里面做查询和分析。
en: So now, when someone on the product team spots a potential issue in production, they often go into the mono repo to investigate and analyze it themselves first.

source_text: 如果确认真的是一个bug，简单的bug，他可能就自己修了。
zh: 如果确认真的是一个bug，简单的bug，他可能就自己修了。
en: If they confirm it’s a bug, they might fix it themselves if it’s a simple one.

source_text: 如果是非常复杂的bug，他再转交给研发，而且他转交的东西里面有bug的分析，可能的原因，甚至还有解决方案。
zh: 如果是非常复杂的bug，他再转交给研发，而且他转交的东西里面有bug的分析，可能的原因，甚至还有解决方案。
en: If it’s a particularly complex bug, they’ll pass it on to the engineering team, along with their analysis, possible causes, and even a proposed fix.

source_text: 呃，除了代码仓库以外呢，打通Slack和Notion对于我们来说也是很重要的一环。
zh: 呃，除了代码仓库以外呢，打通Slack和Notion对于我们来说也是很重要的一环。
en: Beyond the code repository, integrating Slack and Notion is also an important part of this for us.

source_text: 因为我们的产品决策讨论，我们的用户反馈都集中在Slack的各个呃频道里面。
zh: 因为我们的产品决策讨论，我们的用户反馈都集中在Slack的各个呃频道里面。
en: Because our product decisions and user feedback are all discussed across various Slack channels.

source_text: 而我们的需求文档，我们的bug呃任务追踪都在Notion里面。
zh: 而我们的需求文档，我们的bug呃任务追踪都在Notion里面。
en: And our requirements documents, bug reports, and task tracking all live in Notion.

source_text: 那你配置mono的时候，它就会帮你配好这两个连接器。
zh: 那你配置mono的时候，它就会帮你配好这两个连接器。
en: So when you set up Mono, it automatically configures both connectors for you.

source_text: 呃，这样就实现了一开始的那个场景。
zh: 呃，这样就实现了一开始的那个场景。
en: That’s how we make the scenario I described at the beginning possible.

source_text: 呃，一个产品的同学在Slack里面提了一个需求，
zh: 呃，一个产品的同学在Slack里面提了一个需求，
en: Say someone on the product team posts a feature request in Slack.

source_text: 呃，研发同学直接把这个Slack链接发给Manus，Manus用Slack连接器先去读了你们的会话，
zh: 呃，研发同学直接把这个Slack链接发给Manus，Manus用Slack连接器先去读了你们的会话，
en: Then an engineer sends the Slack link straight to Manus, which uses the Slack connector to read the conversation first.

source_text: 然后去Notion里面搜索可能存在的产品文档，然后又去读了当前最新的代码。
zh: 然后去Notion里面搜索可能存在的产品文档，然后又去读了当前最新的代码。
en: Then it searches Notion for any relevant product documents and reads the latest version of the code.

source_text: 他充分了解需求之后，就可以直接开始开发。
zh: 他充分了解需求之后，就可以直接开始开发。
en: Once it fully understands the requirements, it can start developing right away.

source_text: 而且他做到可以上测试环境之后，
zh: 而且他做到可以上测试环境之后，
en: And once it’s ready to deploy to the test environment,

source_text: 它还会再去那个Slack频道下面@那个产品同学，啊，你现在可以测试了。
zh: 它还会再去那个Slack频道下面@那个产品同学，啊，你现在可以测试了。
en: It’ll also go back to that Slack channel and tag the product team member: “You can test it now.”

source_text: 如果有哪里不对，你告诉我。那么这么几次来回之后，这个功能就可以直接上线了。
zh: 如果有哪里不对，你告诉我。那么这么几次来回之后，这个功能就可以直接上线了。
en: “If anything isn’t right, let me know.” After a few rounds of back-and-forth, the feature can go live.

source_text: 呃，哦，sorry，呃，这个，哎，怎么上一页啊。
zh: 呃，哦，sorry，呃，这个，哎，怎么上一页啊。
en: Uh, oh, sorry—how do I go back to the previous slide?

source_text: 哦，呃。
zh: 哦，呃。
en: Oh, uh.

source_text: 哎，好像缺了一页。
zh: 哎，好像缺了一页。
en: Oh, looks like a slide is missing.

source_text: 呃，
zh: 呃，
en: Uh...

source_text: 哦，没没没事没事。
zh: 哦，没没没事没事。
en: Oh, no, no, it’s fine.

source_text: 呃，呃，另外一个东西就是一个全链路的otel日志追踪系统。
zh: 呃，呃，另外一个东西就是一个全链路的otel日志追踪系统。
en: Uh, another thing is an end-to-end log tracing system built on OpenTelemetry.

source_text: 呃，这个东西则是加速AI debug的一个关键。
zh: 呃，这个东西则是加速AI debug的一个关键。
en: This is key to speeding up AI debugging.

source_text: 呃，因为AI可以用同一个trace ID，
zh: 呃，因为AI可以用同一个trace ID，
en: Because the AI can use the same trace ID,

source_text: 呃，一路查到底。
zh: 呃，一路查到底。
en: Uh, to trace it all the way through.

source_text: 它最后可以直接定位到，呃，这个bug是由哪个仓库哪个代码是谁在哪一次改动引起的。
zh: 它最后可以直接定位到，呃，这个bug是由哪个仓库哪个代码是谁在哪一次改动引起的。
en: Ultimately, it can pinpoint which repository and code the bug came from, who changed it, and which commit introduced it.

source_text: 呃，这个过程通常可以在20分钟内完成。
zh: 呃，这个过程通常可以在20分钟内完成。
en: This process can usually be completed within 20 minutes.

source_text: 对于那些比较紧急的线上故障，呃，我们还可以开启极速模式，
zh: 对于那些比较紧急的线上故障，呃，我们还可以开启极速模式，
en: For more urgent production incidents, we can also switch to fast-track mode,

source_text: 它可以在5分钟之内完成故障的定位和修复方法的建议。
zh: 它可以在5分钟之内完成故障的定位和修复方法的建议。
en: It can identify the cause of the incident and suggest a fix within five minutes.

source_text: 呃，这一页在涛哥的文章里也提到过，就是有了mono以后，我们很快就享受到了mono的好处，
zh: 呃，这一页在涛哥的文章里也提到过，就是有了mono以后，我们很快就享受到了mono的好处，
en: This was also mentioned in Tao’s article: once we had the monorepo, we quickly started seeing its benefits.

source_text: 因为产品同学和设计师同学也开始积极的参与研发的工作。
zh: 因为产品同学和设计师同学也开始积极的参与研发的工作。
en: Because product managers and designers also started actively participating in development.

source_text: 大家可以看到这里有一位最积极的产品同学，合了160多个PR。
zh: 大家可以看到这里有一位最积极的产品同学，合了160多个PR。
en: As you can see, one particularly active product manager merged more than 160 PRs.

source_text: 其实以前，呃，我们会有很多的体验优化和UI优化的小需求，积压在研发管道上，因为各种各样的原因无法被推进。
zh: 其实以前，呃，我们会有很多的体验优化和UI优化的小需求，积压在研发管道上，因为各种各样的原因无法被推进。
en: In the past, a lot of small UX and UI improvements would pile up in the development pipeline and couldn’t move forward for one reason or another.

source_text: 呃，但现在产品同学和设计师同学可以自己研发自己体验，然后自己上线。
zh: 呃，但现在产品同学和设计师同学可以自己研发自己体验，然后自己上线。
en: But now, product managers and designers can build these improvements themselves, try them out, and ship them.

source_text: 这里有一个典型的例子就是，呃，一位产品同学要做一个语音输入的优化功能，
zh: 这里有一个典型的例子就是，呃，一位产品同学要做一个语音输入的优化功能，
en: A typical example is a product manager who wanted to improve the voice input feature.

source_text: 于是他让Manus给他做了一个prototype，测试了市面上十几款主流的语音模型，确定好了最适合的那个以后，
zh: 于是他让Manus给他做了一个prototype，测试了市面上十几款主流的语音模型，确定好了最适合的那个以后，
en: So he asked Manus to build a prototype, tested more than a dozen popular speech models, and chose the one that worked best.

source_text: 它又让Manus基于我们的前端代码仓库写了一个动态的交互展示视频。
zh: 它又让Manus基于我们的前端代码仓库写了一个动态的交互展示视频。
en: Then he asked Manus to use our frontend codebase to create a video demonstrating the interaction.

source_text: 然后他把这个视频发到了我们的产品讨论群里，大家看完之后立马就get到了这个功能，好用在哪里，
zh: 然后他把这个视频发到了我们的产品讨论群里，大家看完之后立马就get到了这个功能，好用在哪里，
en: He then shared the video in our product discussion group, and everyone immediately understood what made the feature useful.

source_text: 为什么要做这样的优化。
zh: 为什么要做这样的优化。
en: Why we needed to make this improvement.

source_text: 这个功能后来很快就上线了，而且我每天都会用，因为我比较喜欢用语音功能。
zh: 这个功能后来很快就上线了，而且我每天都会用，因为我比较喜欢用语音功能。
en: The feature launched soon after, and I use it every day because I prefer voice input.

source_text: 那这里衍生出一个问题就是，呃，code review的问题。
zh: 那这里衍生出一个问题就是，呃，code review的问题。
en: That raises a related question: what about code review?

source_text: 呃，大家一开始可能会觉得产品同学自己提代码会不会有问题，但其实后来我们发现，呃，
zh: 呃，大家一开始可能会觉得产品同学自己提代码会不会有问题，但其实后来我们发现，呃，
en: At first, people might worry that having product managers submit code themselves could cause problems. But we later found that...

source_text: 如果他们用的coding agent已经是旗舰模型，我们的code review系统也是旗舰模型，
zh: 如果他们用的coding agent已经是旗舰模型，我们的code review系统也是旗舰模型，
en: If they’re using a coding agent powered by a flagship model, and our code review system is also powered by a flagship model,

source_text: 再加上mono里面有很多的架构设计、研发的准则，其实他们提上的代码质量是完全OK的。
zh: 再加上mono里面有很多的架构设计、研发的准则，其实他们提上的代码质量是完全OK的。
en: And with all the architectural guidelines and development standards built into our monorepo, the quality of the code they submit is actually perfectly fine.

source_text: 而且我们还建立了领域负责人的审核机制，
zh: 而且我们还建立了领域负责人的审核机制，
en: We also put a review process in place where the person responsible for each domain signs off on the code.

source_text: 像是支付系统，呃，付费模块，或者是核心的prompt，呃，都必须由对应的负责人呃，同意之后这个PR才可以合。
zh: 像是支付系统，呃，付费模块，或者是核心的prompt，呃，都必须由对应的负责人呃，同意之后这个PR才可以合。
en: For things like the payment system, paid features, or core prompts, the PR can only be merged after the person responsible for that area approves it.

source_text: 呃，我们实践下来，目前，呃，没有发生过在线上因为代码质量而导致的事故。
zh: 呃，我们实践下来，目前，呃，没有发生过在线上因为代码质量而导致的事故。
en: In practice, we haven’t had any production incidents caused by code quality so far.

source_text: 呃，那为了让公司更多人来参与这个AI native研发呢，我们做了，呃，组织架构和技术架构的双重升级。
zh: 呃，那为了让公司更多人来参与这个AI native研发呢，我们做了，呃，组织架构和技术架构的双重升级。
en: To get more people across the company involved in AI-native development, we upgraded both our organizational structure and our technical architecture.

source_text: 在技术架构上，我们把Manus完全变成了插件化的系统，呃，由一个精简的内核加周围的外围的这些功能模块，呃，
zh: 在技术架构上，我们把Manus完全变成了插件化的系统，呃，由一个精简的内核加周围的外围的这些功能模块，呃，
en: On the technical side, we made Manus fully modular, with a lean core surrounded by plug-in feature modules.

source_text: 架构这个插件化对于架构升级是，呃，一个硬仗，但我们，我们花了相当长的时间和精力，但好处也非常明显，因为内核通常是精简的，
zh: 架构这个插件化对于架构升级是，呃，一个硬仗，但我们，我们花了相当长的时间和精力，但好处也非常明显，因为内核通常是精简的，
en: Making the architecture modular was a major undertaking. We spent a lot of time and effort on it, but the benefits are clear: the core stays lean,

source_text: 不变的，而外围的这些插件，它的功能是非常内聚的。
zh: 不变的，而外围的这些插件，它的功能是非常内聚的。
en: and relatively stable, while each of the surrounding plugins has a tightly focused purpose.

source_text: 这样AI在开发的时候，它可以更少的去做跨仓库的工作。
zh: 这样AI在开发的时候，它可以更少的去做跨仓库的工作。
en: That way, when AI is developing features, it needs to do less work across repositories.

source_text: 呃，一方面提高了AI写代码的效率，另一方面也降低了整体系统的风险，
zh: 呃，一方面提高了AI写代码的效率，另一方面也降低了整体系统的风险，
en: This makes AI more efficient at writing code while also reducing the risk to the system as a whole.

source_text: 不会由于一个单点的功能故障而导致整个系统都出问题。
zh: 不会由于一个单点的功能故障而导致整个系统都出问题。
en: A failure in one feature won’t bring down the entire system.

source_text: 而在组织架构上，我们采取，呃，扁平化的原则，呃，
zh: 而在组织架构上，我们采取，呃，扁平化的原则，呃，
en: On the organizational side, we adopted a flat structure.

source_text: 按照事情去分人，而不是按照人去分事情。
zh: 按照事情去分人，而不是按照人去分事情。
en: We assign people to the work, rather than dividing the work among people.

source_text: 通常一个人或者两三个人的，呃，小组就可以维护一整个大模块。
zh: 通常一个人或者两三个人的，呃，小组就可以维护一整个大模块。
en: Typically, one person—or a small team of two or three—can maintain an entire major module.

source_text: 呃，大家会对自己负责的模块有非常强的这个责任感，而且其他人也会非常积极的给你这个模块提交代码。
zh: 呃，大家会对自己负责的模块有非常强的这个责任感，而且其他人也会非常积极的给你这个模块提交代码。
en: People take strong ownership of the modules they’re responsible for, while others are also eager to contribute code to those modules.

source_text: 呃，以至于有时候我会感觉自己在维护一个开源项目，呃，我记得有一个后端同学，他自己，呃，
zh: 呃，以至于有时候我会感觉自己在维护一个开源项目，呃，我记得有一个后端同学，他自己，呃，
en: Sometimes it even feels like I’m maintaining an open-source project. I remember one backend engineer who...

source_text: 在我不知道的情况下端到端的给Manus Studio做了一个远程电脑终端控制功能，因为他要操作自己家里的电脑来工作。
zh: 在我不知道的情况下端到端的给Manus Studio做了一个远程电脑终端控制功能，因为他要操作自己家里的电脑来工作。
en: Without me knowing, he built an end-to-end remote desktop control feature for Manus Studio because he needed to access his home computer for work.

source_text: 这个功能现在也在线上， 而且一直是他来负责维护和，呃，优化。
zh: 这个功能现在也在线上， 而且一直是他来负责维护和，呃，优化。
en: That feature is still live, and he’s continued to maintain and improve it.

source_text: 呃，那说完了mono，呃，再来看一下任务公开化。
zh: 呃，那说完了mono，呃，再来看一下任务公开化。
en: Having covered mono, let’s turn to making tasks public.

source_text: 这个是我们对于AI native写作的更进一步的探索。
zh: 这个是我们对于AI native写作的更进一步的探索。
en: This is another step in our exploration of AI-native writing.

source_text: 起初它其实只是为了解决一个问题，就是我们不知道同事们是怎么用AI的。
zh: 起初它其实只是为了解决一个问题，就是我们不知道同事们是怎么用AI的。
en: At first, it was simply meant to solve one problem: we didn’t know how our colleagues were using AI.

source_text: 呃，对于那些，呃，我们觉得他用AI方式有问题的同学，我们应该怎么去帮助他们。
zh: 呃，对于那些，呃，我们觉得他用AI方式有问题的同学，我们应该怎么去帮助他们。
en: And how could we help colleagues whose approach to using AI we thought could be improved?

source_text: 但是这个系统做出来之后，我们发现它还有很多别的好处。
zh: 但是这个系统做出来之后，我们发现它还有很多别的好处。
en: But after we built the system, we discovered it had many other benefits too.

source_text: 比如说，一个任务可以很多个人接力完成。
zh: 比如说，一个任务可以很多个人接力完成。
en: For example, multiple people can take turns working on the same task.

source_text: 再比如说，你想知道一个事情的进展，你不用去问那个人，
zh: 再比如说，你想知道一个事情的进展，你不用去问那个人，
en: Or if you want to check on something’s progress, you don’t have to ask the person working on it.

source_text: 你直接去看他的agent的任务，你就可以知道他现在到底，呃，是什么进展。
zh: 你直接去看他的agent的任务，你就可以知道他现在到底，呃，是什么进展。
en: You can just check their agent’s task to see exactly how far along they are.

source_text: 呃，比如这就是一个非常典型的，呃，接力任务。
zh: 呃，比如这就是一个非常典型的，呃，接力任务。
en: For example, this is a typical task that gets passed from one person to another.

source_text: 我自己也帮同事接力过好几个，呃，需求。
zh: 我自己也帮同事接力过好几个，呃，需求。
en: I’ve also taken over several requests from colleagues myself.

source_text: 就是很多时候你的，呃，任务只是卡在某一个关键的决策点上，可能是一个技术决策，也可能是一个产品决策。
zh: 就是很多时候你的，呃，任务只是卡在某一个关键的决策点上，可能是一个技术决策，也可能是一个产品决策。
en: Often, a task is stuck at just one key decision point—it might be a technical decision or a product decision.

source_text: 那以前你就要去找那个能做决策的人，啊，跟他交代上下文，然后讨论完之后你又要把结论，
zh: 那以前你就要去找那个能做决策的人，啊，跟他交代上下文，然后讨论完之后你又要把结论，
en: In the past, you’d have to find the person who could make that decision, bring them up to speed, and then, after discussing it, take the conclusion back…

source_text: 呃，发给AI。呃，来回折腾半天。
zh: 呃，发给AI。呃，来回折腾半天。
en: …send it to the AI. The whole back-and-forth would take ages.

source_text: 现在你可以直接把任务链接发给那个人，呃，
zh: 现在你可以直接把任务链接发给那个人，呃，
en: Now you can just send that person a link to the task, and…

source_text: 发给那个能去做决策的人，他就像自己的Manus任务一样，他看完上下文，他可以选择直接追问，啊，
zh: 发给那个能去做决策的人，他就像自己的Manus任务一样，他看完上下文，他可以选择直接追问，啊，
en: Send it to the decision-maker. They can treat it like one of their own Manus tasks: review the context and ask follow-up questions directly.

source_text: 也可以选择当场就把决策做了，然后agent就会又会自己继续跑。
zh: 也可以选择当场就把决策做了，然后agent就会又会自己继续跑。
en: Or they can make the decision right then and there, and the agent will carry on with the task on its own.

source_text: 呃，写作中间的这些摩擦相当于被抹除了。
zh: 呃，写作中间的这些摩擦相当于被抹除了。
en: That essentially removes all the friction along the way.

source_text: 呃，可以这样理解，呃，mono是解决了AI看不全上下文的问题，而任务公开化其实是解决人看不全上下文的问题。
zh: 呃，可以这样理解，呃，mono是解决了AI看不全上下文的问题，而任务公开化其实是解决人看不全上下文的问题。
en: You could think of it this way: Mono solves the problem of AI not having the full context, while making tasks public solves the problem of people not having the full context.

source_text: 呃，更进一步呢，我们还探索了数字分身，或者说数字员工吧，还有自动化接单系统。
zh: 呃，更进一步呢，我们还探索了数字分身，或者说数字员工吧，还有自动化接单系统。
en: Going a step further, we’ve also explored digital avatars—or digital employees, if you will—and an automated system for taking on tasks.

source_text: 呃，我们现在Slack里面其实活跃着很多的基于mono的数字分身。
zh: 呃，我们现在Slack里面其实活跃着很多的基于mono的数字分身。
en: We actually have a lot of Mono-based digital avatars active in our Slack workspace right now.

source_text: 比如有个agent的同事的，呃，分身就是每次，呃，服务发版之后，去检查一下服务的健康状态，
zh: 比如有个agent的同事的，呃，分身就是每次，呃，服务发版之后，去检查一下服务的健康状态，
en: For example, one colleague has an agent-based digital twin that checks the service’s health after every release.

source_text: 然后他还会提醒这次发版带上的那些功能，找到对应的负责人，然后@他们去线上去体验这个功能。
zh: 然后他还会提醒这次发版带上的那些功能，找到对应的负责人，然后@他们去线上去体验这个功能。
en: It also identifies the features included in the release, finds their owners, and tags them to try those features in production.

source_text: 呃，他有一次比我们自己的监控系统更好，更早的发现了一个线上的故障。
zh: 呃，他有一次比我们自己的监控系统更好，更早的发现了一个线上的故障。
en: Once, it caught a production incident before our own monitoring system did.

source_text: 呃，而自动化接单系统，这个灵感其实来源于Loop Engineering。
zh: 呃，而自动化接单系统，这个灵感其实来源于Loop Engineering。
en: The idea for the automated task intake system actually came from Loop Engineering.

source_text: 呃，我们搭了一个boat，这个boat每天都会自动去git hub里面看有哪些issue，然后自己去，呃，写代码，
zh: 呃，我们搭了一个boat，这个boat每天都会自动去git hub里面看有哪些issue，然后自己去，呃，写代码，
en: We built a bot that checks GitHub for issues every day and then writes the code to address them.

source_text: 自己去做测试，然后自己去提PR。
zh: 自己去做测试，然后自己去提PR。
en: It runs the tests and opens a pull request on its own.

source_text: 然后，呃，运行了一段时间，我们发现它提PR的速度，呃，远远大于我们合PR的速度。
zh: 然后，呃，运行了一段时间，我们发现它提PR的速度，呃，远远大于我们合PR的速度。
en: After it had been running for a while, we found it was opening PRs much faster than we could merge them.

source_text: 呃，就是几天下来有几十个PR没人管，没人合。
zh: 呃，就是几天下来有几十个PR没人管，没人合。
en: Within just a few days, dozens of PRs were sitting there with no one reviewing or merging them.

source_text: 呃，而且你并不知道这些PR优先级是什么。
zh: 呃，而且你并不知道这些PR优先级是什么。
en: And we didn’t even know how to prioritize those PRs.

source_text: 呃，这个事情给我们的启发是，嗯，其实人在系统中的关键决策变得更重要。
zh: 呃，这个事情给我们的启发是，嗯，其实人在系统中的关键决策变得更重要。
en: What this taught us is that the key decisions people make within the system are becoming even more important.

source_text: 因为如果没有人去定优先级的话，
zh: 因为如果没有人去定优先级的话，
en: Because if no one sets the priorities,

source_text: 呃，AI的自动化研发很可能，呃，只是在浪费token而已。
zh: 呃，AI的自动化研发很可能，呃，只是在浪费token而已。
en: AI-driven development automation may just end up wasting tokens.

source_text: 呃，最后呢，我，我想再简单分享一下，
zh: 呃，最后呢，我，我想再简单分享一下，
en: Finally, I’d like to briefly share one more thing.

source_text: 呃，我们在过程中踩过的一些坑。
zh: 呃，我们在过程中踩过的一些坑。
en: some of the pitfalls we encountered along the way.

source_text: 呃，时间有限，我觉得，呃，我也只能大概说一说。
zh: 呃，时间有限，我觉得，呃，我也只能大概说一说。
en: Time is limited, so I can only give a brief overview.

source_text: 第一条就是，嗯，
zh: 第一条就是，嗯，
en: The first one is...

source_text: 人的重要性会变得更高。
zh: 人的重要性会变得更高。
en: People will become even more important.

source_text: 因为当AI足够强大之后，
zh: 因为当AI足够强大之后，
en: Because once AI becomes powerful enough,

source_text: 瓶颈其实又回到了人的身上。
zh: 瓶颈其实又回到了人的身上。
en: the bottleneck shifts back to people.

source_text: 呃，我们会发现一个有产品sense的研发同学，他写出来的功能会更好用。
zh: 呃，我们会发现一个有产品sense的研发同学，他写出来的功能会更好用。
en: We’ve found that developers with a good sense of the product build features that are easier to use.

source_text: 呃，一个懂一点代码的产品同学，他提交的PR可能是一遍就过的。
zh: 呃，一个懂一点代码的产品同学，他提交的PR可能是一遍就过的。
en: A product manager who knows a bit of code might submit a PR that gets approved on the first try.

source_text: 那这意味着我们可能需要更多复合型的人才。
zh: 那这意味着我们可能需要更多复合型的人才。
en: That means we may need more people with a mix of skills.

source_text: 呃，这和过去对于人才的需求其实是一个很大的区别。
zh: 呃，这和过去对于人才的需求其实是一个很大的区别。
en: That’s actually a big shift from the kinds of talent we needed in the past.

source_text: 那怎么去识别这些人才，怎么给他们分配适合的事情，呃，其实是相当有挑战的。我们也在不断的探索。
zh: 那怎么去识别这些人才，怎么给他们分配适合的事情，呃，其实是相当有挑战的。我们也在不断的探索。
en: So identifying these people and assigning them the right work is quite challenging. We’re still figuring it out.

source_text: 呃，第二个问题，呃，相信，呃，大家都有感触啊，就是，呃，就就就看不懂。
zh: 呃，第二个问题，呃，相信，呃，大家都有感触啊，就是，呃，就就就看不懂。
en: The second challenge, I think, is something we’ve all experienced: you just can’t make sense of it.

source_text: 就AI刚给你一个决策，你刚做完，下一个又来了，然后它在说什么，就你看了如看。
zh: 就AI刚给你一个决策，你刚做完，下一个又来了，然后它在说什么，就你看了如看。
en: AI gives you a decision to make, and as soon as you’ve acted on it, another one comes in. You read what it says, but it doesn’t really sink in.

source_text: 呃，我，我觉得本质上是你的注意力消耗光了。
zh: 呃，我，我觉得本质上是你的注意力消耗光了。
en: I think, at its core, you’ve simply run out of mental bandwidth.

source_text: 因为现在AI时代，token是一个可再生资源，而人的注意力变成了一个不可再生资源。
zh: 因为现在AI时代，token是一个可再生资源，而人的注意力变成了一个不可再生资源。
en: Because in the AI era, tokens are a renewable resource, but human attention is not.

source_text: 呃，所以我们的感受是，在适当的时候还是要放慢速度，呃，把关键的决策给做对。
zh: 呃，所以我们的感受是，在适当的时候还是要放慢速度，呃，把关键的决策给做对。
en: So we’ve found that sometimes we need to slow down and make sure we get the key decisions right.

source_text: 呃，我个人的一些做法是，嗯，你不要去平均的分配你的注意力。
zh: 呃，我个人的一些做法是，嗯，你不要去平均的分配你的注意力。
en: Personally, I try not to spread my attention evenly across everything.

source_text: 呃，
zh: 呃，
en: Uh...

source_text: 你，你想象你的注意力是一个，呃，用来投资出去的资产。
zh: 你，你想象你的注意力是一个，呃，用来投资出去的资产。
en: Think of your attention as an asset you can invest.

source_text: 那它应该被投在那些价值更高、杠杆率更高的地方，而那些很常规的决策其实应该想办法把它们沉淀成skill，沉淀成，呃，
zh: 那它应该被投在那些价值更高、杠杆率更高的地方，而那些很常规的决策其实应该想办法把它们沉淀成skill，沉淀成，呃，
en: So you should invest it where it creates the most value and has the greatest leverage. For routine decisions, you should find ways to turn them into reusable skills, into, uh...

source_text: agent的memory，还是让AI去，呃，帮你去解决这些事情。
zh: agent的memory，还是让AI去，呃，帮你去解决这些事情。
en: Let the agent’s memory—or AI more broadly—handle those things for you.

source_text: 呃，第三个问题是贵的问题，或者说，呃，在AI上怎么花钱才值得的一个问题。
zh: 呃，第三个问题是贵的问题，或者说，呃，在AI上怎么花钱才值得的一个问题。
en: The third question is about cost—or rather, how to spend money on AI in a way that’s worth it.

source_text: 呃，我们有一位同事一个月花了10万美金的token，然后我们后来，呃，review这个事情，就发现，
zh: 呃，我们有一位同事一个月花了10万美金的token，然后我们后来，呃，review这个事情，就发现，
en: One of our colleagues spent $100,000 on tokens in a month. When we later reviewed it, we found that...

source_text: 嗯，其实对于很多复杂的需求来说，你不能完全让AI去做自动驾驶。
zh: 嗯，其实对于很多复杂的需求来说，你不能完全让AI去做自动驾驶。
en: For many complex tasks, you can’t just put AI on autopilot.

source_text: 呃，所谓自动驾驶是什么意思？
zh: 呃，所谓自动驾驶是什么意思？
en: What do I mean by “autopilot”?

source_text: 就是，呃，你，你给AI一个事情，然后呢，呃，
zh: 就是，呃，你，你给AI一个事情，然后呢，呃，
en: It’s when you give AI a task, and then, uh...

source_text: 让就让它一直做，一直做。
zh: 让就让它一直做，一直做。
en: You just let it keep working on it and working on it.

source_text: 不管AI说什么，你都说，说得对，继续。
zh: 不管AI说什么，你都说，说得对，继续。
en: Whatever the AI says, you just say, “That’s right. Keep going.”

source_text: 呃，我自己也自动就自动驾驶过一段时间。
zh: 呃，我自己也自动就自动驾驶过一段时间。
en: I’ve gone on autopilot with AI myself for a while, too.

source_text: 呃，那现在我们的感觉是，呃，对于复杂的事情你还是要做好，
zh: 呃，那现在我们的感觉是，呃，对于复杂的事情你还是要做好，
en: So what we’ve found is that, for complex tasks, you still need to do a good job of...

source_text: 呃，方案设计。
zh: 呃，方案设计。
en: ...planning out the approach.

source_text: 呃，做好任务的拆分，做好阶段性的验证。
zh: 呃，做好任务的拆分，做好阶段性的验证。
en: Break the task down properly and check the results at each stage.

source_text: 因为，呃，AI和人协作的过程中，
zh: 因为，呃，AI和人协作的过程中，
en: Because, uh, when people and AI work together,

source_text: 呃，该由人控制的质量还是要由人来控制，让AI做自己擅长的事情。
zh: 呃，该由人控制的质量还是要由人来控制，让AI做自己擅长的事情。
en: People still need to oversee the quality of the work, while letting AI do what it does best.

source_text: 呃，我们的目标是做到质量上有保障，但工程上不返工。
zh: 呃，我们的目标是做到质量上有保障，但工程上不返工。
en: Our goal is to ensure quality without having to redo the engineering work.

source_text: 因为你花出去的钱是可以再赚回来的，但你浪费掉的时间成本很可能，呃，是无价的。
zh: 因为你花出去的钱是可以再赚回来的，但你浪费掉的时间成本很可能，呃，是无价的。
en: You can earn back the money you spend, but the time you waste may well be priceless.

source_text: 呃，呃，好像还有一点时间。
zh: 呃，呃，好像还有一点时间。
en: Uh, it looks like we still have a little time.

source_text: 呃，我可以，呃，分享一下我，我或者说一些同事是怎么用AI工作的吧。
zh: 呃，我可以，呃，分享一下我，我或者说一些同事是怎么用AI工作的吧。
en: I can share how I—and some of my colleagues—use AI in our work.

source_text: 呃，我们有一位，呃，agent研发同事，呃，他，他现在，呃，呃，工作方式可以说是赛博朋克。
zh: 呃，我们有一位，呃，agent研发同事，呃，他，他现在，呃，呃，工作方式可以说是赛博朋克。
en: We have a colleague who develops AI agents, and his workflow these days is, well, pretty cyberpunk.

source_text: 呃，他自己有一个Manus的主任务，呃，那个任务每天会去Slack、Notion、邮件里面去找到需要他做的事情，
zh: 呃，他自己有一个Manus的主任务，呃，那个任务每天会去Slack、Notion、邮件里面去找到需要他做的事情，
en: He has a main task running in Manus that checks Slack, Notion, and his email every day for things he needs to do.

source_text: 然后把它们分门别类，哪些是你现在就可以拍板的，哪些可能是要，呃，新建一个任务的，哪些是，呃，还需要别人的输入的，全部都给他罗列好。
zh: 然后把它们分门别类，哪些是你现在就可以拍板的，哪些可能是要，呃，新建一个任务的，哪些是，呃，还需要别人的输入的，全部都给他罗列好。
en: Then it sorts everything into categories: what he can decide right away, what might need a new task, and what still needs input from others. It lays it all out for him.

source_text: 然后他每天来公司，
zh: 然后他每天来公司，
en: Then, when he comes into the office each day,

source_text: 第一件事情就是打开Manus，问一下说，我现在要干嘛。
zh: 第一件事情就是打开Manus，问一下说，我现在要干嘛。
en: the first thing he does is open Manus and ask, “What should I work on now?”

source_text: 然后Manus就会跟他说，哦，你现在有这几个事情要快速决策，这几个事情是不是要新建一个任务，呃，这几个事情在等着别人的输入。
zh: 然后Manus就会跟他说，哦，你现在有这几个事情要快速决策，这几个事情是不是要新建一个任务，呃，这几个事情在等着别人的输入。
en: And Manus tells him, “Here are a few things you need to make quick decisions on, a few that may need new tasks, and a few that are waiting on input from other people.”

source_text: 呃，然后他，他同时可以做非常非常多的事情，就是他的并行化是我们整个公司里面最高的。
zh: 呃，然后他，他同时可以做非常非常多的事情，就是他的并行化是我们整个公司里面最高的。
en: And he can work on a huge number of things at once. He has the highest level of parallelization of anyone in the company.

source_text: 呃，我经常惊讶于，他都在这么饱和的情况下居然还能再接一个需求。
zh: 呃，我经常惊讶于，他都在这么饱和的情况下居然还能再接一个需求。
en: I’m often amazed that, even with so much on his plate, he can still take on another request.

source_text: 然后我自己，呃，也有一个用Manus工作的例子，就是，呃，前几天我发现我们的内部的权限系统特别乱。
zh: 然后我自己，呃，也有一个用Manus工作的例子，就是，呃，前几天我发现我们的内部的权限系统特别乱。
en: I have an example of using Manus for my own work, too. A few days ago, I realized our internal permissions system was a mess.

source_text: 因为这个系统已经存在很久了，呃，大家没有空去管它。
zh: 因为这个系统已经存在很久了，呃，大家没有空去管它。
en: The system had been around for a long time, and no one had had time to maintain it.

source_text: 我就让Manus去梳理，说现在大家的角色都是什么样的，以及大家平时用怎么用这个内部系统呢？
zh: 我就让Manus去梳理，说现在大家的角色都是什么样的，以及大家平时用怎么用这个内部系统呢？
en: So I asked Manus to review everyone’s current roles and how they actually use the internal system day to day.

source_text: 是不是有些人他身上的角色其实他从来没有用过。
zh: 是不是有些人他身上的角色其实他从来没有用过。
en: Are there any roles assigned to people that they’ve never actually used?

source_text: 因为Mono里面对接了我们所有的内部系统，所以Manus很快它就梳理出了，
zh: 因为Mono里面对接了我们所有的内部系统，所以Manus很快它就梳理出了，
en: Because Manus is connected to all our internal systems, it quickly mapped everything out.

source_text: 呃，哪些人的权限可以简化，哪些人，
zh: 呃，哪些人的权限可以简化，哪些人，
en: Whose permissions could be simplified, and whose…

source_text: 呃，要保留。
zh: 呃，要保留。
en: …needed to be kept.

source_text: 然后我让他把那些能简化的权限挨个发Slack私信，
zh: 然后我让他把那些能简化的权限挨个发Slack私信，
en: Then I asked it to send each person whose permissions could be simplified a Slack DM.

source_text: 呃，去，去挨个问大家说，呃，你现在角色是这样的，但你平时只用这几个功能，
zh: 呃，去，去挨个问大家说，呃，你现在角色是这样的，但你平时只用这几个功能，
en: I had it ask them one by one: “These are your current permissions, but you only use these few features day to day…”

source_text: 我给你简化行不行？
zh: 我给你简化行不行？
en: “Would it be okay if I simplified your permissions?”

source_text: 呃，你还有没有别的需求？
zh: 呃，你还有没有别的需求？
en: “Is there anything else you need?”

source_text: 呃，然后我其实两天之后我，我就把这个结果回收了，然后他就Manus就帮我把这些角色的权限做了调整。
zh: 呃，然后我其实两天之后我，我就把这个结果回收了，然后他就Manus就帮我把这些角色的权限做了调整。
en: Then, two days later, I collected the responses, and Manus helped me adjust those people’s permissions.

source_text: 有一个很有意思的地方是，我这个私信是Manus发出去的，所以那个私信下面会带一个，呃，
zh: 有一个很有意思的地方是，我这个私信是Manus发出去的，所以那个私信下面会带一个，呃，
en: One interesting detail is that Manus sent those DMs, so each message had a, uh…

source_text: from Manus。
zh: from Manus。
en: From Manus.

source_text: 我，我偷偷，我，我去看了一些那个同事的回信，
zh: 我，我偷偷，我，我去看了一些那个同事的回信，
en: I, uh, snuck a look at some of my coworkers’ replies.

source_text: 发现里面有30%也是Manus回复的。
zh: 发现里面有30%也是Manus回复的。
en: I found that about 30% of the replies were from Manus too.

source_text: 就是现在大家就是这样一个，呃，很赛博朋克的一个，一个工作，工作的情况。
zh: 就是现在大家就是这样一个，呃，很赛博朋克的一个，一个工作，工作的情况。
en: That’s what work is like now for everyone—kind of cyberpunk.

source_text: 对，因为，因为我同时是会有很多的事情在并发，所以像这样的事情以前可能我还真得专门抽时间来做，但现在我就完全，呃，就是delegate给Manus，
zh: 对，因为，因为我同时是会有很多的事情在并发，所以像这样的事情以前可能我还真得专门抽时间来做，但现在我就完全，呃，就是delegate给Manus，
en: Right, because I have a lot of things going on at once. In the past, I would’ve had to set aside time for something like this, but now I can just delegate it to Manus.

source_text: 因为它可以一步步做。
zh: 因为它可以一步步做。
en: Because it can handle it step by step.

source_text: 我只要偶尔去查看一下，或者说等它提醒我的，我要看的时候我就看一下就行了。
zh: 我只要偶尔去查看一下，或者说等它提醒我的，我要看的时候我就看一下就行了。
en: I just need to check in occasionally, or wait for it to notify me when there’s something I need to look at.

source_text: 对，呃，好，今天的话分享大概就是这些内容。
zh: 对，呃，好，今天的话分享大概就是这些内容。
en: Right, well, that’s about all I wanted to share today.

source_text: 呃，时间有限，有些内容只能就是提到一点。
zh: 呃，时间有限，有些内容只能就是提到一点。
en: Time is limited, so I could only touch on some of these topics briefly.

source_text: 呃，再次感谢主办方的邀请。
zh: 呃，再次感谢主办方的邀请。
en: And thanks again to the organizers for inviting me.

source_text: 呃，我也希望可以抛砖引玉，如果让大家对于AI Native协作有了一些想法或者说想讨论的话，呃，非常欢迎大家跟我们交流。谢谢。
zh: 呃，我也希望可以抛砖引玉，如果让大家对于AI Native协作有了一些想法或者说想讨论的话，呃，非常欢迎大家跟我们交流。谢谢。
en: I hope this has sparked some ideas. If you have thoughts about AI-native collaboration or would like to discuss it further, we’d love to hear from you. Thank you.

source_text: 谢谢。
zh: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.

source_text: 好的，谢谢Man
zh: 好的，谢谢Man
en: Okay, thank you, Man.

source_text: us的范斌。
zh: us的范斌。
en: Fan Bin from Manus.

source_text: Thank you, uh, Fanbin from Manus.
zh: 谢谢来自 Manus 的范斌。
en: Thank you, uh, Fanbin from Manus.

zh: 我们再休息五分钟，然后……
en: And we're gonna take another five-minute break, and we'll

zh: 五分钟后回来。
en: be back in five minutes.

en: Let’s take another five-minute break and come back at 3:35. Thank you.

en: Okay, I…

zh: 我可以买麦克风吗？
en: Can I purchase mics?

zh: 你能看到HDR效果吗？
en: Can you see the HDR?

zh: 呃，不行。
en: Uh, no.

zh: 也许下次再进入下一个阶段。
en: Next time to the next stage, maybe.

source_text: I think it's on.
zh: 我觉得麦克风已经开了。
en: I think it's on.

source_text: It's not a full, full screen.
zh: 还不是全屏显示。
en: It's not a full, full screen.

source_text: It should be the full screen.
zh: 应该是全屏显示。
en: It should be the full screen.

zh: 我觉得这样可以。
en: I think it's okay.

zh: 嗯，可以。
en: Yeah, it's okay.

zh: 可能是字体太小了。
en: It's maybe the font is small.

zh: 好，好。
en: Okay, okay.

zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

zh: 哦，就这样的是吧？
en: Oh, so that’s how it works?

en: That’s it, then.

source_text: It's full screen.
zh: 现在是全屏了。
en: It's full screen.

zh: 那就对的，应该对的。
en: Yes, that’s right. It should be.

source_text: 那应该对的，上面都是对的。
zh: 那应该对的，上面都是对的。
en: That should be right. Everything above is correct.

source_text: Okay, okay. That's correct.
zh: 好，好。没错。
en: Okay, okay. That's correct.

source_text: 好。
zh: 好。
en: Okay.

en: Okay, okay.

zh: 然后它那个字就不那么，就是有点我估计。
en: And then the text isn’t quite as… I guess it’s a bit…

zh: 他们在一些边框区都会有点，那这个。
en: There are some dots around the edges, so this…

zh: 一会儿讲，一会儿讲的。
en: I’ll talk about it in a moment.

source_text: 你大吗？
zh: 你大吗？
en: Are you big?

source_text: 你大吗？
zh: 你大吗？
en: Are you big?

source_text: 啊。
zh: 啊。
en: Ah.

source_text: 不是，Mary，你就插这儿就行，插这儿就行。
zh: 不是，Mary，你就插这儿就行，插这儿就行。
en: No, Mary, just plug it in here. Right here.

source_text: 还有一分钟。
zh: 还有一分钟。
en: One more minute.

source_text: It's fine.
zh: 没问题。
en: It's fine.

source_text: 呃，大家好，然后我们还有一分钟开始，所以大家尽快入座。
zh: 呃，大家好，然后我们还有一分钟开始，所以大家尽快入座。
en: Hi, everyone. We’ll be starting in one minute, so please take your seats.

source_text: 呃， we are about to start in one minute.
zh: 呃，我们还有一分钟就开始。
en: 呃， we are about to start in one minute.

source_text: 好的，我们尽快入座，谢谢。
zh: 好的，我们尽快入座，谢谢。
en: Okay, let’s take our seats as soon as possible. Thank you.

source_text: Alright, uh, let's get started.
zh: 好，呃，我们开始吧。
en: Alright, uh, let's get started.

source_text: 呃， the next speaker is Jakub from Excel.
zh: 呃，下一位发言的是来自 Excel 的雅库布。
en: 呃， the next speaker is Jakub from Excel.

source_text: 呃，下一场是来自Excel的分享，呃，分享者是Jakub。我们掌声欢迎。
zh: 呃，下一场是来自Excel的分享，呃，分享者是Jakub。我们掌声欢迎。
en: Next up is a presentation from Excel. Please give Jakub a warm welcome.

source_text: Hello everyone, today we're going to be walking through how Excel can power open-source personal agents around OneRequest, finding somewhere to go hang out in Shanghai.
zh: 大家好，今天我们会介绍如何利用 Excel，为 OneRequest 打造开源个人智能体，帮你在上海找个适合出去玩的地方。
en: Hello everyone, today we're going to be walking through how Excel can power open-source personal agents around OneRequest, finding somewhere to go hang out in Shanghai.

source_text: We'll follow the request through a few things, the concept of memory, Excel's web search, browser use, open weight models,
zh: 我们会围绕这个请求，依次介绍几个方面：记忆机制、Excel 的网页搜索、浏览器操作，以及开放权重模型。
en: We'll follow the request through a few things, the concept of memory, Excel's web search, browser use, open weight models,

source_text: and then how you can end up with a plan in a new place that you can keep.
zh: 最后，我们会看看如何为一个陌生地方制定一份可以保存下来的游玩计划。
en: and then how you can end up with a plan in a new place that you can keep.

source_text: First.
zh: 首先。
en: First.

source_text: Of all, what is Excel?
zh: 首先，Excel 是什么？
en: Of all, what is Excel?

source_text: Excel is a search layer for AI agents.
zh: Excel 是面向 AI 智能体的搜索层。
en: Excel is a search layer for AI agents.

source_text: We bring together our independent web search index and network of data partnerships to power a versatile API for LLMs and personal agents.
zh: 我们整合自有的独立网页搜索索引和数据合作伙伴网络，为大语言模型和个人智能体提供灵活多用的 API。
en: We bring together our independent web search index and network of data partnerships to power a versatile API for LLMs and personal agents.

source_text: Excel is indexed over 100 billion web pages and growing, constantly crawling and updating them for our customers.
zh: Excel 已收录超过一千亿个网页，而且还在不断增长；我们持续抓取和更新这些网页，为客户提供最新信息。
en: Excel is indexed over 100 billion web pages and growing, constantly crawling and updating them for our customers.

source_text: We serve said web pages, and as little as 300 milliseconds on average.
zh: 我们提供这些网页的搜索结果，平均只需 300 毫秒。
en: We serve said web pages, and as little as 300 milliseconds on average.

source_text: Later, we'll talk about how we serve token-rich highlights for those pages,
zh: 稍后，我们会介绍如何为这些网页提供信息量丰富的精选片段。
en: Later, we'll talk about how we serve token-rich highlights for those pages,

source_text: which are important for keeping and then task time low, using Excel alongside LLMs.
zh: 这些精选片段有助于在将 Excel 与大语言模型配合使用时，降低响应延迟和任务耗时。
en: which are important for keeping and then task time low, using Excel alongside LLMs.

source_text: Today, companies like Cursor and Cognition use us for web search within their coding agent products to serve up-to-date coding documentation,
zh: 如今，Cursor 和 Cognition 等公司在其编程智能体产品中使用我们的网页搜索服务，获取最新的编程文档，
en: Today, companies like Cursor and Cognition use us for web search within their coding agent products to serve up-to-date coding documentation,

source_text: and companies like HubSpot use us to keep CRM data enriched and up-to-date.
zh: HubSpot 等公司也使用我们的服务，不断补充并更新 CRM 数据。
en: and companies like HubSpot use us to keep CRM data enriched and up-to-date.

source_text: But today, I want to focus on a rapidly growing vertical alongside Grok Instinct and Muse,
zh: 但今天，我想重点谈谈一个快速增长的垂直领域，与 Grok、Instinct 和 Muse 相关，
en: But today, I want to focus on a rapidly growing vertical alongside Grok Instinct and Muse,

source_text: personal agents.
zh: 个人智能体。
en: personal agents.

source_text: Systems that use information about the world to help with decisions in your own life.
zh: 这类系统利用现实世界的信息，帮助你做出个人生活中的决策。
en: Systems that use information about the world to help with decisions in your own life.

source_text: And I'm Jakub Hojsa, a forward deployed engineer at Excel.
zh: 我是 Jakub Hojsa，Exa 的前线部署工程师。
en: And I'm Jakub Hojsa, a forward deployed engineer at Excel.

source_text: I work with developers that need search in their products.
zh: 我与需要在产品中集成搜索功能的开发者合作。
en: I work with developers that need search in their products.

source_text: I was recently in Hong Kong, and I took some photos on the left side.
zh: 我最近去了香港，拍了左边这些照片。
en: I was recently in Hong Kong, and I took some photos on the left side.

source_text: When I land in a new city, I always find myself using AI to help me discover new places to eat and take photos.
zh: 每到一座新城市，我总会用 AI 帮我寻找值得一吃、一拍的地方。
en: When I land in a new city, I always find myself using AI to help me discover new places to eat and take photos.

source_text: The last year I've spent at Excel, I've seen a seismic shift. In how search is used.
zh: 过去一年在 Exa 工作期间，我见证了搜索使用方式的巨大转变。
en: The last year I've spent at Excel, I've seen a seismic shift. In how search is used.

source_text: I'm sure we all know about the chatbot paradigm.
zh: 相信大家都熟悉聊天机器人的交互模式。
en: I'm sure we all know about the chatbot paradigm.

source_text: You can ask DeepSeek Chat a question, and you get an answer.
zh: 你可以向 DeepSeek Chat 提问，然后得到答案。
en: You can ask DeepSeek Chat a question, and you get an answer.

source_text: Then came agent SDKs that let you delegate a task to a system that can search, browse, and write code on your behalf to complete a task.
zh: 随后，智能体开发工具包出现了。你可以把任务交给这样的系统，让它代你搜索、浏览网页和编写代码，直到完成任务。
en: Then came agent SDKs that let you delegate a task to a system that can search, browse, and write code on your behalf to complete a task.

source_text: We now see this cloud agent model in products from OpenAI, Anthropic, Cognition, and Cursor, as well as DeepSeek and MiniMax here in China.
zh: 如今，从 OpenAI、Anthropic、Cognition 和 Cursor，到中国的 DeepSeek 和 MiniMax，我们都能在它们的产品中看到这种云端智能体模式。
en: We now see this cloud agent model in products from OpenAI, Anthropic, Cognition, and Cursor, as well as DeepSeek and MiniMax here in China.

source_text: A personal agent adds continuity.
zh: 个人智能体则让这种服务更具连续性。
en: A personal agent adds continuity.

source_text: It can carry context from OneRequest into Next.
zh: 它能把上一次请求的上下文带到下一次请求中。
en: It can carry context from OneRequest into Next.

source_text: My budget, my preferences, and the plan we already started.
zh: 比如我的预算、我的偏好，以及我们已经着手制定的计划。
en: My budget, my preferences, and the plan we already started.

source_text: It also opens the doors of the famed idea of proactive assistance.
zh: 这也为人们期待已久的主动式协助打开了大门。
en: It also opens the doors of the famed idea of proactive assistance.

source_text: An agent that can pick up where we left off and help with what comes next.
zh: 这样的智能体能接着上次的进度，帮我们处理接下来的事。
en: An agent that can pick up where we left off and help with what comes next.

source_text: The building blocks are context,
zh: 基础要素是上下文，
en: The building blocks are context,

source_text: search, tools, and persistence. Let's give one something to do.
zh: 搜索、工具和持久记忆。我们来给它派个任务吧。
en: search, tools, and persistence. Let's give one something to do.

source_text: Here.
zh: 在这里。
en: Here.

source_text: The request.
zh: 这个请求。
en: The request.

source_text: I want to go eat in Shanghai.
zh: 我想去上海吃点东西。
en: I want to go eat in Shanghai.

source_text: Help me find a good place to eat.
zh: 帮我找一家好吃的餐厅。
en: Help me find a good place to eat.

source_text: Let's take that request through the whole evening.
zh: 让我们看看这个请求如何贯穿整个夜晚。
en: Let's take that request through the whole evening.

source_text: Find a place to take a look at the photos inside, account for a friend's food preferences, and turn the conversation into a plan.
zh: 找一家餐厅，看看店内的照片，考虑朋友的饮食偏好，再把讨论落实成具体计划。
en: Find a place to take a look at the photos inside, account for a friend's food preferences, and turn the conversation into a plan.

source_text: Watch the agent read the memory here.
zh: 注意看，智能体在这里读取了记忆。
en: Watch the agent read the memory here.

source_text: The agent already had my budget saved.
zh: 智能体之前就记下了我的预算。
en: The agent already had my budget saved.

source_text: 300 yuan per person, so 600 yuan for two.
zh: 每人300元，两个人一共600元。
en: 300 yuan per person, so 600 yuan for two.

source_text: The goal for this would be for this to be injected into the session memory when deemed necessary.
zh: 我们的目标是，在必要时将这些信息注入会话记忆。
en: The goal for this would be for this to be injected into the session memory when deemed necessary.

source_text: Closed-source models already have this concept of memory, uh,
zh: 闭源模型已经有了“记忆”这个概念，呃……
en: Closed-source models already have this concept of memory, uh,

source_text: in ChatGPT and, uh, Claude,
zh: 比如 ChatGPT 和 Claude 里就有，呃……
en: in ChatGPT and, uh, Claude,

source_text: for example, but since we're building with an open-source model, I found one to use.
zh: 比如说。但因为我们用的是开源模型，所以我找到了一个可用的方案。
en: for example, but since we're building with an open-source model, I found one to use.

source_text: When I go out, I care about the whole experience.
zh: 我出去吃饭时，很看重整体体验。
en: When I go out, I care about the whole experience.

source_text: I want somewhere where I have a good atmosphere,
zh: 我想找个氛围好的地方，
en: I want somewhere where I have a good atmosphere,

source_text: somewhere where I maybe enjoy spending an evening, and then the room matters just as much as the food.
zh: 一个能让我愉快地待上一晚的地方；环境和食物一样重要。
en: somewhere where I maybe enjoy spending an evening, and then the room matters just as much as the food.

source_text: So a search brings those kind of requirements that we have together from my memory.
zh: 所以，搜索会从我的记忆中调出这些需求，并把它们整合起来。
en: So a search brings those kind of requirements that we have together from my memory.

source_text: Um, for developers,
zh: 嗯，对开发者来说，
en: Um, for developers,

source_text: memory becomes useful because it helps construct a task.
zh: 记忆之所以有用，是因为它能帮助构建任务。
en: memory becomes useful because it helps construct a task.

source_text: The budget just becomes part of the search here, and then the purpose of the evening is shaped with what deserves attention within the memory and my prompt.
zh: 预算在这里就成了搜索条件之一，而这次晚间出行的目的，则由我的提示词和记忆中值得关注的信息共同决定。
en: The budget just becomes part of the search here, and then the purpose of the evening is shaped with what deserves attention within the memory and my prompt.

source_text: Um, so we have a candidate.
zh: 嗯，所以我们有了一个备选方案。
en: Um, so we have a candidate.

source_text: It's this place called Lost Haven on the Bund, and we have a specific branch and an address here on this card.
zh: 这家店叫 Lost Haven，位于外滩。这张卡片上有具体的分店和地址。
en: It's this place called Lost Haven on the Bund, and we have a specific branch and an address here on this card.

source_text: Uh, but then the next thing I want is visual.
zh: 呃，不过接下来我想看的是图片。
en: Uh, but then the next thing I want is visual.

source_text: Uh, I want to go be able to see the photos and make a decision from there.
zh: 呃，我想先看看照片，再做决定。
en: Uh, I want to go be able to see the photos and make a decision from there.

source_text: So I'll make a request to go find screenshots.
zh: 所以我会发出请求，去找一些截图。
en: So I'll make a request to go find screenshots.

source_text: Now, in this instance, while Excel does return images with a request, uh, I find it useful to pull up a browser use.
zh: 现在，在这个例子里，虽然 Excel 会应请求返回图片，但我发现直接打开浏览器查看更方便。
en: Now, in this instance, while Excel does return images with a request, uh, I find it useful to pull up a browser use.

source_text: So we are able to pull up a browser of a website that has photos of the venue here.
zh: 这样我们就能在浏览器里打开一个网站，查看这家店的照片。
en: So we are able to pull up a browser of a website that has photos of the venue here.

source_text: Here's the restaurant's photo gallery.
zh: 这是这家餐厅的照片集。
en: Here's the restaurant's photo gallery.

source_text: And the image stays connected to the source and can come into the chat,
zh: 而且图片会保留来源链接，也可以直接显示在聊天中。
en: And the image stays connected to the source and can come into the chat,

source_text: so we can remember where it comes from.
zh: 这样我们就能记得图片是从哪里来的。
en: so we can remember where it comes from.

source_text: Now, we've used personal context.
zh: 现在，我们已经用到了个人背景信息。
en: Now, we've used personal context.

source_text: We've retrieved the evidence and a visual check.
zh: 我们已经获取了相关证据，也进行了目视核查。
en: We've retrieved the evidence and a visual check.

source_text: Uh, so now we can take a look at the open-source system, uh, behind this interaction.
zh: 呃，现在我们来看看这次交互背后的开源系统。
en: Uh, so now we can take a look at the open-source system, uh, behind this interaction.

source_text: So first of all, I think, uh, something important to note is that there's a lot of these closed-source personal agents that are out here.
zh: 首先，我觉得有一点很重要：现在市面上有很多闭源的个人智能体。
en: So first of all, I think, uh, something important to note is that there's a lot of these closed-source personal agents that are out here.

source_text: Uh, we have obviously Muse, Instinct, and GrokBot.
zh: 呃，比较知名的显然有 Muse、Instinct 和 GrokBot。
en: Uh, we have obviously Muse, Instinct, and GrokBot.

source_text: Uh, but not everyone's super comfortable with sending all their information to these closed-source systems.
zh: 但并不是每个人都愿意把自己的所有信息交给这些闭源系统。
en: Uh, but not everyone's super comfortable with sending all their information to these closed-source systems.

source_text: Uh, so I thought it was important to maybe share, like, how it architects, uh, like an open-source system, uh, for a personal agent.
zh: 所以我觉得有必要分享一下，如何为个人智能体设计一个开源系统架构。
en: Uh, so I thought it was important to maybe share, like, how it architects, uh, like an open-source system, uh, for a personal agent.

source_text: Um, more than anything, I think myself I would love a system that could be inspected for what it remembers.
zh: 最重要的是，我自己希望有一个系统，能让我查看它记住了什么。
en: Um, more than anything, I think myself I would love a system that could be inspected for what it remembers.

source_text: Uh, and be able to see why a tool was called, why it fails, uh, and when it failed.
zh: 还能看清它为什么调用某个工具、为什么会失败，以及是什么时候失败的。
en: Uh, and be able to see why a tool was called, why it fails, uh, and when it failed.

source_text: Uh, and that would help me improve the system instead of relying on someone else's, um, now.
zh: 这样我就能自己改进这个系统，而不必依赖别人的系统。
en: Uh, and that would help me improve the system instead of relying on someone else's, um, now.

source_text: Instinct was one of the design references for this little demo.
zh: Instinct 是这个小型演示的设计参考之一。
en: Instinct was one of the design references for this little demo.

source_text: Um, and I think it's a really good starting point to create a small inspectable version of what we have there.
zh: 我觉得可以以它为起点，做一个规模较小、运行过程也能看得清楚的版本。
en: Um, and I think it's a really good starting point to create a small inspectable version of what we have there.

source_text: Um, now,
zh: 嗯，接下来，
en: Um, now,

source_text: for the sake of this demo, it's pulling up in, in this small little demo environment, but I think that there's several useful APIs that allow you to connect to iMessage,
zh: 为了演示，这里是在一个小型演示环境中运行的。不过，我觉得有几个很实用的 API，可以让它接入 iMessage。
en: for the sake of this demo, it's pulling up in, in this small little demo environment, but I think that there's several useful APIs that allow you to connect to iMessage,

source_text: such as Link, um, and then I believe there might also be an API for WeChat, for example.
zh: 比如 Link。另外，我想微信可能也有相应的 API。
en: such as Link, um, and then I believe there might also be an API for WeChat, for example.

source_text: So all of these concepts can be pulled into, like, whatever interface you'd like.
zh: 所以，这些功能都可以整合到你想用的任何界面中。
en: So all of these concepts can be pulled into, like, whatever interface you'd like.

source_text: Um, but yeah, we have, uh, MemZero for the memory.
zh: 嗯，不过我们用 MemZero 来管理记忆。
en: Um, but yeah, we have, uh, MemZero for the memory.

source_text: So we're leveraging that as, like, an open-source library to do that.
zh: 所以，我们会利用 MemZero 这个开源库来实现记忆功能。
en: So we're leveraging that as, like, an open-source library to do that.

source_text: Uh, we have the browser use library,
zh: 嗯，我们用了 Browser Use 库。
en: Uh, we have the browser use library,

source_text: which allows us to do, uh, browser use over whatever context we pull from search.
zh: 这样就能根据搜索到的相关信息，用浏览器执行操作。
en: which allows us to do, uh, browser use over whatever context we pull from search.

source_text: And then we have, uh, Quen OpenAway model, uh, accessed through OpenRouter.
zh: 然后，我们还通过 OpenRouter 调用了 Qwen 开放权重模型。
en: And then we have, uh, Quen OpenAway model, uh, accessed through OpenRouter.

source_text: Now, Excel specifically supplying web search with, uh, token-dense highlights, uh, but every component here will have a clear job.
zh: 这里的 Exa 专门为网络搜索提供信息密度高的摘要，而每个组件都有明确的职责。
en: Now, Excel specifically supplying web search with, uh, token-dense highlights, uh, but every component here will have a clear job.

source_text: And then here's how it works.
zh: 接下来讲讲它是怎么运作的。
en: And then here's how it works.

source_text: So you would first have the memory supplying the relevant personal context, um, and then you would have Quen conducting the reasoning over this.
zh: 首先，记忆模块会提供相关的个人背景信息，然后由 Qwen 根据这些信息进行推理。
en: So you would first have the memory supplying the relevant personal context, um, and then you would have Quen conducting the reasoning over this.

source_text: So whenever you deem necessary to call a memory tool call, you're able to do that.
zh: 所以，只要你认为有必要调用记忆工具，就可以随时调用。
en: So whenever you deem necessary to call a memory tool call, you're able to do that.

source_text: Now, Excel is able to bring back search results with highlights, and I'll show you what that looks like in a second.
zh: 现在，Exa 可以返回附有重点摘要的搜索结果，我待会儿会展示具体效果。
en: Now, Excel is able to bring back search results with highlights, and I'll show you what that looks like in a second.

source_text: Um, but these results return to the model.
zh: 嗯，不过这些结果会返回给模型。
en: Um, but these results return to the model.

source_text: Now,
zh: 现在，
en: Now,

source_text: not all the time will a highlight be sufficient, uh, for you to answer a question, uh, for example, when I was looking for a screenshot, I can go find the restaurants from the search results,
zh: 但搜索结果中的重点摘要并不总是足以回答问题。比如，我之前想找一张截图时，可以根据搜索结果找到那些餐厅，
en: not all the time will a highlight be sufficient, uh, for you to answer a question, uh, for example, when I was looking for a screenshot, I can go find the restaurants from the search results,

source_text: and I might be able to go find that on the page that contains an image, but then I might want to be able to pull up the browser to go do that.
zh: 也可能在包含图片的网页上找到那张截图，但这时我可能需要打开浏览器来查找。
en: and I might be able to go find that on the page that contains an image, but then I might want to be able to pull up the browser to go do that.

source_text: So I think the guiding principle here is search first.
zh: 所以我认为，这里的指导原则是先搜索。
en: So I think the guiding principle here is search first.

source_text: You're able to read the highlights of the page, and then identify what the task still needs.
zh: 你可以先阅读网页的重点摘要，再判断完成任务还需要什么。
en: You're able to read the highlights of the page, and then identify what the task still needs.

source_text: Uh, and this, this keeps every single tool call very focused on, uh, one specific part of this, uh, for efficiency.
zh: 嗯，这样每次工具调用都能只针对其中一个具体环节，提高效率。
en: Uh, and this, this keeps every single tool call very focused on, uh, one specific part of this, uh, for efficiency.

source_text: Uh, what Excel kind of provides in these instances is not just the 100 billion, uh, web page index, uh, but we also index new sources within 15 minutes.

en: Uh, what Excel kind of provides in these instances is not just the 100 billion, uh, web page index, uh, but we also index new sources within 15 minutes.

source_text: We have SEC filings for finance and earnings calls and, uh, we have over 3 million podcasts, full transcripts of podcasts, uh, we also have events, and recently due to this large boom of personal agents,

en: Uh, so if you want to go find, uh, pizzas in San Francisco, you can go find all 100 pizza places in San Francisco and their prices and their menus. Uh, and all of this.

source_text: Um,

source_text: So this is the scale of scale of the system or problem we are trying to solve so every day our LM gateway is serving around 3 million requests 3 million LM requests for our users that's across yeah that's across four of the data centers globally we have and we serve models from multiple upstream providers we have about 22 models that's serving 95% of the request from several providers they all speak different protocols some speak the Anthropic messages protocol some are the standard OpenAI compatible protocols uh Gemini and so on so um we need to reliably serve these requests to our users because we have researchers testing their hypothesis we have developers who is writing important codes or even FPGA codes we have even business users handling their Excel sheets and PowerPoints um but Arrow do happens we do observe around 0.4% of the error rates from upstream providers this may not sound a lot but if you look at the base then it it's actually a lot of errors so to if you are individual users one error will ruin your experience。

en:
So that’s the scale of the problem we’re trying to solve. Every day, our LLM gateway handles around three million requests across our four data centers worldwide. We serve models from multiple upstream providers, with about 22 models accounting for 95% of requests. They use different protocols: some use Anthropic’s Messages API, others use OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, and so on.

We need to serve these requests reliably. Researchers are testing hypotheses, developers are writing critical code—including FPGA code—and business users are working on spreadsheets and presentations. But errors do happen: we see an upstream error rate of about 0.4%. That may not sound like much, but at this scale, it adds up to a lot of errors. And for an individual user, even one error can ruin the experience.

source_text: LM gateway, one tricky thing about this, if you compare it with a typical web proxy, is that HTTP 200, which is the standard HTTP code for successful requests, does not always mean successful here.
