source_text: 呃接下来有请GitHub的Elisa Lee分享的内容是可信上下文企业数据与agent之间缺失的一层，有请。
zh: 呃接下来有请GitHub的Elisa Lee分享的内容是可信上下文企业数据与agent之间缺失的一层，有请。
en: Next, please welcome Elisa Lee from GitHub. She’ll be speaking about “Trusted Context: The Missing Layer Between Enterprise Data and Agents.” Elisa, the floor is yours.

source_text: very honor to be here to give the the last talk of today
zh: very honor to be here to give the the last talk of today
en: It’s an honor to be here and give the final talk of the day.

source_text: I'm Alyssa，I'm the chief of staff and the head of open source community at DataHub，
zh: I'm Alyssa，I'm the chief of staff and the head of open source community at DataHub，
en: I’m Alyssa, Chief of Staff and Head of the Open Source Community at DataHub.

source_text: which is actually the largest open source context management platform。
zh: which is actually the largest open source context management platform。
en: DataHub is actually the largest open-source context management platform.

source_text: I want to start with a very quick overview of this whole talk：humans used to be the ones running sloppy queries against data that don't fully understand。
zh: I want to start with a very quick overview of this whole talk：humans used to be the ones running sloppy queries against data that don't fully understand。
en: I want to start with a quick overview of this talk: Humans used to be the ones running sloppy queries against data they didn’t fully understand.

source_text: Today it is the agents at far greater scale with far more confidence。
zh: Today it is the agents at far greater scale with far more confidence。
en: Today, it’s agents doing the same thing, but at a much greater scale and with far more confidence.

source_text: So this talk is about the layer that has to sit between your enterprise data and those agents that and those agents so that the confidence and trust are earned。
zh: So this talk is about the layer that has to sit between your enterprise data and those agents that and those agents so that the confidence and trust are earned。
en: So this talk is about the layer that needs to sit between your enterprise data and those agents, so their confidence is justified and their outputs can be trusted.

source_text: Let's start with the problem statement。
zh: Let's start with the problem statement。
en: Let’s start with the problem statement.

source_text: In the age of AI, the core problem in a data org hasn't changed，only the persona has。
zh: In the age of AI, the core problem in a data org hasn't changed，only the persona has。
en: In the age of AI, the core problem facing data organizations hasn’t changed—only who’s asking the questions has.

source_text: People double check a weird number before it goes into a deck。
zh: People double check a weird number before it goes into a deck。
en: People double-check a suspicious number before putting it in a presentation.

source_text: Agents don't。
zh: Agents don't。
en: Agents don’t.

source_text: According to a survey I venture beat,
zh: According to a survey I venture beat,
en: According to a survey by VentureBeat,

source_text: 57% of the enterprises traced a wrong agent answer back to missing context。
zh: 57% of the enterprises traced a wrong agent answer back to missing context。
en: Fifty-seven percent of enterprises traced an incorrect agent answer back to missing context.

source_text: So we're not seeing a model problem but a context problem。
zh: So we're not seeing a model problem but a context problem。
en: So what we’re seeing isn’t a model problem—it’s a context problem.

source_text: 31% says it recurs。
zh: 31% says it recurs。
en: Thirty-one percent say it happens repeatedly.

source_text: And only 17% call their AI outcomes consistently reliable。
zh: And only 17% call their AI outcomes consistently reliable。
en: And only 17% say their AI outcomes are consistently reliable.

source_text: Gartner also published a study this spring to say that a robust context layer is a foundational to AI success。
zh: Gartner also published a study this spring to say that a robust context layer is a foundational to AI success。
en: Gartner also published a study this spring saying that a robust context layer is foundational to AI success.

source_text: Without it, you don't have an agent problem，you have a context problem under the hood of an agent。
zh: Without it, you don't have an agent problem，you have a context problem under the hood of an agent。
en: Without it, what looks like an agent problem is really a context problem under the hood.

source_text: Mechanically, this is what the AI context layer looks like。
zh: Mechanically, this is what the AI context layer looks like。
en: In practical terms, here’s what the AI context layer looks like.

source_text: Sources on the left include like warehouses,
zh: Sources on the left include like warehouses,
en: Sources on the left include data warehouses,

source_text: BI tools, unstructured data documents, and the metadata graph itself。
zh: BI tools, unstructured data documents, and the metadata graph itself。
en: BI tools, unstructured documents, and the metadata graph itself.

source_text: That feeds context intelligence，
zh: That feeds context intelligence，
en: That feeds into context intelligence,

source_text: which generates candidate context and routes it through an expert validation。
zh: which generates candidate context and routes it through an expert validation。
en: which generates candidate context and routes it through expert validation.

source_text: So the loop is generate validate and activate。Every piece that comes out of that carries a trust grade。
zh: So the loop is generate validate and activate。Every piece that comes out of that carries a trust grade。
en: So the loop is: generate, validate, and activate. Everything that comes out of it carries a trust grade.

source_text: About context lifecycle in 4 parts: ingest, understand, validate, and activate.
zh: 上下文的生命周期分为四个阶段：采集、理解、验证和应用。
en: About context lifecycle in 4 parts: ingest, understand, validate, and activate.

source_text: So we start with context ingestion.
zh: 我们先从上下文采集开始。
en: So we start with context ingestion.

source_text: Enterprises context is incredibly fragmented; some of it is living in the warehouse, some of it's in BI dashboards, and some are in documents.
zh: 企业的上下文信息极其分散：有些存放在数据仓库中，有些在 BI 仪表板里，还有些散落在文档中。
en: Enterprises context is incredibly fragmented; some of it is living in the warehouse, some of it's in BI dashboards, and some are in documents.

source_text: Slack and even Google Docs, for example.
zh: 比如 Slack，甚至 Google 文档中也有。
en: Slack and even Google Docs, for example.

source_text: We bring all of that into one unified context layer rather than asking teams to manually recreate it.
zh: 我们把这些信息汇集到统一的上下文层，而不是让各个团队手动重新整理。
en: We bring all of that into one unified context layer rather than asking teams to manually recreate it.

source_text: Second is context intelligence, which we generate context by extracting semantic meaning from query logs,
zh: 第二是上下文智能：我们通过从查询日志中提取语义信息，来生成上下文。
en: Second is context intelligence, which we generate context by extracting semantic meaning from query logs,

source_text: BI dashboards, and also a lot of unstructured documents. So this is a continuous progress that we automatically do.
zh: BI 仪表板，以及大量非结构化文档。这个过程会持续进行，并由我们自动完成。
en: BI dashboards, and also a lot of unstructured documents. So this is a continuous progress that we automatically do.

source_text: And then third, we go into context hub, which is a dedicated workspace for subject matter experts to validate and also enrich data meanings.
zh: 第三步是进入上下文中心。这是一个专供领域专家使用的工作空间，让他们验证并进一步完善数据的含义。
en: And then third, we go into context hub, which is a dedicated workspace for subject matter experts to validate and also enrich data meanings.

source_text: Last but not least, we move on to activate context, which unlocks semantic value wherever agents and humans work.
zh: 最后，我们会激活上下文，让智能体和人们无论在哪里工作，都能利用其中的语义价值。
en: Last but not least, we move on to activate context, which unlocks semantic value wherever agents and humans work.

source_text: It can be done over MCP,
zh: 这可以通过 MCP 来完成。
en: It can be done over MCP,

source_text: skills, API SDK, and also a personalized UX.
zh: 也可以通过技能、API SDK，以及个性化的用户体验来实现。
en: skills, API SDK, and also a personalized UX.

source_text: So we actually just graduated from a 3-month long private and public beta into general availability.
zh: 我们刚刚结束了为期三个月的封闭测试和公开测试，正式全面上线。
en: So we actually just graduated from a 3-month long private and public beta into general availability.

source_text: We work closely with 30-plus customers to get them to success with DataHub's context platform.
zh: 我们与 30 多家客户密切合作，帮助他们成功用好 DataHub 的上下文平台。
en: We work closely with 30-plus customers to get them to success with DataHub's context platform.

source_text: Without DataHub context, the agent often guesses and hallucinates.
zh: 没有 DataHub 提供的上下文，智能体往往只能猜测，甚至会产生幻觉。
en: Without DataHub context, the agent often guesses and hallucinates.

source_text: For instance, when a loan officer asks a Snowflake context agent, Cortex agent, "How much is in high-risk commercial real estate loans?"
zh: 例如，当信贷员向 Snowflake Cortex 智能体提问：“高风险商业房地产贷款的余额是多少？”
en: For instance, when a loan officer asks a Snowflake context agent, Cortex agent, "How much is in high-risk commercial real estate loans?"

source_text: it ends up picking an 80% loan-to-value threshold because it sounds possible.
zh: 它最后会选用 80% 的贷款价值比作为阈值，仅仅因为这听起来似乎合理。
en: it ends up picking an 80% loan-to-value threshold because it sounds possible.

source_text: The result is then only a $9 million in loan value.
zh: 结果算出来的贷款余额只有 900 万美元。
en: The result is then only a $9 million in loan value.

source_text: This was confidently stated and completely wrong.
zh: 它说得信誓旦旦，却完全错了。
en: This was confidently stated and completely wrong.

source_text: So with DataHub context, we actually retrieved the actual glossary term, and fixes the realized that the loan the LTV is actually 76%, which means 6 loans at $33 million in loan value.
zh: 有了 DataHub 提供的上下文，智能体就能检索到正式的术语定义，发现贷款价值比的阈值其实是 76%。按这个标准，高风险贷款共有 6 笔，贷款余额为 3300 万美元。
en: So with DataHub context, we actually retrieved the actual glossary term, and fixes the realized that the loan the LTV is actually 76%, which means 6 loans at $33 million in loan value.

source_text: So this slide is running is what was already running in production today.
zh: 所以，这张幻灯片展示的是目前已经在生产环境中运行的功能。
en: So this slide is running is what was already running in production today.

source_text: So at a Miro, which is one of our great customers running AI with us, agent accuracy actually went from roughly 50% to 90% once grounded in DataHub context.
zh: 以 Miro 为例，他们是与我们合作运行 AI 的优秀客户之一。接入 DataHub 的上下文后，智能体的准确率从约 50% 提升到了 90%。
en: So at a Miro, which is one of our great customers running AI with us, agent accuracy actually went from roughly 50% to 90% once grounded in DataHub context.

source_text: That's in this chart.
zh: 这张图表里就有。
en: That's in this chart.

source_text: Another customer we love is Pinterest.
zh: 另一位我们非常看重的客户是 Pinterest。
en: Another customer we love is Pinterest.

source_text: The analytics agent sees 10 times the usage of the next most used internal agent.
zh: 这个数据分析智能体的使用量，是内部使用量排名第二的智能体的 10 倍。
en: The analytics agent sees 10 times the usage of the next most used internal agent.

source_text: So you're just spending minutes, not hours, for a trusted answer.
zh: 所以，获得一个可信的答案只需几分钟，而不再是几个小时。
en: So you're just spending minutes, not hours, for a trusted answer.

source_text: So that's around 70% less manual documentation work for them.
zh: 这让他们的人工文档编写工作量减少了约 70%。
en: So that's around 70% less manual documentation work for them.

source_text: At Block, agents answer metadata questions instantly over MCP.
zh: 在 Block，智能体通过 MCP 即时回答有关元数据的问题。
en: At Block, agents answer metadata questions instantly over MCP.

source_text: And another top 3 global bank is actually building a conversational text-to-SQL mobile banking agent with DataHub. That's the context layer underneath it.
zh: 还有一家全球前三的银行，正在利用 DataHub 构建一款对话式手机银行智能体，让用户用自然语言查询数据并生成 SQL。DataHub 就是它底层的上下文层。
en: And another top 3 global bank is actually building a conversational text-to-SQL mobile banking agent with DataHub. That's the context layer underneath it.

source_text: So.
zh: 所以。
en: So.

source_text: Every major platform is actually building its own version of the context platform.
zh: 各大平台其实都在构建自己的上下文平台。
en: Every major platform is actually building its own version of the context platform.

source_text: So there's like AWS context, Snowflake Cortex, Horizon,
zh: 比如 AWS 的上下文服务、Snowflake Cortex、Horizon，
en: So there's like AWS context, Snowflake Cortex, Horizon,

source_text: Databricks Unity, and Genie.
zh: 还有 Databricks Unity 和 Genie。
en: Databricks Unity, and Genie.

source_text: Microsoft Fabric, IQ, Google's knowledge catalog, etc., etc.
zh: 微软的 Fabric 和 IQ、谷歌的知识目录，等等。
en: Microsoft Fabric, IQ, Google's knowledge catalog, etc., etc.

source_text: So we really urge all enterprises to own your own business logic.
zh: 所以，我们强烈建议所有企业掌握自己的业务逻辑。
en: So we really urge all enterprises to own your own business logic.

source_text: Nobody else should own what high-risk means at your own company.
zh: 在你自己的公司，什么算“高风险”，不该由别人来定义。
en: Nobody else should own what high-risk means at your own company.

source_text: So you should really store it in a vendor-neutral format and not locked in inside one platform's layer.
zh: 所以，你应该把这些业务逻辑存储在不依赖特定供应商的格式中，而不是锁定在某个平台的上下文层里。
en: So you should really store it in a vendor-neutral format and not locked in inside one platform's layer.

source_text: Buy the context infrastructure underneath it because teams that cobble that together themselves tend to move in a couple of quarters, and the context doesn't.
zh: 底层的上下文基础设施则应该直接采购，因为自行拼凑这套设施的团队，往往过几个季度就换人了，但上下文需要长期保留。
en: Buy the context infrastructure underneath it because teams that cobble that together themselves tend to move in a couple of quarters, and the context doesn't.

source_text: So we're all of your data ever living one system.
zh: 毕竟，你的所有数据不可能始终都存放在同一个系统里。
en: So we're all of your data ever living one system.

source_text: I believe the answer is really no.
zh: 我认为答案其实是否定的。
en: I believe the answer is really no.

source_text: And that's where the value of DataHub as a vendor-neutral platform comes from.
zh: 这正是 DataHub 作为供应商中立平台的价值所在。
en: And that's where the value of DataHub as a vendor-neutral platform comes from.

source_text: So I would like to end today with an analogy that we like to use internally at DataHub.
zh: 最后，我想用一个我们在 DataHub 内部常用的类比来结束今天的分享。
en: So I would like to end today with an analogy that we like to use internally at DataHub.

source_text: So we can think of the entire data estate as city streets.
zh: 我们可以把整个数据体系想象成一座城市的街道。
en: So we can think of the entire data estate as city streets.

source_text: There are some streets that are on Snowflake, some are on Databricks,
zh: 有些街道位于 Snowflake，有些位于 Databricks。
en: There are some streets that are on Snowflake, some are on Databricks,

source_text: Oracle, and spread across unstructured data.
zh: 还有些位于 Oracle，另一些则散布在非结构化数据中。
en: Oracle, and spread across unstructured data.

source_text: What we provide is similar to Google Maps that allow agents and humans to navigate all these three streets.
zh: 我们提供的就像谷歌地图，让智能体和人都能在这些街道之间找到方向。
en: What we provide is similar to Google Maps that allow agents and humans to navigate all these three streets.

source_text: So just like traffic on Google Maps actually tells us which streets to avoid and which streets to take to get to our destination in the most optimized manner,
zh: 就像谷歌地图会根据实时路况告诉我们该避开哪些街道、走哪些街道，才能以最优路线到达目的地一样，
en: So just like traffic on Google Maps actually tells us which streets to avoid and which streets to take to get to our destination in the most optimized manner,

source_text: we provide trust signals that allow agents to navigate the millions and thousands of data sets that are spread across a very fragmented data estate.
zh: 我们提供可信度信号，帮助智能体在高度分散的数据环境中，找到并使用遍布各处的海量数据集。
en: we provide trust signals that allow agents to navigate the millions and thousands of data sets that are spread across a very fragmented data estate.

source_text: So our aspiration is that we will soon see all of the work that data engineers and analysts do be entirely identified through autonomous agents.
zh: 因此，我们的愿景是：在不久的将来，数据工程师和分析师所做的工作，都能由自主智能体独立完成。
en: So our aspiration is that we will soon see all of the work that data engineers and analysts do be entirely identified through autonomous agents.

source_text: And that's very crucial to get a lot of enterprises up and running with trusted AI agents that matter.
zh: 这对于帮助更多企业部署真正有用、值得信赖的 AI 智能体至关重要。
en: And that's very crucial to get a lot of enterprises up and running with trusted AI agents that matter.

source_text: So as I mentioned,
zh: 正如我刚才提到的，
en: So as I mentioned,

source_text: we're the largest open-source project running context management and metadata management.

en: we're the largest open-source project running context management and metadata management.

source_text: You can find us at our official website.

zh: 大家早上好，我是孟颖，我是这次大会的

source_text: 嗯，然后昨天呢，我们其实对大家的热情感到非常的受宠若惊啊，然后，呃，也是我们今天第、其、其实也是我们这次第一次办这种规模的大会。

en: Uh, so this is our first time hosting such a large-scale conference.

source_text: We were overwhelmingly thrilled to see so much energy from so many people from y-yesterday.
zh: 昨天看到大家如此热情、充满活力，我们感到无比激动。
en: We were overwhelmingly thrilled to see so much energy from so many people from y-yesterday.

source_text: So if you have any questions, have any feedback, feel free to let us know.
zh: 所以，如果大家有任何问题或建议，请随时告诉我们。
en: So if you have any questions, have any feedback, feel free to let us know.

en: And if you need any help at the venue today, feel free to find the conference staff with the orange, with the orange la-la-lanyard. They will be able to, will be able to help, to help you out.

zh: 嗯，下面呢，就让我，呃，下面呢，我将有、有请，呃，今天第二天我们大会的开场嘉宾 Chris，

source_text: 他也是我一个非常好的朋友。

en: He’s also a very good friend of mine.

source_text: 他是 World、World Labs 的联、联合创始人，来为我们今天开、开场。
zh: 他是 World、World Labs 的联、联合创始人，来为我们今天开、开场。
en: He’s the co-founder of World Labs, and he’ll kick things off for us today.

source_text: Uh, next, le-let's give a warm welcome to, to, to Chris, who is the co-founder of World Labs, who is also a dear friend of mine, to kick us off with his key keynote speech.
zh: 接下来，让我们热烈欢迎 World Labs 的联合创始人、也是我的好朋友 Chris，为我们带来开场主题演讲。
en: Uh, next, le-let's give a warm welcome to, to, to Chris, who is the co-founder of World Labs, who is also a dear friend of mine, to kick us off with his key keynote speech.

source_text: Hi, everyone.
zh: 大家好。
en: Hi, everyone.

source_text: Um, I'm Chris.
zh: 我是克里斯。
en: Um, I'm Chris.

source_text: Uh, it's fantastic to be here. Such great energy.
zh: 很高兴来到这里，现场气氛真棒。
en: Uh, it's fantastic to be here. Such great energy.

source_text: It's been incredibly fun the last days, um,
zh: 过去几天过得特别开心。
en: It's been incredibly fun the last days, um,

source_text: to, to, uh, interact with everyone.
zh: 能和大家交流，真是太开心了。
en: to, to, uh, interact with everyone.

source_text: Today, I want to make the term "world model" clearer to use.
zh: 今天，我想把“世界模型”这个概念讲清楚，让大家更容易理解和使用。
en: Today, I want to make the term "world model" clearer to use.

source_text: What you see here is a world model generation from the Atlas model,
zh: 大家现在看到的，是 Atlas 模型生成的一个世界模型。
en: What you see here is a world model generation from the Atlas model,

source_text: from World Labs.
zh: 它来自 World Labs。
en: from World Labs.

source_text: But the term "world model" now appears not only in graphics, robotics, and video generation, but also biology, chemistry, business software, and many other places.
zh: 不过，如今“世界模型”这个词不仅出现在图形学、机器人和视频生成领域，也出现在生物学、化学、企业软件等许多领域。
en: But the term "world model" now appears not only in graphics, robotics, and video generation, but also biology, chemistry, business software, and many other places.

source_text: Those systems are very different.
zh: 这些系统彼此差别很大。
en: Those systems are very different.

source_text: I will give us a vocabulary and system for comparing what they represent, what we can ask and expect them to do, and where they might evolve for agentic workflows and beyond.
zh: 我会提出一套术语和框架，帮助大家比较这些系统能表征什么、我们能要求并期待它们做什么，以及它们未来如何服务于智能体工作流程，乃至更广泛的应用。
en: I will give us a vocabulary and system for comparing what they represent, what we can ask and expect them to do, and where they might evolve for agentic workflows and beyond.

source_text: A very brief intro.
zh: 先做个简短的介绍。
en: A very brief intro.

source_text: Um, my background is in the intersection of machine learning,
zh: 嗯，我的研究背景主要在机器学习、
en: Um, my background is in the intersection of machine learning,

source_text: computer vision, and computer graphics.
zh: 计算机视觉和计算机图形学的交叉领域。
en: computer vision, and computer graphics.

source_text: Among other things, but particularly relevant, uh, for today,
zh: 我的研究还涉及其他领域，不过与今天的话题特别相关的是，
en: Among other things, but particularly relevant, uh, for today,

source_text: I worked on 3D reconstruction rendering and those are some examples of my prior academic work.
zh: 我做过三维重建和渲染方面的研究，这里展示的是我此前的一些学术成果。
en: I worked on 3D reconstruction rendering and those are some examples of my prior academic work.

source_text: This includes reconstructing the physical properties of things so that they are ready for simulation, um, for example, for the hairs on the person in the upper right,
zh: 其中包括重建物体的物理属性，让它们能够用于仿真。比如右上角那个人的头发，
en: This includes reconstructing the physical properties of things so that they are ready for simulation, um, for example, for the hairs on the person in the upper right,

source_text: and materials of the plushies in the bottom center.
zh: 以及下方中间那些毛绒玩具的材质。
en: and materials of the plushies in the bottom center.

source_text: So the common thread here is understanding something so that we can recover it from observations, render it, and interact with it.
zh: 所以，这些工作的共同点是理解事物，从而根据观测重建它、渲染它，并与它交互。
en: So the common thread here is understanding something so that we can recover it from observations, render it, and interact with it.

source_text: Those are some of the questions that are now key to answer with world models.
zh: 这些正是如今需要借助世界模型来解答的一些关键问题。
en: Those are some of the questions that are now key to answer with world models.

source_text: This background led me to co-fund World Labs in early 2024 with Fei-Fei Li,
zh: 这样的研究背景促使我在2024年初与李飞飞共同创立了 World Labs。
en: This background led me to co-fund World Labs in early 2024 with Fei-Fei Li,

source_text: Justin Johnson, and Ben Mildenhal to expand spatial intelligence.
zh: 以及贾斯汀·约翰逊和本·米尔登霍尔，旨在推动空间智能的发展。
en: Justin Johnson, and Ben Mildenhal to expand spatial intelligence.

source_text: What you see here are worlds generated by our first public relea-released model and product, Marble.
zh: 大家现在看到的这些世界，是由我们首个公开发布的模型及产品 Marble 生成的。
en: What you see here are worlds generated by our first public relea-released model and product, Marble.

source_text: Given text, image, depth, or video, it produces navigable, editable, and renderable 3D worlds you can explore.
zh: 只需输入文字、图像、深度信息或视频，它就能生成可供探索、自由漫游、编辑和渲染的三维世界。
en: Given text, image, depth, or video, it produces navigable, editable, and renderable 3D worlds you can explore.

source_text: A world model.
zh: 一个世界模型。
en: A world model.

source_text: Earlier this year,
zh: 今年早些时候，
en: Earlier this year,

source_text: um, I had an e-scooter accident.
zh: 嗯，我骑电动滑板车时出了事故。
en: um, I had an e-scooter accident.

source_text: Please be careful with these things.
zh: 骑这种车一定要小心。
en: Please be careful with these things.

source_text: Um, with a neck, uh,
zh: 嗯，我的脖子，呃，
en: Um, with a neck, uh,

source_text: arm, several rib, and facial fractures and concussion, um, I took a step back from my active role at World Labs and spent the last months focusing on recovery.
zh: 我的手臂、几根肋骨和面部都发生了骨折，还患有脑震荡。嗯，所以我暂时放下了在 World Labs 的日常工作，过去几个月一直专心休养。
en: arm, several rib, and facial fractures and concussion, um, I took a step back from my active role at World Labs and spent the last months focusing on recovery.

source_text: So since then, I do not hold an active role, uh, I don't do not hold an active role with a company anymore.
zh: 所以从那以后，我就不再参与公司的日常工作了。
en: So since then, I do not hold an active role, uh, I don't do not hold an active role with a company anymore.

source_text: Whoop. And here we go.
zh: 哇！我们开始吧。
en: Whoop. And here we go.

source_text: Um,
zh: 嗯，
en: Um,

source_text: and I'm speaking in a personal capacity today.
zh: 今天我仅以个人身份发言。
en: and I'm speaking in a personal capacity today.

source_text: Hopefully, I will never show such an intense picture in a talk again.
zh: 希望以后演讲时，我再也不用展示这么触目惊心的照片了。
en: Hopefully, I will never show such an intense picture in a talk again.

source_text: Um,
zh: 嗯，
en: Um,

source_text: but this is my first public talk since my recovery, and I'm super excited to be back and to be talking about ambitious ideas again.
zh: 不过，这是我康复后第一次公开演讲。能重新站在这里，和大家探讨宏大的构想，我特别兴奋。
en: but this is my first public talk since my recovery, and I'm super excited to be back and to be talking about ambitious ideas again.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好了。
en: All right.

source_text: So as I became more active again recently, I visited many founders and kept hearing the term "world model," but used very differently.
zh: 最近我逐渐恢复活动，拜访了许多创业者，反复听到“世界模型”这个词，但每个人对它的用法都很不一样。
en: So as I became more active again recently, I visited many founders and kept hearing the term "world model," but used very differently.

source_text: It felt a little bit like this.
zh: 感觉有点像这样。
en: It felt a little bit like this.

source_text: Um, Billa Wal tweeted this tweet right in time again. Uh, this was just in August. Um, let's see here.
zh: 嗯，Billa Wal 又恰逢其时地发了这条推文。呃，就是今年八月份的事。嗯，我找找看。
en: Um, Billa Wal tweeted this tweet right in time again. Uh, this was just in August. Um, let's see here.

source_text: I think the clicker is, is, uh, let me see here. Not let's go back.
zh: 我想翻页器是……呃，我看看。不是，先回到上一页。
en: I think the clicker is, is, uh, let me see here. Not let's go back.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好。
en: Okay.

source_text: There it is. And now once again. Great. So this was just in August.
zh: 找到了。现在再按一下。好。这是今年八月的事。
en: There it is. And now once again. Great. So this was just in August.

source_text: Um, my friends at World Labs had released a blog post about what world models are in the summer,
zh: 嗯，我在 World Labs 的朋友们今年夏天发了一篇博客文章，介绍什么是世界模型。
en: Um, my friends at World Labs had released a blog post about what world models are in the summer,

source_text: and Yann LeCun also recently talked about it.
zh: 杨立昆最近也谈到了这个话题。
en: and Yann LeCun also recently talked about it.

source_text: So when Meng Ying invited me to speak here,
zh: 所以，当孟颖邀请我来这里演讲时，
en: So when Meng Ying invited me to speak here,

source_text: it felt really timely to have a look at what all these ideas and taxonomies have in common and where the differences between models really matter.
zh: 我觉得现在正是时候，来看看这些想法和分类有哪些共通之处，以及不同模型之间的哪些差异真正重要。
en: it felt really timely to have a look at what all these ideas and taxonomies have in common and where the differences between models really matter.

source_text: So by the end of the talk, we will not only have a good idea of how to think about these methods, but also where world models may be headed and evolve. So what is a world model?
zh: 所以，听完这场报告，大家不仅能更清楚地理解这些方法，也能了解世界模型未来可能的发展方向。那么，什么是世界模型呢？
en: So by the end of the talk, we will not only have a good idea of how to think about these methods, but also where world models may be headed and evolve. So what is a world model?

source_text: In reinforcement learning,
zh: 在强化学习中，
en: In reinforcement learning,

source_text: a world model is a model of how a world behaves.
zh: 世界模型就是描述世界如何运作的模型。
en: a world model is a model of how a world behaves.

source_text: So for an agent, a very useful question is, what happens next if I act?
zh: 所以，对智能体来说，一个很重要的问题是：如果我采取某个行动，接下来会发生什么？
en: So for an agent, a very useful question is, what happens next if I act?

source_text: If I push this cup, where might it move?
zh: 如果我推一下这个杯子，它可能会往哪里移动？
en: If I push this cup, where might it move?

source_text: If I take this turn, what might I see?
zh: 如果我在这里转弯，可能会看到什么？
en: If I take this turn, what might I see?

source_text: That is a really important question in RL, where the modern use of the term in AI originated.
zh: 这是强化学习中一个非常重要的问题，而“世界模型”这个术语在现代人工智能中的用法正是源于强化学习。
en: That is a really important question in RL, where the modern use of the term in AI originated.

source_text: It does not require the representation to be visual at all.
zh: 它完全不要求这种表征必须是视觉形式的。
en: It does not require the representation to be visual at all.

source_text: The common idea is that we have an internal representation we can use to reason about something beyond the current observation. And we'll get more concrete.
zh: 核心思想是：我们有一种内部表征，可以用它来推理当前观察之外的情况。接下来我们会讲得更具体一些。
en: The common idea is that we have an internal representation we can use to reason about something beyond the current observation. And we'll get more concrete.

source_text: This is.
zh: 这是。
en: This is.

source_text: A classical and fairly general RL agent process for acting in a partially observable environment.
zh: 一个经典且相当通用的强化学习智能体在部分可观测环境中采取行动的流程。
en: A classical and fairly general RL agent process for acting in a partially observable environment.

source_text: The world has a state, um, but the agent receives ob-observations only that reveal only a part of it.
zh: 环境有一个状态，呃，但智能体只能接收到观测信息，而这些信息只揭示了状态的一部分。
en: The world has a state, um, but the agent receives ob-observations only that reveal only a part of it.

source_text: The state estimator combines those observations with its previous belief and the action it just took.
zh: 状态估计器将这些观测与先前的信念状态以及刚刚执行的动作结合起来。
en: The state estimator combines those observations with its previous belief and the action it just took.

source_text: It produces an updated belief about what might be happening.
zh: 它会更新对当前可能发生的情况的判断。
en: It produces an updated belief about what might be happening.

source_text: The policy then uses that belief to choose an action.
zh: 然后，策略会根据这一判断来选择动作。
en: The policy then uses that belief to choose an action.

source_text: Now, don't get hung up on this specific implementation of an agent or a system.
zh: 现在，别太纠结于智能体或系统的这种具体实现方式。
en: Now, don't get hung up on this specific implementation of an agent or a system.

source_text: I use it only as an example to illustrate the use cases for a world model.
zh: 我只是用它举个例子，来说明世界模型有哪些用途。
en: I use it only as an example to illustrate the use cases for a world model.

source_text: So where is the world model here?
zh: 那么，这里的世界模型在哪里呢？
en: So where is the world model here?

source_text: It contributes implicitly to this process.
zh: 它以隐含的方式参与了这一过程。
en: It contributes implicitly to this process.

source_text: Knowledge of how the world changes and how observations arise can support the state estimator.
zh: 了解世界如何变化、观测信息如何产生，有助于状态估计器发挥作用。
en: Knowledge of how the world changes and how observations arise can support the state estimator.

source_text: However, that is implemented, and the same knowledge can support planning when we compute a policy.
zh: 无论具体如何实现，同样的知识也能在制定策略时支持规划。
en: However, that is implemented, and the same knowledge can support planning when we compute a policy.

source_text: You can see how a world model supports many possible implementations of the agent as well as use cases beyond RL.
zh: 由此可见，世界模型不仅能支持智能体的多种实现方式，还能用于强化学习之外的场景。
en: You can see how a world model supports many possible implementations of the agent as well as use cases beyond RL.

source_text: Turns out it's really, really helpful to reason about the world and, in particular, being able to make predictions about things that are not currently observed.
zh: 事实证明，理解和推理世界非常有用，尤其是能够预测那些当前观测不到的事物。
en: Turns out it's really, really helpful to reason about the world and, in particular, being able to make predictions about things that are not currently observed.

source_text: But that le- still leaves so much flexibility in what a world model could actually do here.
zh: 但这仍然给世界模型在这里究竟能发挥什么作用，留下了很大的空间。
en: But that le- still leaves so much flexibility in what a world model could actually do here.

source_text: That suggests a functional taxonomy, and that's what my friends at World Labs wrote about this summer.
zh: 这就启发我们按功能对世界模型进行分类，而这正是我在 World Labs 的朋友们今年夏天撰文探讨的内容。
en: That suggests a functional taxonomy, and that's what my friends at World Labs wrote about this summer.

source_text: We use that functional taxonomy to see what a specific world model does.
zh: 我们用这种功能分类法来分析具体的世界模型能做什么。
en: We use that functional taxonomy to see what a specific world model does.

source_text: For example,
zh: 例如，
en: For example,

source_text: rendering produces observations.
zh: 渲染会生成观测结果。
en: rendering produces observations.

source_text: What would I see from here?
zh: 从这里我会看到什么？
en: What would I see from here?

source_text: Simulation produces a representation of a possible world state.
zh: 模拟会生成一种可能的世界状态的表征。
en: Simulation produces a representation of a possible world state.

source_text: What would happen if I pushed the cup?
zh: 如果我推一下这个杯子，会发生什么？
en: What would happen if I pushed the cup?

source_text: Um, planning produces actions.
zh: 嗯，规划会生成行动方案。
en: Um, planning produces actions.

source_text: What should I do to pick it up?
zh: 我该怎么做才能把它拿起来？
en: What should I do to pick it up?

source_text: A world model can implement all of these functions or any subset, including none.
zh: 一个世界模型可以实现所有这些功能，也可以只实现其中一部分，甚至一个都不实现。
en: A world model can implement all of these functions or any subset, including none.

source_text: The inverse is not true only because a model supports one of these functions does not mean that it is a world model.
zh: 反过来却不成立：一个模型支持其中某项功能，并不意味着它就是世界模型。
en: The inverse is not true only because a model supports one of these functions does not mean that it is a world model.

source_text: It just helps us to categorize models better by what they do.
zh: 这只是帮助我们根据模型的功能，更清楚地对它们进行分类。
en: It just helps us to categorize models better by what they do.

source_text: And this is inexpensible taxonomy of capabilities.
zh: 而且，这并不是一份详尽的能力分类。
en: And this is inexpensible taxonomy of capabilities.

source_text: These three operations connect directly to the agent world loop, but they do not exhaust the questions we can ask.
zh: 这三种操作与智能体和世界的交互循环直接相关，但我们能提出的问题远不止这些。
en: These three operations connect directly to the agent world loop, but they do not exhaust the questions we can ask.

source_text: Or the computations we can perform using a world model.
zh: 或者说，我们利用世界模型能够进行的计算也远不止这些。
en: Or the computations we can perform using a world model.

source_text: I think.
zh: 我认为。
en: I think.

source_text: These operations around the agent's representation of the world it acts in.
zh: 这些操作都围绕着智能体对其所处并采取行动的世界的表征展开。
en: These operations around the agent's representation of the world it acts in.

source_text: Rendering tells us what we might observe.
zh: 渲染告诉我们可能会观察到什么。
en: Rendering tells us what we might observe.

source_text: Simulation lets us explore consequences.
zh: 模拟让我们能够探索各种可能的后果。
en: Simulation lets us explore consequences.

source_text: Planning uses an objective to choose behavior.
zh: 规划根据目标来选择行动。
en: Planning uses an objective to choose behavior.

source_text: They can share the same underlying model,
zh: 它们可以共用同一个底层模型，
en: They can share the same underlying model,

source_text: or be spread across multiple models.
zh: 也可以由多个模型分别承担。
en: or be spread across multiple models.

source_text: The world model, or world models, we use to implement this agentic loop.
zh: 我们用来实现这一智能体循环的世界模型，可以是一个，也可以是多个。
en: The world model, or world models, we use to implement this agentic loop.

source_text: So let's revisit our initial question on what constitutes a world model, armed with this additional knowledge and taxonomy, and see where it gets us.
zh: 现在，结合这些补充知识和分类，我们再来看看最初的问题：什么才算世界模型？看看能得出什么结论。
en: So let's revisit our initial question on what constitutes a world model, armed with this additional knowledge and taxonomy, and see where it gets us.

en: I'm just using the, the fun meme as, um, a little hook throughout the talk, and the models as examples here.

en: So this is a video that I made with Kling 4.0, and we move around a generated intersection and keep encountering red traffic lights for all, uh, for all directions.

en: What matters here is, would the model correctly reason about traffic lights from views other than the initial view?

en: So does it keep simulating and updating them correctly?

source_text: A locally consistent render for one frame may only be a part of what an application needs, or another application may be completely sufficient. And that's what this dimension covers.
zh: 对某些应用来说，单帧画面在局部看起来自洽，可能只是需求的一部分；但对另一些应用来说，这可能已经完全足够。这就是这一维度所考察的内容。
en: A locally consistent render for one frame may only be a part of what an application needs, or another application may be completely sufficient. And that's what this dimension covers.

source_text: So this leaves us well-armed with a taxonomy to navigate world models in our context, in particular in an AI and RL sense.
zh: 这样一来，我们就有了一套分类框架，能更好地理解和梳理我们所讨论的世界模型，尤其是人工智能和强化学习语境下的世界模型。
en: So this leaves us well-armed with a taxonomy to navigate world models in our context, in particular in an AI and RL sense.

source_text: So a world model is a predictive model for how a world behaves,
zh: 所以，世界模型是一种预测世界如何运作的模型，
en: So a world model is a predictive model for how a world behaves,

source_text: with a set of functions in domain.
zh: 以及定义域内的一组函数。
en: with a set of functions in domain.

source_text: X, with scale resolution A, B, and coverage C.
zh: X，其尺度为 A、分辨率为 B、覆盖范围为 C。
en: X, with scale resolution A, B, and coverage C.

source_text: So now.
zh: 那么现在。
en: So now.

source_text: We can look again at all the models in, in this picture.
zh: 我们可以再来看一看这张图里的所有模型。
en: We can look again at all the models in, in this picture.

source_text: And now we find that if we take these additional questions into account, we can actually separate them really well and understand better where they're going.
zh: 现在我们发现，如果把这些额外的问题也考虑进去，就能很好地区分这些模型，也能更清楚地理解它们各自的发展方向。
en: And now we find that if we take these additional questions into account, we can actually separate them really well and understand better where they're going.

source_text: So this we can do now. I'll also bring back our tweets.
zh: 现在我们就可以这么做。我也会把之前的推文调出来。
en: So this we can do now. I'll also bring back our tweets.

source_text: And if you look at those, most of them are referring to a world model in the RL sense,
zh: 如果看这些推文，你会发现其中大多数说的都是强化学习意义上的世界模型，
en: And if you look at those, most of them are referring to a world model in the RL sense,

source_text: whether that's for user interfaces or human cells.
zh: 无论是用于用户界面，还是用于人类细胞。
en: whether that's for user interfaces or human cells.

source_text: Some are still being used in a different way.
zh: 不过，也有一些仍然采用不同的用法。
en: Some are still being used in a different way.

source_text: And what do we do with those?
zh: 那这些又该怎么处理呢？
en: And what do we do with those?

source_text: If we want to distinguish those as well, we can separate predictive and descriptive models.
zh: 如果还想区分这些模型，我们可以把它们分为预测型模型和描述型模型。
en: If we want to distinguish those as well, we can separate predictive and descriptive models.

source_text: So a purely descriptive model opens a very wide range, for example, like databases, and may go far outside of AI and reinforcement learning use cases.
zh: 纯粹的描述型模型涵盖的范围很广，比如数据库，甚至可能远远超出人工智能和强化学习的应用场景。
en: So a purely descriptive model opens a very wide range, for example, like databases, and may go far outside of AI and reinforcement learning use cases.

source_text: So I won't explore this direction further in this talk.
zh: 所以，在这次演讲中，我就不再深入探讨这个方向了。
en: So I won't explore this direction further in this talk.

source_text: Um, but this leaves us with a taxonomy that can cover really a lot of ground.
zh: 不过，这样我们就得到了一套分类体系，能够涵盖相当广泛的领域。
en: Um, but this leaves us with a taxonomy that can cover really a lot of ground.

source_text: It's a powerful tool to quickly narrow down what you're dealing with and whether that fits your purpose and task.
zh: 它是一个很有用的工具，能帮你快速判断眼前的模型属于哪一类，以及它是否适合你的目标和任务。
en: It's a powerful tool to quickly narrow down what you're dealing with and whether that fits your purpose and task.

source_text: All right.
zh: 好。
en: All right.

source_text: So again, I'll con- continue discussing AI and reinforcement learning predictive world models.
zh: 接下来，我会继续讨论人工智能和强化学习中的预测型世界模型。
en: So again, I'll con- continue discussing AI and reinforcement learning predictive world models.

source_text: So looking forward, I want to extrapolate a little.
zh: 展望未来，我想在现有基础上做一点推演。
en: So looking forward, I want to extrapolate a little.

source_text: To quote Ilya, let's feel the AGI together a little bit.
zh: 借用伊利亚的话，让我们一起稍微感受一下通用人工智能吧。
en: To quote Ilya, let's feel the AGI together a little bit.

source_text: So my.
zh: 那么，我的……
en: So my.

source_text: Thesis is that world models will define how intelligence interfaces with our world.
zh: 我的核心观点是：世界模型将决定智能如何与我们的世界交互。
en: Thesis is that world models will define how intelligence interfaces with our world.

source_text: World models define how an agent can explore a specific domain, navigate it, and interact with it.
zh: 世界模型决定了智能体如何探索、理解并与特定领域互动。
en: World models define how an agent can explore a specific domain, navigate it, and interact with it.

source_text: And the world model let it ask useful questions and consider the consequences.
zh: 世界模型还能让智能体提出有价值的问题，并思考行动可能带来的后果。
en: And the world model let it ask useful questions and consider the consequences.

source_text: Operations.
zh: 操作。
en: Operations.

source_text: A world model is an interface between the abstract reasoning and the action and perception space.
zh: 世界模型是抽象推理与行动、感知空间之间的接口。
en: A world model is an interface between the abstract reasoning and the action and perception space.

source_text: An agent can query a world model and obtain predictions.
zh: 智能体可以查询世界模型，获得预测结果。
en: An agent can query a world model and obtain predictions.

source_text: The world, in turn, helps uh, the world model, in turn, helps with observations and planning actions. Let's res- return to our illustrative agentic loop.
zh: 反过来，世界模型也能帮助智能体理解观测结果、规划行动。让我们回到刚才用来说明问题的智能体循环。
en: The world, in turn, helps uh, the world model, in turn, helps with observations and planning actions. Let's res- return to our illustrative agentic loop.

source_text: This is the exemplary loop we know.
zh: 这就是我们熟悉的典型循环。
en: This is the exemplary loop we know.

source_text: Now, with more intelligence, we need more space.
zh: 现在，随着智能水平的提升，我们需要更大的空间。
en: Now, with more intelligence, we need more space.

source_text: And with the progress towards generalized agentic reasoning and multimodal models, they can take the role of a coherent long-term system two component.
zh: 随着通用智能体推理和多模态模型的发展，它们可以充当连贯的长期系统的组成部分。
en: And with the progress towards generalized agentic reasoning and multimodal models, they can take the role of a coherent long-term system two component.

source_text: In case you're not familiar with the distinction between system one and two, it's a co- cognitive psychology-inspired analo- analogy for higher-level,
zh: 如果你不熟悉系统一和系统二的区别：这是借鉴认知心理学提出的类比，用来描述更高层次的……
en: In case you're not familiar with the distinction between system one and two, it's a co- cognitive psychology-inspired analo- analogy for higher-level,

source_text: slower reasoning in system two: real-time perception control in system one, and sometimes extended to a controller in system zero.
zh: 系统二负责较慢的推理，系统一负责实时感知与控制；有时还会进一步延伸出负责控制的系统零。
en: slower reasoning in system two: real-time perception control in system one, and sometimes extended to a controller in system zero.

source_text: So the agent's long-term identity goals and reasoning happen in system two.
zh: 因此，智能体的长期身份认知、目标设定和推理都由系统二负责。
en: So the agent's long-term identity goals and reasoning happen in system two.

source_text: The lower loop now can become a system one module and even domain-specific.
zh: 下层循环现在可以成为系统一模块，甚至可以针对特定领域进行专门设计。
en: The lower loop now can become a system one module and even domain-specific.

source_text: It uses a world model to maintain an estimate of the situation and guide the actions in that domain.
zh: 它利用世界模型持续估计当前情境，并指导该领域中的行动。
en: It uses a world model to maintain an estimate of the situation and guide the actions in that domain.

source_text: The connection between the two matters just as much.
zh: 两者之间的衔接同样重要。
en: The connection between the two matters just as much.

source_text: Reasoning needs to incorporate what the system one loop currently believes, including relevant uncertainty or a failed action, and it can then create or modify policies that work in real time.
zh: 系统二的推理需要考虑系统一循环当前对情境的判断，包括相关的不确定性或行动失败的信息，然后据此制定或调整能够实时执行的策略。
en: Reasoning needs to incorporate what the system one loop currently believes, including relevant uncertainty or a failed action, and it can then create or modify policies that work in real time.

source_text: We can extend that to multiple domains and let the agent work across multiple interfaces at the same time.
zh: 我们还可以将其扩展到多个领域，让智能体同时通过多个界面开展工作。
en: We can extend that to multiple domains and let the agent work across multiple interfaces at the same time.

source_text: So these are two-domain modules.
zh: 所以，这些是双领域模块。
en: So these are two-domain modules.

source_text: Um,
zh: 嗯，
en: Um,

source_text: one might handle physical interaction using vis- vision, touch, and motion.
zh: 其中一个模块可以利用视觉、触觉和运动能力来处理物理交互。
en: one might handle physical interaction using vis- vision, touch, and motion.

source_text: Um, another might handle digital workflows using language and tools.
zh: 嗯，另一个模块则可以借助语言和工具处理数字化工作流程。
en: Um, another might handle digital workflows using language and tools.

source_text: A large multimodal model can reason across many different domains.
zh: 大型多模态模型能够跨多个不同领域进行推理。
en: A large multimodal model can reason across many different domains.

source_text: So each module uses its own world models, possibly. Again, this is just illustrative.
zh: 所以，每个模块可能都有自己的世界模型。重申一下，这只是示意。
en: So each module uses its own world models, possibly. Again, this is just illustrative.

source_text: And its current belief represents the domain state, estimation updates that belief, and a policy selects actions.
zh: 它当前的认知表征了该领域的状态；估计过程会更新这一认知，策略则负责选择行动。
en: And its current belief represents the domain state, estimation updates that belief, and a policy selects actions.

source_text: The domain module contains those responsibilities.
zh: 领域模块承担这些职责。
en: The domain module contains those responsibilities.

source_text: It is more than just the world model itself.
zh: 它不只是世界模型本身。
en: It is more than just the world model itself.

source_text: So this is an example that can be extended.
zh: 所以，这只是一个可以进一步扩展的例子。
en: So this is an example that can be extended.

source_text: Um, you can, uh, imagine modules for other domains with representations of and operations suited to each one.
zh: 嗯，你可以设想其他领域也有相应的模块，每个模块都有适合该领域的表征方式和操作。
en: Um, you can, uh, imagine modules for other domains with representations of and operations suited to each one.

source_text: So when a task requires reasoning across domains or resolving a conflict, that is a natural responsibility for system two using higher-level reasoning.
zh: 因此，当任务需要跨领域推理或解决冲突时，自然就该由系统二运用更高层次的推理来处理。
en: So when a task requires reasoning across domains or resolving a conflict, that is a natural responsibility for system two using higher-level reasoning.

source_text: I'm leaving the detailed coordination mechanism open here.
zh: 这里我暂不限定具体的协调机制。
en: I'm leaving the detailed coordination mechanism open here.

source_text: Also, consider the concrete implementation as an example.
zh: 另外，也请把这个具体实现视为一个示例。
en: Also, consider the concrete implementation as an example.

source_text: These boxes mainly describe responsibilities.
zh: 这些框主要说明各部分的职责。
en: These boxes mainly describe responsibilities.

source_text: So in a learned system,
zh: 所以，在一个通过学习构建的系统中，
en: So in a learned system,

source_text: some of them may share parameters or live in the same network.
zh: 其中一些模块可能共享参数，或者存在于同一个网络中。
en: some of them may share parameters or live in the same network.

source_text: So this is one proposed organization, um, rather than a required architecture for intelligence.
zh: 所以，这只是一种可能的组织方式，而不是智能系统必须采用的架构。
en: So this is one proposed organization, um, rather than a required architecture for intelligence.

source_text: Um, but it illustrates how much world models can enhance agentic workflows in powerful ways.
zh: 嗯，不过，这个例子说明了世界模型能够极大地提升智能体工作流程的能力。
en: Um, but it illustrates how much world models can enhance agentic workflows in powerful ways.

source_text: World models are going to define how intelligence interfaces with the world.
zh: 世界模型将决定智能如何与世界交互。
en: World models are going to define how intelligence interfaces with the world.

source_text: For some domains, we already understand the representations and operations quite well.
zh: 在某些领域，我们已经相当了解其中的表征方式和运作机制。
en: For some domains, we already understand the representations and operations quite well.

source_text: There are many others where the most interesting work is still ahead.
zh: 但在许多其他领域，最令人期待的探索仍在前方。
en: There are many others where the most interesting work is still ahead.

source_text: An example: what would a world model of a mind look like?
zh: 举个例子：一个关于心智的世界模型会是什么样的？
en: An example: what would a world model of a mind look like?

source_text: What does someone believe or need?
zh: 一个人相信什么，又需要什么？
en: What does someone believe or need?

source_text: How can we communicate better and support each other with that understanding?
zh: 有了这样的理解，我们怎样才能更好地沟通、相互支持？
en: How can we communicate better and support each other with that understanding?

source_text: Can that create deep alignment?
zh: 这能实现深层次的对齐吗？
en: Can that create deep alignment?

source_text: Improving how people and AI will work and live together long-term is something I find deeply inspiring. So if you're interested in working on those questions too, let's talk.
zh: 如何让人与人工智能在未来更好地协作、共处，是一件让我深受鼓舞的事。如果你也想研究这些问题，欢迎来聊聊。
en: Improving how people and AI will work and live together long-term is something I find deeply inspiring. So if you're interested in working on those questions too, let's talk.

source_text: Thank you so much.
zh: 非常感谢。
en: Thank you so much.

source_text: So Chris have definitely given a fascinating talk about world models.
zh: 克里斯刚才关于世界模型的演讲确实非常精彩。
en: So Chris have definitely given a fascinating talk about world models.

source_text: And, uh, it's so great to have you back too.
zh: 而且，呃，也很高兴你能再次来到这里。
en: And, uh, it's so great to have you back too.

source_text: Um, now we're going to invite Bing Liu, VP of Engineering from Haijin, to tell us why HTML is all of our agents need.
zh: 接下来，我们有请海金的工程副总裁刘兵，为我们讲讲为什么 HTML 就是我们的智能体所需要的一切。
en: Um, now we're going to invite Bing Liu, VP of Engineering from Haijin, to tell us why HTML is all of our agents need.

source_text: 谢谢。
zh: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.

zh: 大家好。
en: Hi, everyone.

zh: 大家都好吗？

zh: 我叫斌。

source_text: First,
zh: 首先，
en: First,

source_text: uh, please give it a round of applause to,
zh: 呃，请大家用掌声欢迎……
en: uh, please give it a round of applause to,

source_text: uh, Chris again. That was a great talk.
zh: 呃，再次把掌声送给克里斯！刚才的演讲太精彩了。
en: uh, Chris again. That was a great talk.

source_text: By far, I think my favorite talk, uh,
zh: 目前为止，我觉得我最喜欢的演讲，呃，
en: By far, I think my favorite talk, uh,

source_text: at, uh, uh, at the conference.
zh: 是这次大会上我最喜欢的一场。
en: at, uh, uh, at the conference.

source_text: Uh, my name is Bin.
zh: 呃，我叫斌。
en: Uh, my name is Bin.

source_text: Uh, I run our agentic video business at Haijin.
zh: 呃，我负责海进的智能体视频业务。
en: Uh, I run our agentic video business at Haijin.

source_text: Today,
zh: 今天，
en: Today,

source_text: I wanted to convince you that HTML is all your agents need.
zh: 我想让大家相信，HTML 就是你们的智能体所需要的一切。
en: I wanted to convince you that HTML is all your agents need.

source_text: But the key, uh, to the whole talk is actually, hopefully, inspire some of you, uh, to rethink how you should be doing context engineering for your own agents and your products.
zh: 不过，这场演讲最重要的目的，其实是希望能启发大家重新思考：该如何为自己的智能体和产品做好上下文工程。
en: But the key, uh, to the whole talk is actually, hopefully, inspire some of you, uh, to rethink how you should be doing context engineering for your own agents and your products.

source_text: Uh.
zh: 呃。
en: Uh.

source_text: Can I get a show of hands?
zh: 在场的各位能举一下手吗？
en: Can I get a show of hands?

source_text: How many have you worked on, uh, context engineering?
zh: 有多少人做过上下文工程？
en: How many have you worked on, uh, context engineering?

source_text: For your agents?
zh: 为你们的智能体？
en: For your agents?

source_text: Your products?
zh: 或者你们的产品？
en: Your products?

source_text: Great.
zh: 很好。
en: Great.

source_text: A lot.
zh: 很多人。
en: A lot.

source_text: I did too.
zh: 我也做过。
en: I did too.

source_text: Um,
zh: 嗯。
en: Um,

source_text: context engineering, usually, we think about memory, tools, RAG, loops, etc.,
zh: 说到上下文工程，我们通常会想到记忆、工具、检索增强生成（RAG）、循环等等。
en: context engineering, usually, we think about memory, tools, RAG, loops, etc.,

source_text: etc.
zh: 等等。
en: etc.

source_text: But I'm not going to be talking about that today.
zh: 但我今天不打算讲这些。
en: But I'm not going to be talking about that today.

source_text: Uh, there are a lot of other talks that are great about these, uh, topics.
zh: 嗯，关于这些话题，已经有很多很精彩的演讲了。
en: Uh, there are a lot of other talks that are great about these, uh, topics.

source_text: We learn from them as well. So what am I going to talk about?
zh: 我们也能从中学习。那么，我今天要讲什么呢？
en: We learn from them as well. So what am I going to talk about?

source_text: I want you and everyone here to take a step back and think about what should be the shape of your agent's context. Now you're more confused.
zh: 我想请在座各位先退一步，想想你的智能体的上下文究竟应该是什么样子。现在你们可能更困惑了。
en: I want you and everyone here to take a step back and think about what should be the shape of your agent's context. Now you're more confused.

source_text: So I'm going to use a real example of how we at Haijin built Video Agent.
zh: 所以，我会用一个真实案例，讲讲我们海津是如何打造视频智能体的。
en: So I'm going to use a real example of how we at Haijin built Video Agent.

source_text: And what are the context engineering learnings that we've, uh, uh, accumulated over that journey?
zh: 以及在这个过程中，我们在上下文工程方面积累了哪些经验？
en: And what are the context engineering learnings that we've, uh, uh, accumulated over that journey?

source_text: And how we got from just starting, uh, to now.
zh: 以及我们是如何从起步一路走到今天的。
en: And how we got from just starting, uh, to now.

source_text: For those of you who don't know what Haijin does,
zh: 如果在座有朋友还不了解海津是做什么的，
en: For those of you who don't know what Haijin does,

source_text: uh, we are an AI video company.
zh: 我们是一家人工智能视频公司。
en: uh, we are an AI video company.

source_text: However,
zh: 不过，
en: However,

source_text: uh, we are not, um,
zh: 呃，我们并不是……
en: uh, we are not, um,

source_text: the we don't make,
zh: 我们不做……
en: the we don't make,

source_text: uh, short dramas,
zh: 呃，短剧，
en: uh, short dramas,

source_text: Hollywood films, uh, etc., etc.
zh: 好莱坞电影之类的。
en: Hollywood films, uh, etc., etc.

source_text: Those are amazing videos.
zh: 那些视频都很精彩。
en: Those are amazing videos.

source_text: There are, you know, many great companies like MiniMax and Seedance, uh, and many other companies focusing on those type of videos.
zh: 有很多优秀的公司，比如 MiniMax、Seedance 等，都专注于制作这类视频。
en: There are, you know, many great companies like MiniMax and Seedance, uh, and many other companies focusing on those type of videos.

source_text: For Haijin, uh, our mission and vision is that we believe video is one of, if not the best, communication format.
zh: 对 Haijin 来说，我们的使命和愿景是：我们相信视频即使不是最好的，也是最好的沟通方式之一。
en: For Haijin, uh, our mission and vision is that we believe video is one of, if not the best, communication format.

source_text: Uh, most of the people are, um, would rather watch a one-minute video than to read a five-page document.
zh: 大多数人宁愿看一分钟的视频，也不愿读一份五页的文档。
en: Uh, most of the people are, um, would rather watch a one-minute video than to read a five-page document.

source_text: Uh, internally, we have replaced a lot of our documentation using video.
zh: 在公司内部，我们已经用视频取代了很多文字文档。
en: Uh, internally, we have replaced a lot of our documentation using video.

source_text: And we believe that video is a critical tool for everyone here, builders, to communicate your ideas, your stories, and your product to the world.
zh: 我们相信，视频是这里每一位创造者向世界传达想法、讲述故事、展示产品的重要工具。
en: And we believe that video is a critical tool for everyone here, builders, to communicate your ideas, your stories, and your product to the world.

source_text: So we believe that we need to build an agent, uh, that allows our users to make these type of videos, uh, with ease.
zh: 因此，我们认为需要打造一个智能体，让用户能够轻松制作这类视频。
en: So we believe that we need to build an agent, uh, that allows our users to make these type of videos, uh, with ease.

source_text: And.
zh: 还有。
en: And.

source_text: So when we started,
zh: 所以，一开始的时候，
en: So when we started,

source_text: we built an agent on top of the video editor that we have built over the years.
zh: 我们在多年打磨的视频编辑器之上，构建了一个智能体。
en: we built an agent on top of the video editor that we have built over the years.

source_text: This video editor has your script on the left-hand side, has all of the, uh, you know, you can change the colors, you can st- uh,
zh: 这个视频编辑器左边是脚本，你还可以调整颜色，也可以……
en: This video editor has your script on the left-hand side, has all of the, uh, you know, you can change the colors, you can st- uh,

source_text: edit the scenes.
zh: 编辑各个场景。
en: edit the scenes.

source_text: And this editor is built on top of at least 2,000 lines of JSON.
zh: 而这个编辑器的底层，至少有两千行 JSON 代码。
en: And this editor is built on top of at least 2,000 lines of JSON.

source_text: Sometimes 6,000, sometimes 10,000.
zh: 有时是六千行，有时甚至达到一万行。
en: Sometimes 6,000, sometimes 10,000.

source_text: Because most of our products, before the agentic world, were built on things like JSONs, XMLs, and whatever underlying data structure.
zh: 因为在智能体时代到来之前，我们的大多数产品都是基于 JSON、XML 等底层数据结构构建的。
en: Because most of our products, before the agentic world, were built on things like JSONs, XMLs, and whatever underlying data structure.

source_text: And so your first inclination when you build an agent is to build an agent that can write your format.
zh: 所以，当你着手构建智能体时，第一反应往往是让它学会生成你现有的数据格式。
en: And so your first inclination when you build an agent is to build an agent that can write your format.

source_text: In this case, this 2,000-line JSON.
zh: 在这个例子里，就是让它生成那份两千行的 JSON。
en: In this case, this 2,000-line JSON.

source_text: But the problem.
zh: 但问题是，
en: But the problem.

source_text: With that is agents, most of the agents, and unless you train your own model, aren't trained to write your JSON.
zh: 大多数智能体并没有经过专门训练，无法生成你所需的 JSON 格式，除非你自己训练模型。
en: With that is agents, most of the agents, and unless you train your own model, aren't trained to write your JSON.

source_text: It is trained to write JSON. Don't get me wrong.
zh: 它是经过训练、会写 JSON 的。别误会我的意思。
en: It is trained to write JSON. Don't get me wrong.

source_text: Agents are really good at writing JSON.
zh: 智能体非常擅长生成 JSON。
en: Agents are really good at writing JSON.

source_text: But agents actually cannot reason within your JSON, at least not to the extent that we would want it to.
zh: 但智能体其实无法基于你特定的 JSON 结构进行推理，至少达不到我们期望的水平。
en: But agents actually cannot reason within your JSON, at least not to the extent that we would want it to.

source_text: For instance, these are two four-line JSONs.
zh: 比如，这里有两段 JSON，每段只有四行。
en: For instance, these are two four-line JSONs.

source_text: They look perfectly fine. To an agent.
zh: 在智能体看来，它们都完全没问题。
en: They look perfectly fine. To an agent.

source_text: However, one is laid out correctly.
zh: 但其中只有一个结构是正确的。
en: However, one is laid out correctly.

source_text: The other one, uh, you can't even see the words.
zh: 另一个呢，呃，你连字都看不清。
en: The other one, uh, you can't even see the words.

source_text: But when an agent is just looking at those lines,
zh: 但当智能体只是看着这几行内容时，
en: But when an agent is just looking at those lines,

source_text: the agent has no idea that it made a mistake, right?
zh: 智能体根本不知道自己犯了错，对吧？
en: the agent has no idea that it made a mistake, right?

source_text: So when we were working on context engineering, we have to feed this image back into the agent.
zh: 所以，在做上下文工程时，我们必须把这张图片反馈给智能体。
en: So when we were working on context engineering, we have to feed this image back into the agent.

source_text: The agent's like, "Oh, shoot. I made a mistake. Let me change those numbers."
zh: 智能体会想：“哎呀，我弄错了。让我改改这些数字。”
en: The agent's like, "Oh, shoot. I made a mistake. Let me change those numbers."

source_text: So internally, we have this analogy when we were building, you know, the entire video agent on top of this context, this 2,000-line JSON context,
zh: 所以在内部，我们开发整个视频智能体时，常用这样一个类比：它所依赖的上下文，是一份两千行的 JSON。
en: So internally, we have this analogy when we were building, you know, the entire video agent on top of this context, this 2,000-line JSON context,

source_text: is that we're trying to harness the LLM's intelligence into something that it's actually not that good at.
zh: 我们其实是在尝试利用大语言模型的智能，去做它本来不太擅长的事。
en: is that we're trying to harness the LLM's intelligence into something that it's actually not that good at.

source_text: Uh, internally, we say it's almost like asking, um, Shakespeare to write a Chinese poem.
zh: 呃，我们内部常说，这几乎就像让莎士比亚写一首中文诗。
en: Uh, internally, we say it's almost like asking, um, Shakespeare to write a Chinese poem.

source_text: You're giving it a bunch of Chinese poem, uh, uh, uh, examples.
zh: 你给它看了很多中文诗歌的例子。
en: You're giving it a bunch of Chinese poem, uh, uh, uh, examples.

source_text: And it actually can write something.
zh: 而且它确实能写出点东西来。
en: And it actually can write something.

source_text: It looks okay.
zh: 看起来还行。
en: It looks okay.

source_text: It looks like a poem.
zh: 看起来像首诗。
en: It looks like a poem.

source_text: But is it a great one?
zh: 但它真的是一首好诗吗？
en: But is it a great one?

source_text: Absolutely not.
zh: 绝对不是。
en: Absolutely not.

source_text: So we decided that we might need to reshape our agent's context so that we send Shakespeare back to be writing place.
zh: 所以我们决定，可能需要重新组织智能体的上下文，让莎士比亚回到他擅长的创作领域。
en: So we decided that we might need to reshape our agent's context so that we send Shakespeare back to be writing place.

source_text: So what is what does agents uh, what are they trained on?
zh: 那么，智能体是用什么数据训练的呢？
en: So what is what does agents uh, what are they trained on?

source_text: What are they really, really good at?
zh: 它们究竟最擅长什么？
en: What are they really, really good at?

source_text: I think everyone now would absolutely agree most, if not all, of the Frontier Labs LLMs are incredible at writing code. And they will continue to be.
zh: 我想现在大家都会认同：前沿实验室的大多数大语言模型，甚至可能是全部，都非常擅长编写代码，而且今后也会继续如此。
en: I think everyone now would absolutely agree most, if not all, of the Frontier Labs LLMs are incredible at writing code. And they will continue to be.

source_text: So what if our entire context is built on top of code and file systems?
zh: 那么，如果我们把整个上下文都建立在代码和文件系统之上，会怎么样呢？
en: So what if our entire context is built on top of code and file systems?

source_text: So we threw out our JSON completely.
zh: 于是，我们彻底弃用了 JSON。
en: So we threw out our JSON completely.

source_text: And we just let agents write HTMLs.
zh: 然后，我们就让智能体直接编写 HTML。
en: And we just let agents write HTMLs.

source_text: And that's when we started building Hyperframes.
zh: 也正是在那时，我们开始打造 Hyperframes。
en: And that's when we started building Hyperframes.

source_text: Hyperframe is an open-source framework that we open-sourced earlier this year in April, where we let agents write pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code.
zh: Hyperframe 是一个开源框架，我们在今年四月将它开源。它让智能体能够直接编写纯 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 代码。
en: Hyperframe is an open-source framework that we open-sourced earlier this year in April, where we let agents write pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code.

source_text: And with the framework, you can render an MP4 video out of it.
zh: 借助这个框架，你可以将这些代码渲染成 MP4 视频。
en: And with the framework, you can render an MP4 video out of it.

source_text: You might be thinking, "What?
zh: 你可能会想：“什么？”
en: You might be thinking, "What?

source_text: HTML video?
zh: 用 HTML 做视频？
en: HTML video?

source_text: What, what does that mean?
zh: “等等，这是什么意思？”
en: What, what does that mean?

source_text: " On the left-hand side, you see a very simple HTML code, a couple lines of divs, titles, some JavaScript. And on the right is the video that this HTML can create.
zh: 左边是一段非常简单的 HTML 代码，只有几行 div 标签、标题和一些 JavaScript；右边则是这段 HTML 生成的视频。
en: " On the left-hand side, you see a very simple HTML code, a couple lines of divs, titles, some JavaScript. And on the right is the video that this HTML can create.

source_text: So imagine a mental model when you're just looking at a landing page of a website.
zh: 你可以这样理解：想象一下你正在浏览一个网站的首页。
en: So imagine a mental model when you're just looking at a landing page of a website.

source_text: And imagine that website just kept on changing.
zh: 再想象一下，这个网页会不断变化。
en: And imagine that website just kept on changing.

source_text: The words fly in, fly out, flips, animations.
zh: 文字飞入飞出、翻转，还有各种动画效果。
en: The words fly in, fly out, flips, animations.

source_text: There's a video that comes into the scene, goes full screen, goes back to center.
zh: 一个视频进入画面，放大到全屏，然后又缩回画面中央。
en: There's a video that comes into the scene, goes full screen, goes back to center.

source_text: There's sound come on,
zh: 接着响起了声音，
en: There's sound come on,

source_text: etc., etc.
zh: 等等，诸如此类。
en: etc., etc.

source_text: Sure, you were looking at a landing page.
zh: 没错，你刚才看到的就是一个网站首页。
en: Sure, you were looking at a landing page.

source_text: But that can also be a video.
zh: 但它也可以是一段视频。
en: But that can also be a video.

source_text: So that's the core idea of this context reshaping.
zh: 所以，这就是“重塑语境”的核心理念。
en: So that's the core idea of this context reshaping.

source_text: And when we open-sourced it, we claimed that agentic video is HTML.
zh: 我们将它开源时，提出了一个观点：智能体生成的视频就是 HTML。
en: And when we open-sourced it, we claimed that agentic video is HTML.

source_text: And 22 days later, Anthropic agrees. They copied our idea.
zh: 22 天后，Anthropic 也认同了这个观点。他们照搬了我们的创意。
en: And 22 days later, Anthropic agrees. They copied our idea.

source_text: They said,
zh: 他们说，
en: They said,

source_text: "Uh,
zh: 呃，
en: "Uh,

source_text: yeah, HTML is a new markdown,
zh: 对，HTML 就是新的 Markdown，
en: yeah, HTML is a new markdown,

source_text: unreasonable, effective HTML, didn't, you know, mention us at all. That's okay."
zh: “HTML 好用得离谱，却完全没提到我们。不过没关系。”
en: unreasonable, effective HTML, didn't, you know, mention us at all. That's okay."

source_text: But.
zh: 但是。
en: But.

source_text: I want to show you guys a real quick example of what our agent can do now.
zh: 我想快速给大家展示一个例子，看看我们的智能体现在能做什么。
en: I want to show you guys a real quick example of what our agent can do now.

source_text: Of course.
zh: 当然。
en: Of course.

source_text: Uh.
zh: 呃。
en: Uh.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好。
en: Okay.

source_text: We'll just play it directly.
zh: 我们直接播放就好。
en: We'll just play it directly.

source_text: Huh?
zh: 嗯？
en: Huh?

source_text: Uh.
zh: 呃。
en: Uh.

source_text: That's awkward.
zh: 有点尴尬。
en: That's awkward.

source_text: Oh, there we go.
zh: 哦，好了。
en: Oh, there we go.

source_text: Please play.
zh: 请播放。
en: Please play.

source_text: Is oh, maybe it's just because my laptop is too, uh, too out of battery.
zh: 哦，可能只是因为我的笔记本电脑快没电了。
en: Is oh, maybe it's just because my laptop is too, uh, too out of battery.

source_text: 有电池吗？
zh: 有电池吗？
en: Do you have a battery?

source_text: 没有，就老虎了。
zh: 没有，就老虎了。
en: No, just the tiger.

source_text: 好。
zh: 好。
en: Okay.

source_text: 你那儿有吗？
zh: 你那儿有吗？
en: Do you have one over there?

source_text: 啊，有的。
zh: 啊，有的。
en: Oh, yes, I do.

source_text: 我，我 wait for him to pull it up if he can, and we'll keep going.
zh: 我等他把画面调出来，如果可以的话，我们就继续。
en: 我，我 wait for him to pull it up if he can, and we'll keep going.

source_text: But before we see the actual final output, hopefully, which we can play in a second.
zh: 不过在看最终成品之前——希望我们马上就能播放。
en: But before we see the actual final output, hopefully, which we can play in a second.

source_text: Um, people called our videos slop.
zh: 嗯，有人说我们的视频是粗制滥造的垃圾。
en: Um, people called our videos slop.

source_text: Oh, oh, looks like something is playing.
zh: 哦，哦，好像有东西开始播放了。
en: Oh, oh, looks like something is playing.

source_text: Unplug?
zh: 拔掉插头？
en: Unplug?

source_text: Hyperframes.
zh: 超级帧。
en: Hyperframes.

source_text: Thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢。
en: Thank you very much.

source_text: This video, thank you.
zh: 这个视频，谢谢。
en: This video, thank you.

source_text: This video was made by me.
zh: 这个视频是我制作的。
en: This video was made by me.

source_text: I have never learned After Effects Premiere Cut.
zh: 我从来没学过 After Effects、Premiere 或 Final Cut。
en: I have never learned After Effects Premiere Cut.

source_text: I don't even know how to use CapCut.
zh: 我连剪映都不会用。
en: I don't even know how to use CapCut.

source_text: But now I can make these type of videos to communicate the value of our products with just prompting our agent.
zh: 但现在，我只要给智能体输入提示词，就能制作这类视频，向大家展示我们产品的价值。
en: But now I can make these type of videos to communicate the value of our products with just prompting our agent.

source_text: I think it's an incredible unlock for me and for everyone here.
zh: 我觉得，这对我和在座的每一位来说，都是一次巨大的能力解锁。
en: I think it's an incredible unlock for me and for everyone here.

source_text: Because we built it for the AI builders.
zh: 因为我们是为 AI 开发者打造的。
en: Because we built it for the AI builders.

source_text: We built it for the builders who are, who have their story to tell, but don't know how to make a good video.
zh: 我们打造它，是为了帮助那些有故事想讲、却不知道如何制作好视频的创作者。
en: We built it for the builders who are, who have their story to tell, but don't know how to make a good video.

source_text: Um, but like I said, when we first started, just four months or six months ago, people think the videos that we make are slop. They were.
zh: 不过，就像我说的，四五个月前我们刚起步时，大家觉得我们做的视频是粗制滥造的。确实如此。
en: Um, but like I said, when we first started, just four months or six months ago, people think the videos that we make are slop. They were.

source_text: And, uh, they still are.
zh: 呃，现在也还是这样。
en: And, uh, they still are.

source_text: Today.
zh: 今天。
en: Today.

source_text: They still kind of do today.
zh: 直到今天，大家多少还是这么觉得。
en: They still kind of do today.

source_text: Um, but the models get better over time.
zh: 嗯，不过模型会随着时间不断进步。
en: Um, but the models get better over time.

source_text: And every single time the model gets better, our product gets better.
zh: 每次模型进步，我们的产品也会随之变得更好。
en: And every single time the model gets better, our product gets better.

source_text: Sorry.
zh: 抱歉。
en: Sorry.

source_text: And as of today, we have about 80,000 GitHub stars.
zh: 截至今天，我们在 GitHub 上已经收获了大约 8 万颗星。
en: And as of today, we have about 80,000 GitHub stars.

source_text: We are a globally number two installed skills and, uh, I actually think that we are hitting 700,000, uh, videos a day.
zh: 我们的技能包安装量位居全球第二，而且我觉得我们现在每天生成的视频已经达到 70 万条。
en: We are a globally number two installed skills and, uh, I actually think that we are hitting 700,000, uh, videos a day.

source_text: I think a week ago it was 500.
zh: 我记得一周前还是 500 颗星。
en: I think a week ago it was 500.

source_text: And, yeah, the top star, yeah. Anyways.
zh: 对，星标数也名列前茅。总之……
en: And, yeah, the top star, yeah. Anyways.

source_text: So, but this talk is not just about convincing you that Hyperframes is a great product.
zh: 不过，今天这场分享不只是为了说服大家 Hyperframes 是一款出色的产品。
en: So, but this talk is not just about convincing you that Hyperframes is a great product.

source_text: It is.
zh: 它确实很出色。
en: It is.

source_text: You guys should be using our tools.
zh: 大家都应该用用我们的工具。
en: You guys should be using our tools.

source_text: Um, but it's more about how we landed on building Hyperframes and the agentic system on top of it.
zh: 不过，今天更想讲的是，我们为什么决定打造 Hyperframes，以及如何在它的基础上构建智能体系统。
en: Um, but it's more about how we landed on building Hyperframes and the agentic system on top of it.

source_text: It's that we believe that agents are incredibly good at coding.
zh: 因为我们相信，智能体非常擅长写代码。
en: It's that we believe that agents are incredibly good at coding.

source_text: It might be good at many other things too, but just think about coding alone.
zh: 它们可能还擅长很多别的事，但我们先只看写代码这一项。
en: It might be good at many other things too, but just think about coding alone.

source_text: Many companies, including the Frontier Labs, they are replacing documents with HTMLs.
zh: 包括前沿实验室在内的许多公司，正在用 HTML 页面取代传统文档。
en: Many companies, including the Frontier Labs, they are replacing documents with HTMLs.

source_text: Many of the Claude artifacts or, uh,
zh: 比如 Claude 生成的很多作品，呃……
en: Many of the Claude artifacts or, uh,

source_text: GPT outputs are actually code.
zh: GPT 输出的实际上是代码。
en: GPT outputs are actually code.

source_text: Um, design.
zh: 呃，设计。
en: Um, design.

source_text: One of my favorite tools, AI tools, is called Paper, and there's a few others.
zh: 我最喜欢的一款 AI 工具叫 Paper，此外还有几款类似的工具。
en: One of my favorite tools, AI tools, is called Paper, and there's a few others.

source_text: They've built an entire Figma, but on top of HTML.
zh: 他们基于 HTML 打造了一整套类似 Figma 的设计工具。
en: They've built an entire Figma, but on top of HTML.

source_text: Because, again, for the same reasons,
zh: 因为，还是出于同样的原因，
en: Because, again, for the same reasons,

source_text: agents are really good at writing code. And it knows what a good-looking code looks like.
zh: 智能体非常擅长写代码，也知道什么样的代码写得漂亮。
en: agents are really good at writing code. And it knows what a good-looking code looks like.

source_text: And knows how to write it.
zh: 也知道该怎么写。
en: And knows how to write it.

source_text: Going back to my Shakespeare, uh,
zh: 再回到我刚才说的莎士比亚，呃……
en: Going back to my Shakespeare, uh,

source_text: analogy, when Shakespeare is writing the play,
zh: 打个比方，莎士比亚在写剧本时，
en: analogy, when Shakespeare is writing the play,

source_text: it already knows that it's a good play.
zh: 他已经知道这会是一部好剧。
en: it already knows that it's a good play.

source_text: It doesn't need to write the play and then read it and be like, "Oh, I guess it does do that." But anyways, you get my point.
zh: 他不需要先把剧本写出来，再读一遍，然后说：“哦，好像还真得这么做。”不过，你明白我的意思。
en: It doesn't need to write the play and then read it and be like, "Oh, I guess it does do that." But anyways, you get my point.

source_text: Slides.
zh: 幻灯片。
en: Slides.

source_text: This whole slide that you guys just saw, completely HTML.
zh: 你们刚才看到的这一整页幻灯片，完全是用 HTML 做的。
en: This whole slide that you guys just saw, completely HTML.

source_text: And many companies, Manus, Jenspark, ChatGPT, them, they all are building slides using HTML.
zh: 很多公司和产品，比如 Manus、Genspark、ChatGPT，都在用 HTML 制作幻灯片。
en: And many companies, Manus, Jenspark, ChatGPT, them, they all are building slides using HTML.

source_text: Um, and this is more of an extension, but gaming,
zh: 嗯，再延伸一点，还有游戏。
en: Um, and this is more of an extension, but gaming,

source_text: games used to be built on, uh, Unity, Unreal,
zh: 过去，游戏一般是用 Unity、虚幻引擎开发的。
en: games used to be built on, uh, Unity, Unreal,

source_text: all of these, like, very heavy engines.
zh: 这些引擎都很庞大，开发起来也很繁重。
en: all of these, like, very heavy engines.

en: But these days, many people are building games just by building 3JS,

en: JavaScript, uh, and on top of HTML.

en: So I know when I said I want to convince you that HTML is all your agents need.

zh: 呃，但我确实认为，应该想想模型……
en: Uh, but I do believe that thinking about what the model.

source_text: Are going to keep,
zh: 将会继续……

zh: 呃，你真正需要问自己的是：模型在哪些方面会不断进步？
en: uh, going to keep getting better and better at is the question that you really need to be asking yourself.

zh: 你的产品会乘着这股浪潮前进，还是与之对抗？
en: And will your product be writing that wave, or will you be fighting it?

zh: 你知道，
en: You know,

zh: Hyperframes 在过去差不多四周里实现了增长。
en: Hyperframes saw the growth for the past, like, four, uh, you know, four weeks.

source_text: We even if the team didn't do anything for the last four weeks, we will still grow.
zh: 即使团队过去四周什么都没做，我们照样会增长。
en: We even if the team didn't do anything for the last four weeks, we will still grow.

en: Because our product just got better as the models got better.

source_text: So a very popular question in the Silicon Valley these days is, when models get 10x better, does your product get better, or does it get destroyed?
zh: 所以，如今硅谷有个很热门的问题：当模型的能力提升十倍时，你的产品会变得更好，还是会被淘汰？
en: So a very popular question in the Silicon Valley these days is, when models get 10x better, does your product get better, or does it get destroyed?

zh: 我认为，答案取决于你为模型提供的上下文是如何组织的。
en: And I think that the answer to that question lies in the shape of your context.

en: And that's.

en: Our team, uh, Wenbo Miao, uh, and myself, uh, will be in the, uh,

source_text: Uh, now let's welcome, um, 杨颖老
zh: 呃，下面让我们欢迎杨颖老师。
en: Uh, now let's welcome, um, 杨颖老

source_text: 师，江湖人称屠龙的胭脂锦。
zh: 师，江湖人称屠龙的胭脂锦。
en: ...known in the industry as the dragon-slaying Yanzhi Jin.

source_text: 啊，全网拥有超过340万的粉丝，她会用她美妆产业的创业经验给大家讲解AI应用的壁垒在哪里。
zh: 啊，全网拥有超过340万的粉丝，她会用她美妆产业的创业经验给大家讲解AI应用的壁垒在哪里。
en: She has over 3.4 million followers across social media, and she’ll draw on her experience building a business in the beauty industry to explain the barriers to using AI.

source_text: 欢迎杨颖老师。
zh: 欢迎杨颖老师。
en: Please welcome Yang Ying.

source_text: 听说我是一个就是科学家，搞过算法，也搞自媒体，然后我也做过这个零售行业。
zh: 听说我是一个就是科学家，搞过算法，也搞自媒体，然后我也做过这个零售行业。
en: I’ve been told I’m a bit of a scientist. I’ve worked on algorithms and created content online, and I’ve also worked in retail.

source_text: 那么我觉得，
zh: 那么我觉得，
en: So I think…

source_text: 所有的AI工程师和所有的AI的投资人， 其实现在都面临3个非常终极的天问，我觉得是一个3个非常终极的严肃的问题。
zh: 所有的AI工程师和所有的AI的投资人， 其实现在都面临3个非常终极的天问，我觉得是一个3个非常终极的严肃的问题。
en: All AI engineers and investors are facing three fundamental questions right now—three very serious questions.

source_text: 第一个问题是AGI模型太贵了，估值太贵了，一般人已经进不去了。
zh: 第一个问题是AGI模型太贵了，估值太贵了，一般人已经进不去了。
en: The first is that AGI models cost too much, and valuations are too high. Ordinary people can’t get into the field anymore.

source_text: 那如果我们进不了AGI模型，怎么办？
zh: 那如果我们进不了AGI模型，怎么办？
en: So if we can’t get into building AGI models, what do we do?

source_text: 对吧？
zh: 对吧？
en: Right?

source_text: 这是一个。
zh: 这是一个。
en: That’s the first question.

source_text: 那好，就是说我们如果是投资这个，投资这个垂直模型，那垂直领域，
zh: 那好，就是说我们如果是投资这个，投资这个垂直模型，那垂直领域，
en: Okay, so what if we invest in vertical models for specific industries…

source_text: 哪些垂直领域会被AGI吞没？
zh: 哪些垂直领域会被AGI吞没？
en: Which verticals will be swallowed up by AGI?

source_text: 这是一个很重要的问题。
zh: 这是一个很重要的问题。
en: That’s a very important question.

source_text: 就是我每次去跟人谈，我要做垂直AI的时候，他们都会说AGI会吞没一切垂直AI。
zh: 就是我每次去跟人谈，我要做垂直AI的时候，他们都会说AGI会吞没一切垂直AI。
en: Every time I tell people I want to build a vertical AI company, they say AGI will swallow up every vertical AI application.

source_text: 那是一切垂直，是一切的这个垂直AI都会被AGI吞没吗？
zh: 那是一切垂直，是一切的这个垂直AI都会被AGI吞没吗？
en: Or will AGI swallow up every vertical AI application?

source_text: 第三个就是。
zh: 第三个就是。
en: And the third question is…

source_text: AI。
zh: AI。
en: AI.

source_text: 到底怎么在实体产业盈利？
zh: 到底怎么在实体产业盈利？
