source_text: I'm Leonie.
zh: 我叫莱奥妮。
en: I'm Leonie.

source_text: I work on the post-training team at Liquid AI.
zh: 我在 Liquid AI 的后训练团队工作。
en: I work on the post-training team at Liquid AI.

source_text: And at Liquid, we build efficient models for the edge.
zh: 在 Liquid AI，我们开发能够在边缘设备上高效运行的模型。
en: And at Liquid, we build efficient models for the edge.

source_text: So initially, my talk was going to be about how we're building open models for on-device agents.
zh: 我原本打算讲讲我们是如何为端侧智能体开发开放模型的。
en: So initially, my talk was going to be about how we're building open models for on-device agents.

source_text: But then this happened, raise your hand if you've heard of GEV or decision models. Yes, quite a few. Awesome.
zh: 但后来出现了这个。听说过 GEV 或决策模型的请举手。嗯，还真不少。太好了。
en: But then this happened, raise your hand if you've heard of GEV or decision models. Yes, quite a few. Awesome.

source_text: If you haven't, in mid-September, Typesafe AI released GEV. And GEV is a new type of frontier model.
zh: 如果还没听说过，简单介绍一下：今年九月中旬，Typesafe AI 发布了 GEV。GEV 是一种新型的前沿模型。
en: If you haven't, in mid-September, Typesafe AI released GEV. And GEV is a new type of frontier model.

source_text: Typesafe calls them system one models.
zh: Typesafe 称之为“系统一模型”。
en: Typesafe calls them system one models.

source_text: Everyone else in the industry currently calls them decision models.
zh: 目前业内其他人都称之为“决策模型”。
en: Everyone else in the industry currently calls them decision models.

source_text: Now, why is everyone so excited about them?
zh: 那么，为什么大家都对这类模型如此兴奋呢？
en: Now, why is everyone so excited about them?

source_text: So if you think about it, how we're using LLMs today in our modern software is not only for text generation or chat.
zh: 仔细想想，如今我们在软件中使用大语言模型，并不只是让它生成文本或进行聊天。
en: So if you think about it, how we're using LLMs today in our modern software is not only for text generation or chat.

source_text: It's also to make a lot of small decisions.
zh: 还会用它来做很多小决策。
en: It's also to make a lot of small decisions.

source_text: So in the form of tool calling, for example, you have the model generate structured outputs.
zh: 比如在工具调用中，我们会让模型生成结构化输出。
en: So in the form of tool calling, for example, you have the model generate structured outputs.

source_text: So it's generating tokens.
zh: 所以，它本质上还是在生成词元。
en: So it's generating tokens.

source_text: And that's expensive, takes time, and it can lead to mistakes.
zh: 但这样做成本高、耗时，还容易出错。
en: And that's expensive, takes time, and it can lead to mistakes.

source_text: A decision model does one pass and returns you a typed answer and a confidence score.
zh: 决策模型只需运行一次，就能返回一个带有类型信息的答案和一个置信度分数。
en: A decision model does one pass and returns you a typed answer and a confidence score.

source_text: So that makes the decisions fast,
zh: 这样一来，决策就更快了，
en: So that makes the decisions fast,

source_text: cheap, and somewhat reliable.
zh: 成本更低，也比较可靠。
en: cheap, and somewhat reliable.

source_text: So naturally, everyone then rushed to build their own decision models.
zh: 于是，大家自然而然地争相构建自己的决策模型。
en: So naturally, everyone then rushed to build their own decision models.

source_text: Including us.
zh: 我们也不例外。
en: Including us.

source_text: So in the last six or seven weeks, we've released a bunch of different decision models.
zh: 所以，在过去六七周里，我们发布了一系列不同的决策模型。
en: So in the last six or seven weeks, we've released a bunch of different decision models.

source_text: Um, so we have very powerful API-hosted ones, and we have smaller, uh, open ones for edge devices.
zh: 嗯，我们既有通过 API 提供的高性能模型，也有适用于边缘设备、体量更小的开放模型。
en: Um, so we have very powerful API-hosted ones, and we have smaller, uh, open ones for edge devices.

source_text: So last time I checked this morning, our D1 Ultra model is leading the decision index, the artificial intelligence decision index.
zh: 我今天早上查看时，我们的 D1 Ultra 模型在人工智能决策指数榜单上位居榜首。
en: So last time I checked this morning, our D1 Ultra model is leading the decision index, the artificial intelligence decision index.

source_text: And it's very competitive with GEV. So that's why I decided to change my talk to this.
zh: 而且它与 GEV 相比也很有竞争力。所以我决定把这次演讲改为介绍它。
en: And it's very competitive with GEV. So that's why I decided to change my talk to this.

source_text: Now,
zh: 那么，
en: Now,

source_text: is it a good idea to change your talk the week before to something completely new and that could be outdated anytime?
zh: 在演讲前一周，临时把主题换成一个全新的、而且随时可能过时的话题，真的是个好主意吗？
en: is it a good idea to change your talk the week before to something completely new and that could be outdated anytime?

source_text: Well,
zh: 嗯，
en: Well,

source_text: let's ask a decision model.
zh: 让我们问问决策模型吧。
en: let's ask a decision model.

source_text: So here's how a decision model works.
zh: 那么，决策模型是这样工作的。
en: So here's how a decision model works.

source_text: You give it a state, in this case.
zh: 你给它输入一个当前状态，比如这里的情况。
en: You give it a state, in this case.

source_text: I'm saying I'm giving a talk in a week.
zh: 我一周后要做一场演讲。
en: I'm saying I'm giving a talk in a week.

source_text: Uh, I'm thinking about changing the topic to something completely new that's changing every day.
zh: 呃，我在考虑把演讲主题换成一个全新的、而且每天都在变化的内容。
en: Uh, I'm thinking about changing the topic to something completely new that's changing every day.

source_text: Uh,
zh: 呃，
en: Uh,

source_text: and I give it a question about this state.
zh: 然后，我会针对这个情况向它提一个问题。
en: and I give it a question about this state.

source_text: So is this a good idea?
zh: 那么，这样做是个好主意吗？
en: So is this a good idea?

source_text: And then the model does a forward pass, uh, and returns a typed answer.
zh: 然后，模型进行一次前向计算，呃，返回一个特定类型的答案。
en: And then the model does a forward pass, uh, and returns a typed answer.

source_text: In this case,
zh: 在这种情况下，
en: In this case,

source_text: it was very sure that this is a very bad idea.
zh: 它非常确定这绝对不是个好主意。
en: it was very sure that this is a very bad idea.

source_text: Um,
zh: 嗯，
en: Um,

source_text: this is just one way to interact with a decision model.
zh: 这只是与决策模型交互的一种方式。
en: this is just one way to interact with a decision model.

source_text: These are called primitives.
zh: 这些叫作基本操作。
en: These are called primitives.

source_text: Uh, this one is, um, called a null.
zh: 呃，这个叫作“空值”（null）。
en: Uh, this one is, um, called a null.

source_text: So it's a yes or no question.
zh: 所以这是一个是非题。
en: So it's a yes or no question.

source_text: But there's also something called score.
zh: 但还有一种叫作“评分”（score）的基本操作。
en: But there's also something called score.

source_text: So I can ask it, uh, on a scale from 1 to 5, how good of an idea is this?
zh: 所以我可以问它：从 1 到 5 分来看，这个主意有多好？
en: So I can ask it, uh, on a scale from 1 to 5, how good of an idea is this?

source_text: In this case, it said 1, very bad.
zh: 这次它给了 1 分，意思是非常糟糕。
en: In this case, it said 1, very bad.

source_text: Uh, then there's also choice.
zh: 呃，还有一种叫作“选择”（choice）的基本操作。
en: Uh, then there's also choice.

source_text: So I can give it different options.
zh: 所以我可以给它不同的选项。
en: So I can give it different options.

source_text: So I can say, should I stay with my original topic?
zh: 所以我可以问：“我应该继续用原来的主题吗？”
en: So I can say, should I stay with my original topic?

source_text: Should I,
zh: 我应该……吗？
en: Should I,

source_text: uh, change to the new topic?
zh: 呃，改用新主题吗？
en: uh, change to the new topic?

source_text: Should I do something completely different?
zh: 还是应该做点完全不同的事？
en: Should I do something completely different?

source_text: And notice how here the model's also returning me a confidence score.
zh: 注意，这里模型还返回了一个置信度分数。
en: And notice how here the model's also returning me a confidence score.

source_text: And this confidence score is what makes these models so useful because decision models can be wrong, but they will tell you when they're unsure.
zh: 而这种置信度分数正是这些模型如此有用的原因：决策模型可能会出错，但它们会告诉你自己什么时候没有把握。
en: And this confidence score is what makes these models so useful because decision models can be wrong, but they will tell you when they're unsure.

source_text: So you get to decide where you want to put that threshold.
zh: 所以你可以自行决定把置信度阈值设在哪里。
en: So you get to decide where you want to put that threshold.

source_text: So you can say, for example,
zh: 所以你可以说，比如：
en: So you can say, for example,

source_text: if the model is 90% confident, then just run with it. And otherwise, ask a human for the input.
zh: 如果模型有九成把握，就直接采用它的结果；否则，就请人来判断。
en: if the model is 90% confident, then just run with it. And otherwise, ask a human for the input.

source_text: So.
zh: 所以。
en: So.

source_text: This is super useful for agent use cases, right?
zh: 这对智能体的应用场景特别有用，对吧？
en: This is super useful for agent use cases, right?

source_text: So obviously, everyone's super excited about these models.
zh: 所以，显然大家都对这些模型感到非常兴奋。
en: So obviously, everyone's super excited about these models.

source_text: How do we actually build these?
zh: 我们究竟该怎么构建这些模型呢？
en: How do we actually build these?

source_text: So unfortunately, we can't really copy GEV because all we know about GEV is from their release blog, and there they say something like, it's a new model architecture.
zh: 不过遗憾的是，我们没法直接照搬 GEV，因为我们对它的了解都来自发布博客，而博客里只说了类似“这是一种新的模型架构”这样的话。
en: So unfortunately, we can't really copy GEV because all we know about GEV is from their release blog, and there they say something like, it's a new model architecture.

source_text: They're using something called reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions. And to be honest, we have no idea what any of that means.
zh: 他们用的是一种叫作“面向校准决策的强化学习”的方法。说实话，这到底是什么意思，我们也完全搞不懂。
en: They're using something called reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions. And to be honest, we have no idea what any of that means.

source_text: Uh,
zh: 呃，
en: Uh,

source_text: but this is not criticism, right?
zh: 但这不是在批评他们，对吧？
en: but this is not criticism, right?

source_text: Credit where credit is due.
zh: 该肯定的还是得肯定。
en: Credit where credit is due.

source_text: We have to give a huge shout-out to the Typesafe AI team.
zh: 我们得好好感谢一下 Typesafe AI 团队。
en: We have to give a huge shout-out to the Typesafe AI team.

source_text: For making an entire industry rethink how we should be building these models to achieve true automation.
zh: 是他们让整个行业重新思考：要实现真正的自动化，我们究竟该如何构建这些模型。
en: For making an entire industry rethink how we should be building these models to achieve true automation.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: GEV gives us a target, but not the recipe. That's fine.
zh: GEV 为我们指明了目标，却没有告诉我们具体怎么做。没关系。
en: GEV gives us a target, but not the recipe. That's fine.

source_text: This is where the open ecosystem is coming in.
zh: 这正是开放生态系统发挥作用的地方。
en: This is where the open ecosystem is coming in.

source_text: So the rest of this talk could also be titled How the Open Ecosystem is Reverse Engineering GEV.
zh: 所以，接下来的演讲也可以叫作《开放生态系统如何逆向解析 GEV》。
en: So the rest of this talk could also be titled How the Open Ecosystem is Reverse Engineering GEV.

source_text: Uh,
zh: 呃，
en: Uh,

source_text: I'm going to be focusing on how we at Liquid build our decision models, but you'll see some of these points reflected in the Open Ecosystem as well.
zh: 接下来我会重点介绍 Liquid 是如何构建决策模型的，不过你也会看到，其中一些思路同样体现在开放生态系统中。
en: I'm going to be focusing on how we at Liquid build our decision models, but you'll see some of these points reflected in the Open Ecosystem as well.

source_text: Now,
zh: 那么，
en: Now,

source_text: Typesafe has spent two years in stealth building GEV.
zh: Typesafe 花了两年时间秘密研发 GEV。
en: Typesafe has spent two years in stealth building GEV.

source_text: And then after the release, it took less than a week for a copy to appear.
zh: 而发布之后，不到一周就出现了一个复刻版。
en: And then after the release, it took less than a week for a copy to appear.

source_text: Turns out all you need to make a decision model is any LLM and about this many lines of code. Don't read the code.
zh: 事实证明，构建决策模型只需要任意一个大语言模型，再加上这么几行代码就够了。不用细看代码。
en: Turns out all you need to make a decision model is any LLM and about this many lines of code. Don't read the code.

source_text: Just look at how few lines of code that is.
zh: 看看，代码就这么几行。
en: Just look at how few lines of code that is.

source_text: So this is called an inference-only technique.
zh: 所以，这叫作纯推理技术。
en: So this is called an inference-only technique.

source_text: And the idea is that you can use any LLM,
zh: 它的核心思路是，你可以使用任何大语言模型，
en: And the idea is that you can use any LLM,

source_text: in our case since we're optimizing for on-device, we're using our LFM3 family, and then you prompt the model in a very specific way.
zh: 我们这里针对端侧运行做了优化，所以使用的是自家的 LFM3 系列模型，然后以一种非常特定的方式向模型提问。
en: in our case since we're optimizing for on-device, we're using our LFM3 family, and then you prompt the model in a very specific way.

source_text: So here you can see we give it the state, then the question,
zh: 这里可以看到，我们先向模型提供当前状态，然后提出问题，
en: So here you can see we give it the state, then the question,

source_text: and then for each option, we attach an option-level token. So A, B, and C.
zh: 接着，我们给每个选项都加上一个对应的标记，也就是 A、B 和 C。
en: and then for each option, we attach an option-level token. So A, B, and C.

source_text: And then we tell the model to only answer with the option-level token.
zh: 然后，我们要求模型只回答对应选项的标记。
en: And then we tell the model to only answer with the option-level token.

source_text: The rest of this code is easier to understand if we look at it like this.
zh: 这样来看，剩下的代码就更容易理解了。
en: The rest of this code is easier to understand if we look at it like this.

source_text: So we do one forward pass, and then we're only looking at the logits of the last position because we're only interested in the next token.
zh: 所以，我们只做一次前向计算，然后只看最后一个位置的 logits，因为我们只关心下一个 token。
en: So we do one forward pass, and then we're only looking at the logits of the last position because we're only interested in the next token.

source_text: And then we're only looking at the tokens of the possible option, option codes.
zh: 然后，我们只关注各个选项代码对应的 token。
en: And then we're only looking at the tokens of the possible option, option codes.

source_text: So A, B, and C in this case.
zh: 这里就是 A、B 和 C。
en: So A, B, and C in this case.

source_text: Then we do softmax over it, and boom, we have a decision model.
zh: 接着对这些值做 Softmax 归一化，好了，一个决策模型就有了。
en: Then we do softmax over it, and boom, we have a decision model.

source_text: This.
zh: 就是这个。
en: This.

source_text: This actually works, but it's clearly a naive approach.
zh: 这种方法确实有效，但显然比较粗糙。
en: This actually works, but it's clearly a naive approach.

source_text: It's a good baseline to beat, but clearly, as you can guess, this comes with a lot of problems.
zh: 它是个不错的基准，但显然，正如你能想到的，这种方法也存在很多问题。
en: It's a good baseline to beat, but clearly, as you can guess, this comes with a lot of problems.

source_text: So problem number one,
zh: 那么，第一个问题是，
en: So problem number one,

source_text: as all of you know,
zh: 大家都知道，
en: as all of you know,

source_text: LLMs are trained to predict the next token, not really to make decisions.
zh: 大语言模型训练的目标是预测下一个 token，而不是真正做决策。
en: LLMs are trained to predict the next token, not really to make decisions.

source_text: So that means different.
zh: 所以这意味着不同。
en: So that means different.

source_text: Problems.
zh: 问题。
en: Problems.

source_text: For example, this one.
zh: 比如这个。
en: For example, this one.

source_text: When I change the order of the options in this case, the model returns me a different answer every time. Well, this is bad.
zh: 在这种情况下，只要我调整选项的顺序，模型每次给出的答案就会不一样。这显然是个问题。
en: When I change the order of the options in this case, the model returns me a different answer every time. Well, this is bad.

source_text: Clearly, here in this example, the model is biased towards the letter B, so we need to train the model to actually make decisions. So how does that work?
zh: 很明显，在这个例子中，模型偏向于选择 B，所以我们需要训练它，让它真正学会做决策。那么具体该怎么做呢？
en: Clearly, here in this example, the model is biased towards the letter B, so we need to train the model to actually make decisions. So how does that work?

source_text: We take a bunch of different classification tasks, and we convert them into the prompt template that I just showed you earlier.
zh: 我们选取一系列不同的分类任务，把它们转换成我刚才展示的提示词模板。
en: We take a bunch of different classification tasks, and we convert them into the prompt template that I just showed you earlier.

source_text: And then we do SFT over it.
zh: 然后，我们用这些数据进行监督微调。
en: And then we do SFT over it.

source_text: Some teams do full fine-tuning.
zh: 有些团队会进行全参数微调。
en: Some teams do full fine-tuning.

source_text: Some teams do, uh, LoRA.
zh: 有些团队则会使用 LoRA 微调。
en: Some teams do, uh, LoRA.

source_text: In our case, we found that LoRA was more effective than full fine-tuning, and it's also cheaper.
zh: 在我们的实验中，我们发现 LoRA 比全参数微调效果更好，而且成本也更低。
en: In our case, we found that LoRA was more effective than full fine-tuning, and it's also cheaper.

source_text: So we train the model over these classification tasks into a general-purpose classifier.
zh: 所以，我们用这些分类任务来训练模型，把它培养成一个通用分类器。
en: So we train the model over these classification tasks into a general-purpose classifier.

source_text: So speaking of general-purpose classifiers, now is a decision model more like a classifier or more like an LLM for structured outputs?
zh: 说到通用分类器，决策模型究竟更像分类器，还是更像能生成结构化输出的大语言模型呢？
en: So speaking of general-purpose classifiers, now is a decision model more like a classifier or more like an LLM for structured outputs?

source_text: This is actually where the Open Ecosystem kind of split into two.
zh: 实际上，开源生态在这一点上逐渐分化成了两条路线。
en: This is actually where the Open Ecosystem kind of split into two.

source_text: So we have encoder-based approaches, and we have decoder-based approaches.
zh: 所以，我们有基于编码器的方法，也有基于解码器的方法。
en: So we have encoder-based approaches, and we have decoder-based approaches.

source_text: Luckily, at Liquid, we have both.
zh: 幸运的是，在 Liquid，我们两种方案都有。
en: Luckily, at Liquid, we have both.

source_text: So in our first release,
zh: 所以在我们发布的第一个版本中，
en: So in our first release,

source_text: uh, we decided to do both an encoder-based approach and a decoder-based approach.
zh: 呃，我们决定同时采用基于编码器和基于解码器的方案。
en: uh, we decided to do both an encoder-based approach and a decoder-based approach.

source_text: Last week, we released our newest generation of decision models, and for this, we decided to take the best of both worlds and combine it.
zh: 上周，我们发布了新一代决策模型。这一次，我们决定融合两种方案各自的优势。
en: Last week, we released our newest generation of decision models, and for this, we decided to take the best of both worlds and combine it.

source_text: So what does that mean?
zh: 那这意味着什么呢？
en: So what does that mean?

source_text: We now take a decoder-based approach, and then we lift the causal mask.
zh: 现在我们采用基于解码器的方案，然后去掉因果注意力掩码。
en: We now take a decoder-based approach, and then we lift the causal mask.

source_text: Because if you think about it, an LLM that's trained to predict the next token is only supposed to look at all the past tokens,
zh: 因为仔细想想，训练来预测下一个词元的大语言模型，本来只能看到之前的所有词元，
en: Because if you think about it, an LLM that's trained to predict the next token is only supposed to look at all the past tokens,

source_text: but not at any future tokens.
zh: 而不能看到后面的任何词元。
en: but not at any future tokens.

source_text: So that way, that's why it has a causal mask.
zh: 所以，它才需要因果注意力掩码。
en: So that way, that's why it has a causal mask.

source_text: For a decision model, that doesn't make much sense.
zh: 但对决策模型来说，这就不太合理了。
en: For a decision model, that doesn't make much sense.

source_text: Why shouldn't the decision model not be allowed to look at all of the tokens?
zh: 为什么决策模型不能查看所有词元呢？
en: Why shouldn't the decision model not be allowed to look at all of the tokens?

source_text: So we lift the causal mask and give it bidirectional attention so it can look at all of the tokens, kind of in an encoder, right?
zh: 所以我们去掉因果注意力掩码，让模型具备双向注意力，能够像编码器一样查看所有词元，对吧？
en: So we lift the causal mask and give it bidirectional attention so it can look at all of the tokens, kind of in an encoder, right?

source_text: Now, we have a model that's trained to make predict, uh, make decisions.
zh: 现在，我们有了一个经过训练、能够做出决策的模型。
en: Now, we have a model that's trained to make predict, uh, make decisions.

source_text: There's another problem.
zh: 还有一个问题。
en: There's another problem.

source_text: Right after training, these models are overconfident.
zh: 刚训练完时，这些模型往往过于自信。
en: Right after training, these models are overconfident.

source_text: That means a model can say, I'm 90% confident, but can be right only 70% of the time.
zh: 这意味着，模型可能声称自己有 90% 的把握，实际却只有 70% 的正确率。
en: That means a model can say, I'm 90% confident, but can be right only 70% of the time.

source_text: And remember, earlier I said the confidence score is actually what makes these models so useful.
zh: 还记得吗？我之前说过，置信度分数正是这些模型如此实用的关键。
en: And remember, earlier I said the confidence score is actually what makes these models so useful.

source_text: So when a model says it's 90% confident, it should only be wrong 1 out of 10 times. So how do we calibrate these confidence scores?
zh: 所以，当模型说自己有 90% 的把握时，出错的概率就应该只有十分之一。那么，我们该如何校准这些置信度分数呢？
en: So when a model says it's 90% confident, it should only be wrong 1 out of 10 times. So how do we calibrate these confidence scores?

source_text: So apparently, Typesafe uses something called reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions.
zh: 显然，Typesafe 使用了一种叫作强化学习的方法来校准决策的置信度。
en: So apparently, Typesafe uses something called reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions.

source_text: But it turns out we actually don't need any reinforcement learning at all.
zh: 但事实证明，我们根本不需要强化学习。
en: But it turns out we actually don't need any reinforcement learning at all.

source_text: So at the moment, what a lot of teams are doing in the Open Ecosystem is called temperature scaling.
zh: 目前，开放生态中的许多团队采用的是一种叫作“温度缩放”的方法。
en: So at the moment, what a lot of teams are doing in the Open Ecosystem is called temperature scaling.

source_text: Uh, and if you think about the temperature parameter, maybe you're thinking about the parameter that's used to kind of tune the creativity of your LLM outputs.
zh: 呃，说到温度参数，你可能会想到那个用来调节大语言模型输出创造性的参数。
en: Uh, and if you think about the temperature parameter, maybe you're thinking about the parameter that's used to kind of tune the creativity of your LLM outputs.

source_text: But what you may not know is that it's also useful to kind of shape the distribution of, over your tokens.
zh: 但你可能不知道，它还可以用来调整各个 token 的概率分布。
en: But what you may not know is that it's also useful to kind of shape the distribution of, over your tokens.

source_text: So if you increase the, the temperature parameter, you can kind of flatten out the distribution.
zh: 所以，如果调高温度参数，就可以让概率分布变得更平坦。
en: So if you increase the, the temperature parameter, you can kind of flatten out the distribution.

source_text: And if you decrease it,
zh: 如果把它调低，
en: And if you decrease it,

source_text: you can kind of sharpen it.
zh: 就可以让概率分布更加集中。
en: you can kind of sharpen it.

source_text: And that allows us to calibrate the confidence scores without actually touching the order of the tokens.
zh: 这样一来，我们就能校准置信度分数，而无需改变各个 token 的排序。
en: And that allows us to calibrate the confidence scores without actually touching the order of the tokens.

zh: 所以，这个……
en: So this.

en: But if you choose to have, uh, rather decentralized ecosystem, then you need to figure out a way.

zh: 我们需要一种机制、一个连接层，把这些彼此孤立或分散的节点连接起来。
en: We need to have a way, a layer to allow those isolated or decentralized dots to be connected.

source_text: And in a fair way to communicate with each other and build commerce.
zh: 让它们能够公平地相互沟通，并开展商业活动。
en: And in a fair way to communicate with each other and build commerce.

source_text: At least this is how human being has been, uh, we build the entire human civilization on commerce.
zh: 至少，人类一直是这样：我们在商业活动的基础上建立了整个人类文明。
en: At least this is how human being has been, uh, we build the entire human civilization on commerce.

source_text: Each individual is sovereign.
zh: 每个个体都拥有自主权。
en: Each individual is sovereign.

source_text: And we use language to communicate with each other.
zh: 我们通过语言相互交流。
en: And we use language to communicate with each other.

source_text: We developed all kinds of, uh,
zh: 我们发展出了各种各样的……
en: We developed all kinds of, uh,

source_text: mid-layer, all kinds of, uh,
zh: 中间层，以及各种各样的……
en: mid-layer, all kinds of, uh,

source_text: marketplace to exchange stuff.
zh: 用来交换物品的市场。
en: marketplace to exchange stuff.

source_text: So that's what we think we are coming to the next phase of agentic era.
zh: 所以我们认为，智能体时代即将进入下一个阶段。
en: So that's what we think we are coming to the next phase of agentic era.

source_text: The first part we call it agent is a new web.
zh: 首先，我们认为智能体就是新一代互联网。
en: The first part we call it agent is a new web.

source_text: It's not app.
zh: 它不是应用程序。
en: It's not app.

source_text: It's new web because web is permissionless.
zh: 它是新一代互联网，因为互联网无需许可，人人都能参与。
en: It's new web because web is permissionless.

source_text: It's open. Right?
zh: 它是开放的，对吧？
en: It's open. Right?

source_text: That's how we like OpenClaw and other harnesses open up to developers.
zh: 所以我们希望像 OpenClaw 这样的智能体框架向开发者开放。
en: That's how we like OpenClaw and other harnesses open up to developers.

source_text: If you can quickly adopt it as how you adopt it like HTML back then, then this is how we compare agent,
zh: 如果大家能像当年采用 HTML 那样迅速用上智能体，这就是我们看待智能体的方式。
en: If you can quickly adopt it as how you adopt it like HTML back then, then this is how we compare agent,

source_text: uh, webs.
zh: 呃，互联网。
en: uh, webs.

source_text: And the next step will be the network is the AI. Anybody heard about the name of the network is a computer?
zh: 下一步，网络本身就是 AI。大家听过“网络就是计算机”这句话吗？
en: And the next step will be the network is the AI. Anybody heard about the name of the network is a computer?

source_text: Not many.
zh: 看来听过的人不多。
en: Not many.

source_text: That was, uh, TCP/IP. Right?
zh: 那说的是，呃，TCP/IP 协议，对吧？
en: That was, uh, TCP/IP. Right?

source_text: Basically, it promises a future which is the current reality.
zh: 它描绘的未来，如今已成为现实。
en: Basically, it promises a future which is the current reality.

source_text: You do not need to own everything.
zh: 你不必拥有一切。
en: You do not need to own everything.

source_text: If you have a device in front of you, and if your device is connected to another people's device through this network,
zh: 如果你面前有一台设备，而且它能通过网络连接到别人的设备，
en: If you have a device in front of you, and if your device is connected to another people's device through this network,

source_text: you can visit the content from the other people's device rather than you own the storage, the compute on device.
zh: 你就能访问别人设备上的内容，而不必自己拥有存储空间或计算资源。
en: you can visit the content from the other people's device rather than you own the storage, the compute on device.

source_text: And that is how network works.
zh: 这就是网络的运作方式。
en: And that is how network works.

source_text: And we think in the future we could similarly do the same thing.
zh: 我们认为，未来也可以用类似的方式做到这一点。
en: And we think in the future we could similarly do the same thing.

source_text: That's how we call it the network is the AI.
zh: 所以我们说，网络就是 AI。
en: That's how we call it the network is the AI.

source_text: If you have your personal agent, if you have your service or brand agent,
zh: 如果你有自己的个人智能体，或者有代表你的服务或品牌的智能体，
en: If you have your personal agent, if you have your service or brand agent,

source_text: you have your fulfillment issue, boundary, scope of the capabilities that you can deliver to yourself or your customer.
zh: 那么，无论是满足自身需求，还是为客户提供服务，你都面临着交付能力的限制与边界。
en: you have your fulfillment issue, boundary, scope of the capabilities that you can deliver to yourself or your customer.

source_text: What if the intent or requirement from your customer falls out of the scope?
zh: 如果客户的意图或需求超出了你的能力范围，该怎么办？
en: What if the intent or requirement from your customer falls out of the scope?

source_text: Can you do some trade or exchange?
zh: 你能通过交易或交换来解决吗？
en: Can you do some trade or exchange?

source_text: That's the issue we think will create a whole new layer upon applications.
zh: 我们认为，这个问题将催生一个建立在应用之上的全新层级。
en: That's the issue we think will create a whole new layer upon applications.

source_text: That is to build marketplace, different kind of marketplace, not just one, not just one Google for all the discoverability of all the webs, but different type of, uh, exchange, trade places,
zh: 也就是说，要建立各种各样的交易市场，而不是只靠一个像谷歌那样的平台来检索整个网络；我们需要不同类型的交换和交易平台，
en: That is to build marketplace, different kind of marketplace, not just one, not just one Google for all the discoverability of all the webs, but different type of, uh, exchange, trade places,

source_text: marketplaces, except their users are agents.
zh: 这些交易市场的用户是智能体。
en: marketplaces, except their users are agents.

source_text: So this is a new interoperation layer that we think is can be built upon a free network.
zh: 所以我们认为，可以在开放网络之上构建这样一个全新的互操作层。
en: So this is a new interoperation layer that we think is can be built upon a free network.

source_text: If your company, if your big organization, there's governance layer and you can continue using different type of model, different type of harness,
zh: 如果你所在的是一家大公司或大型组织，就会有一套治理机制，让你可以继续使用不同类型的模型和智能体运行框架，
en: If your company, if your big organization, there's governance layer and you can continue using different type of model, different type of harness,

source_text: even allow your employees to use different coding agents as long as you can provide a way to allow them to access the permissions and the accessibilities. While keeping their sovereignty.
zh: 甚至可以允许员工使用不同的编程智能体，只要你能为它们提供获取必要权限和访问能力的途径，同时保留员工的自主权。
en: even allow your employees to use different coding agents as long as you can provide a way to allow them to access the permissions and the accessibilities. While keeping their sovereignty.

source_text: Keeping individuality, choosing their preferred setups.
zh: 保留各自的独特性，自由选择自己偏好的配置。
en: Keeping individuality, choosing their preferred setups.

source_text: And if it's cross organization, this is what we have done.
zh: 如果涉及跨组织协作，这正是我们已经实现的。
en: And if it's cross organization, this is what we have done.

source_text: Previously, but in a private way.
zh: 之前也做过，但采用的是私有方式。
en: Previously, but in a private way.

source_text: You can share what we call intent exchange.
zh: 你可以共享我们所说的“意图交换”。
en: You can share what we call intent exchange.

source_text: You can share the intent that you cannot fulfill.
zh: 你可以分享自己无法实现的意图。
en: You can share the intent that you cannot fulfill.

source_text: And you can probably broadcast to the other B2B partners you had already established the cooperation with, but not in the traditional B2B style, but in agent to agent style.
zh: 你还可以把这些意图广播给已经建立合作关系的其他企业伙伴，但不是通过传统的企业对企业方式，而是通过智能体之间的交互来实现。
en: And you can probably broadcast to the other B2B partners you had already established the cooperation with, but not in the traditional B2B style, but in agent to agent style.

source_text: And this is how we think B2B commerce, like procurement, sourcing, you need, you can do a lot of better,
zh: 我们认为，企业间的采购、寻源等商业活动，都可以通过这种方式做得更好。
en: And this is how we think B2B commerce, like procurement, sourcing, you need, you can do a lot of better,

source_text: um, procurement process.
zh: 嗯，采购流程。
en: um, procurement process.

source_text: That's, that's for example in this way.
zh: 比如说，可以这样做。
en: That's, that's for example in this way.

source_text: For individuals,
zh: 对个人而言，
en: For individuals,

source_text: you can probably connect each other be friends, let your personal agents be friends.
zh: 你们也可以互相建立联系、成为朋友，还可以让各自的个人智能体也成为朋友。
en: you can probably connect each other be friends, let your personal agents be friends.

source_text: And this is not something in the far future. This is today. This is, uh, what's already happening.
zh: 这并不是遥远未来才会发生的事，而是今天正在发生的事。
en: And this is not something in the far future. This is today. This is, uh, what's already happening.

source_text: So this is a future, I think, I encourage if you're agent builder, if you're one organization, if you are not builder, you are individual, but you own several personal agents,
zh: 我认为这就是未来。所以，无论你是智能体开发者、企业机构，还是拥有多个个人智能体的普通用户，我都鼓励你们参与进来。
en: So this is a future, I think, I encourage if you're agent builder, if you're one organization, if you are not builder, you are individual, but you own several personal agents,

source_text: and you can have a try.
zh: 不妨试一试。
en: and you can have a try.

source_text: We can probably start with, uh, my agent, for example.
zh: 比如，我们可以先从我的智能体开始。
en: We can probably start with, uh, my agent, for example.

source_text: If you use your personal agent, you can try to connect my personal agent.
zh: 如果你有自己的个人智能体，可以试着让它和我的个人智能体建立联系。
en: If you use your personal agent, you can try to connect my personal agent.

source_text: This is on GrabBot.
zh: 它就在 GrabBot 上。
en: This is on GrabBot.

source_text: If you use Claude Code, Codex,
zh: 如果你用的是 Claude Code 或 Codex，
en: If you use Claude Code, Codex,

source_text: Grab Instinct, for example, Muse and some other Hermes agent, you can connect with my agent.
zh: 比如 Grab Instinct、Muse，还有其他一些 Hermes 智能体，都可以连接我的智能体。
en: Grab Instinct, for example, Muse and some other Hermes agent, you can connect with my agent.

source_text: So probably when you guys are connected with each other, there will be a new growth of users that's building the foundation of a new layer of economy,
zh: 当大家的智能体彼此连接起来时，或许会带来新一轮用户增长，为新一层经济生态奠定基础。
en: So probably when you guys are connected with each other, there will be a new growth of users that's building the foundation of a new layer of economy,

source_text: not just human users, but all of our agents. Thank you, guys.
zh: 不仅是人类用户，也包括我们所有的智能体。谢谢大家。
en: not just human users, but all of our agents. Thank you, guys.

source_text: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.

source_text: Thank you very much for sharing this interesting perspective about agents, new agent economy. That's what we're looking for in the near future.
zh: 非常感谢你分享关于智能体和新兴智能体经济的精彩见解。这正是我们期待在不久的将来看到的。
en: Thank you very much for sharing this interesting perspective about agents, new agent economy. That's what we're looking for in the near future.

source_text: 啊，那今天我们稍微休息个10分钟，然后大家3点半回来，我们继续下午的分享。谢谢大家。
zh: 啊，那今天我们稍微休息个10分钟，然后大家3点半回来，我们继续下午的分享。谢谢大家。
en: Let’s take a 10-minute break and come back at 3:30 to continue this afternoon’s presentations. Thank you, everyone.

zh: 各位请就座。我们即将开始今天下午下半场的分享。
en: Everyone, please take your seat. We're going to start the sharing for the second half of this afternoon.

en: Okay, for the next sharing, we're going to invite David Cho.

source_text: From Quant Sparkle AI to share a very interesting method that from quantum computing that could teach how, um, robotics to make real-world decisions better.
zh: 他来自 Quant Sparkle AI，将分享一种源自量子计算的有趣方法，帮助机器人在现实世界中做出更好的决策。
en: From Quant Sparkle AI to share a very interesting method that from quantum computing that could teach how, um, robotics to make real-world decisions better.

source_text: Please welcome David.
zh: 让我们欢迎 David。
en: Please welcome David.

source_text: Okay, thank you.
zh: 好的，谢谢。
en: Okay, thank you.

source_text: All right, um, I guess everybody has already had a very nice break.
zh: 好了，想必大家刚才都休息得不错。
en: All right, um, I guess everybody has already had a very nice break.

source_text: And first of all, thank you very much,
zh: 首先，非常感谢大家。
en: And first of all, thank you very much,

source_text: and good afternoon, everyone.
zh: 大家下午好。
en: and good afternoon, everyone.

source_text: We are Quant Sparkle, and, uh, I am David from Quant Sparkle.
zh: 我们是 Quant Sparkle，我是来自 Quant Sparkle 的 David。
en: We are Quant Sparkle, and, uh, I am David from Quant Sparkle.

source_text: I'm the CTO of this company.
zh: 我是这家公司的首席技术官。
en: I'm the CTO of this company.

source_text: So what we are doing right now, uh, is quite an interesting topic.
zh: 我们目前正在做的事情，是一个相当有意思的课题。
en: So what we are doing right now, uh, is quite an interesting topic.

source_text: We are trying to leverage quantum computing to solve physical AI problems, more specifically, we are leveraging quantum computing in order to better train physical AI models so this.
zh: 我们正尝试利用量子计算解决物理人工智能领域的问题。更具体地说，我们希望借助量子计算，更好地训练物理人工智能模型。
en: We are trying to leverage quantum computing to solve physical AI problems, more specifically, we are leveraging quantum computing in order to better train physical AI models so this.

source_text: Is, uh, our team,
zh: 这是我们的团队。
en: Is, uh, our team,

source_text: and we do a very brief introduction of ourselves.
zh: 接下来，我们简单介绍一下自己。
en: and we do a very brief introduction of ourselves.

source_text: Uh, Cynthia also, uh, under, under the stage,
zh: Cynthia 也在台下。
en: Uh, Cynthia also, uh, under, under the stage,

source_text: and she's our CEO.
zh: 她是我们的首席执行官。
en: and she's our CEO.

source_text: Um, me, myself, uh, I am the CTO, and this is the second one.
zh: 我本人是首席技术官，这是我第二次创业。
en: Um, me, myself, uh, I am the CTO, and this is the second one.

source_text: So, um, I have been, like, uh, uh, doing my master's in Carnegie Mellon University and also my PhD in Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.
zh: 我在卡内基梅隆大学读硕士，之后在香港科技大学读博士。
en: So, um, I have been, like, uh, uh, doing my master's in Carnegie Mellon University and also my PhD in Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

source_text: Um, I have been also working with NASA as well before.
zh: 我之前也曾与美国国家航空航天局，也就是 NASA，合作过。
en: Um, I have been also working with NASA as well before.

source_text: So right now I go to this very interesting field to do quantum computing, and, uh,
zh: 现在，我投身于量子计算这个非常有意思的领域，然后……
en: So right now I go to this very interesting field to do quantum computing, and, uh,

source_text: across, uh, physical AI.
zh: 以及物理人工智能领域。
en: across, uh, physical AI.

source_text: We also have a, um,
zh: 我们还有一位，嗯……
en: We also have a, um,

source_text: quantum expert, uh, Qi Gao,
zh: 量子计算专家高琦。
en: quantum expert, uh, Qi Gao,

source_text: uh, to be our, uh,
zh: 来担任我们的……
en: uh, to be our, uh,

source_text: uh, uh, to serve our, uh, um, technology in, uh, quantum computing.
zh: 为我们提供量子计算方面的技术支持。
en: uh, uh, to serve our, uh, um, technology in, uh, quantum computing.

source_text: So in order to.
zh: 所以，为了……
en: So in order to.

source_text: Go into the AGI area, there are three different variables we are going to change simultaneously.
zh: 要迈向通用人工智能，我们需要同时改变三个不同的变量。
en: Go into the AGI area, there are three different variables we are going to change simultaneously.

source_text: The first one, uh, is algorithm or models.
zh: 第一个是算法或模型。
en: The first one, uh, is algorithm or models.

source_text: The second one is data, and the third one is how we do the computation.
zh: 第二个是数据，第三个是计算方式。
en: The second one is data, and the third one is how we do the computation.

source_text: I would like to present to you what are the problems and challenges right now in physical AI.
zh: 我想向大家介绍一下实体人工智能目前面临的问题和挑战。
en: I would like to present to you what are the problems and challenges right now in physical AI.

source_text: From the data side, we, we know the data is especially data collected by, uh, real person, real robots.
zh: 从数据层面来看，我们知道，尤其是由真人和实体机器人采集的数据……
en: From the data side, we, we know the data is especially data collected by, uh, real person, real robots.

source_text: Those data are expensive.
zh: 这些数据的获取成本很高。
en: Those data are expensive.

source_text: And secondly, um, those data, they have, uh, a lot of bias as well as noise.
zh: 其次，这些数据还存在大量偏差和噪声。
en: And secondly, um, those data, they have, uh, a lot of bias as well as noise.

source_text: We can also use simulation to accumulate such kind of data.
zh: 我们也可以通过仿真来积累这类数据。
en: We can also use simulation to accumulate such kind of data.

source_text: However, we all know that there are seem to real gaps.
zh: 但我们都知道，仿真与现实之间存在差距。
en: However, we all know that there are seem to real gaps.

source_text: And it is, uh, it is useful to, like, mention what is the mathematical principle of seem to real gap.
zh: 这里值得一提的是，仿真与现实之间的差距，其背后的数学原理是什么。
en: And it is, uh, it is useful to, like, mention what is the mathematical principle of seem to real gap.

source_text: It's basically the,
zh: 它本质上是……
en: It's basically the,

source_text: uh, state transition distribution between the simulator world and our real physical world, uh, are different.
zh: 仿真环境和现实物理世界的状态转移分布是不同的。
en: uh, state transition distribution between the simulator world and our real physical world, uh, are different.

source_text: So this is very important to know because we would use this, uh, later on.

zh: 有可能会将机器人获取新能力的成本从大团队开发数个月去逐渐推动到一个人去用两周内去交付。
en: We may be able to bring the cost of giving a robot a new capability down from months of work by a large team to a deployment delivered by one person in under two weeks.

source_text: 就像我们就今天出现的AI coding一样，普通人没有经受过专业的计算机训练，
zh: 就像我们就今天出现的AI coding一样，普通人没有经受过专业的计算机训练，
en: Just like with AI coding today, even people without formal computer science training...

source_text: 但是却可以一个人去完成过去可能整个二三十个开发团队才能够做到的事情。
zh: 但是却可以一个人去完成过去可能整个二三十个开发团队才能够做到的事情。
en: …can now do on their own what used to take an entire development team of twenty or thirty people.

source_text: 那我们希望具身智能在，我觉得可能会在未来半年或者一年内，我们能够做到由一个算法工程师，或者甚至是一个受训过的蓝领工人，
zh: 那我们希望具身智能在，我觉得可能会在未来半年或者一年内，我们能够做到由一个算法工程师，或者甚至是一个受训过的蓝领工人，
en: We hope that within the next six months to a year, embodied AI will reach a point where a single algorithm engineer—or even a trained blue-collar worker—can...

source_text: 我们可以叫它FDE或者 anyway，就在两周内完成一个工位的交付。
zh: 我们可以叫它FDE或者 anyway，就在两周内完成一个工位的交付。
en: We might call that person an FDE, or whatever—but they could deploy a robot at a workstation within two weeks.

source_text: 那在这种情况下，就意味着具身智能可以打开规模化 to be 的一个新的里程碑，可以做更多的商业化场景的尝试。
zh: 那在这种情况下，就意味着具身智能可以打开规模化 to be 的一个新的里程碑，可以做更多的商业化场景的尝试。
en: That would mark a new milestone on the path to scaling embodied AI and allow us to explore many more commercial applications.

source_text: 那再进一步的话，像刚刚提到的，可能我们在现在谈论的算法工程师或者蓝领工人，
zh: 那再进一步的话，像刚刚提到的，可能我们在现在谈论的算法工程师或者蓝领工人，
en: And taking that a step further, as I mentioned earlier, the algorithm engineer or blue-collar worker we’re talking about today...

source_text: 他其实做到的还是用我们常规的技术性的工具链，比如说数据采集、模型训练、
zh: 他其实做到的还是用我们常规的技术性的工具链，比如说数据采集、模型训练、
en: They would still be using our conventional technical toolchain, such as data collection and model training...

source_text: 测评，然后不断的闭环去让机器人赋予新的能力。
zh: 测评，然后不断的闭环去让机器人赋予新的能力。
en: …evaluation, and an iterative feedback loop to give the robot new capabilities.

source_text: 但如果这个能力真的已经降低到，呃，由普通人用一些普通人尝试性的操作，比如说语言、文本、图像，甚至是一些身体的姿态，
zh: 但如果这个能力真的已经降低到，呃，由普通人用一些普通人尝试性的操作，比如说语言、文本、图像，甚至是一些身体的姿态，
en: But if it becomes simple enough for ordinary people to use intuitive inputs—like speech, text, images, or even body movements—

source_text: 就像我们人教会一个小朋友做一件事情一样，去教会一个机器人获取一个新的能力，那就意味着我们进入了具身智能 to C 的时代。
zh: 就像我们人教会一个小朋友做一件事情一样，去教会一个机器人获取一个新的能力，那就意味着我们进入了具身智能 to C 的时代。
en: Just as we teach a child to do something, people could teach a robot a new skill. That would mean we’ve entered the era of consumer-facing embodied AI.

source_text: 所以我们会，会，大家会看到有非常多的讨论关于 to be 和 to C，但至少在我看来，其实有一个非常重要的脉络，
zh: 所以我们会，会，大家会看到有非常多的讨论关于 to be 和 to C，但至少在我看来，其实有一个非常重要的脉络，
en: So you’ll hear a lot of discussion about B2B and B2C. But to me, there’s a very important progression here.

source_text: 就是我们需要不断的去压低具身智能获取新任务的难度。
zh: 就是我们需要不断的去压低具身智能获取新任务的难度。
en: We need to keep making it easier for embodied AI to learn new tasks.

source_text: 我们推动整个具身智能系数向，就是这个轴线的右边不断去推进，就会使得我们能够打开更多的场景，创造更多的商业价值。
zh: 我们推动整个具身智能系数向，就是这个轴线的右边不断去推进，就会使得我们能够打开更多的场景，创造更多的商业价值。
en: As we keep moving embodied AI further along this spectrum—making it easier to learn new tasks—we’ll unlock more applications and create greater commercial value.

source_text: 所以我今天可能想要分享的呢，也是，呃，我们在实践中怎么样去真的去降低新任务获取的难度。
zh: 所以我今天可能想要分享的呢，也是，呃，我们在实践中怎么样去真的去降低新任务获取的难度。
en: So today, I’d like to share what we’ve learned in practice about making it easier for robots to learn new tasks.

source_text: 这是一项非常复杂系统工程，当然它可能也包括了硬件，包括了部署，呃，但是可能我今天更多会聚焦到，
zh: 这是一项非常复杂系统工程，当然它可能也包括了硬件，包括了部署，呃，但是可能我今天更多会聚焦到，
en: This is a highly complex undertaking that involves hardware and deployment, among other things. But today, I’ll focus more on...

source_text: 呃，我自己的工作本身，就是可能围绕一些数据和模型相关的，包括说真实场景的数据采集、基座模型的训练、后训练相关的技术，
zh: 呃，我自己的工作本身，就是可能围绕一些数据和模型相关的，包括说真实场景的数据采集、基座模型的训练、后训练相关的技术，
en: My own work focuses mainly on data and models, including collecting data in real-world settings, training foundation models, and developing post-training techniques.

source_text: 以及一些，呃，可能最近比较火的一些 agentic system 去，去帮助整个 robotic system 能够去做一些自动化。
zh: 以及一些，呃，可能最近比较火的一些 agentic system 去，去帮助整个 robotic system 能够去做一些自动化。
en: And some of the agentic systems that have attracted a lot of attention recently, which can help automate parts of the overall robotics system.

source_text: 对，首先是数据，但刚刚谈到的，如果我们想要真的想要让具身智能的模型获取新任务更加简单，
zh: 对，首先是数据，但刚刚谈到的，如果我们想要真的想要让具身智能的模型获取新任务更加简单，
en: Right. First, there’s data. But as I mentioned, if we really want to make it easier for embodied AI models to learn new tasks,

source_text: 那就要求我们的基座模型一定要建过足够多人类真实生产生活中所遇到的场景、物体和任务。
zh: 那就要求我们的基座模型一定要建过足够多人类真实生产生活中所遇到的场景、物体和任务。
en: Our foundation models need to have been exposed to a wide enough range of the settings, objects, and tasks people encounter in everyday life and work.

source_text: 那穷车智能团队呢，其实是在2027年，
zh: 那穷车智能团队呢，其实是在2027年，
en: The Qiongche Intelligent team was actually founded in 2027,

source_text: 呃，当时穷车还没有成立，我们是国内最早去做大规模数据采集的团队之一，同时我们也在2023年率先发布了全球范围内率先发布了无本体的数据采集方案。
zh: 呃，当时穷车还没有成立，我们是国内最早去做大规模数据采集的团队之一，同时我们也在2023年率先发布了全球范围内率先发布了无本体的数据采集方案。
en: At the time, Qiongche hadn’t been founded yet. We were one of the first teams in China to collect data at scale, and in 2023, we were among the first worldwide to introduce a robot-agnostic data collection approach.

source_text: 同时我们在今年呢，也基于我们自己的无体、无本体的采集设备去做大规模的数据采集。
zh: 同时我们在今年呢，也基于我们自己的无体、无本体的采集设备去做大规模的数据采集。
en: And this year, we’ve been using our own robot-agnostic collection devices to gather data at scale.

source_text: 无本体采集最大的特点就在于，它不再将数采发生在比如说数采工厂或者一个单一的一个，一个车间里面。
zh: 无本体采集最大的特点就在于，它不再将数采发生在比如说数采工厂或者一个单一的一个，一个车间里面。
en: The key advantage of robot-agnostic data collection is that it no longer has to take place in a dedicated data-collection facility or a single workshop.

source_text: 这就意味着我们可以把数采工具带到非常多真实的生产场景里面，我们面对真实的物体、真实的场景去做真实的任务，
zh: 这就意味着我们可以把数采工具带到非常多真实的生产场景里面，我们面对真实的物体、真实的场景去做真实的任务，
en: That means we can bring our data-collection tools into a wide range of real-world workplaces and perform real tasks with real objects in real settings.

source_text: 采集到更多真实的经验，这才能帮助像前页描述的一样，当我们的机器人真的走到一个新的环境里面，呃，它面对这个新的环境，能够以更低的成本学会新的任务。
zh: 采集到更多真实的经验，这才能帮助像前页描述的一样，当我们的机器人真的走到一个新的环境里面，呃，它面对这个新的环境，能够以更低的成本学会新的任务。
en: This lets us collect more real-world experience. As the previous slide showed, that’s what helps a robot learn new tasks at lower cost when it enters an unfamiliar environment.

source_text: 然后也就是从今年开始吧，我们，呃，让数采这个过程走出了数采工厂，我们没有建设任何一座数采工厂，
zh: 然后也就是从今年开始吧，我们，呃，让数采这个过程走出了数采工厂，我们没有建设任何一座数采工厂，
en: Starting this year, we’ve moved data collection out of dedicated facilities. In fact, we haven’t built a single one.

source_text: 在全国现在是接近100个城市，峰值有超过1,000名数采员为我们服务。
zh: 在全国现在是接近100个城市，峰值有超过1,000名数采员为我们服务。
en: We now operate in nearly 100 cities across China, with more than 1,000 data collectors working with us at peak times.

source_text: 到截至今天为止，大概收集了，呃，超过30，接近30万小时的，呃，这个我们自己的数采方案的数据，当然同步我们也在采购，包括 EagleTrace 或者自然，自然视频的 data。
zh: 到截至今天为止，大概收集了，呃，超过30，接近30万小时的，呃，这个我们自己的数采方案的数据，当然同步我们也在采购，包括 EagleTrace 或者自然，自然视频的 data。
en: As of today, we’ve collected nearly 300,000 hours of data using our own collection system. At the same time, we’re also acquiring data from sources such as EagleTrace and natural videos.

source_text: 呃，当然这样的规模化的采集其实会带来困难的。
zh: 呃，当然这样的规模化的采集其实会带来困难的。
en: Of course, collecting data at this scale comes with challenges.

source_text: 如果说我们是在工厂里面采集，它最大的优势就在于整个采集的过程是非常容易管理的，因为在同一个房间里面，
zh: 如果说我们是在工厂里面采集，它最大的优势就在于整个采集的过程是非常容易管理的，因为在同一个房间里面，
en: If we were collecting data in a factory, the biggest advantage would be that the whole process is much easier to manage because everyone is in the same room.

source_text: 可能我们同时有100名数采员在对着一个虚假的桌子和一些虚假的物体做相同的操作，那其实非常容易去传达它，
zh: 可能我们同时有100名数采员在对着一个虚假的桌子和一些虚假的物体做相同的操作，那其实非常容易去传达它，
en: You might have a hundred data collectors at once performing the same actions at mock tables with mock objects. That makes it very easy to communicate the instructions.

source_text: 你今天应该采集什么样的任务，以及当它采集出现过程的，出现问题的过程中呢，你也能够第一时间的发现，第一时间的去指正。
zh: 你今天应该采集什么样的任务，以及当它采集出现过程的，出现问题的过程中呢，你也能够第一时间的发现，第一时间的去指正。
en: You can tell them what tasks to collect data for that day, and if anything goes wrong during collection, you can spot it and correct it right away.

source_text: 但当如果这个数据采集离开了这样固定的数采工位，进入到了真实的生产和工作场景，它的管理的困难就会极度的加大，
zh: 但当如果这个数据采集离开了这样固定的数采工位，进入到了真实的生产和工作场景，它的管理的困难就会极度的加大，
en: But once data collection moves beyond fixed stations into real production and work environments, it becomes much harder to manage.

source_text: 因为这些人他可能主观上会偷懒，或者客观上他不理解数据采集的过程，他可能没有办法把这个数据采集过程很好的做好。
zh: 因为这些人他可能主观上会偷懒，或者客观上他不理解数据采集的过程，他可能没有办法把这个数据采集过程很好的做好。
en: Some collectors may slack off, or they may simply not understand the process well enough to collect the data properly.

source_text: 然后另外一点，当这个数据变得足够多样，他使用的是一些在数采运营过程中难以预期到的物、物体、场景，呃，这样更多样的物体，
zh: 然后另外一点，当这个数据变得足够多样，他使用的是一些在数采运营过程中难以预期到的物、物体、场景，呃，这样更多样的物体，
en: Another challenge is that as the data becomes more diverse, collectors encounter objects and settings that are hard to anticipate when planning the data collection process.

source_text: 就会使得质检和标注的难度也急剧的上升。
zh: 就会使得质检和标注的难度也急剧的上升。
en: That also makes quality control and annotation much more difficult.

source_text: 因此想要去，呃，就当我们做了这种无本体的采集，获得了更多样的数据，我们就需要面对这样的困难，那破解这样的困难呢，就需要搭建更加稳健的整个 data infra 的 system。
zh: 因此想要去，呃，就当我们做了这种无本体的采集，获得了更多样的数据，我们就需要面对这样的困难，那破解这样的困难呢，就需要搭建更加稳健的整个 data infra 的 system。
en: So when we use this kind of collection without a physical robot and obtain more diverse data, we have to deal with these challenges. Overcoming them requires a more robust data infrastructure system.

source_text: 呃，当然我觉得整个数据管线其实在 AI 领域是一个非常常见的东西，
zh: 呃，当然我觉得整个数据管线其实在 AI 领域是一个非常常见的东西，
en: Of course, I think data pipelines are very common in AI.

source_text: 包括说，呃，更常规的 AI，以及说自动驾驶领域，大家都会需要有高效的数据管线来保证我们时刻有好的数据交付给训练的过程。
zh: 包括说，呃，更常规的 AI，以及说自动驾驶领域，大家都会需要有高效的数据管线来保证我们时刻有好的数据交付给训练的过程。
en: That’s true of conventional AI and autonomous driving as well: both need efficient data pipelines to ensure a steady supply of high-quality data for training.

source_text: 但其实对于具身来讲，刚刚提到的两点困难，它就会带来一些新的挑战，比如说我们其实需要让这个数据，它不只是能够交付给训练，
zh: 但其实对于具身来讲，刚刚提到的两点困难，它就会带来一些新的挑战，比如说我们其实需要让这个数据，它不只是能够交付给训练，
en: But for embodied AI, the two difficulties I just mentioned create new challenges. For example, the data can’t just be delivered for training.

source_text: 还需要在几乎在 T+0 的时间范围内，给一线的数采、数采的团队第一时间的反馈，
zh: 还需要在几乎在 T+0 的时间范围内，给一线的数采、数采的团队第一时间的反馈，
en: We also need to give frontline data collection teams immediate feedback, almost in real time.

source_text: 告诉它最新采集到的一个 batch 的 data 是好的还是坏的。
zh: 告诉它最新采集到的一个 batch 的 data 是好的还是坏的。
en: We need to tell them right away whether the latest batch of collected data is good or bad.

source_text: 然后同时呢，因为整个数据它在，呃，不只是刚刚提到的这种质量的反馈，也包括面向训练的数据的质检和标注，也都会变得更加复杂，
zh: 然后同时呢，因为整个数据它在，呃，不只是刚刚提到的这种质量的反馈，也包括面向训练的数据的质检和标注，也都会变得更加复杂，
en: At the same time, it’s not just the quality feedback I mentioned earlier that gets harder. Quality control and annotation of the data used for training also become more complex.

source_text: 所以我们也会需要有更多 AI native 的 data infra，我们会让更多的 AI 技术去帮助我们完成质检、标注等等的流程。
zh: 所以我们也会需要有更多 AI native 的 data infra，我们会让更多的 AI 技术去帮助我们完成质检、标注等等的流程。
en: So we need more AI-native data infrastructure, using AI to help with quality control, annotation, and other parts of the pipeline.

source_text: 至少在穷车今天的实践里面，我们已经完全放弃了，呃，生产级别的人工的质检、标注和，呃，就是你能想到的各种对数据处理的工作。
zh: 至少在穷车今天的实践里面，我们已经完全放弃了，呃，生产级别的人工的质检、标注和，呃，就是你能想到的各种对数据处理的工作。
en: At least in our work at Qiongche today, we’ve completely moved away from manual quality checks, annotation, and pretty much every other kind of production-level data processing you can think of.

source_text: 我们认为这个其实在，呃，至少在具身这样的，这样的场景里面是不具备人类标注员实践的价值的。
zh: 我们认为这个其实在，呃，至少在具身这样的，这样的场景里面是不具备人类标注员实践的价值的。
en: We don’t think it’s practical to rely on human annotators for this, at least in embodied AI settings.

source_text: 对，然后有了这个模型呢，我有了这些数据呢，我们训练了自己的基座模型，
zh: 对，然后有了这个模型呢，我有了这些数据呢，我们训练了自己的基座模型，
en: Right. With that data, we trained our own foundation model.

source_text: 当然今天时间的问题，可能只能非常简单的介绍，就是告诉大家我们是一个世界模型的架构，我们输入的是图像和，呃，一些，
zh: 当然今天时间的问题，可能只能非常简单的介绍，就是告诉大家我们是一个世界模型的架构，我们输入的是图像和，呃，一些，
en: Given the time, I can only give a very brief overview. We use a world-model architecture, and the inputs are images and, uh, some…

source_text: 呃， language 的 prompt 去给这个机器人做一些指令，然后输出是一些对未来 window 的预测，
zh: 呃， language 的 prompt 去给这个机器人做一些指令，然后输出是一些对未来 window 的预测，
en: We use language prompts to give the robot instructions, and the model outputs predictions for a future time window.

source_text: 以及 action 的预测。
zh: 以及 action 的预测。
en: As well as predictions of the actions it will take.

source_text: 当然为什么选择世界模型，其实也非常简单，就是当我们拥有了更加丰富的数据，能够更好的建模这个人类物理世界的时候呢，
zh: 当然为什么选择世界模型，其实也非常简单，就是当我们拥有了更加丰富的数据，能够更好的建模这个人类物理世界的时候呢，
en: Why did we choose a world model? The reason is simple: with richer data, we can better model the physical world humans live in.

source_text: 世界模型能够更好的吸收这些数据，
zh: 世界模型能够更好的吸收这些数据，
en: A world model can make better use of this data.

source_text: 然后来进一步帮助这个模型在真的建到 novel 的物理世界的时候，它能够知道怎么去面对这个物理世界。
zh: 然后来进一步帮助这个模型在真的建到 novel 的物理世界的时候，它能够知道怎么去面对这个物理世界。
en: That, in turn, helps the model navigate unfamiliar physical environments when it encounters them in the real world.

source_text: 那，呃，当然其实我们之前只是发布了一个我们自己模型的 preview，然后未来其实在下个月我们会发布一个更详尽的技术报告，
zh: 那，呃，当然其实我们之前只是发布了一个我们自己模型的 preview，然后未来其实在下个月我们会发布一个更详尽的技术报告，
en: So far, we’ve only released a preview of our model. Next month, we’ll publish a more detailed technical report.

source_text: the senior principal AI application engineer from 1Password, to talk about a very, very important area, which is AI security. Please welcome Grace.

source_text: Thank you.

source_text: Today my talk shows a common problem that we have to tackle in AI security, which is the answer: should this agent be allowed to do that?
zh: 今天，我想谈谈 AI 安全中一个我们必须解决的常见问题：这个智能体是否应该被允许执行这项操作？
en: Today my talk shows a common problem that we have to tackle in AI security, which is the answer: should this agent be allowed to do that?

source_text: So let me start with an example.
zh: 我先举个例子。
en: So let me start with an example.

source_text: Um, suppose you're an engineer, oh,
zh: 嗯，假设你是一名工程师，呃，
en: Um, suppose you're an engineer, oh,

source_text: okay.
zh: 好的。
en: okay.

source_text: Okay, suppose you're an engineer debugging an, uh, production issue.
zh: 好，假设你是一名工程师，正在排查一个生产环境中的问题。
en: Okay, suppose you're an engineer debugging an, uh, production issue.

source_text: So you go to your coding agent and you say, "The checkout service is failing since the last deploy. Find out why.
zh: 于是，你找到编程智能体，对它说：“上次部署后，结账服务一直出故障。查查是什么原因。
en: So you go to your coding agent and you say, "The checkout service is failing since the last deploy. Find out why.

source_text: " Your agent starts to propose tool calls.
zh: ”你的智能体开始提出要调用哪些工具。
en: " Your agent starts to propose tool calls.

source_text: The first one that it does is an AWS log filter against your production account.
zh: 它首先会在你的生产环境 AWS 账户中筛选日志。
en: The first one that it does is an AWS log filter against your production account.

source_text: So it's read-only,
zh: 所以它只有读取权限，
en: So it's read-only,

source_text: and it gets the grant and the tool call executes.
zh: 于是它获得授权，工具调用也随之执行。
en: and it gets the grant and the tool call executes.

source_text: Then the agent looks at the log.
zh: 接着，智能体查看日志。
en: Then the agent looks at the log.

source_text: Well, based on the logs,
zh: 嗯，根据日志来看，
en: Well, based on the logs,

source_text: it was underscaled.
zh: 服务扩容不足。
en: it was underscaled.

source_text: So then it starts proposing the next tool call, which is to update the service.
zh: 于是，它开始提出下一步工具调用：更新服务。
en: So then it starts proposing the next tool call, which is to update the service.

source_text: Well,
zh: 嗯，
en: Well,

source_text: is this command useful?
zh: 这条命令有用吗？
en: is this command useful?

source_text: Maybe. Is it safe?
zh: 可能有用。但安全吗？
en: Maybe. Is it safe?

source_text: That's not really clear.
zh: 这还真说不准。
en: That's not really clear.

source_text: So how do we determine agent intent?
zh: 那么，我们该如何判断智能体的意图？
en: So how do we determine agent intent?

source_text: And in order to figure out if your commands are safe, we need to know how to do that.
zh: 而要判断你的命令是否安全，我们得知道该怎么判断。
en: And in order to figure out if your commands are safe, we need to know how to do that.

source_text: Agents their intent becomes action through tool calls.
zh: 智能体通过调用工具将意图付诸行动。
en: Agents their intent becomes action through tool calls.

source_text: So in this case, the user's task is to investigate a failing task, and the proposed tool call ended up being a modification to the production account.
zh: 所以在这个例子中，用户的任务是调查一个失败的任务，但智能体提出的工具调用却是修改生产环境账户。
en: So in this case, the user's task is to investigate a failing task, and the proposed tool call ended up being a modification to the production account.

source_text: And so the reason, the agent's reason isn't necessarily trustworthy.
zh: 所以，智能体给出的理由未必可信。
en: And so the reason, the agent's reason isn't necessarily trustworthy.

source_text: So we need to be able to answer, uh, with high confidence whether the call fits the task.
zh: 所以，我们需要能够高度确信地判断，这次工具调用是否符合任务要求。
en: So we need to be able to answer, uh, with high confidence whether the call fits the task.

source_text: And if it doesn't, we need to stop the agent from executing that call.
zh: 如果不符合，我们就得阻止智能体执行这次工具调用。
en: And if it doesn't, we need to stop the agent from executing that call.

source_text: So how do we do that?
zh: 那么，我们该怎么做呢？
en: So how do we do that?

source_text: Well, we can implement a component that is a runtime intent judge that's able to take in context the agent's session prior to the tool call,
zh: 我们可以实现一个运行时意图判断组件，让它结合工具调用前智能体会话的上下文来判断。
en: Well, we can implement a component that is a runtime intent judge that's able to take in context the agent's session prior to the tool call,

source_text: including the tool call information itself, it needs to be able to execute with low latency at runtime,
zh: 包括工具调用本身的信息，而且它需要能在运行时以低延迟完成判断。
en: including the tool call information itself, it needs to be able to execute with low latency at runtime,

source_text: so that it doesn't add user friction because multiple tool calls can be executing all at once.
zh: 这样就不会增加用户操作的阻力，因为多个工具调用可能同时执行。
en: so that it doesn't add user friction because multiple tool calls can be executing all at once.

source_text: Then it ideally should run locally so that the context, including sensitive information, doesn't go off-post.
zh: 最好还能在本地运行，避免上下文中的敏感信息被传到外部。
en: Then it ideally should run locally so that the context, including sensitive information, doesn't go off-post.

source_text: Uh, well, what are some of the approaches?
zh: 呃，那么有哪些可行的方法呢？
en: Uh, well, what are some of the approaches?

source_text: Um, let me go over some of the common ones.
zh: 嗯，我来介绍几种常见的方法。
en: Um, let me go over some of the common ones.

source_text: Well,
zh: 嗯，
en: Well,

source_text: one, you can write deterministic rules, basically, for example, a regex that's able to grep, uh, what the command, what the tool call has and tries to classify what the tool call does.
zh: 第一种是编写确定性规则，比如用正则表达式匹配工具调用中的命令，尝试判断这次调用是做什么的。
en: one, you can write deterministic rules, basically, for example, a regex that's able to grep, uh, what the command, what the tool call has and tries to classify what the tool call does.

source_text: You can also try to use a hosted large language model, for example, a Kimi K3, or if you're in the US, you can use Claude or OpenAI models.
zh: 你也可以尝试使用托管的大语言模型，比如 Kimi K3；如果你在美国，也可以使用 Claude 或 OpenAI 的模型。
en: You can also try to use a hosted large language model, for example, a Kimi K3, or if you're in the US, you can use Claude or OpenAI models.

source_text: These will be able to provide deeper reasoning over large amounts of context but your context will still leave the host.
zh: 这些模型能够结合大量上下文进行更深入的推理，但你的上下文信息仍会被发送到托管服务商。
en: These will be able to provide deeper reasoning over large amounts of context but your context will still leave the host.

source_text: They'll be slower and costlier.
zh: 它们的速度会更慢，成本也更高。
en: They'll be slower and costlier.

source_text: Third,
zh: 第三种，
en: Third,

source_text: you can also do custom trained classifiers, such as an XGBoost model.
zh: 你也可以使用专门训练的分类器，比如 XGBoost 模型。
en: you can also do custom trained classifiers, such as an XGBoost model.

source_text: However, these will re-require labeling lots of data, which most teams don't have, and every time your tool call data, uh,
zh: 不过，这需要给大量数据打标签，而大多数团队都没有这些数据；而且每当工具调用数据，呃，
en: However, these will re-require labeling lots of data, which most teams don't have, and every time your tool call data, uh,

source_text: changes, you'll have to retrain.
zh: 发生变化，你就得重新训练模型。
en: changes, you'll have to retrain.

source_text: So here, I focus on a slightly different set of models, which is two smaller models.
zh: 所以，这里我关注的是另一种方案：使用两个较小的模型。
en: So here, I focus on a slightly different set of models, which is two smaller models.

source_text: One is a generative small language model, um, and I compare that model with a set of open-source decision models to see how well they can perform in solving this specific problem.
zh: 一个是生成式小语言模型。嗯，我会将它与一组开源决策模型进行比较，看看它们在解决这个特定问题时表现如何。
en: One is a generative small language model, um, and I compare that model with a set of open-source decision models to see how well they can perform in solving this specific problem.

source_text: Uh, here's.
zh: 呃，这里是……
en: Uh, here's.

source_text: Experiment setup.
zh: 实验设置。
en: Experiment setup.

source_text: Um, I created synthetic I created synthetic tool calls that are basically command-line tools, and each of the models that I mentioned were prompted with the same prompt, which includes the context the task and the agent read, uh, reason.
zh: 嗯，我生成了一些模拟的工具调用，基本上都是命令行工具。前面提到的每个模型都使用相同的提示词，其中包含任务背景，以及智能体的读取和推理过程。
en: Um, I created synthetic I created synthetic tool calls that are basically command-line tools, and each of the models that I mentioned were prompted with the same prompt, which includes the context the task and the agent read, uh, reason.

source_text: As well as a set of questions that probes whether the tool call is safe, whether what kind of operation it could be.
zh: 以及一组用于判断工具调用是否安全、属于哪种操作类型的问题。
en: As well as a set of questions that probes whether the tool call is safe, whether what kind of operation it could be.

source_text: And we ask the models to be able to output a access-level classification on these tool calls.
zh: 我们要求这些模型对这些工具调用输出访问权限级别分类。
en: And we ask the models to be able to output a access-level classification on these tool calls.

source_text: This access level then is a plot, uh,
zh: 然后把这些访问权限级别绘制成图，呃……
en: This access level then is a plot, uh,

source_text: a we apply policy on top of these access levels.
zh: 我们再根据这些访问权限级别应用相应的策略。
en: a we apply policy on top of these access levels.

source_text: So each of these access levels indicate low risk or high risk from read all the way to admin.
zh: 因此，从只读到管理员权限，这些访问级别分别对应着由低到高的风险。
en: So each of these access levels indicate low risk or high risk from read all the way to admin.

source_text: Let's look at the results.
zh: 我们来看一下结果。
en: Let's look at the results.

source_text: Here in the green bars, we see is the result for the model when it's asked to pick an exact label.
zh: 这里的绿色柱状条显示的是模型被要求选择一个准确标签时的结果。
en: Here in the green bars, we see is the result for the model when it's asked to pick an exact label.

source_text: You can see that for the decision models, which in which I compare GEV, uh, CLEF, D1, um, as well as LEA, a much smaller 4, 400 million, uh, parameter model.
zh: 可以看到，在这些决策模型中，我比较了 GEV、CLEF、D1，以及参数量小得多、只有 4 亿参数的 LEA 模型。
en: You can see that for the decision models, which in which I compare GEV, uh, CLEF, D1, um, as well as LEA, a much smaller 4, 400 million, uh, parameter model.

source_text: Ex with the exception of LEA, the other decision models actually perform pretty similarly.
zh: 除了 LEA，其他决策模型的表现其实都差不多。
en: Ex with the exception of LEA, the other decision models actually perform pretty similarly.

source_text: Between 91% to 93% accuracy.
zh: 准确率在 91% 到 93% 之间。
en: Between 91% to 93% accuracy.

source_text: However, there was a key difference.
zh: 不过，其中有一个关键区别。
en: However, there was a key difference.

source_text: Some models are a little bit more cautious, so when the prediction was low in confidence, it would defer and pick unknown when it had the ch- the chance to do so.
zh: 有些模型会更谨慎一些：当预测的置信度较低时，如果可以选择“未知”，它们就会暂缓判断，选“未知”。
en: Some models are a little bit more cautious, so when the prediction was low in confidence, it would defer and pick unknown when it had the ch- the chance to do so.

source_text: And you can see that liquid D1 actually did this about 50% of the time.
zh: 可以看到，Liquid D1 大约有 50% 的时候会这样做。
en: And you can see that liquid D1 actually did this about 50% of the time.

source_text: And so the decision model that you choose matters, and the probabilities that you get are not apples to apples.
zh: 所以，选择哪种决策模型很重要；不同模型给出的概率也不能直接拿来比较。
en: And so the decision model that you choose matters, and the probabilities that you get are not apples to apples.

source_text: So we need to be careful not to compare them exactly.
zh: 所以，我们要注意，不能直接把它们作精确比较。
en: So we need to be careful not to compare them exactly.

source_text: Uh, then the SLM, the Qwen 2.7, 7 billion parameter,
zh: 接下来是小语言模型 Qwen 2.5，参数量为 70 亿。
en: Uh, then the SLM, the Qwen 2.7, 7 billion parameter,

source_text: only was had a 72%, significantly lower accuracy.
zh: 它的准确率只有 72%，明显更低。
en: only was had a 72%, significantly lower accuracy.

source_text: And so again, I think this result enforces that the decision model is a better solution.
zh: 所以，我认为这个结果再次表明，使用决策模型是更好的方案。
en: And so again, I think this result enforces that the decision model is a better solution.

source_text: Let's.
zh: 我们……
en: Let's.

source_text: Look at some failure modes in the classification, which is also really important in how we treat them.
zh: 我们来看看分类中的一些失效情况，这对我们如何处理它们也很重要。
en: Look at some failure modes in the classification, which is also really important in how we treat them.

source_text: So some errors are riskier than others to let through.
zh: 有些错误一旦漏检，风险会比其他错误更高。
en: So some errors are riskier than others to let through.

source_text: And here's an example,
zh: 这里有一个例子。
en: And here's an example,

source_text: uh, where there's a nuance in the command that's being executed.
zh: 呃，这里执行的命令有一个细微差别。
en: uh, where there's a nuance in the command that's being executed.

source_text: Uh, suppose.
zh: 呃，假设……
en: Uh, suppose.

source_text: The agent is trying to solve the task where AWS GuardDuty, which is the threat detection model on your production service,
zh: 智能体正在处理这样一项任务：AWS GuardDuty 是用于生产服务的威胁检测系统，
en: The agent is trying to solve the task where AWS GuardDuty, which is the threat detection model on your production service,

source_text: um, is causing lots of issues in the migration traffic,
zh: 嗯，它给迁移流量造成了很多问题，
en: um, is causing lots of issues in the migration traffic,

source_text: but the pro-proposed tool call tries to delete this detector.
zh: 但拟议中的工具调用却试图删除这个检测器。
en: but the pro-proposed tool call tries to delete this detector.

source_text: So it looks like this tool call can be classified as delete, or it can be classified as admin, which is actually turning off a useful service on your production account.
zh: 所以，这个工具调用既可以归类为“删除”操作，也可以归类为“管理”操作；但实际上，它是在关闭生产账号上一项有用的服务。
en: So it looks like this tool call can be classified as delete, or it can be classified as admin, which is actually turning off a useful service on your production account.

source_text: And so when you look at the different decision models and how they classify this, there's actually a key difference.
zh: 所以，当你查看不同的决策模型如何对这项操作分类时，就会发现一个关键区别。
en: And so when you look at the different decision models and how they classify this, there's actually a key difference.

source_text: Some models could classify this as delete, which is not exactly the right classification with low confidence.
zh: 有些模型可能会以较低的置信度将其归类为“删除”，但这并不完全准确。
en: Some models could classify this as delete, which is not exactly the right classification with low confidence.

source_text: So how do we handle these cases?
zh: 那么，我们该如何处理这些情况呢？
en: So how do we handle these cases?

source_text: Well,
zh: 嗯，
en: Well,

source_text: we can actually choose a threshold for which we cut off the decision and say, if it's below a specific confidence level, we should defer that, uh, decision to a person for review.
zh: 我们可以设定一个置信度阈值：如果模型的置信度低于这个阈值，就把这项判断交由人工审核。
en: we can actually choose a threshold for which we cut off the decision and say, if it's below a specific confidence level, we should defer that, uh, decision to a person for review.

source_text: And so we also need to be careful not to choose a single threshold across all models because sometimes, uh, that threshold can be too high for one, and you end up deferring,
zh: 因此，我们也要注意，不能对所有模型都采用同一个阈值，因为这个阈值对某些模型来说可能过高，结果就会把太多判断交给人工审核，
en: And so we also need to be careful not to choose a single threshold across all models because sometimes, uh, that threshold can be too high for one, and you end up deferring,

source_text: deferring way too many calls to, to people, making that model unuseful.
zh: 这样会把太多调用交给人工审核，导致模型失去实用价值。
en: deferring way too many calls to, to people, making that model unuseful.

source_text: So.
zh: 所以。
en: So.

source_text: Let me put this together in a reference production architecture and how we can implement an intent judge.
zh: 接下来，我会把这些内容整合成一个可供参考的生产环境架构，并说明如何实现意图判定器。
en: Let me put this together in a reference production architecture and how we can implement an intent judge.

source_text: Um,
zh: 嗯，
en: Um,

source_text: a user initiates a session with their AI agent, typically, say, uh, Claude or Codex or your favorite coding tool,
zh: 用户通常会通过 Claude、Codex 或自己常用的编程工具，与 AI 智能体开始一次会话。
en: a user initiates a session with their AI agent, typically, say, uh, Claude or Codex or your favorite coding tool,

source_text: uh, it submit the user submits a task, and the task starts to propose tool calls.
zh: 用户提交一项任务后，智能体就开始提出工具调用请求。
en: uh, it submit the user submits a task, and the task starts to propose tool calls.

source_text: The tool calls can be intercepted by a gateway implemented as an MCP server.
zh: 这些工具调用可以由一个以 MCP 服务器形式实现的网关拦截。
en: The tool calls can be intercepted by a gateway implemented as an MCP server.

source_text: This gateway is you can think of this gateway as a approval or an access gateway.
zh: 你可以把这个网关理解为审批网关或访问控制网关。
en: This gateway is you can think of this gateway as a approval or an access gateway.

source_text: It forwards the, the context that the and the evidence, including the call, task, and reason, to an intent judge.
zh: 它会将相关上下文和证据，包括工具调用、任务及调用原因，转发给意图判定器。
en: It forwards the, the context that the and the evidence, including the call, task, and reason, to an intent judge.

source_text: The intent judge is essentially a harness that wraps around a decision model and the and the prompts and the questions and the choices and outputs the classification result.
zh: 意图判定器本质上是一套封装框架：它将决策模型、提示词、问题和选项整合起来，输出分类结果。
en: The intent judge is essentially a harness that wraps around a decision model and the and the prompts and the questions and the choices and outputs the classification result.

source_text: Then it can invoke a policy gate component, which can hold, for example, an enterprise or a company's, uh, specific policies or rules,
zh: 然后，它可以调用策略关卡组件，其中可以配置企业或公司的具体政策和规则。
en: Then it can invoke a policy gate component, which can hold, for example, an enterprise or a company's, uh, specific policies or rules,

source_text: and be able to retrieve the current grant authorization that the user has to make a decision to either approve, deny, or escalate the tool call, returning that response to the AI agent.
zh: 它还可以查询用户当前获得的授权，据此决定批准、拒绝工具调用，或将其上报处理，并将决定返回给 AI 智能体。
en: and be able to retrieve the current grant authorization that the user has to make a decision to either approve, deny, or escalate the tool call, returning that response to the AI agent.

source_text: So here I want to.
zh: 所以这里我想……
en: So here I want to.

source_text: Show a demo that illustrates an implementation of this and how it works.
zh: 演示一下这一方案的具体实现及其工作方式。
en: Show a demo that illustrates an implementation of this and how it works.

source_text: On the on the left-hand side is your agent session, and on your right-hand side.
zh: 左侧是智能体会话，右侧则是……
en: On the on the left-hand side is your agent session, and on your right-hand side.

source_text: Is your access gateway response.
zh: 是访问网关返回的响应。
en: Is your access gateway response.

source_text: So you can see the agent session initiates the first task, and you the user right now has a grant that's up to read,
zh: 可以看到，智能体会话发起了第一个任务，而你作为用户，目前获得的授权仅限于读取权限。
en: So you can see the agent session initiates the first task, and you the user right now has a grant that's up to read,

source_text: and that's something that we can set custom.
zh: 这一点我们可以自定义设置。
en: and that's something that we can set custom.

source_text: Then the agent proposes a read tool call, which is permitted, and that response is returned to the agent, and the agent beg- begins execution.
zh: 随后，智能体提议调用读取工具。由于该操作获得许可，网关便将批准结果返回给智能体，智能体随即开始执行。
en: Then the agent proposes a read tool call, which is permitted, and that response is returned to the agent, and the agent beg- begins execution.

source_text: Next, you have a denied response request.
zh: 接下来是一个被拒绝的请求。
en: Next, you have a denied response request.

source_text: When a new tool call is sent to the access gateway and the classification is an update, and that does not meet policy. And so this is an illustration of how this could work.
zh: 当新的工具调用发送到访问网关后，如果被归类为更新操作，而该操作又不符合策略要求，就会被拒绝。这就是这一机制如何运作的示例。
en: When a new tool call is sent to the access gateway and the classification is an update, and that does not meet policy. And so this is an illustration of how this could work.

source_text: Um, so let me summarize with some practices in production, lessons in production.
zh: 嗯，最后我来总结一下生产环境中的一些实践经验和教训。
en: Um, so let me summarize with some practices in production, lessons in production.

source_text: So first, we need to be able to test the whole system, uh, specifically against two important metrics.
zh: 首先，我们需要能够对整个系统进行测试，重点关注两项重要指标。
en: So first, we need to be able to test the whole system, uh, specifically against two important metrics.

source_text: The first one is how many risky calls are we letting through, uh, via the intent judge and via the whole the whole, uh, system.
zh: 第一个指标是：经过意图判定和整个系统后，有多少高风险调用被放行了。
en: The first one is how many risky calls are we letting through, uh, via the intent judge and via the whole the whole, uh, system.

source_text: And we want to minimize those.
zh: 我们希望尽可能减少这类情况。
en: And we want to minimize those.

source_text: How many safe calls are we letting through?
zh: 我们放行了多少安全的调用？
en: How many safe calls are we letting through?

source_text: We want to maximize those.
zh: 我们希望尽可能多地放行这类调用。
en: We want to maximize those.

source_text: And we also want to make sure that the evaluation input data, uh, for the intent judge includes ex-examples of both.
zh: 我们还要确保意图判定器的评估数据中同时包含这两类调用的示例。
en: And we also want to make sure that the evaluation input data, uh, for the intent judge includes ex-examples of both.

source_text: And the second aspect is tuning the intent judge.
zh: 第二个方面是调优意图判定器。
en: And the second aspect is tuning the intent judge.

source_text: So it's very rare that the first time when you configure a decision agent, uh, using a decision model, you have the right context or the right question input.
zh: 所以，第一次用决策模型配置决策智能体时，就能提供恰当的上下文或提出恰当的问题，这种情况非常少见。
en: So it's very rare that the first time when you configure a decision agent, uh, using a decision model, you have the right context or the right question input.

source_text: Um, we need to be able to examine all of the errors and fix that input, make sure that every all the information is in there and there's no nothing missing.
zh: 我们需要检查所有错误，并修正输入，确保所需信息都已包含，没有遗漏。
en: Um, we need to be able to examine all of the errors and fix that input, make sure that every all the information is in there and there's no nothing missing.

source_text: Then we also look need to look at our, uh, evalu-evaluation data, uh, and make sure that the labeling on all of the samples are unambiguous, and that if you have reviewers creating that dataset,
zh: 然后，我们还需要检查评估数据，确保所有样本的标注都清晰明确；如果这份数据集是由审核人员创建的，还要确保……
en: Then we also look need to look at our, uh, evalu-evaluation data, uh, and make sure that the labeling on all of the samples are unambiguous, and that if you have reviewers creating that dataset,

source_text: the reviewers agree on those labels because human expert judgment is very important in being able to validate how good the performance of your intent judge is.
zh: 审核人员要对这些标注达成一致，因为人类专家的判断对于验证意图判定器的性能至关重要。
en: the reviewers agree on those labels because human expert judgment is very important in being able to validate how good the performance of your intent judge is.

source_text: Third, as we've looked at before, how you choose those thres-thresholds really matter,
zh: 第三，正如我们之前看到的，阈值的选择非常重要。
en: Third, as we've looked at before, how you choose those thres-thresholds really matter,

source_text: and they need to be calibrated on your validation data.
zh: 而且这些阈值需要根据验证数据进行校准。
en: and they need to be calibrated on your validation data.

source_text: And then finally,
zh: 最后，
en: And then finally,

source_text: consider fine-tuning last when there are still persistent errors.
zh: 如果仍有持续存在的错误，最后再考虑微调。
en: consider fine-tuning last when there are still persistent errors.

source_text: Okay.
zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

source_text: In conclusion, should this agent be allowed to do that?
zh: 总之，应该允许这个智能体这样做吗？
en: In conclusion, should this agent be allowed to do that?

source_text: Only if the call fits the task and your policy allows it.
zh: 只有当这次调用符合任务要求，且政策允许时，才可以。
en: Only if the call fits the task and your policy allows it.

source_text: So judge each tool call against the user's task,
zh: 所以，要根据用户的任务来判断每一次工具调用，
en: So judge each tool call against the user's task,

source_text: before it runs, use a decision model to judge intent,
zh: 在工具调用执行之前，先用决策模型判断其意图，
en: before it runs, use a decision model to judge intent,

source_text: which model you choose matters, and when the model's unsure, uh, send and escalate to a human approver.
zh: 选择哪种模型很重要；如果模型拿不准，就提交给人工审批。
en: which model you choose matters, and when the model's unsure, uh, send and escalate to a human approver.

source_text: All right?
zh: 明白了吗？
en: All right?

source_text: That's it. Thank you very much.
zh: 就这些。非常感谢。
en: That's it. Thank you very much.

source_text: Thank you, Grace.
zh: 谢谢你，格蕾丝。
en: Thank you, Grace.

source_text: Very, very important topic, for sure.
zh: 这确实是一个非常、非常重要的话题。
en: Very, very important topic, for sure.

en: Um, 下

en: Okay.

zh: 你好，有请丁浩来给我们讲，嗯，未来不远，呃，来自未来不远机器人的，呃，CTO丁浩给我们讲解从硬件到大脑。

zh: 哦，sorry，正好，拜拜。
en: Oh, sorry. Okay, bye-bye.

source_text: 没关系，没关系。

en: No worries, no worries.
